export {

/** URL of the WebAssembly module shipped next to the package entry point. */
export declare const wasmUrl: URL;

/**
 * Load and instantiate the WebAssembly module (idempotent). `source`

 * workers, read with node:fs in Node).
 */
export declare function init(source?: InitInput | Promise<InitInput>): Promise<void>;

/**
 * Instantiate synchronously from bytes or a compiled `WebAssembly.Module`
 * (idempotent). Without an argument it reads the `.wasm` next to the module
 * where the runtime offers synchronous file access.
 */
export declare function initSync(source?: SyncInitInput): void;

/** `fontpixel::bitmap::bytes::ByteLayout`: Packed wire layout, including X11's independent bit/byte order and scan units. Swapping happens when bit and byte significance differ. For example, LSB bits with little-endian bytes need bit reversal only. Inconsistent partial scan units (`scan_unit > row_alignment` when swapping) are rejected, as SPEC-v3 requires. Gray8 accepts only MSB/Big/scan_unit=1; row padding/order still apply. */
export interface ByteLayout {
    /** Significance within bytes. */
    bit_order?: BitOrder;
    /** Significance within scan units. */
    byte_order?: ByteOrder;
    /** Row padding in bytes: 1, 2, 4 or 8. */
    row_alignment?: number;
    /** Bytes per scan unit: 1, 2, 4 or 8. */
    scan_unit?: number;
    /** Top-down or bottom-up. */
    row_order?: RowOrder;
}

export type ByteOrder = "big" | "little";

    iigs_read_charset?: string | null;

    vfont_read_byte_order?: string | null;

    /** Explicit handling of fractional Palm density coordinates (default exact). */

    c_width?: number | null;
    /** Generic C cell height; requires `c_width`. */
    c_height?: number | null;
    /** First code in generic C arrays, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */

    /** Generic C baseline down from cell top (default height). */

    image_read_radix?: number | null;
    /** Input filename code domain (default legacy). */

    /** Input image background (default black). */

    /** Input glyph baseline measured down from each image's top. */

    /** HEX input/output rows (default 16); never inferred from record length. */

    /** HEX baseline-to-bottom distance (default 0). */
    hex_descent?: number | null;
    /** Explicit source FNT/FON legacy code page (does not remap byte positions). */

    /** Primary input byte budget (default 64 MiB). */

    /** Individual companion-file byte budget. */

    /** Aggregate resource and codec allocation budget (default 256 MiB). */
    max_total_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum companion reads and directory entries. */

    /** Explicit raster size for reviewed off-grid/curved outlines. */
    ppem?: number | null;
    /** Select a TTC/OTC face (zero based); otherwise read every face. */

    /** Rasterize outlines even when matching embedded images exist. */
    no_embedded_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit design units per pixel; requires --ppem. */
    grid_units?: number | null;
    /** Reviewed horizontal and vertical translations in pixel units. */

/** `fontpixel_ops::commands::CharsetResponse`: A written charset conversion. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::chiwriter::ChiwriterWriteOptions`: Native output choices. */

    stride?: number | null;
    /** Cell width; absent preserves the source or uses the widest glyph. */
    width?: number | null;
    /** Cell height; absent preserves the source or uses the tallest glyph. */

    /** Distance from the cell top to baseline. */

    /** V3 baseline-to-next-cell-top distance. */

    /** Latin-1 filename, at most thirteen bytes. */

    /** Permit numeric Unicode positions. */

    /** Explicit gray-to-mono threshold. */

    /** Shared ceilings. */

}

export type CodeMode = "auto" | "single_byte" | "double_byte";

/** `fontpixel::formats::hzk::CodeSpace`: Slot numbering independent of bitmap storage. */
export type CodeSpace = "gb2312" | "ascii";

/** `fontpixel::model::Codepoint`: A Unicode number or a code in the owning font's explicitly identified charset. Unicode-tagged raw source numbers, including surrogates and values above U+10FFFF, are retained for tolerant BDF/SPEC parity. Use `scalar()` to validate scalar interpretation; writers must report unsupported codes rather than drop them. */
export type CodepointDict = CodepointDictUnicode | CodepointDictLegacy;

/** `fontpixel::model::Codepoint::Legacy`: Charset-specific code; not implicitly interpreted as Unicode. */
export interface CodepointDictLegacy {
    /** Charset-specific code; not implicitly interpreted as Unicode. */
    Legacy: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::Codepoint::Unicode`: Number declared to use Unicode, possibly invalid in a malformed source. */
export interface CodepointDictUnicode {
    /** Number declared to use Unicode, possibly invalid in a malformed source. */
    Unicode: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::consoleet::CodepointMode`: Meaning of numeric hexadecimal filenames. */
export type CodepointMode = "legacy" | "unicode";

/** `fontpixel::merge::selection::CodepointRange`: Inclusive Unicode scalar range. */
export interface CodepointRange {
    /** First included scalar. */
    start: number;
    /** Last included scalar. */
    end: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::collection::Limits`: Collection-wide budgets, including repeated references and extracted faces. */
export interface CollectionLimits {
    /** Per-face common limits. */
    sfnt?: SfntLimits;
    /** Maximum collection faces. */
    max_faces?: number;
    /** Maximum cumulative table-directory records. */
    max_table_references?: number;
    /** Maximum sum of extracted standalone face sizes. */
    max_expanded_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::ColorFlavor`: Native color bitmap container, with black RGB and exact coverage alpha. */
export type ColorFlavor = "cbdt" | "sbix";

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::ColorWriteOptions`: Options for native color bitmap output. */
export interface ColorWriteOptions {
    /** Table, PNG, model, output and native readback budgets. */
    limits?: SfntBitmapLimits;
    /** Output table family. The default is CBDT/CBLC. */
    flavor?: ColorFlavor;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::mgtk::Columns`: Raster storage width. */
export type Columns = "auto" | "single" | "double";

/** `fontpixel::formats::comfont::ComfontCodec`: Native executable font codec. */

    /** Input choices. */
    read_options?: ComfontReadOptions;
    /** Output choices. */
    write_options?: ComfontWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::comfont::ComfontReadOptions`: Native payload interpretation; no input executable is run. */
export interface ComfontReadOptions {
    /** Require an envelope variant; default checks signatures. */

    /** Baseline below the cell top. */

}

export type ComfontVariant = "fontedit" | "frapt" | "frapt_tsr" | "letafont" | "mania" | "psfcom" | "udg";

/** `fontpixel::formats::comfont::ComfontWriteOptions`: Original executable output profile. */
export interface ComfontWriteOptions {
    /** Historical envelope. */
    variant?: ComfontVariant;
    /** CP/M installation target (CP/M variants only). */

    /** Optional native cell rectangle. */

    /** Explicit Gray8 threshold. */

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cff::Command`: Absolute path commands. CFF contours close implicitly on move/endchar. */
export type Command = "close" | CommandMoveTo | CommandLineTo | CommandCurveTo;

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cff::Command::CurveTo`: Draw a cubic Bézier using two controls and an endpoint. */
export interface CommandCurveTo {
    /** Draw a cubic Bézier using two controls and an endpoint. */
    curve_to: [[number, number], [number, number], [number, number]];
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cff::Command::LineTo`: Draw a straight segment. */
export interface CommandLineTo {
    /** Draw a straight segment. */
    line_to: [number, number];
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cff::Command::MoveTo`: Begin a contour. */
export interface CommandMoveTo {
    /** Begin a contour. */
    move_to: [number, number];
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::Component`: One composite component. Matrix words are signed exact F2DOT14 values. */
export interface Component {
    /** Child glyph ID. */
    glyph_id: number;
    /** Offset or point attachment. */
    anchor: Anchor;
    /** `(xx, xy, yx, yy)`; x'=xx*x+yx*y, y'=xy*x+yy*y. */
    transform: number[];
    /** Offset transform policy. */
    offset_mode: OffsetMode;
    /** Retain ROUND_XY_TO_GRID; unhinted design-space flattening does not grid fit. */
    round_to_grid: boolean;
    /** Retain USE_MY_METRICS for a caller's metrics resolver. */
    use_my_metrics: boolean;
    /** Component contours may overlap. */
    overlap: boolean;
    /** Retain historical NON_OVERLAPPING flag (bit 4, obsolete). */
    non_overlapping: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::CompositeGlyph`: Composite glyph's ordered child references and opaque interpreter program. */
export interface CompositeGlyph {
    /** Components in point-numbering order; must not be empty. */
    components: Component[];
    /** Preserved instruction bytes. */
    instructions: SerdeBytes;
}

/** `fontpixel::bitmap::CompositeMode`: Pixel-compositing rule within the intersection of source and destination. Outside that intersection, destination pixels remain unchanged. */
export type CompositeMode = "over" | "replace" | "or" | "and" | "xor" | "clear" | "add" | "subtract" | "max" | "min" | "multiply" | "alpha_over";

/** `fontpixel::formats::Confidence`: Increasing strength of structural evidence, with filename hints below content. */
export type Confidence = "no_match" | "extension" | "possible" | "certain";

    /** PSF output version, 1 or 2 (default 2). */

    /** PSF Unicode table policy (default auto). */
    psf_unicode_table?: string | null;
    /** Windows raster output version; defaults to source version or 2. */

    /** Windows dfCharSet identifier, 0..255 (ANSI=0, OEM=255). */

    /** Explicit target page for OEM, symbol, or historical Windows mappings. */

}

    /** Fallback two-byte little-endian load address when no matching source prefix exists. */

    /** Total serialized bytes of every asset. */
    bytes: number;
    /** Output format identifier. */
    format: string;
    /** Output entry point. */
    output: string;
    /** Complete read, edit and write diagnostics. */
    report: Report;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::convert::AssetSummary`: One asset of a written output. */
export interface ConvertAssetSummary {
    /** Serialized length in bytes. */
    bytes: number;
    /** Asset path relative to the output's directory. */
    path: string;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::convert::ConvertRequest`: Convert one or more inputs into one output, or each input separately. */
export interface ConvertRequest {
    /** One or more inputs, combined as ordered strikes in a FontSet. */
    inputs?: string[];
    /** Output entry point. No file is opened until conversion succeeds. */
    output?: string;
    /** Explicit input format. */
    from?: string | null;
    /** Explicit output format; required if the extension is ambiguous. */
    to?: string | null;
    /** Reject any read/write information loss before creating output assets. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Convert each input separately into an existing output directory; requires --to. */
    each?: boolean;
    /** Select a zero-based combined strike, or one strike from each input with --each. */
    font_index?: number | null;
    /** Explicit normalized output family; original source/XLFD provenance is retained. */
    family?: string | null;
    /** Explicit normalized output style/subfamily; does not infer weight or permissions. */
    style?: string | null;
    /** Exact full display name; otherwise a changed family/style clears a stale one. */
    full_name?: string | null;
    /** Exact PostScript name; otherwise a changed family/style clears a stale one. */
    postscript_name?: string | null;
    /** Literal normalized output version name (no implicit Version prefix). */
    font_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit copyright statement; this does not infer legal permission. */
    copyright?: string | null;
    /** Explicit license text; unrelated original provenance is retained. */
    license?: string | null;
    /** Explicit license URL; does not grant permission or contact the URL. */
    license_url?: string | null;
    /** Explicit foundry/vendor display name. */
    foundry?: string | null;
    /** Replace every glyph's scalable advance (BDF SWIDTH x) with round-half-even(DWIDTH x * --swidth-units / PPEM). Overwritten source values are reported as loss, so --strict rejects them. */
    swidth_ppem?: number | null;
    /** Scalable units per em for --swidth-ppem (BDF uses 1000). */
    swidth_units?: number | null;
    /** Exact FONT/XLFD name. The decomposed XLFD fields and an existing FONT property follow it; other name properties are not rewritten. */
    font_name?: string | null;
    /** Point size (BDF SIZE); requires --resolution. */
    point_size?: number | null;
    /** Resolution as X,Y dots per inch (BDF SIZE); requires --point-size. */
    resolution?: [number, number] | null;
    /** Set an integer property, NAME=VALUE (repeatable). PIXEL_SIZE, FONT_ASCENT/DESCENT and other integer metrics keep the model in sync. */
    set_integer_property?: string[];
    /** Set a text property, NAME=TEXT (repeatable). */
    set_text_property?: string[];
    /** Remove every record of a property (repeatable). Comments and copyright/notice/licence properties cannot be removed. */
    remove_property?: string[];

    report?: ReportStyle;

    byte_order?: Significance | null;
    /** PCF bitmap bit order. */
    bit_order?: Significance | null;

    /** Vertical line record of horizontal-only strikes: zero (native) or mirror-horizontal (a copy of the horizontal record). */

    /** hmtx: full (native, one long metric per glyph) or compact-trailing. */
    otb_hmtx?: string | null;
    /** Glyph IDs: first-seen (native) or codepoint (encoded glyphs by smallest scalar, then unencoded glyphs in first-seen order). */
    otb_glyph_order?: string | null;
    /** DRCS output cell width; requires --drcs-cell-height. */

    /** DRCS output cell height; requires --drcs-cell-width. */

    /** DRCS cell left edge relative to the glyph origin (default zero). */

    /** DRCS cell bottom edge relative to the baseline (default zero). */

    /** DRCS character set size (default 94). */
    drcs_charset?: string | null;
    /** DEC character set designator (default a space followed by @). */

    /** Use 8-bit DCS/ST control bytes instead of ESC P / ESC backslash. */

    /** Explicit raw layout preset (VGA, C64, Spectrum, CH8, MSX or Harlekin). */

    /** Raw glyph width; overrides a selected preset. */

    /** Raw glyph height; overrides a selected preset. */

    /** Exact raw glyph count; otherwise consume complete records. */

    /** First raw slot code, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    raw_first?: string | null;
    /** Bit order within each raw byte (default msb). */

    /** Raw row order (default top-down). */
    raw_row_order?: string | null;
    /** Raw alignment: byte-aligned rows or continuous packed bits. */

    /** Row-major or byte-column-major storage within each horizontal strip. */

    /** Glyph cells placed side by side in each raw horizontal strip (default 1). */

    /** Extra padding bytes after every raw row. */

    /** Prefix bytes before the first raw glyph. */

    /** Fallback two-byte little-endian load address when no matching source prefix exists. */

    /** Explicit charset identity of raw slot codes. */

    /** DOS CPI input pointers (default linear). */

    /** Exact charset label of FONTX2 source codes. */

    /** Explicit HZK/ASC preset, e.g. HZK16, HZK24S, ASC16. */

    /** HZK glyph width; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_width?: number | null;
    /** HZK glyph height; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_height?: number | null;
    /** HZK first slot code, e.g. 0xA1A1. */
    hzk_first?: string | null;
    /** HZK last permitted slot code, inclusive. */

    /** HZK slot domain for custom geometry. */

    /** HZK bitmap storage orientation (default rows). */

    /** Exact HZK input or output glyph count. */

    /** Explicit NFNT legacy charset label. */

    /** Relative AppleDouble companion when reading the data fork. */

    /** Explicitly threshold imported BMFont grayscale; default preserves samples. */
    bmfont_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** GEM input header integer order; default uses structural detection. */
    gem_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** GEM input bitmap word order; default follows its header flag. */
    gem_read_word_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input integer order; default uses version stamps. */
    snf_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input bitmap layout: bits,bytes,row-padding,scan-unit,rows; e.g. msb,big,4,1,top-down. */

    /** Scoped PNG mask for a PILfont descriptor (its native suffix is .pbm). */

    /** Scoped PNG atlas for a Playdate FNT descriptor. */

    /** Playdate source atlas cell height. */

    /** Charset label for MGTK legacy positions; no implicit Unicode remapping. */
    mgtk_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Family name supplied externally for a QPF font. */
    qpf_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Require the DAVIC specification or FreeType PFR wire dialect. */
    pfr_read_dialect?: string | null;
    /** Require a Xerox native font family. */
    xerox_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicit baseline for Alto files with a zero native header baseline. */

    /** Require the SBCS or DBCS PC/GEOS layout. */
    pcgeos_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly round fractional PC/GEOS input metrics. */
    pcgeos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Retain the additional GPI unmapped null descriptor (default true). */

    /** Require a RISC OS bitmap generation. */
    riscos_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Relative RISC OS IntMetrics input companion. */

    /** Explicit marker-image dialect; otherwise inspect native controls. */

    /** Ordered SFont labels, comma-separated U+0041 or legacy:0x41. */
    sfont_read_codepoints?: string[];
    /** SFont baseline down from glyph top. */
    sfont_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a Daisy-Dot input generation. */
    daisy_read_version?: string | null;
    /** PolyPrint baseline measured from the cell top. */
    polyprint_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Print Shop baseline measured from the cell top. */
    printshop_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a TasPrint input platform. */
    tasprint_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit PCW input width. */
    tasprint_read_width?: number | null;
    /** Require PXL version 1001 or 1002. */
    pxl_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Scoped TFM sidecar path for PXL input. */
    pxl_read_tfm?: string | null;
    /** Require a Signum editor or printer input layout. */
    signum_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Signum baseline. */

    /** Explicit Signum line height. */

    /** Include the later GEOS DEL slot when interpreting a native strike. */
    geos_read_include_del?: boolean;
    /** Bare Japanese Macintosh resource type (default fbit). */

    /** Scoped bitmap data fork for an fbit resource. */
    fbit_read_data_fork?: string | null;
    /** Scoped AppleDouble resource companion for an fbit data-fork input. */
    fbit_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
    /** Explicit cell width for bare HFNT input. */
    fbit_read_hfnt_width?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for Lisa legacy positions. */
    lisa_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Accept shortened SymbOS character ranges. */
    symbos_read_allow_short_range?: boolean;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific bit order zero. */
    wsfont_known_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific byte order zero. */
    wsfont_known_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** BeOS coverage interpretation (default native8). */
    beos_read_coverage?: string | null;
    /** Permit explicit rounding of fractional BeOS advances on input. */
    beos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Require a prebuilt bitmap numeric byte order. */
    prebuilt_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Prebuilt input bitmap pixel order (default msb; independent of numeric byte order). */
    prebuilt_read_bitmap_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Catalyst native directory origin (default resource-body). */
    catalyst_offset_base?: string | null;
    /** Require ChiWriter version 3 or 4. */
    chiwriter_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit compatible bitmap directory origin. */
    chiwriter_read_layout?: string | null;
    /** ChiWriter input raster bytes per row. */
    chiwriter_read_stride?: number | null;
    /** Require Dashen screen/printer generation. */
    dashen_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly accept the historical monobit PCL descriptor-size discrepancy. */
    hppcl_allow_legacy_descriptor_size?: boolean;
    /** Baseline below cell top for BBC, COM, Consoleet, GRASP, HRCG, Wyse, XBIN and Zap. */
    native_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Charset label for native console positions; numeric codes stay unchanged. */
    native_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Require one executable font loader variant. */
    comfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of Consoleet numeric filenames (default legacy). */
    consoleet_read_codes?: string | null;
    /** Require one Zap font layout. */
    zapfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Override the inferred first legacy code in a Dr. Halo font. */
    drhalo_read_first?: number | null;
    /** Korean 8×4×4 input: compose Hangul syllables or retain component slots. */
    hanfont_read_mode?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset label for Apple IIgs legacy character codes. */
    iigs_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** DRCS baseline down from cell top (default cell height). */
    drcs_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** DEC device matrix rules for both reading and writing DRCS. */
    drcs_terminal?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Berkeley vfont input integer byte order. */
    vfont_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Require a Palm wrapper instead of recognizing its structure. */
    palm_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Explicit handling of fractional Palm density coordinates (default exact). */
    palm_rounding?: string | null;
    /** Interpret GDR source codes as legacy positions instead of Unicode. */
    gdr_read_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicitly reduce KBITX grayscale during import; default retains exact samples. */
    kbitx_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Crop PBF blank margins during import, with a loss report. */
    pbf_trim?: boolean;
    /** C header dialect (default auto). */
    c_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Explicit C source or LVGL binary input container (default auto). */
    c_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Read the pre-2019 two-byte U8x8 header. */
    c_read_u8x8_legacy?: boolean;
    /** C input array or GFXfont symbol to select. */
    c_array?: string | null;
    /** Generic C cell width; requires height, first code and charset. */
    c_width?: number | null;
    /** Generic C cell height; requires `c_width`. */
    c_height?: number | null;
    /** First code in generic C arrays, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    c_first?: string | null;
    /** unicode or an explicit legacy charset name. */
    c_charset?: string | null;
    /** Generic C baseline down from cell top (default height). */
    c_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Generic C bytes store the leftmost pixel in bit zero. */
    c_lsb_first?: boolean;
    /** Relative JSON/TOML atlas mapping, resolved beside the primary input. */
    image_mapping?: string | null;
    /** Literal prefix on numeric glyph filenames in an input directory. */
    image_read_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Input directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_read_radix?: number | null;
    /** Input filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_read_domain?: string | null;
    /** Input image background (default black). */
    image_read_background?: string | null;
    /** Input glyph baseline measured down from each image's top. */
    image_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** HEX input/output rows (default 16); never inferred from record length. */
    hex_height?: number | null;
    /** HEX baseline-to-bottom distance (default 0). */
    hex_descent?: number | null;
    /** Explicit source FNT/FON legacy code page (does not remap byte positions). */
    fnt_read_code_page?: string | null;
    /** Primary input byte budget (default 64 MiB). */
    max_input_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Individual companion-file byte budget. */
    max_resource_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Aggregate resource and codec allocation budget (default 256 MiB). */
    max_total_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum companion reads and directory entries. */
    max_resources?: number | null;
    /** Explicit raster size for reviewed off-grid/curved outlines. */
    ppem?: number | null;
    /** Select a TTC/OTC face (zero based); otherwise read every face. */
    face_index?: number | null;
    /** Rasterize outlines even when matching embedded images exist. */
    no_embedded_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit design units per pixel; requires --ppem. */
    grid_units?: number | null;
    /** Reviewed horizontal and vertical translations in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_x?: number;
    /** Reviewed vertical translation in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_y?: number;
    /** Outline shape for SVG/TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2/TTC conversion. */
    shape?: Shape | null;
    /** Dot diameter or separate-square side relative to one pixel. */
    dotsize?: number | null;
    /** Native dot reuse; default patterns. Literal favors smaller webfonts. */
    dot_reuse?: string | null;
    /** Design units per source pixel (default 100). */
    ppu?: number | null;
    /** Explicit units per em for outline output. */
    upm?: number | null;
    /** Embed a matching EBDT/EBLC bitmap strike in outline output. */
    embed_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale-to-monochrome threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Outline source in webfonts/TTC (auto selects CFF squares, TrueType dots). */
    woff2_source?: string | null;
    /** WOFF2 Brotli quality, 0 through 11 (default 11). */
    woff2_quality?: number | null;
    /** Intra-font Brotli workers (1..16), independent of batch task workers. */
    woff2_threads?: number | null;
    /** Write a version 2 TTC/OTC header. */
    collection_v2?: boolean;
    /** Glyph 0 of TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2/TTC output: preserve (the source .notdef, otherwise an empty glyph) or empty (empty outline with exact design-unit metrics; requires --notdef-advance; replacing a source .notdef is loss). */
    notdef?: string | null;
    /** Empty .notdef advance width in design units. */
    notdef_advance?: number | null;
    /** Empty .notdef left side bearing in design units (default 0). */
    notdef_lsb?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::cpi::CpiCodec`: CPI registry codec. */
export interface CpiCodec {
    /** Import settings. */
    read_options?: CpiReadOptions;
    /** Export settings. */
    write_options?: CpiWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::cpi::CpiReadOptions`: CPI import settings. */
export interface CpiReadOptions {
    /** Pointer representation. */
    pointer_mode?: PointerMode;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::cpi::Version`: CPI wire container. */
export type CpiVersion = "font" | "font_nt" | "dr_font" | "cp" | "cpx";

/** `fontpixel::formats::cpi::CpiWriteOptions`: CPI export settings. */
export interface CpiWriteOptions {
    /** Output container. */
    version?: CpiVersion;
    /** Fallback page for models lacking codepage metadata. */
    code_page?: number | null;
    /** Explicit grayscale threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Output byte limit. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
    /** Model and read-back limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::comfont::CpmTarget`: CP/M machine whose documented native font memory is installed. */
export type CpmTarget = "pcw" | "cpc" | "spectrum";

/** `fontpixel::compat::bdfparser::font::CreateOptions`: Parameters of `Font.create`; defaults match SPEC-v3 §2.6. */
export interface CreateOptions {
    /** Pixel cell width and nominal size. */
    pixelsize?: WideInt;
    /** Optional baseline-to-top height. */
    ascent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Optional baseline-to-bottom depth. */
    descent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Optional FONT header. */
    fontname?: string | null;
    /** Family property and default FONT name. */
    familyname?: string;
    /** Horizontal resolution. */
    xres?: WideInt;
    /** Vertical resolution. */
    yres?: WideInt;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::cybiko::CybikoCodec`: Registry codec with explicit native input and output choices. */
export interface CybikoCodec {
    /** Native input options. */
    read_options?: CybikoReadOptions;
    /** Native output options. */
    write_options?: CybikoWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::cybiko::CybikoReadOptions`: Native Cybiko byte positions remain Legacy mappings. */
export interface CybikoReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::cybiko::CybikoWriteOptions`: Bounded Cybiko output choices. */
export interface CybikoWriteOptions {
    /** Permit numerical Unicode-to-native byte mapping. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale-to-monochrome threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Cumulative resource limits, including native readback. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Additional primary output byte cap. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::daisy::DaisyCodec`: Registry codec. */
export interface DaisyCodec {
    /** Reading options. */
    read_options?: DaisyReadOptions;
    /** Writing options. */
    write_options?: DaisyWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::daisy::DaisyReadOptions`: Read interpretation; no filesystem search is performed. */
export interface DaisyReadOptions {
    /** Require a particular generation. */
    version?: DaisyVersion | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::daisy::DaisyVersion`: Daisy-Dot file generation. */
export type DaisyVersion = "v2" | "v3" | "magnified";

/** `fontpixel::formats::daisy::DaisyWriteOptions`: Explicit bounded output choices. */
export interface DaisyWriteOptions {
    /** Output generation. */
    version?: DaisyVersion;
    /** Actual height marker plus one; absent uses source metadata or cell height. */
    height?: number | null;
    /** Underline row used to derive baseline. */
    underline?: number | null;
    /** Permit graphics bytes forbidden by the original manual. */
    allow_control_bytes?: boolean;
    /** Permit Unicode numeric positions. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale reduction. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Aggregate output cap. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::dashen::DashenCodec`: Registry codec. */
export interface DashenCodec {
    /** Input choices. */
    read_options?: DashenReadOptions;
    /** Output choices. */
    write_options?: DashenWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::dashen::DashenReadOptions`: Explicit input choices. */
export interface DashenReadOptions {
    /** Require a particular observed generation. */
    version?: DashenVersion | null;
    /** Embedded PCL compatibility policy. */
    pcl?: HppclReadOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::dashen::DashenVersion`: The observed three-byte character-header profiles. */
export type DashenVersion = "v3" | "v4";

/** `fontpixel::formats::dashen::DashenWriteOptions`: Native output choices. */
export interface DashenWriteOptions {
    /** Screen-only or combined screen/printer profile. */
    version?: DashenVersion;
    /** Header top metric; absent preserves it or derives the maximum glyph top minus one. */
    top?: number | null;
    /** Write a code map even for screen-only output. */
    codepoint_map?: boolean;
    /** Embedded printer-font output choices (outer limits always apply). */
    pcl?: HppclWriteOptions;
    /** Permit numeric Unicode positions. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale reduction. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared ceilings. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Aggregate byte cap. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::woff::Decoded`: Reconstructed standalone sfnt plus preserved envelope fields and diagnostics. */
export interface Decoded {
    /** Canonical sfnt with recomputed checksums. */
    sfnt: SerdeBytes;
    /** Version, metadata and vendor-private bytes. */
    auxiliary: Auxiliary;
    /** Metadata decoding issues; invalid font data is always an error. */
    report: Report;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cff::DecodedGlyph`: One evaluated unhinted glyph, with fractions retained. */
export interface DecodedGlyph {
    /** Advance from Type 2/Private DICT, transformed to design space. */
    advance: number;
    /** Expanded path. Hint instructions are not applied. */
    commands: Command[];
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fbit::Definition`: Supported native font-definition storage layouts. */
export type Definition = "inline" | "data_fork5" | "data_fork7";

/** `fontpixel::formats::Detected`: Successful detection, explicitly preserving the strength of its evidence. */
export interface Detected {
    /** Selected format. */
    format: FormatInfo;
    /** How the selection was made. */
    confidence: Confidence;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p3_formats::device::ReadOptions`: Read options: explicit device font containers, bitmap storage and related input metadata. */
export interface DeviceReadOptions {
    /** Scoped PNG mask for a PILfont descriptor (its native suffix is .pbm). */
    pilfont_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Scoped PNG atlas for a Playdate FNT descriptor. */
    playdate_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell width. */
    playdate_read_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell height. */
    playdate_read_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for MGTK legacy positions; no implicit Unicode remapping. */
    mgtk_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Family name supplied externally for a QPF font. */
    qpf_read_family?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p3_formats::device::WriteOptions`: Write options: explicit device font containers, bitmap storage and related input metadata. */
export interface DeviceWriteOptions {
    /** PILfont maximum atlas width (default 800). */
    pilfont_max_width?: number | null;
    /** Processing VLW generation (default 11). */
    vlw_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit VLW smoothing hint; preserves source hint when omitted. */
    vlw_smooth?: boolean | null;
    /** Rockbox file generation (default rb12). */
    rockbox_flavor?: string | null;
    /** Rockbox native coverage representation. */
    rockbox_depth?: string | null;
    /** U8/M load address in decimal. */
    u8m_load_address?: number | null;
    /** Playdate descriptor/atlas or compiled font (default fnt-embedded). */
    playdate_flavor?: string | null;
    /** Playdate output atlas cell width. */
    playdate_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** Playdate output atlas cell height. */
    playdate_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** Explicit Playdate font tracking. */
    playdate_tracking?: number | null;
    /** QPF2 native glyph coverage storage (default gray8). */
    qpf2_glyph_format?: string | null;
    /** MGTK one/two seven-bit raster strips (default auto). */
    mgtk_columns?: string | null;
}

    /** First input. */

    /** Second input. */

    /** Explicit format of both inputs. */

    /** Explicit format of the second input (overrides `from`). */

    /** Reject read loss before comparing. */

    /** Maximum detailed records; every difference is still counted. */

    /** Raw glyph width; overrides a selected preset. */

    /** Raw glyph height; overrides a selected preset. */

    /** Exact raw glyph count; otherwise consume complete records. */
