    /** First raw slot code, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    raw_first?: string | null;
    /** Bit order within each raw byte (default msb). */
    raw_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Raw row order (default top-down). */
    raw_row_order?: string | null;
    /** Raw alignment: byte-aligned rows or continuous packed bits. */
    raw_packing?: string | null;
    /** Row-major or byte-column-major storage within each horizontal strip. */
    raw_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Glyph cells placed side by side in each raw horizontal strip (default 1). */
    raw_strike_count?: number | null;
    /** Extra padding bytes after every raw row. */
    raw_row_padding?: number | null;
    /** Prefix bytes before the first raw glyph. */
    raw_offset?: number | null;
    /** Fallback two-byte little-endian load address when no matching source prefix exists. */
    raw_default_load_address?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset identity of raw slot codes. */
    raw_charset?: string | null;
    /** DOS CPI input pointers (default linear). */
    cpi_pointer_mode?: string | null;
    /** Exact charset label of FONTX2 source codes. */
    fontx2_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Explicit HZK/ASC preset, e.g. HZK16, HZK24S, ASC16. */
    hzk_preset?: string | null;
    /** HZK glyph width; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_width?: number | null;
    /** HZK glyph height; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_height?: number | null;
    /** HZK first slot code, e.g. 0xA1A1. */
    hzk_first?: string | null;
    /** HZK last permitted slot code, inclusive. */
    hzk_last?: string | null;
    /** HZK slot domain for custom geometry. */
    hzk_code_space?: string | null;
    /** HZK bitmap storage orientation (default rows). */
    hzk_storage?: string | null;
    /** Exact HZK input or output glyph count. */
    hzk_count?: number | null;
    /** Explicit NFNT legacy charset label. */
    nfnt_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Relative AppleDouble companion when reading the data fork. */
    nfnt_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly threshold imported BMFont grayscale; default preserves samples. */
    bmfont_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** GEM input header integer order; default uses structural detection. */
    gem_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** GEM input bitmap word order; default follows its header flag. */
    gem_read_word_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input integer order; default uses version stamps. */
    snf_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input bitmap layout: bits,bytes,row-padding,scan-unit,rows; e.g. msb,big,4,1,top-down. */
    snf_read_layout?: string | null;
    /** Scoped PNG mask for a PILfont descriptor (its native suffix is .pbm). */
    pilfont_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Scoped PNG atlas for a Playdate FNT descriptor. */
    playdate_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell width. */
    playdate_read_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell height. */
    playdate_read_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for MGTK legacy positions; no implicit Unicode remapping. */
    mgtk_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Family name supplied externally for a QPF font. */
    qpf_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Require the DAVIC specification or FreeType PFR wire dialect. */
    pfr_read_dialect?: string | null;
    /** Require a Xerox native font family. */
    xerox_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicit baseline for Alto files with a zero native header baseline. */
    xerox_read_alto_baseline?: number | null;
    /** Require the SBCS or DBCS PC/GEOS layout. */
    pcgeos_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly round fractional PC/GEOS input metrics. */
    pcgeos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Retain the additional GPI unmapped null descriptor (default true). */
    gpi_include_unmapped_null?: boolean | null;
    /** Require a RISC OS bitmap generation. */
    riscos_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Relative RISC OS IntMetrics input companion. */
    riscos_read_metrics?: string | null;
    /** Explicit marker-image dialect; otherwise inspect native controls. */
    sfont_read_flavor?: string | null;
    /** Ordered SFont labels, comma-separated U+0041 or legacy:0x41. */
    sfont_read_codepoints?: string[];
    /** SFont baseline down from glyph top. */
    sfont_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a Daisy-Dot input generation. */
    daisy_read_version?: string | null;
    /** PolyPrint baseline measured from the cell top. */
    polyprint_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Print Shop baseline measured from the cell top. */
    printshop_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a TasPrint input platform. */
    tasprint_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit PCW input width. */
    tasprint_read_width?: number | null;
    /** Require PXL version 1001 or 1002. */
    pxl_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Scoped TFM sidecar path for PXL input. */
    pxl_read_tfm?: string | null;
    /** Require a Signum editor or printer input layout. */
    signum_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Signum baseline. */
    signum_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Explicit Signum line height. */
    signum_line_height?: WideInt | null;
    /** Include the later GEOS DEL slot when interpreting a native strike. */
    geos_read_include_del?: boolean;
    /** Bare Japanese Macintosh resource type (default fbit). */
    fbit_read_kind?: string | null;
    /** Scoped bitmap data fork for an fbit resource. */
    fbit_read_data_fork?: string | null;
    /** Scoped AppleDouble resource companion for an fbit data-fork input. */
    fbit_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
    /** Explicit cell width for bare HFNT input. */
    fbit_read_hfnt_width?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for Lisa legacy positions. */
    lisa_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Accept shortened SymbOS character ranges. */
    symbos_read_allow_short_range?: boolean;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific bit order zero. */
    wsfont_known_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific byte order zero. */
    wsfont_known_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** BeOS coverage interpretation (default native8). */
    beos_read_coverage?: string | null;
    /** Permit explicit rounding of fractional BeOS advances on input. */
    beos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Require a prebuilt bitmap numeric byte order. */
    prebuilt_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Prebuilt input bitmap pixel order (default msb; independent of numeric byte order). */
    prebuilt_read_bitmap_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Catalyst native directory origin (default resource-body). */
    catalyst_offset_base?: string | null;
    /** Require ChiWriter version 3 or 4. */
    chiwriter_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit compatible bitmap directory origin. */
    chiwriter_read_layout?: string | null;
    /** ChiWriter input raster bytes per row. */
    chiwriter_read_stride?: number | null;
    /** Require Dashen screen/printer generation. */
    dashen_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly accept the historical monobit PCL descriptor-size discrepancy. */
    hppcl_allow_legacy_descriptor_size?: boolean;
    /** Baseline below cell top for BBC, COM, Consoleet, GRASP, HRCG, Wyse, XBIN and Zap. */
    native_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Charset label for native console positions; numeric codes stay unchanged. */
    native_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Require one executable font loader variant. */
    comfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of Consoleet numeric filenames (default legacy). */
    consoleet_read_codes?: string | null;
    /** Require one Zap font layout. */
    zapfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Override the inferred first legacy code in a Dr. Halo font. */
    drhalo_read_first?: number | null;
    /** Korean 8×4×4 input: compose Hangul syllables or retain component slots. */
    hanfont_read_mode?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset label for Apple IIgs legacy character codes. */
    iigs_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** DRCS baseline down from cell top (default cell height). */
    drcs_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** DEC device matrix rules for both reading and writing DRCS. */
    drcs_terminal?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Berkeley vfont input integer byte order. */
    vfont_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Require a Palm wrapper instead of recognizing its structure. */
    palm_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Explicit handling of fractional Palm density coordinates (default exact). */
    palm_rounding?: string | null;
    /** Interpret GDR source codes as legacy positions instead of Unicode. */
    gdr_read_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicitly reduce KBITX grayscale during import; default retains exact samples. */
    kbitx_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Crop PBF blank margins during import, with a loss report. */
    pbf_trim?: boolean;
    /** C header dialect (default auto). */
    c_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Explicit C source or LVGL binary input container (default auto). */
    c_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Read the pre-2019 two-byte U8x8 header. */
    c_read_u8x8_legacy?: boolean;
    /** C input array or GFXfont symbol to select. */
    c_array?: string | null;
    /** Generic C cell width; requires height, first code and charset. */
    c_width?: number | null;
    /** Generic C cell height; requires `c_width`. */
    c_height?: number | null;
    /** First code in generic C arrays, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    c_first?: string | null;
    /** unicode or an explicit legacy charset name. */
    c_charset?: string | null;
    /** Generic C baseline down from cell top (default height). */
    c_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Generic C bytes store the leftmost pixel in bit zero. */
    c_lsb_first?: boolean;
    /** Relative JSON/TOML atlas mapping, resolved beside the primary input. */
    image_mapping?: string | null;
    /** Literal prefix on numeric glyph filenames in an input directory. */
    image_read_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Input directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_read_radix?: number | null;
    /** Input filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_read_domain?: string | null;
    /** Input image background (default black). */
    image_read_background?: string | null;
    /** Input glyph baseline measured down from each image's top. */
    image_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** HEX input/output rows (default 16); never inferred from record length. */
    hex_height?: number | null;
    /** HEX baseline-to-bottom distance (default 0). */
    hex_descent?: number | null;
    /** Explicit source FNT/FON legacy code page (does not remap byte positions). */
    fnt_read_code_page?: string | null;
    /** Primary input byte budget (default 64 MiB). */
    max_input_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Individual companion-file byte budget. */
    max_resource_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Aggregate resource and codec allocation budget (default 256 MiB). */
    max_total_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum companion reads and directory entries. */
    max_resources?: number | null;
    /** Explicit raster size for reviewed off-grid/curved outlines. */
    ppem?: number | null;
    /** Select a TTC/OTC face (zero based); otherwise read every face. */
    face_index?: number | null;
    /** Rasterize outlines even when matching embedded images exist. */
    no_embedded_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit design units per pixel; requires --ppem. */
    grid_units?: number | null;
    /** Reviewed horizontal and vertical translations in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_x?: number;
    /** Reviewed vertical translation in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_y?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::commands::Difference`: One detected difference. */
export interface Difference {
    /** Difference category, e.g. `glyph_bitmap` or `font_count`. */
    kind: string;
    /** Zero-based strike index. */
    font_index: number;
    /** Affected code, when the difference concerns one mapping. */
    codepoint?: number | null;
    /** Affected glyph index, when the difference concerns one glyph. */
    glyph_index?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::bitmap::geometry::Direction`: Concatenation direction. Left/up reverse placement, not the supplied list. */
export type Direction = "right" | "left" | "down" | "up";

/** `fontpixel::formats::dosstart::DosstartCodec`: Native dosstart registry codec. */
export interface DosstartCodec {
    /** Input profile choices. */
    read_options?: DosstartReadOptions;
    /** Output conversion and resource choices. */
    write_options?: W5a1CommonNativeWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::dosstart::DosstartReadOptions`: Typed dosstart input choices. */
export interface DosstartReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::variants::metadata::DotGlyph`: Glyph ID of the shared dot glyph of TrueType dot outlines. */
export type DotGlyph = "last" | "after_notdef";

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cff::DotOptions`: Shared circle configuration, in design units. */
export interface DotOptions {
    /** Positive size of a pixel cell. */
    cell_size?: number;
    /** Circle diameter, positive and at most 1.5 times the cell size. */
    diameter?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::variants::export::DotReuse`: Native default-scale dot composite representation; pixels and glyph IDs agree. */
export type DotReuse = "literal" | "rows" | "patterns";

/** `fontpixel::formats::draw::DrawCodec`: Hexdraw registry codec. */
export interface DrawCodec {
    /** Export configuration. */
    write_options?: DrawWriteOptions;
}

/**
 * `fontpixel_ops::options::DrawMode`: Glyph spacing mode for rendering.
 *
 * Input aliases: ``1``, ``0``.
 */
export type DrawMode = "advance" | "cell" | "ink" | "1" | "0";

/** `fontpixel_ops::options::DrawOrder`: Glyph ordering for `--all` rendering. */
export type DrawOrder = "ascending" | "descending" | "file" | "reverse-file";

/** `fontpixel::formats::draw::DrawWriteOptions`: Bounded hexdraw export settings. */
export interface DrawWriteOptions {
    /** Explicit grayscale threshold; absent rejects grayscale. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Maximum emitted text bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
    /** Reader and model budgets. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::drcs::DrcsCharset`: Downloaded character-set size. Codes remain legacy graphic-set positions. */
export type DrcsCharset = "ninety_four" | "ninety_six";

/** `fontpixel::formats::drcs::DrcsCodec`: Native DRCS codec. */
export interface DrcsCodec {
    /** Reader interpretation. */
    read_options?: DrcsReadOptions;
    /** Writer projection and limits. */
    write_options?: DrcsWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::drcs::DrcsReadOptions`: DRCS reading interpretation. */
export interface DrcsReadOptions {
    /** Terminal profile; dimensions cannot be inferred from omitted parameters. */
    terminal?: Terminal;
    /** Baseline down from the cell top; omitted means the cell bottom. */
    baseline?: WideInt | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::drcs::DrcsWriteOptions`: Bounded DRCS writer options. */
export interface DrcsWriteOptions {
    /** Terminal profile limiting downloadable matrices. */
    terminal?: Terminal;
    /** Output cell; omitted derives a common enclosing cell. */
    cell?: Bounds | null;
    /** Output set size. */
    charset?: DrcsCharset;
    /** One final byte with up to two intermediate bytes; default is space-at. */
    designator?: string;
    /** Use C1 DCS/ST bytes instead of seven-bit escape sequences. */
    eight_bit_controls?: boolean;
    /** Explicit threshold required for Gray8 output. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Bounds on source, output, model and temporary storage. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::drhalo::DrhaloCodec`: Native drhalo registry codec. */
export interface DrhaloCodec {
    /** Input profile choices. */
    read_options?: DrhaloReadOptions;
    /** Output conversion and resource choices. */
    write_options?: W5a1CommonNativeWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::drhalo::DrhaloReadOptions`: Typed drhalo input choices. */
export interface DrhaloReadOptions {
    /** Override the historically inferred first legacy position. */
    first_codepoint?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::charset::merge_categories::EastAsianWidth`: Exact East Asian Width property. */
export type EastAsianWidth = "ambiguous" | "fullwidth" | "halfwidth" | "neutral" | "narrow" | "wide";

/** `fontpixel::outline::path::Edge`: A directed Bézier edge. Callers explicitly supply contour-closing edges. */
export type Edge = EdgeLine | EdgeQuad | EdgeCubic;

/** `fontpixel::outline::path::Edge::Cubic`: Cubic segment. */
export interface EdgeCubic {
    /** Cubic segment. */
    cubic: [[number, number], [number, number], [number, number], [number, number]];
}

/** `fontpixel::outline::path::Edge::Line`: Straight segment. */
export interface EdgeLine {
    /** Straight segment. */
    line: [[number, number], [number, number]];
}

/** `fontpixel::outline::path::Edge::Quad`: Quadratic segment. */
export interface EdgeQuad {
    /** Quadratic segment. */
    quad: [[number, number], [number, number], [number, number]];
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p2_formats::editor::ReadOptions`: Read options: bMFont descriptor/page choices and native editor formats. */
export interface EditorReadOptions {
    /** Explicitly threshold imported BMFont grayscale; default preserves samples. */
    bmfont_read_threshold?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p2_formats::editor::WriteOptions`: Write options: bMFont descriptor/page choices and native editor formats. */
export interface EditorWriteOptions {
    /** BMFont descriptor encoding (default text). */
    bmfont_encoding?: string | null;
    /** BMFont PNG page width in pixels. */
    bmfont_page_width?: number | null;
    /** BMFont PNG page height in pixels. */
    bmfont_page_height?: number | null;
    /** Empty pixels between BMFont glyphs. */
    bmfont_padding?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::edwin::EdwinCodec`: Native edwin registry codec. */
export interface EdwinCodec {
    /** Input profile choices. */
    read_options?: EdwinReadOptions;
    /** Output conversion and resource choices. */
    write_options?: W5a1CommonNativeWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::edwin::EdwinReadOptions`: Typed edwin input choices. */
export interface EdwinReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedAverageWidth`: Arithmetic for OS/2 `xAvgCharWidth` over nonzero design advances. */
export type EmbeddedAverageWidth = "nearest" | "floor";

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::EmbeddedCodec`: Feature-selected registry hooks for all three embedded families. In serde form only `kind` is required; omitted options take their defaults, as in [`EmbeddedCodec::new`]. */
export interface EmbeddedCodec {
    /** The intended bitmap table family. */
    kind: BitmapKind;
    /** Detailed extraction choices. */
    read_options?: EmbeddedReadOptions;
    /** Detailed OTB/bdat output choices. */
    write_options?: EmbeddedWriteOptions;
    /** Color container choice and budgets. */
    color_write_options?: ColorWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedGlyphOrder`: Glyph ID order of the bitmap glyphs (glyph 0 stays `.notdef`). */
export type EmbeddedGlyphOrder = "first_seen" | "codepoint";

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedHmtx`: hmtx storage of trailing glyphs that share the last advance. */
export type EmbeddedHmtx = "full" | "compact_trailing";

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedIndexLayout`: EBLC/bloc index subtable organisation; never changes decoded glyphs. */
export type EmbeddedIndexLayout = "canonical" | "spanning" | EmbeddedIndexLayoutSharedMetricRuns;

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedIndexLayout::SharedMetricRuns`: Runs of at least `minimum_run` consecutive glyph IDs with identical small metrics and nonempty images use index format 2/image format 5; all other glyphs use index format 3/image format 2, both bit-aligned. Requires horizontal-only small metrics; run metrics carry zero vertical fields, which is reported. */
export interface EmbeddedIndexLayoutSharedMetricRuns {
    /** Runs of at least `minimum_run` consecutive glyph IDs with identical small metrics and nonempty images use index format 2/image format 5; all other glyphs use index format 3/image format 2, both bit-aligned. Requires horizontal-only small metrics; run metrics carry zero vertical fields, which is reported. */
    shared_metric_runs: EmbeddedIndexLayoutSharedMetricRunsFields;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedIndexLayout::SharedMetricRuns::fields`: Runs of at least `minimum_run` consecutive glyph IDs with identical small metrics and nonempty images use index format 2/image format 5; all other glyphs use index format 3/image format 2, both bit-aligned. Requires horizontal-only small metrics; run metrics carry zero vertical fields, which is reported. */
export interface EmbeddedIndexLayoutSharedMetricRunsFields {
    /** Shortest run stored with shared metrics, at least 1. */
    minimum_run: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedLineExtremes`: EBLC/bloc `minOriginSB`, `minAdvanceSB`, `maxBeforeBL`, `minAfterBL`. */
export type EmbeddedLineExtremes = "computed" | "zero";

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedMetadataOptions`: Explicit head, OS/2, post, name and strike-table controls for OTB/bdat. */
export interface EmbeddedMetadataOptions {
    /** Complete name table. The `Arc` lets registry and transport clones share one allocation, which the writer charges once to its own budget. */
    names?: NameTable | null;
    /** Exact `head.flags`; reserved bit 15 must be clear. */
    head_flags?: number | null;
    /** `head.lowestRecPPEM`, at least 1. */
    lowest_rec_ppem?: number | null;
    /** `head.created` and `head.modified`, seconds since 1904-01-01 00:00 UTC. Absent writes zero (deterministic native default). */
    timestamps?: WideInt[] | null;
    /** OS/2 table version 3 or 4 (identical layout; native default 4). */
    os2_version?: number | null;
    /** Four printable-ASCII bytes for `achVendID` (native default `NONE`). */
    vendor_id?: SerdeBytes | null;
    /** Ten PANOSE bytes (native default all zero). */
    panose?: SerdeBytes | null;
    /** `ulUnicodeRange1..4` policy. */
    unicode_ranges?: EmbeddedUnicodeRanges;
    /** `usBreakChar` (native default 0). */
    break_char?: number | null;
    /** `fsType` embedding permissions; only defined bits, at most one usage permission among bits 1..=3. */
    embedding_flags?: number | null;
    /** `fsSelection`; bits 10..=15 must be clear, and bits 7..=9 require OS/2 version 4. */
    selection_flags?: number | null;
    /** `xAvgCharWidth` arithmetic; advances themselves are unchanged. */
    average_width?: EmbeddedAverageWidth;
    /** Post glyph names (format 2) or nameless format 3. */
    post_names?: EmbeddedPostNames;
    /** `post.isFixedPitch` override; absent follows the source spacing. */
    fixed_pitch?: boolean | null;
    /** cmap (0, 4) record policy for BMP-only maps. */
    cmap_unicode_full?: FullRecords;
    /** EBLC/bloc horizontal `widthMax` source. */
    width_max?: EmbeddedWidthMax;
    /** EBLC/bloc index subtable organisation. */
    index_layout?: EmbeddedIndexLayout;
    /** Optional empty TrueType outline tables. */
    outline_tables?: EmbeddedOutlineTables;
    /** `maxp.maxZones` (1 or 2) with [`EmbeddedOutlineTables::EmptyGlyf`]; absent writes 1 (no instructions use the twilight zone). */
    max_zones?: number | null;
    /** Glyph 0 policy. */
    notdef?: EmbeddedNotdef;
    /** EBLC/bloc caret slope numerator and denominator for every strike's horizontal record (native default 1, 0: upright). */
    caret_slope?: number[] | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc line-metric extremes. */
    line_extremes?: EmbeddedLineExtremes;
    /** EBLC/bloc vertical record of horizontal-only strikes. */
    vertical_line_metrics?: EmbeddedVerticalLineMetrics;
    /** `post.underlinePosition` and `underlineThickness` in design units. Replacing a source underline metric is reported as loss. */
    underline?: number[] | null;
    /** hmtx storage. */
    hmtx?: EmbeddedHmtx;
    /** Glyph ID order. */
    glyph_order?: EmbeddedGlyphOrder;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedNotdef`: Glyph 0 of the bitmap font. */
export type EmbeddedNotdef = "preserve" | EmbeddedNotdefEmpty;

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedNotdef::Empty`: No bitmap in any strike and this hmtx advance in design units. Replacing a source `.notdef` glyph is reported as loss. */
export interface EmbeddedNotdefEmpty {
    /** No bitmap in any strike and this hmtx advance in design units. Replacing a source `.notdef` glyph is reported as loss. */
    empty: EmbeddedNotdefEmptyFields;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedNotdef::Empty::fields`: No bitmap in any strike and this hmtx advance in design units. Replacing a source `.notdef` glyph is reported as loss. */
export interface EmbeddedNotdefEmptyFields {
    /** hmtx advance width in design units. */
    advance_width: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedOutlineTables`: Optional TrueType outline tables of a bitmap-only font. */
export type EmbeddedOutlineTables = "none" | "empty_glyf";

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedPostNames`: Whether the post table carries glyph names. */
export type EmbeddedPostNames = "keep" | "omit";

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::EmbeddedReadOptions`: Options for bitmap FontSet extraction. */
export interface EmbeddedReadOptions {
    /** All sfnt, expansion and image budgets. */
    limits?: SfntBitmapLimits;
    /** Color coverage is alpha by default; true uses alpha-weighted darkness. */
    color_darkness?: boolean;
    /** Explicit Gray8-to-Mono threshold. None retains exact gray coverage. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::EmbeddedReferenceStrike`: Source of shared design metrics for native OTB/bdat output. */
export type EmbeddedReferenceStrike = "first" | "largest_ppem" | EmbeddedReferenceStrikeIndex;

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::EmbeddedReferenceStrike::Index`: Zero-based FontSet strike index, then all other strikes in original order. */
export interface EmbeddedReferenceStrikeIndex {
    /** Zero-based FontSet strike index, then all other strikes in original order. */
    index: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::EmbeddedRounding`: Rounding of signed pixel metrics scaled into design units. */
export type EmbeddedRounding = "nearest_ties_away_from_zero" | "nearest_ties_even";

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedUnicodeRanges`: OS/2 `ulUnicodeRange1..4` policy. */
export type EmbeddedUnicodeRanges = "coverage" | "non_bmp_only" | EmbeddedUnicodeRangesExact;

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedUnicodeRanges::Exact`: Exact caller bits. Reserved bits 123..=127 must be clear. */
export interface EmbeddedUnicodeRangesExact {
    /** Exact caller bits. Reserved bits 123..=127 must be clear. */
    exact: number[];
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedVerticalLineMetrics`: EBLC/bloc vertical line metrics of strikes without vertical glyph metrics. */
export type EmbeddedVerticalLineMetrics = "zero" | "mirror_horizontal";

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::metadata::EmbeddedWidthMax`: Source of the EBLC/bloc horizontal `widthMax` line metric. */
export type EmbeddedWidthMax = "bitmap_width" | "advance";

/** `fontpixel::formats::embedded::EmbeddedWriteOptions`: Options for native OTB/bdat output. */
export interface EmbeddedWriteOptions {
    /** All table, bitmap, glyph and output budgets. */
    limits?: SfntBitmapLimits;
    /** Explicit EBSC instructions; an empty list uses retained source EBSC, if any. */
    scaling?: Scale[];
    /** Explicit design units per em in 16..=16384; None preserves automatic scaling. Supported for OTB/bdat, not color output. */
    units_per_em?: number | null;
    /** Source priority for common design metrics; physical strike order is unchanged. */
    reference_strike?: EmbeddedReferenceStrike;
    /** Pixel-to-design scaling only; the OS/2 average retains ties-up rounding. */
    rounding?: EmbeddedRounding;
    /** Explicit head/OS/2/post/name/strike-table metadata; the default keeps native output byte for byte. */
    metadata?: EmbeddedMetadataOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cmap::EncodedCmap`: Serialized cmap and a compatibility fact callers can report. */
export interface EncodedCmap {
    /** Complete table bytes, including full-Unicode format 12 unless [`FullRecords::WhenNeeded`] found format 4 sufficient. */
    data: SerdeBytes;
    /** Whether a complete representable BMP format 4 is included (U+FFFF is only in format 12). False never means the full-Unicode map was truncated. */
    has_bmp_subtable: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::metrics::EncodedMetrics`: Header + metric array bytes. The header's count matches compact storage. */
export interface EncodedMetrics {
    /** hhea or vhea bytes. */
    header: SerdeBytes;
    /** hmtx or vmtx bytes. */
    metrics: SerdeBytes;
    /** Count of full pairs before trailing bearing-only entries. */
    num_long_metrics: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::Encoding`: Image container choice; default infers it from the output name. */
export type Encoding = "png" | "bmp" | "gif" | "tga" | "pbm" | "pgm";

/** `fontpixel::variants::export::Encoded`: Complete standalone sfnt output and conversion diagnostics. */
export interface ExportEncoded {
    /** TTF or OTF bytes with native GSUB. */
    bytes: SerdeBytes;
    /** Source information that could not be represented. */
    report: Report;
}

/** `fontpixel::variants::export::Options`: Native variant output choices, independent from the outer webfont container. */
export interface ExportOptions {
    /** Outline shape. */
    shape?: Shape;
    /** Pixel diameter/side; merged squares require 1. */
    dot_size?: number;
    /** Dot representation at 100 units/pixel and diameter 0.9; default Patterns. */
    dot_reuse?: DotReuse;
    /** Font design units per source pixel. */
    units_per_pixel?: number;
    /** Override units per em; default pixel size times scale. */
    units_per_em?: number | null;
    /** TrueType or CFF. */
    flavor?: OutlineFlavor;
    /** Include a matching monochrome EBDT/EBLC strike. */
    embed_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit Gray8 conversion; absence rejects gray outlines. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Override full family name. */
    family?: string | null;
    /** Style name; default Square/SquareSeparate/Dot. */
    style?: string | null;
    /** Legacy subfamily (name ID 2); absent preserves `Regular`, independent of ID 17. Ignored when an exact `names` table is supplied. */
    legacy_style?: string | null;
    /** Exact full display name; absent retains family/style generation. Ignored when an exact `names` table is supplied. */
    full_name?: string | null;
    /** Exact PostScript name; absent retains existing generation. Ignored when an exact `names` table is supplied. */
    postscript_name?: string | null;
    /** Deterministic version text without the `Version ` prefix. */
    version?: string;
    /** Four-byte vendor identifier. */
    vendor?: string;
    /** Optional copyright override. */
    copyright?: string | null;
    /** Optional license override. */
    license?: string | null;
    /** Optional license URL override. */
    license_url?: string | null;
    /** Replace generated names with an exact caller-supplied name table. */
    names?: NameTable | null;
    /** Glyph 0 policy; the default keeps the source/generated `.notdef`. */
    notdef?: NotdefPolicy;
    /** Explicit head/OS/2/post/maxp/gasp/cmap and glyph-order controls; the default reproduces the native tables. */
    metadata?: MetadataOptions;
    /** Layout, source and output limits. */
    limits?: LayoutLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::os2::Extension`: OS/2 version-2-and-later fields. */
export interface Extension {
    /** x-height, in design units. */
    x_height: number;
    /** Capital height, in design units. */
    cap_height: number;
    /** Default character code. */
    default_char: number;
    /** Break character code. */
    break_char: number;
    /** Maximum context length for shaping lookups. */
    max_context: number;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::extra_formats::ReadOptions`: Read options: explicit KBITX/PBF input choices and PBF/HBF output geometry. */
export interface ExtraFormatsReadOptions {
    /** Explicitly reduce KBITX grayscale during import; default retains exact samples. */
    kbitx_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Crop PBF blank margins during import, with a loss report. */
    pbf_trim?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::extra_formats::WriteOptions`: Write options: explicit KBITX/PBF input choices and PBF/HBF output geometry. */
export interface ExtraFormatsWriteOptions {
    /** Pebble output wire version (default 3). */
    pbf_version?: string | null;
    /** Pebble bitmap encoding; RLE4 requires v3. */
    pbf_compression?: string | null;
    /** Pebble glyph offset width (default auto). */
    pbf_offset_width?: string | null;
    /** Pebble hash bucket count, 1..255 (default 255). */
    pbf_hash_buckets?: number | null;
    /** Pebble Unicode field width; default chooses 2 or 4 bytes. */
    pbf_codepoint_bytes?: string | null;
    /** Pebble line-top baseline override in pixels. */
    pbf_max_height?: number | null;
    /** Pebble BMP fallback codepoint, e.g. U+003F. */
    pbf_wildcard?: string | null;
    /** Relative HBF bitmap asset name, resolved beside the output header. */
    hbf_bitmap_name?: string | null;
    /** Split HBF bitmaps after this many glyphs per asset. */
    hbf_glyphs_per_file?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::commands::FaceValidation`: Checks applied to one strike or sfnt face. */
export interface FaceValidation {
    /** Zero-based strike or face index. */
    font_index: number;
    /** Glyphs in the strike or face. */
    glyph_count: number;
    /** Names of the passed checks. */
    checks: string[];
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::c::Family`: Input/output C dialect. Auto is only valid for reads. */
export type Family = "auto" | "font8x8" | "tmat" | "generic" | "gfx" | "u8g2" | "lvgl" | "netbsd" | "u8glib" | "u8x8";

/** `fontpixel::formats::fbit::FbitCodec`: Registry adapter for fbit and explicitly selected HFNT. */
export interface FbitCodec {
    /** Native input policy. */
    read_options?: FbitReadOptions;
    /** Native output policy. */
    write_options?: FbitWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fbit::FbitReadOptions`: Explicit record and external data-fork interpretation. */
export interface FbitReadOptions {
    /** Kind of a bare resource; envelope resource types are authoritative. */
    kind?: ResourceKind;
    /** Explicit companion for a bare fdef 5/7 resource. */
    data_fork?: ResourcePath | null;
    /** AppleDouble resource companion when the primary asset is its data fork. */
    apple_double_resource?: ResourcePath | null;
    /** Explicit HFNT cell width when the empirical square-root rule is unsuitable. */
    hfnt_width?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fbit::FbitWriteOptions`: Bounded native output policy. */
export interface FbitWriteOptions {
    /** Resource kind for newly generated output. */
    kind?: ResourceKind;
    /** Outer native Macintosh envelope; Bare is the default. */
    container?: NfntContainer;
    /** fbit bitmap storage. HFNT always stores bytes inline. */
    definition?: Definition;
    /** Companion name for bare split output; default is primary name plus `.data`. */
    data_fork?: ResourcePath | null;
    /** Required explicit Gray8 reduction. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Cumulative resource and allocation limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum bytes across the output bundle. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::gsub::Feature`: One feature and its ordered lookup indices. */
export interface Feature {
    /** Usually `locl` for regional fonts. */
    tag: string;
    /** Indices into `Gsub::lookups`. */
    lookups: number[];
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::figlet::FigletCodec`: Registry codec for FIGfont v2. */
export interface FigletCodec {
    /** Typed input choices. */
    read_options?: FigletReadOptions;
    /** Typed output choices. */
    write_options?: FigletWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::figlet::FigletReadOptions`: FIGfont reader choices; non-space bytes always project to ink. */
export interface FigletReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::figlet::FigletWriteOptions`: Bounded FIGfont bitmap output choices. */
export interface FigletWriteOptions {
    /** Override common cell height; otherwise infer it from line height and glyphs. */
    height?: number | null;
    /** Override baseline row count; otherwise use model ascent or glyph tops. */
    baseline?: number | null;
    /** Permit nonnegative legacy code numbers as FIGfont codes. */
    legacy_as_unicode?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale reduction threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum output length, also bounded by reader input limits. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::container::Flavor`: Single-font sfnt flavor. Collection and web wrappers are handled separately. */
export type Flavor = "true_type" | "cff" | "apple_true_type";

/** `fontpixel::formats::fnt::FntCodec`: Configurable registry implementation for Windows raster fonts. */
export interface FntCodec {
    /** Legacy encoding interpretation. */
    read_options?: FntReadOptions;
    /** Output version, code page and limits. */
    write_options?: FntWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fnt::FntReadOptions`: FNT/FON read interpretation; bytes always remain legacy glyph codes. */
export interface FntReadOptions {
    /** Explicit encoding for OEM, symbol, unknown or historical ANSI charsets. It labels legacy codes and does not change their numbers. */
    code_page?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fnt::Version`: Windows raster font version. */
export type FntVersion = "one" | "two" | "three";

/** `fontpixel::formats::fnt::FntWriteOptions`: Bounded deterministic FNT output. */
export interface FntWriteOptions {
    /** None preserves a source FNT version, otherwise defaults to version 2. */
    version?: FntVersion | null;
    /** Windows dfCharSet identifier. None preserves source or infers a known page. */
    charset?: number | null;
    /** Explicit code page for Unicode mapping, including OEM/symbol charsets. */
    code_page?: string | null;
    /** Required for Gray8 input. Conversion is reported as a loss. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Limits on source/model/output work. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum output bytes, independently of aggregate working memory. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fon::FonCodec`: Immutable FON codec; output always uses an NE resource-only container. */
export interface FonCodec {
    /** FNT legacy charset interpretation for every resource. */
    read_options?: FntReadOptions;
    /** FNT version, code page, and shared resource limits for every output font. */
    write_options?: FntWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::FontCharset`: Charset identity and source metadata. Glyph legacy codes belong to this charset; Unicode aliases are independently tagged and never implicitly remapped. */
export interface FontCharset {
    /** Original CHARSET_REGISTRY spelling/value. */
    registry?: string | null;
    /** Original CHARSET_ENCODING spelling/value. */
    encoding?: string | null;
    /** Optional explicit codec override (canonicalization performed by CharsetCodec). */
    name?: string | null;
    /** Explicit GL interpretation when the source establishes it. */
    gl?: boolean | null;
    /** Original Windows/FNT character-set byte, if present. */
    windows_charset?: number | null;
    /** Explicit source code page when supplied. */
    code_page?: number | null;
    /** Original HBF/other code ranges, inclusive and in source order. */
    code_ranges: [number, number][];
}

/** `fontpixel::model::Font`: A single size/style strike with file-order glyphs and an indexed cmap. Private storage prevents stale indexes after edits; clone preserves stable IDs. */
export interface FontDict {
    /** Glyph slots by stable ID; removed slots are None. */
    glyphs: (GlyphDict | null)[];
    /** Font-wide metrics. */
    metrics: FontMetrics;
    /** Naming fields. */
    names: FontNames;
    /** Declared charset. */
    charset: FontCharset;
    /** Format ID the font was read from. */
    source_format?: string | null;
    /** Format header properties. */
    headers: PropertiesDict;
    /** Font properties. */
    properties: PropertiesDict;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::FontMetrics`: Per-strike metrics; absence is distinct from a specified value of zero. */
export interface FontMetrics {
    /** Nominal pixel size. */
    pixel_size?: number | null;
    /** Horizontal pixels per em. */
    ppem_x?: number | null;
    /** Vertical pixels per em. */
    ppem_y?: number | null;
    /** Exact typographic point size. */
    point_size?: Rational | null;
    /** Horizontal/vertical dots per inch. */
    resolution?: Vector | null;
    /** Baseline-to-top distance. */
    ascent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Baseline-to-bottom distance (usually positive). */
    descent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Font cell/ink bounds, exactly as supplied by the source. */
    bounds?: Bounds | null;
    /** Additional line gap. */
    line_gap?: WideInt | null;
    /** Explicit baseline-to-baseline distance, independent of line gap. */
    line_height?: WideInt | null;
    /** Underline position relative to baseline. */
    underline_position?: WideInt | null;
    /** Underline thickness. */
    underline_thickness?: WideInt | null;
    /** Default glyph ID in this font (if separately specified). */
    default_glyph?: GlyphId | null;
    /** Default code in its explicit encoding domain. */
    default_character?: CodepointDict | null;
    /** Space advance if separately specified. */
    space_width?: WideInt | null;
    /** P/M/C spacing classification. */
    spacing?: Spacing | null;
    /** Font-level BDF defaults, inherited by codecs when individual metrics are absent. */
    glyph_defaults: GlyphMetrics;
    /** BDF METRICSSET (0, 1 or 2); unknown source values remain in raw headers. */
    metrics_set?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::FontNames`: Names and human-readable metadata, without discarding their original properties. */
export interface FontNames {
    /** Family name. */
    family?: string | null;
    /** Style/subfamily name. */
    style?: string | null;
    /** Full display name. */
    full?: string | null;
    /** PostScript name. */
    postscript?: string | null;
    /** Version string. */
    version?: string | null;
    /** Copyright statement. */
    copyright?: string | null;
    /** License text or identifier. */
    license?: string | null;
    /** License URL if separate from the text. */
    license_url?: string | null;
    /** Foundry/vendor name. */
    foundry?: string | null;
    /** Original BDF FONT/XLFD name (not regenerated from normalized names). */
    xlfd?: string | null;
    /** Parsed XLFD fields in source order, retaining empty fields. */
    xlfd_fields: string[];
    /** Additional language/platform-specific names in source order. */
    localized: PropertiesDict;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::FontSet`: All strikes/styles in one logical input, in source file order. */
export interface FontSetDict {
    /** Ordered strikes. No single-strike format may silently select one. */
    fonts: FontDict[];
    /** Original container metadata in file order. */
    properties: PropertiesDict;
    /** Container/source format identifier, if known. */
    source_format?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fontx2::Fontx2Codec`: Native registry codec. */
export interface Fontx2Codec {
    /** Reader charset declaration. */
    read_options?: Fontx2ReadOptions;
    /** Writer configuration. */
    write_options?: Fontx2WriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fontx2::Fontx2ReadOptions`: Reader charset declaration; source codes are always retained as Legacy. */
export interface Fontx2ReadOptions {
    /** Explicit charset override. Defaults to Shift-JIS for DBCS and unknown ANK. */
    charset?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fontx2::Fontx2WriteOptions`: Bounded, deterministic writer configuration. */
export interface Fontx2WriteOptions {
    /** Single-byte, double-byte or automatic selection. */
    mode?: CodeMode;
    /** Output charset. ANK requires an explicit charset for Unicode conversion. */
    charset?: string | null;
    /** Cell width; otherwise source cell or maximum bitmap width. */
    width?: number | null;
    /** Cell height; otherwise source cell or maximum bitmap height. */
    height?: number | null;
    /** Explicit grayscale threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Readback-compatible resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum generated bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::FormatInfo`: Static format metadata, including compiled feature state. */
export interface FormatInfo {
    /** Stable CLI/API identifier. */
    id: string;
    /** Human-readable name. */
    name: string;
    /** Possible extensions without dots; hints only, including compound suffixes. */
    extensions: string[];
    /** Whether this build enables the format's Cargo feature. */
    feature_enabled: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::FormatStatus`: Available hooks, separate from catalogue membership and feature selection. */
export interface FormatStatus {
    /** Catalogue information. */
    format: FormatInfo;
    /** An actual content detector is registered. */
    detect: boolean;
    /** An actual reader is registered. */
    read: boolean;
    /** An actual writer is registered. */
    write: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::ReadOptions`: Common options; each implemented format will add strongly typed options. */
export interface FormatsReadOptions {
    /** Explicit ID bypassing auto-detection. */
    format?: string | null;
    /** Input resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::inspect::FormatsRequest`: List every catalogue format with its compiled implementation status. */
export interface FormatsRequest {
    /** Emit machine-readable metadata and capability flags. */
    json?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::WriteOptions`: Common write options. Format-specific options belong to later format modules. */
export interface FormatsWriteOptions {
    /** Refuse to return assets if the combined read/write report has loss. Omitted in serialized form means `false`, as in [`WriteOptions::new`]. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Primary relative output name; codecs may add sibling/nested sidecars. */
    primary_name: ResourcePath;
    /** Additional native-write and gzip/envelope budgets. `None` preserves the typed writer's limits. Present limits intersect those limits, so a common setting cannot silently enlarge a codec budget, with one exception: the built-in outline writers (`ttf`, `otf`, `woff`, `woff2`, `ttc`, `vector-raster`) whose own total is still the default 256 MiB take a larger common `max_total_bytes` as their total, so an explicit larger budget can admit a larger outline or webfont job. Built-in native wrappers validate the model and restrict their codec before writing; compressed output also enforces the applicable envelope and replay budgets. Plain output additionally checks the sum of all returned asset lengths against `max_output_bytes`, after error/strict diagnostics. Codecs without a native output cap may encode under their resource budget before this returned-output check. A typed per-asset cap is not an aggregate cap. */
    transport_limits?: TransportLimits | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cmap::FullRecords`: Which cmap encoding records list the full-repertoire format-12 subtable. */
export type FullRecords = "always" | "non-bmp" | "when-needed";

/** `fontpixel::formats::fzx::FzxCodec`: Registry codec for FZX. */
export interface FzxCodec {
    /** Typed input choices. */
    read_options?: FzxReadOptions;
    /** Typed output choices. */
    write_options?: FzxWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fzx::FzxReadOptions`: FZX reader options; the standard has a single wire layout. */
export interface FzxReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::fzx::FzxWriteOptions`: Bounded FZX writing choices. */
export interface FzxWriteOptions {
    /** Explicit line height; otherwise use model line height or pixel size. */
    height?: number | null;
    /** Explicit tracking; otherwise retain source value or infer a common gap. */
    tracking?: number | null;
    /** Permit Unicode numbers as legacy byte positions. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale reduction threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared resource budget. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Output cap, also bounded by reader input limits. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::variants::metadata::GaspPolicy`: Whether the export writes a `gasp` table. */
export type GaspPolicy = "write" | "omit";

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::gasp::GaspTable`: Explicit gasp table, ordered by inclusive upper bound. */
export interface GaspTable {
    /** Version 0 permits bits 0–1, version 1 permits bits 0–3. */
    version: number;
    /** Strictly ascending ranges ending at 65535. */
    ranges: Range[];
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::gdr::GdrCodec`: Registry codec. */
export interface GdrCodec {
    /** Character interpretation. */
    read_options?: GdrReadOptions;
    /** Output choices. */
    write_options?: GdrWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::gdr::GdrReadOptions`: Input character interpretation. */
export interface GdrReadOptions {
    /** Interpret native 16-bit character codes as Unicode, default true. */
    unicode?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::gdr::GdrVersion`: Supported native strike descriptor versions. */
export type GdrVersion = "v39" | "v40" | "v41" | "v42";

/** `fontpixel::formats::gdr::GdrWriteOptions`: Bounded native GDR output choices. */
export interface GdrWriteOptions {
    /** Native strike descriptor layout. */
    version?: GdrVersion;
    /** Collection UID; absent preserves `gdr.collection_uid`, or zero. */
    collection_uid?: number | null;
    /** Use Unicode mappings, or explicitly interpret legacy code numbers. */
    unicode?: boolean;
    /** Explicit threshold for grayscale input. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared allocation/geometry limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum encoded file length. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::gem::GemCodec`: Registry codec. */
export interface GemCodec {
    /** Reader interpretation. */
    read_options?: GemReadOptions;
    /** Writer choices. */
    write_options?: GemWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::gem::GemReadOptions`: Explicit GEM input interpretation. */
export interface GemReadOptions {
    /** Integer order; absent requires unique structural detection. */
    byte_order?: ByteOrder | null;
    /** Raster word order; absent follows the standard-form flag. */
    bitmap_word_order?: ByteOrder | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::gem::GemWriteOptions`: Bounded GEM output choices. */
export interface GemWriteOptions {
    /** Integer byte order, default Motorola big endian. */
    byte_order?: ByteOrder;
    /** Raster word order, independent of integer byte order. */
    bitmap_word_order?: ByteOrder;
    /** Explicitly allow Unicode scalar numbers as untagged legacy codes. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Shared geometry and allocation limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum output length, also bounded by reader limits. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
    /** Explicit threshold for grayscale input; absent rejects grayscale. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::GeometricWidth`: Explicit width policy for geometric symbols. */
export type GeometricWidth = "half" | "full";

/** `fontpixel::formats::hzk::Geometry`: Complete interpretation of a headerless file; no field is inferred from its name. */
export interface Geometry {
    /** Logical bitmap width, excluding low padding bits. */
    width: number;
    /** Logical bitmap height. */
    height: number;
    /** First raw slot code (e.g. 0xa1a1 or 0xb0a1). */
    first_code: number;
    /** Final permitted raw slot code, inclusive. */
    last_code: number;
    /** GB2312 grid or ASC linear slots. */
    code_space: CodeSpace;
    /** Row-major or transposed column-major bytes. */
    storage: Storage;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::geos::GeosCodec`: Native registry codec. */
export interface GeosCodec {
    /** Input policy. */
    read_options?: GeosReadOptions;
    /** Output policy. */
    write_options?: GeosWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::geos::GeosContainer`: Native resource packaging. */
export type GeosContainer = "bare" | "cvt";

/** `fontpixel::formats::geos::GeosReadOptions`: Ambiguous final character policy. */
export interface GeosReadOptions {
    /** Decode the later DEL entry; false accepts original 95-character resources. */
    include_del?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::geos::GeosVariant`: GEOS strike families, including the documented Bits'N'Picas extensions. */
export type GeosVariant = "standard" | "extended" | "utf8" | "mega" | "mega_utf8";

/** `fontpixel::formats::geos::GeosWriteOptions`: Bounded native output choices. */
export interface GeosWriteOptions {
    /** Container; absent preserves source packaging, otherwise CVT. */
    container?: GeosContainer | null;
    /** Strike family; absent preserves each strike's family. */
    variant?: GeosVariant | null;
    /** Include DEL; absent preserves the read policy, otherwise false. */
    include_del?: boolean | null;
    /** Native ten-bit font identifier. */
    font_id?: number | null;
    /** Directory name, up to sixteen Latin-1 bytes. */
    family?: string | null;
    /** Reuse a native resource only after a complete same-limit model comparison. */
    preserve_native?: boolean;
    /** Explicit permission to interpret Unicode scalars as original byte codes. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit permission to interpret legacy codes as Unicode in extended output. */
    legacy_as_unicode?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Output cap, also bounded by max_input_bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::gf::GfCodec`: Registry codec for GF fonts. */
export interface GfCodec {
    /** Typed TeX output choices. */
    write_options?: TexWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::Encoded`: Encoded outlines and values the caller must reconcile with head/maxp. */
export interface GlyfEncoded {
    /** Glyph data, each entry aligned to two bytes. */
    glyf: SerdeBytes;
    /** Location table with `numGlyphs + 1` entries. */
    loca: SerdeBytes;
    /** Value for head.indexToLocFormat (0 or 1). */
    index_to_loc_format: number;
    /** Whole-font control-point bounds, or zeros for all-empty fonts. */
    bounds: number[];
    /** Recomputed geometry maxima. */
    statistics: Statistics;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::Limits`: Geometry and work limits in addition to the common sfnt byte budgets. */
export interface GlyfLimits {
    /** Container/table/glyph budgets. */
    sfnt?: SfntLimits;
    /** Per-glyph expanded geometry budgets. */
    geometry?: OutlineLimits;
    /** Maximum components in one composite. */
    max_components?: number;
    /** Maximum nested composite depth (hard ceiling 64). */
    max_depth?: number;
    /** Maximum graph-node visits while expanding one glyph, including empty nodes. */
    max_visits?: number;
    /** Cumulative simple points across the font. */
    max_total_points?: number;
    /** Cumulative component records across the font. */
    max_total_components?: number;
    /** Cumulative instruction bytes across the font. */
    max_total_instructions?: number;
    /** Cumulative graph-node visits while encoding an entire font. */
    max_total_visits?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::GlyfTable`: Parsed glyph order, beginning with glyph 0 (`.notdef`). */
export interface GlyfTable {
    /** Stable glyph-ID order. */
    glyphs: SfntGlyfGlyph[];
}

/** `fontpixel::model::GlyphBitmap`: Runtime bitmap depth for a glyph. Conversions must be requested explicitly. */
export type GlyphBitmap = GlyphBitmapMono | GlyphBitmapGray8;

/** `fontpixel::model::GlyphBitmap::Gray8`: Byte-per-pixel grayscale raster. */
export interface GlyphBitmapGray8 {
    /** Byte-per-pixel grayscale raster. */
    gray8: BitmapDict;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::GlyphBitmap::Mono`: Compact monochrome raster. */
export interface GlyphBitmapMono {
    /** Compact monochrome raster. */
    mono: BitmapDict;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::Glyph`: One glyph, including unencoded glyphs, multiple mappings and Unicode sequences. Extra source attributes retain insertion order, spelling, duplicates and raw data. */
export interface GlyphDict {
    /** Zero, one or several encodings in their original order. */
    codepoints: CodepointDict[];
    /** Unicode sequences (e.g. PSF combining entries), distinct from aliases. */
    unicode_sequences: number[][];
    /** Original STARTCHAR/PostScript/format-specific name, if present. */
    name?: string | null;
    /** Horizontal, vertical and optional source-specific metrics. */
    metrics: GlyphMetrics;
    /** Only the source BBX rectangle, not a whole-font cell. */
    bitmap: GlyphBitmap;
    /** Original per-glyph fields, including unencoded alternate codes if needed. */
    properties: PropertiesDict;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::qpf2::GlyphFormat`: Raster representation declared by the QPF2 header. */
export type GlyphFormat = "gray8" | "mono";

/** `fontpixel::model::GlyphId` */
export type GlyphId = number;

/** `fontpixel::model::GlyphMetrics`: Glyph metrics. `None` means absent, distinct from an explicit zero vector. */
export interface GlyphMetrics {
    /** Ink rectangle dimensions must match the bitmap; offsets are relative to origin. */
    bounds: Bounds;
    /** Horizontal device advance (BDF DWIDTH). */
    advance?: Vector | null;
    /** Horizontal scalable advance (BDF SWIDTH, normally per 1000 units). */
    scalable_advance?: Vector | null;
    /** Vertical device advance (BDF DWIDTH1). */
    vertical_advance?: Vector | null;
    /** Vertical scalable advance (BDF SWIDTH1). */
    vertical_scalable_advance?: Vector | null;
    /** BDF VVECTOR (vector from horizontal to vertical origin). */
    vertical_origin?: Vector | null;
    /** Optional independent FNT ABC spacing. */
    abc?: AbcWidths | null;
    /** Other formats' left side bearing, when explicitly supplied. */
    left_bearing?: WideInt | null;
    /** Other formats' right side bearing, when explicitly supplied. */
    right_bearing?: WideInt | null;
    /** Top-left image-relative offset (e.g. BMFont); not confused with y-up BBX. */
    image_offset?: Vector | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcf::GlyphPad`: Alignment of each bitmap row in bytes. */
export type GlyphPad = "1" | "2" | "4" | "8";

/** `fontpixel::formats::gpi::GpiCodec`: Native registry codec. */
export interface GpiCodec {
    /** Input policy. */
    read_options?: GpiReadOptions;
    /** Output policy. */
    write_options?: GpiWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::gpi::GpiContainer`: Native GPI resource packaging. */
export type GpiContainer = "bare" | "ne" | "lx";

/** `fontpixel::formats::gpi::GpiKind`: Native character increment representation. */
export type GpiKind = "fixed" | "proportional" | "abc";

/** `fontpixel::formats::gpi::GpiReadOptions`: Native optional-glyph policy. */
export interface GpiReadOptions {
    /** Retain the extra unmapped .null descriptor when the table has one. */
    include_unmapped_null?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::gpi::GpiWriteOptions`: Bounded native output policy. */
export interface GpiWriteOptions {
    /** Container; absent preserves source, otherwise bare for one strike and LX for many. */
    container?: GpiContainer | null;
    /** Native increment kind; absent preserves source, otherwise type 3. */
    kind?: GpiKind | null;
    /** OS/2 code-page field; zero and 850 identify UGL without reinterpreting codes. */
    codepage?: number | null;
    /** Registered native font identifier. */
    registry_id?: number | null;
    /** Reuse bytes only after a full same-limit model comparison. */
    preserve_native?: boolean;
    /** Explicit permission to use Unicode numbers as native legacy codes. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Output cap, also bounded by max_input_bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::grasp::GraspCodec`: Native grasp codec. */
export interface GraspCodec {
    /** Reader interpretation. */
    read_options?: NativeReadOptions;
    /** Writer projection and bounds. */
    write_options?: W5a2CommonNativeWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::gsub::Gsub`: Lossless semantics of GSUB 1.0/1.1 without variation or filtering behavior. */
export interface Gsub {
    /** Script and language feature routing. */
    scripts: Record<string, Script>;
    /** Feature records, with duplicates allowed as OpenType requires. */
    features: Feature[];
    /** Single-substitution maps, in application order. */
    lookups: Record<string, number>[];
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hanfont::HanfontCodec`: Strongly typed registry codec. */
export interface HanfontCodec {
    /** Input interpretation. */
    read_options?: HanfontReadOptions;
    /** Output policy. */
    write_options?: HanfontWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hanfont::HanfontReadOptions`: Explicit layout and requested projection. */
export interface HanfontReadOptions {
    /** Native layout. */
    layout?: Layout;
    /** Native component slots or composed syllables. */
    mode?: ReadMode;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hanfont::HanfontWriteOptions`: Native component output; no inferred inverse decomposition is performed. */
export interface HanfontWriteOptions {
    /** Native layout. */
    layout?: Layout;
    /** Explicit grayscale reduction for component glyphs. */

    /** Cumulative source, output and default-readback budgets. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum generated bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hbf::HbfCodec`: Registry HBF codec. Reads are controlled by the common resource limits. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hbf::writer::HbfWriteOptions`: Deterministic HBF header and bitmap-asset choices. */
export interface HbfWriteOptions {
    /** Bitmap name relative to the header directory; default is the header stem plus `.bin`. */
    bitmap_name?: ResourcePath | null;
    /** Maximum glyphs per bitmap asset; `None` writes one file. Must be positive. */
    glyphs_per_file?: number | null;
    /** Threshold for Gray8 conversion; `None` refuses grayscale input. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Glyph, pixel, metadata and aggregate output limits. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hex::HexCodec`: Registry codec; read/write options are independent. */
export interface HexCodec {
    /** Explicit input geometry. */
    read_options?: HexReadOptions;
    /** Output choices. */
    write_options?: HexWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hex::HexReadOptions`: Geometry not encoded in a HEX file. Defaults to height 16 and descent zero. */
export interface HexReadOptions {
    /** Positive number of rows in each glyph; never guessed from record length. */
    height?: number;
    /** Baseline-to-cell-bottom distance, at most height. */
    descent?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hex::HexWriteOptions`: Deterministic HEX writer choices. */
export interface HexWriteOptions {
    /** Geometry used by the consumer; must match its read options. */
    geometry?: HexReadOptions;
    /** Gray8 threshold, required for grayscale input. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Glyph, pixel, record and cumulative resource budgets. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum generated bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p3_formats::historical::ReadOptions`: Read options: native historical printer-font variants and associated metric files. */
export interface HistoricalReadOptions {
    /** Require a Daisy-Dot input generation. */
    daisy_read_version?: string | null;
    /** PolyPrint baseline measured from the cell top. */
    polyprint_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Print Shop baseline measured from the cell top. */
    printshop_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a TasPrint input platform. */
    tasprint_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit PCW input width. */
    tasprint_read_width?: number | null;
    /** Require PXL version 1001 or 1002. */
    pxl_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Scoped TFM sidecar path for PXL input. */
    pxl_read_tfm?: string | null;
    /** Require a Signum editor or printer input layout. */
    signum_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Signum baseline. */
    signum_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Explicit Signum line height. */
    signum_line_height?: WideInt | null;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p3_formats::historical::WriteOptions`: Write options: native historical printer-font variants and associated metric files. */
export interface HistoricalWriteOptions {
    /** Daisy-Dot output generation (default 3). */
    daisy_version?: string | null;
    /** Actual Daisy-Dot height marker plus one. */
    daisy_height?: number | null;
    /** Daisy-Dot underline row, which defines its baseline. */
    daisy_underline?: number | null;
    /** Explicitly allow graphics bytes forbidden by the Daisy-Dot manual. */
    daisy_allow_control_bytes?: boolean;
    /** TasPrint output platform (default 48k). */
    tasprint_version?: string | null;
    /** TasPrint PCW output width. */
    tasprint_width?: number | null;
    /** PCW character count: the documented 127 or observed 128. */
    tasprint_pcw_count?: number | null;
    /** Native PXL output generation (default 1001). */
    pxl_version?: string | null;
    /** Optional relative name of the generated PXL metric sidecar. */
    pxl_tfm?: string | null;
    /** PXL magnification value. */
    pxl_magnification?: number | null;
    /** Signum output layout (default e24). */
    signum_version?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hmzk::HmzkCodec`: Registry codec with explicit native input and output choices. */
export interface HmzkCodec {
    /** Native input options. */
    read_options?: HmzkReadOptions;
    /** Native output options. */
    write_options?: HmzkWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hmzk::HmzkReadOptions`: HMZK has one native wire layout. */
export interface HmzkReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hmzk::HmzkWriteOptions`: Explicit coverage reduction and cumulative output limits. */
export interface HmzkWriteOptions {
    /** Grayscale-to-monochrome threshold; absent means no implicit conversion. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Cumulative source, scratch, output and readback budget. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Additional primary output byte cap. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hppcl::HppclCodec`: Registry codec. */
export interface HppclCodec {
    /** Input interpretation. */
    read_options?: HppclReadOptions;
    /** Output choices. */
    write_options?: HppclWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hppcl::HppclCompression`: Raster encoding. */
export type HppclCompression = "raw" | "rle";

/** `fontpixel::formats::hppcl::HppclOrientation`: Raster orientation in the physical printer coordinate system. */
export type HppclOrientation = "portrait" | "landscape" | "reverse_portrait" | "reverse_landscape";

/** `fontpixel::formats::hppcl::HppclReadOptions`: Input compatibility policy. */
export interface HppclReadOptions {
    /** Accept the historical monobit writer's 16-byte descriptor-size field when an exact class-1 payload proves its actual descriptor is 14 bytes. */
    allow_legacy_descriptor_size?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hppcl::HppclWriteOptions`: Native bounded output choices. */
export interface HppclWriteOptions {
    /** Physical raster orientation. */
    orientation?: HppclOrientation;
    /** Character compression. */
    compression?: HppclCompression;
    /** Maximum character-command payload, including its common/descriptor bytes. */
    continuation_bytes?: number;
    /** Use format 20 and these explicit horizontal/vertical resolutions. */
    resolution?: [number, number] | null;
    /** Explicit PCL symbol-set number; no Unicode encoding is inferred. */
    symbol_set?: number | null;
    /** Permit numeric Unicode positions. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale reduction. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared ceilings. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Output cap. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hrcg::HrcgCodec`: Native hrcg codec. */
export interface HrcgCodec {
    /** Reader interpretation. */
    read_options?: NativeReadOptions;
    /** Writer projection and bounds. */
    write_options?: W5a2CommonNativeWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hzk::HzkCodec`: Registry codec. The registry deliberately does not install a content detector. */

    /** Explicit output interpretation. */
    write_options?: HzkWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hzk::HzkReadOptions`: Explicit HZK/ASC read configuration. Defaults intentionally require a preset. */
export interface HzkReadOptions {
    /** Conventional named layout. */
    preset?: Preset | null;
    /** Complete geometry, overriding the preset when present. */

    /** Require an exact slot count; otherwise infer count from whole glyph records. */
    glyph_count?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hzk::HzkWriteOptions`: Deterministic raw-font output configuration. */
export interface HzkWriteOptions {
    /** Conventional named layout. */
    preset?: Preset | null;
    /** Complete geometry, overriding the preset when present. */
    geometry?: Geometry | null;
    /** Explicit output slots; otherwise stop at the last mapped slot. */
    glyph_count?: number | null;
    /** Explicit threshold for grayscale input. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Readback-compatible resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum output size. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::iigs::IigsCodec`: Registry codec with independent read and write choices. */
export interface IigsCodec {
    /** Legacy code interpretation. */
    read_options?: IigsReadOptions;
    /** Native output policy. */
    write_options?: IigsWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::iigs::Container`: Outer representation of one QuickDraw II font data fork. */
export type IigsContainer = "bare" | "binscii";

/** `fontpixel::formats::iigs::IigsReadOptions`: Explicit interpretation of otherwise unlabelled byte character codes. */

    /** Legacy charset name. Codes are never implicitly converted to Unicode. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::iigs::Version`: QuickDraw II font record version. */
export type IigsVersion = "auto" | "1.1" | "1.5";

/** `fontpixel::formats::iigs::IigsWriteOptions`: Deterministic bounded QuickDraw II output options. */
export interface IigsWriteOptions {
    /** Native data fork or segmented text transport. */
    container?: IigsContainer;
    /** Header version policy. */

    /** Explicit Gray8-to-Mono reduction; absence rejects Gray8 output. */

    /** Source, native, output and default-readback allocation limits. */

    /** Maximum output size. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::ImageCodec`: Image codec installed by the `image` feature. */

    /** Input mapping and native directory profile. */

    /** Output packing and limits. */
    write_options?: ImageWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::image_formats::ReadOptions`: Read options: explicit atlas and native image-directory options. */
export interface ImageFormatsReadOptions {
    /** Relative JSON/TOML atlas mapping, resolved beside the primary input. */
    image_mapping?: string | null;
    /** Literal prefix on numeric glyph filenames in an input directory. */
    image_read_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Input directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_read_radix?: number | null;
    /** Input filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_read_domain?: string | null;
    /** Input image background (default black). */
    image_read_background?: string | null;
    /** Input glyph baseline measured down from each image's top. */
    image_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::image_formats::WriteOptions`: Write options: explicit atlas and native image-directory options. */
export interface ImageFormatsWriteOptions {
    /** Output image organization (default atlas). */
    image_layout?: string | null;
    /** Explicit image container (directory default png; atlas uses extension). */
    image_encoding?: string | null;
    /** Atlas columns (default 16). */
    image_columns?: number | null;
    /** Atlas mapping format (default json). */
    image_mapping_format?: string | null;
    /** Literal prefix on numeric output glyph filenames. */
    image_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Output directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_radix?: number | null;
    /** Output filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_domain?: string | null;
    /** Output image background (default black). */
    image_background?: string | null;
    /** Output glyph baseline measured down from the image top. */
    image_baseline?: WideInt | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::imageset::ImageLayout`: Native image organization. */
export type ImageLayout = "atlas" | "imageset";

/** `fontpixel::render::image::ImageOptions`: Image export options shared by PNG and SVG. */
export interface ImageOptions {
    /** Positive integer nearest-neighbor scale (SVG viewBox remains unscaled). */
    scale?: number;
    /** Ink color. */
    foreground?: Rgba;
    /** Paper color; transparent is supported explicitly. */
    background?: Rgba;
    /** Scaled dimensions/pixels and encoded-output byte budget. */
    limits?: BitmapLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::ImageReadOptions`: Atlas mapping or native directory interpretation. */
export interface ImageReadOptions {
    /** Filename labels and coverage for a native directory input. */
    imageset?: ImageSetOptions;
    /** Explicit mapping; mutually exclusive with mapping_path. */
    mapping?: Mapping | null;
    /** Caller-authorized relative JSON/TOML mapping asset. */
    mapping_path?: ResourcePath | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::imageset::ImageSetBackground`: Explicit coverage projection for the native glyph images. */
export type ImageSetBackground = "black" | "white" | "alpha";

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::imageset::ImageSetDomain`: Domain supplied by the caller; filenames themselves carry only integers. */
export type ImageSetDomain = "legacy" | "unicode";

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::imageset::ImageSetOptions`: Native directory naming and interpretation, with no private metadata file. */
export interface ImageSetOptions {
    /** Literal filename prefix, default empty; must contain no path separator. */
    prefix?: string;
    /** Integer radix from 2 through 36, default hexadecimal. */
    radix?: number;
    /** Explicit interpretation of the filename number. */
    domain?: ImageSetDomain;
    /** Explicit grayscale or transparency interpretation. */
    background?: ImageSetBackground;
    /** Optional baseline measured from each image's top; absent means bottom. */
    baseline?: WideInt | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::ImageWriteOptions`: Bounded deterministic atlas or native directory output. */
export interface ImageWriteOptions {
    /** Atlas with mapping, or native separately labelled glyph images. */
    layout?: ImageLayout;
    /** Native directory labels, coverage and optional external baseline. */
    imageset?: ImageSetOptions;
    /** Container override; otherwise use output extension. */
    encoding?: Encoding | null;
    /** JSON by default. */
    mapping_format?: MappingFormat;
    /** Number of fixed-size atlas cells in each row; default 16. */
    columns?: number;
    /** Explicit threshold required for Gray8 to GIF/PBM conversion. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Output and intermediate resource budgets. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::report::Impact`: Effect on source information. Strict mode rejects `Loss` at any severity. */
export type Impact = "none" | "repair" | "loss";

/** `fontpixel_ops::inspect::InfoRequest`: Inspect a font, including its metrics, properties and diagnostics. */
export interface InfoRequest {
    /** Primary input asset. */
    input?: string;
    /** Explicit input format, otherwise use structural detection then hints. */
    from?: string | null;
    /** Emit machine-readable font information and diagnostics. */
    json?: boolean;
    /** Explicit raw layout preset (VGA, C64, Spectrum, CH8, MSX or Harlekin). */

    /** Raw glyph width; overrides a selected preset. */

    /** Raw glyph height; overrides a selected preset. */

    /** Exact raw glyph count; otherwise consume complete records. */

    /** First raw slot code, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    raw_first?: string | null;
    /** Bit order within each raw byte (default msb). */

    /** Raw row order (default top-down). */
    raw_row_order?: string | null;
    /** Raw alignment: byte-aligned rows or continuous packed bits. */
    raw_packing?: string | null;
    /** Row-major or byte-column-major storage within each horizontal strip. */
    raw_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Glyph cells placed side by side in each raw horizontal strip (default 1). */
    raw_strike_count?: number | null;
    /** Extra padding bytes after every raw row. */
    raw_row_padding?: number | null;
    /** Prefix bytes before the first raw glyph. */
    raw_offset?: number | null;
    /** Fallback two-byte little-endian load address when no matching source prefix exists. */
    raw_default_load_address?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset identity of raw slot codes. */
    raw_charset?: string | null;
    /** DOS CPI input pointers (default linear). */

    /** Exact charset label of FONTX2 source codes. */
