    /** Explicit HZK/ASC preset, e.g. HZK16, HZK24S, ASC16. */
    hzk_preset?: string | null;
    /** HZK glyph width; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_width?: number | null;
    /** HZK glyph height; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_height?: number | null;
    /** HZK first slot code, e.g. 0xA1A1. */
    hzk_first?: string | null;
    /** HZK last permitted slot code, inclusive. */
    hzk_last?: string | null;
    /** HZK slot domain for custom geometry. */
    hzk_code_space?: string | null;
    /** HZK bitmap storage orientation (default rows). */
    hzk_storage?: string | null;
    /** Exact HZK input or output glyph count. */
    hzk_count?: number | null;
    /** Explicit NFNT legacy charset label. */

    /** Relative AppleDouble companion when reading the data fork. */

    /** Explicitly threshold imported BMFont grayscale; default preserves samples. */

    /** GEM input bitmap word order; default follows its header flag. */
    gem_read_word_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input integer order; default uses version stamps. */
    snf_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input bitmap layout: bits,bytes,row-padding,scan-unit,rows; e.g. msb,big,4,1,top-down. */
    snf_read_layout?: string | null;
    /** Scoped PNG mask for a PILfont descriptor (its native suffix is .pbm). */

    /** Scoped PNG atlas for a Playdate FNT descriptor. */
    playdate_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell width. */
    playdate_read_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell height. */
    playdate_read_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for MGTK legacy positions; no implicit Unicode remapping. */
    mgtk_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Family name supplied externally for a QPF font. */
    qpf_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Require the DAVIC specification or FreeType PFR wire dialect. */

    /** Require a Xerox native font family. */
    xerox_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicit baseline for Alto files with a zero native header baseline. */

    /** Require the SBCS or DBCS PC/GEOS layout. */
    pcgeos_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly round fractional PC/GEOS input metrics. */
    pcgeos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Retain the additional GPI unmapped null descriptor (default true). */
    gpi_include_unmapped_null?: boolean | null;
    /** Require a RISC OS bitmap generation. */
    riscos_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Relative RISC OS IntMetrics input companion. */

    /** Explicit marker-image dialect; otherwise inspect native controls. */

    /** Ordered SFont labels, comma-separated U+0041 or legacy:0x41. */
    sfont_read_codepoints?: string[];
    /** SFont baseline down from glyph top. */
    sfont_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a Daisy-Dot input generation. */
    daisy_read_version?: string | null;
    /** PolyPrint baseline measured from the cell top. */
    polyprint_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Print Shop baseline measured from the cell top. */
    printshop_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a TasPrint input platform. */
    tasprint_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit PCW input width. */
    tasprint_read_width?: number | null;
    /** Require PXL version 1001 or 1002. */
    pxl_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Scoped TFM sidecar path for PXL input. */
    pxl_read_tfm?: string | null;
    /** Require a Signum editor or printer input layout. */
    signum_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Signum baseline. */
    signum_baseline?: WideInt | null;

export interface LisaWriteOptions {
    /** Native compression policy. */
    compression?: LisaCompression;
    /** Explicit Gray8-to-Mono threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Cumulative source/model/expansion/output/reread limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum output bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::Loaded`: A decoded model and all read diagnostics. */
export interface LoadedDict {
    /** Decoded model (`FontSet` for the built-in font registry). */
    fonts: unknown;
    /** Reader diagnostics. */
    report: Report;
    /** The actual format used to decode the input. */
    format: string;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::LocaFormat`: Loca serialization choice. */
export type LocaFormat = "auto" | "short" | "long";

/** `fontpixel::report::Location`: Optional location; glyph index and codepoint need not both be known. */
export interface Location {
    /** Strike/font index in a collection. */
    font_index?: number | null;
    /** Original glyph index, including unencoded glyphs. */
    glyph_index?: number | null;
    /** Original code (not assumed to be a Unicode scalar). */
    codepoint?: number | null;
    /** Source asset, if known. */
    asset?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::metrics::LongMetric`: A long metric, in font design units, in glyph-ID order. */
export interface LongMetric {
    /** Advance width or height. */
    advance: number;
    /** Left or top side bearing. */
    bearing: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::c::LvglBpp`: Native LVGL output coverage depth. */
export type LvglBpp = "one" | "two" | "four" | "eight";

/** `fontpixel::formats::c::LvglCompression`: Native LVGL bitmap storage. */
export type LvglCompression = "plain" | "rle" | "rle_xor";

/** `fontpixel_ops::p2_formats::mac::ReadOptions`: Read options: macintosh resource containers and explicit legacy charsets. */
export interface MacReadOptions {
    /** Explicit NFNT legacy charset label. */
    nfnt_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Relative AppleDouble companion when reading the data fork. */
    nfnt_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p2_formats::mac::WriteOptions`: Write options: macintosh resource containers and explicit legacy charsets. */
export interface MacWriteOptions {
    /** Macintosh output container (default dfont). */
    nfnt_container?: string | null;
    /** Resource type used for newly authored Macintosh bitmaps. */
    nfnt_resource_type?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::Mapping`: A catalogue-compatible mapping, optionally carrying native metadata. */
export interface Mapping {
    /** Native schema version; absent for external catalogue maps. */
    fontpixel_image?: number | null;
    /** Safe image name when this mapping is the entry point. */
    image?: string | null;
    /** Nominal font pixel size (required for external mappings). */
    pixel_size?: number | null;
    /** Baseline measured down from the cell top; defaults to pixel_size. */
    baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Selected opaque RGB colors; empty means any nontransparent pixel. */
    foreground?: SerdeBytes[];
    /** Regular cell width and height, both positive. */
    cell_size?: number[] | null;
    /** Regular row-major Unicode sequence, one scalar per cell. */
    characters?: string | null;
    /** Explicit top-left image rectangles; mutually exclusive with grid options. */
    cells?: Cell[] | null;
    /** Skip blank non-whitespace external cells, reporting every omission. */
    omit_blank?: boolean;
    /** Optional catalogue variant name (not a font family assignment). */
    name?: string | null;
    /** Exact native font/container metadata. */
    native?: NativeMetadata | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::MappingFormat`: Mapping serialization. */
export type MappingFormat = "json" | "toml";

/** `fontpixel_ops::merge::AssetSummary`: One asset of a merge output. */
export interface MergeAssetSummary {
    /** Asset path relative to the output's directory. */
    path: string;
    /** Serialized length in bytes. */
    bytes: number;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::merge::MergeInput`: One ordered merge part. */
export interface MergeInput {
    /** Input font. */
    input: string;
    /** Selected codes, e.g. `cjk` or `western,geometric`. */
    take: SelectionDict;
    /** Vertical offset in pixels (positive moves glyphs up). */
    dy?: WideInt;
    /** Explicit input format. */
    from?: string | null;
    /** Zero-based strike, required when the input holds several fonts. */
    font_index?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::MergeOptions`: Explicit merge choices. */
export interface MergeOptions {
    /** Required new family. */
    family: string;
    /** Requested spacing. */
    spacing?: MergeSpacing;
    /** Independent geometric width class. */
    geometric_width?: GeometricWidth;
    /** Preserve/report incompatible Western glyphs. */
    allow_misaligned?: boolean;
    /** Permit first other source after selected-present sources. */
    fallback?: boolean;
    /** Nonnegative ascent override. */
    ascent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Nonnegative descent override. */
    descent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Reject unknown/prohibited licensing and information loss. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Aggregate source/work/output limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::merge::MergeOutput`: One merge output. */
export interface MergeOutput {
    /** Output entry point. */
    destination: string;
    /** Explicit output format; otherwise inferred from the destination. */
    format?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::report::MergeReport`: Complete deterministic report. */
export interface MergeReport {
    /** Unicode version. */
    unicode_version: string;
    /** New family. */
    family: string;
    /** Requested mode. */
    requested_spacing: MergeSpacing;
    /** Resolved mode. */
    effective_spacing: MergeSpacing;
    /** Explicit geometric width policy. */
    geometric_width: GeometricWidth;
    /** Modal Han width. */
    full_width?: WideInt | null;
    /** Input-order contribution reports. */
    parts: PartReport[];
    /** All adjusted/misaligned Western glyphs. */
    adjustments: SpacingAdjustment[];
    /** Baseline metric changes. */
    metrics: MetricsReport;
    /** Input-order notices. */
    licenses: LicenseReport[];
    /** Stable shared diagnostics. */
    diagnostics: Report;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::merge::MergeRequest`: Merge selected glyphs from ordered parts and write one or more outputs. */
export interface MergeRequest {
    /** Ordered parts; earlier parts win for overlapping codes. */
    parts?: MergeInput[];
    /** Outputs, all written in one transaction. */
    outputs?: MergeOutput[];
    /** Required output family name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed. */
    family?: string;
    /** Spacing policy: `auto`, `mono` or `prop`. */
    spacing?: MergeSpacing;
    /** Width of geometric symbols: `half` or `full`. */
    geometric_width?: GeometricWidth;
    /** Accept parts whose baselines or cells do not align. */
    allow_misaligned?: boolean;
    /** Let later parts fill codes missing from earlier parts. */
    fallback?: boolean;
    /** Explicit output ascent in pixels. */
    ascent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Explicit output descent in pixels. */
    descent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Reject read, merge or write loss before any output is written. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Diagnostic format. */
    report?: ReportStyle;
    /** PCF table integer byte order. */
    byte_order?: Significance | null;
    /** PCF bitmap bit order. */
    bit_order?: Significance | null;
    /** PCF row alignment in bytes (1, 2, 4 or 8). */
    glyph_pad?: string | null;
    /** PCF bitmap scan unit in bytes (1, 2 or 4). */
    scan_unit?: string | null;
    /** Whether edited size/resolution rewrite existing PCF POINT_SIZE and RESOLUTION* properties (normalized-edits, the default) or the existing properties are kept and each disagreement is reported as loss. */
    pcf_metadata_precedence?: PcfMetadataPrecedence | null;
    /** PSF output version, 1 or 2 (default 2). */
    psf_version?: string | null;
    /** PSF1 cells, 256 or 512; default chooses the smallest fit. */
    psf1_count?: number | null;
    /** PSF Unicode table policy (default auto). */
    psf_unicode_table?: string | null;
    /** Windows raster output version; defaults to source version or 2. */
    fnt_version?: string | null;
    /** Windows dfCharSet identifier, 0..255 (ANSI=0, OEM=255). */
    fnt_charset?: number | null;
    /** Explicit target page for OEM, symbol, or historical Windows mappings. */
    fnt_code_page?: string | null;
    /** Output image organization (default atlas). */
    image_layout?: string | null;
    /** Explicit image container (directory default png; atlas uses extension). */
    image_encoding?: string | null;
    /** Atlas columns (default 16). */
    image_columns?: number | null;
    /** Atlas mapping format (default json). */
    image_mapping_format?: string | null;
    /** Literal prefix on numeric output glyph filenames. */
    image_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Output directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_radix?: number | null;
    /** Output filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_domain?: string | null;
    /** Output image background (default black). */
    image_background?: string | null;
    /** Output glyph baseline measured down from the image top. */
    image_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Output C dialect (default generic). */
    c_family?: string | null;
    /** C source (default) or native LVGL binary output. */
    c_container?: string | null;
    /** U8glib native font record format (default full). */
    u8glib_format?: string | null;
    /** Write the pre-2019 two-byte U8x8 header. */
    u8x8_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Output C symbol (default font). */
    c_name?: string | null;
    /** Inclusive C output range, e.g. U+0020-U+007E. */
    c_range?: string | null;
    /** LVGL coverage bit depth (default 1). */
    lvgl_bpp?: string | null;
    /** LVGL bitmap encoding (default plain). */
    lvgl_compression?: string | null;
    /** Pebble output wire version (default 3). */
    pbf_version?: string | null;
    /** Pebble bitmap encoding; RLE4 requires v3. */
    pbf_compression?: string | null;
    /** Pebble glyph offset width (default auto). */
    pbf_offset_width?: string | null;
    /** Pebble hash bucket count, 1..255 (default 255). */
    pbf_hash_buckets?: number | null;
    /** Pebble Unicode field width; default chooses 2 or 4 bytes. */
    pbf_codepoint_bytes?: string | null;
    /** Pebble line-top baseline override in pixels. */
    pbf_max_height?: number | null;
    /** Pebble BMP fallback codepoint, e.g. U+003F. */
    pbf_wildcard?: string | null;
    /** Relative HBF bitmap asset name, resolved beside the output header. */
    hbf_bitmap_name?: string | null;
    /** Split HBF bitmaps after this many glyphs per asset. */
    hbf_glyphs_per_file?: number | null;
    /** DOS output layout (default CP for .cp, CPX for .cpx, otherwise FONT). */
    cpi_version?: string | null;
    /** DOS code page for fonts without native code-page metadata. */
    cpi_code_page?: number | null;
    /** FONTX2 single-byte ANK or double-byte block tables (default auto). */
    fontx2_mode?: string | null;
    /** Charset used for exact FONTX2 output mapping. */
    fontx2_charset?: string | null;
    /** FONTX2 output cell width. */
    fontx2_width?: number | null;
    /** FONTX2 output cell height. */
    fontx2_height?: number | null;
    /** Macintosh output container (default dfont). */
    nfnt_container?: string | null;
    /** Resource type used for newly authored Macintosh bitmaps. */
    nfnt_resource_type?: string | null;
    /** BMFont descriptor encoding (default text). */
    bmfont_encoding?: string | null;
    /** BMFont PNG page width in pixels. */
    bmfont_page_width?: number | null;
    /** BMFont PNG page height in pixels. */
    bmfont_page_height?: number | null;
    /** Empty pixels between BMFont glyphs. */
    bmfont_padding?: number | null;
    /** TeX design size in points: integer or exact fraction, e.g. 10 or 21/2. */
    tex_design_size?: string | null;
    /** TeX horizontal and vertical resolution in dpi. */
    tex_dpi?: number | null;
    /** TeX horizontal resolution override in dpi. */
    tex_dpi_x?: number | null;
    /** TeX vertical resolution override in dpi. */
    tex_dpi_y?: number | null;
    /** Plan 9 mapping bundle or one subfont image (default font). */
    plan9_container?: string | null;
    /** Maximum glyphs per generated Plan 9 subfont. */
    plan9_max_glyphs?: number | null;
    /** Plan 9 image encoding: raw bytes or standard LZ77 literal blocks. */
    plan9_compression?: string | null;
    /** Amiga output as one strike or a .font descriptor with size assets (default auto). */
    amiga_packaging?: string | null;
    /** Refuse interpreting representable Unicode characters as Amiga Latin-1 codes. */
    amiga_no_unicode_latin1?: boolean;
    /** Amiga planar coverage depth, from 1 through 8 bits. */
    amiga_color_depth?: number | null;
    /** GEM output header integer order (default big). */
    gem_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** GEM output bitmap word order (default big). */
    gem_word_order?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly reinterpret GEM Unicode numbers as untagged legacy codes, with loss. */
    gem_unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** SNF output integer order (default little). */
    snf_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF output bitmap layout: bits,bytes,row-padding,scan-unit,rows. */
    snf_layout?: string | null;
    /** Omit SNF's vendor layout property; reopening may require --snf-read-layout. */
    snf_no_layout_property?: boolean;
    /** PILfont maximum atlas width (default 800). */
    pilfont_max_width?: number | null;
    /** Processing VLW generation (default 11). */
    vlw_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit VLW smoothing hint; preserves source hint when omitted. */
    vlw_smooth?: boolean | null;
    /** Rockbox file generation (default rb12). */
    rockbox_flavor?: string | null;
    /** Rockbox native coverage representation. */
    rockbox_depth?: string | null;
    /** U8/M load address in decimal. */
    u8m_load_address?: number | null;
    /** Playdate descriptor/atlas or compiled font (default fnt-embedded). */
    playdate_flavor?: string | null;
    /** Playdate output atlas cell width. */
    playdate_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** Playdate output atlas cell height. */
    playdate_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** Explicit Playdate font tracking. */
    playdate_tracking?: number | null;
    /** QPF2 native glyph coverage storage (default gray8). */
    qpf2_glyph_format?: string | null;
    /** MGTK one/two seven-bit raster strips (default auto). */
    mgtk_columns?: string | null;
    /** PFR wire dialect; otherwise preserve native source or use FreeType. */
    pfr_dialect?: string | null;
    /** Scalable Screen Font native encoding (default binary). */
    ssfn_encoding?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly interpret legacy numeric labels as SSFN Unicode mappings. */
    ssfn_legacy_as_unicode?: boolean;
    /** Xerox native font family (default bitblt). */
    xerox_variant?: string | null;
    /** Xerox BITBLT strike directory layout (default kerned). */
    xerox_bitblt_layout?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Xerox Alto baseline. */
    xerox_alto_baseline?: number | null;
    /** Native Xerox PrePress raster rotation metadata in arc-minutes. */
    xerox_rotation_minutes?: number | null;
    /** Native PC/GEOS layout, otherwise preserve source or use SBCS. */
    pcgeos_variant?: string | null;
    /** PC/GEOS registered font identifier. */
    pcgeos_font_id?: number | null;
    /** PC/GEOS shared family name. */
    pcgeos_family?: string | null;
    /** Rebuild PC/GEOS records instead of preserving unchanged native bytes. */
    pcgeos_rebuild?: boolean;
    /** Explicitly round fractional PC/GEOS output metrics. */
    pcgeos_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Explicitly use legacy code numbers as Unicode in PC/GEOS DBCS output. */
    pcgeos_legacy_as_unicode?: boolean;
    /** GPI resource packaging; otherwise preserve source choice. */
    gpi_container?: string | null;
    /** GPI character increment representation. */
    gpi_kind?: string | null;
    /** Native OS/2 codepage identifier. */
    gpi_codepage?: number | null;
    /** Native registered OS/2 font identifier. */
    gpi_registry_id?: number | null;
    /** Rebuild GPI records instead of preserving unchanged native bytes. */
    gpi_rebuild?: boolean;
    /** RISC OS bitmap generation (default 6). */
    riscos_version?: string | null;
    /** RISC OS native coverage depth (default mono). */
    riscos_depth?: string | null;
    /** RISC OS one-bit compression (default raw). */
    riscos_compression?: string | null;
    /** Relative name for an output IntMetrics companion. */

    /** IntMetrics generation (default 2). */

    /** Explicitly round coverage to the RISC OS Gray4 palette. */
    riscos_quantize?: boolean;
    /** PFR bitmap encoding (default raw). */

    /** Store PFR rows from top to bottom. */
    pfr_top_down?: boolean;
    /** PFR raw ink bit value (default 1). */
    pfr_black_pixel?: number | null;
    /** Native marker-image dialect (default sfont). */
    sfont_flavor?: string | null;
    /** Ordered SFont output labels, comma-separated U+0041 or legacy:0x41. */
    sfont_codepoints?: string[];
    /** Daisy-Dot output generation (default 3). */
    daisy_version?: string | null;
    /** Actual Daisy-Dot height marker plus one. */
    daisy_height?: number | null;
    /** Daisy-Dot underline row, which defines its baseline. */
    daisy_underline?: number | null;
    /** Explicitly allow graphics bytes forbidden by the Daisy-Dot manual. */
    daisy_allow_control_bytes?: boolean;

    tasprint_version?: string | null;
    /** TasPrint PCW output width. */

    /** PCW character count: the documented 127 or observed 128. */

    /** Native PXL output generation (default 1001). */
    pxl_version?: string | null;
    /** Optional relative name of the generated PXL metric sidecar. */
    pxl_tfm?: string | null;
    /** PXL magnification value. */

    /** Signum output layout (default e24). */
    signum_version?: string | null;
    /** GEOS output resource envelope (default preserves source, otherwise cvt). */
    geos_container?: string | null;

    geos_include_del?: boolean | null;

    /** Rebuild GEOS records instead of preserving unchanged native resources. */

    /** Explicitly use legacy codes as Unicode in GEOS extended output. */

    /** WSF wire bit order. */

    /** Explicitly project Unicode numbers to Palm legacy character codes. */
    palm_unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** GDR strike descriptor version (default 41). */
    gdr_version?: string | null;

    otb_upm?: number | null;
    /** OTB/bdat metric source: first, largest y-ppem, or a zero-based strike index. */
    otb_reference?: string | null;
    /** OTB/bdat pixel-to-design rounding; absent preserves native half-away rounding. */
    otb_rounding?: string | null;
    /** Complete OTB/bdat name table record PLATFORM/ENCODING/LANGUAGE/NAME_ID=TEXT. */
    otb_name_record?: string[];
    /** Name record with exact bytes: PLATFORM/ENCODING/LANGUAGE/NAME_ID=HEX. */
    otb_name_record_hex?: string[];
    /** BCP 47 language tag for name format 1; the Nth tag is language 0x8000+N. */
    otb_name_language_tag?: string[];
    /** Exact head.flags (bit 15 is reserved); native default 11. */
    otb_head_flags?: number | null;
    /** head.lowestRecPPEM, 1..=65535; native default 8. */
    otb_lowest_rec_ppem?: number | null;
    /** head.created, seconds since 1904-01-01 UTC; requires --otb-modified. */
    otb_created?: WideInt | null;
    /** head.modified, seconds since 1904-01-01 UTC; requires --otb-created. */
    otb_modified?: WideInt | null;
    /** OS/2 table version (same layout); native default 4. */
    otb_os2_version?: string | null;
    /** OS/2 achVendID, exactly four printable ASCII characters; native NONE. */
    otb_vendor?: string | null;
    /** Ten comma-separated PANOSE bytes; native default all zero. */
    otb_panose?: SerdeBytes | null;
    /** OS/2 Unicode ranges: coverage (native), non-bmp (only bit 57, when the cmap maps a supplementary scalar), or four comma-separated words. */
    otb_unicode_ranges?: string | null;
    /** OS/2 usBreakChar; native default 0. */
    otb_break_char?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 fsType embedding permissions; native default 0. */
    otb_fs_type?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 fsSelection; native default 0x40 (regular). */
    otb_fs_selection?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 xAvgCharWidth arithmetic over nonzero advances (native nearest). */
    otb_average_width?: string | null;
    /** post glyph names: keep (format 2, native) or omit (format 3, reported loss). */
    otb_post_names?: string | null;
    /** post.isFixedPitch override; absent follows the source spacing. */
    otb_fixed_pitch?: boolean | null;
    /** cmap format-12 records: always (native: (0,4) and (3,10)), non-bmp (omit (0,4) for BMP-only maps) or when-needed (format 12 only when format 4 cannot hold the map, under (3,10) only). Mappings never change. */
    otb_cmap_unicode_full?: string | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc widthMax: bitmap (largest bitmap width, native) or advance. */
    otb_width_max?: string | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc index layout: canonical (native), shared-runs, or spanning (one format-1 subtable across glyph IDs absent from a strike). */
    otb_index_layout?: string | null;
    /** Shortest shared-metric run with --otb-index-layout shared-runs (default 8). */
    otb_index_min_run?: number | null;
    /** TrueType outline tables: none (native OTB) or empty-glyf (one-byte glyf, short loca, maxp 1.0; outline-derived bounds and bearings become zero). */
    otb_outline_tables?: string | null;
    /** maxp.maxZones (1 or 2) with --otb-outline-tables empty-glyf (default 1). */
    otb_max_zones?: string | null;
    /** Glyph 0: preserve (native) or empty (no bitmap in any strike, hmtx advance from --otb-notdef-advance; replacing a source .notdef is loss). */
    otb_notdef?: string | null;
    /** Empty .notdef advance width in design units. */
    otb_notdef_advance?: number | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc caret slope RISE,RUN of every strike (native 1,0: upright). */
    otb_caret_slope?: number[] | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc minOriginSB/minAdvanceSB/maxBeforeBL/minAfterBL: computed (native) or zero. */
    otb_line_extremes?: string | null;
    /** Vertical line record of horizontal-only strikes: zero (native) or mirror-horizontal (a copy of the horizontal record). */
    otb_vertical_line_metrics?: string | null;
    /** post underline POSITION,THICKNESS in design units; replacing source underline metrics is reported as loss. */
    otb_underline?: number[] | null;
    /** hmtx: full (native, one long metric per glyph) or compact-trailing. */
    otb_hmtx?: string | null;
    /** Glyph IDs: first-seen (native) or codepoint (encoded glyphs by smallest scalar, then unencoded glyphs in first-seen order). */
    otb_glyph_order?: string | null;
    /** DRCS output cell width; requires --drcs-cell-height. */
    drcs_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** DRCS output cell height; requires --drcs-cell-width. */
    drcs_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** DRCS cell left edge relative to the glyph origin (default zero). */
    drcs_cell_x?: WideInt | null;
    /** DRCS cell bottom edge relative to the baseline (default zero). */
    drcs_cell_y?: WideInt | null;
    /** DRCS character set size (default 94). */
    drcs_charset?: string | null;
    /** DEC character set designator (default a space followed by @). */
    drcs_designator?: string | null;
    /** Use 8-bit DCS/ST control bytes instead of ESC P / ESC backslash. */
    drcs_eight_bit_controls?: boolean;
    /** Explicit raw layout preset (VGA, C64, Spectrum, CH8, MSX or Harlekin). */
    raw_preset?: string | null;
    /** Raw glyph width; overrides a selected preset. */
    raw_width?: number | null;
    /** Raw glyph height; overrides a selected preset. */
    raw_height?: number | null;
    /** Exact raw glyph count; otherwise consume complete records. */
    raw_count?: number | null;
    /** First raw slot code, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    raw_first?: string | null;
    /** Bit order within each raw byte (default msb). */
    raw_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Raw row order (default top-down). */
    raw_row_order?: string | null;
    /** Raw alignment: byte-aligned rows or continuous packed bits. */
    raw_packing?: string | null;
    /** Row-major or byte-column-major storage within each horizontal strip. */
    raw_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Glyph cells placed side by side in each raw horizontal strip (default 1). */
    raw_strike_count?: number | null;
    /** Extra padding bytes after every raw row. */
    raw_row_padding?: number | null;
    /** Prefix bytes before the first raw glyph. */
    raw_offset?: number | null;
    /** Fallback two-byte little-endian load address when no matching source prefix exists. */
    raw_default_load_address?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset identity of raw slot codes. */
    raw_charset?: string | null;
    /** DOS CPI input pointers (default linear). */
    cpi_pointer_mode?: string | null;
    /** Exact charset label of FONTX2 source codes. */
    fontx2_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Explicit HZK/ASC preset, e.g. HZK16, HZK24S, ASC16. */
    hzk_preset?: string | null;
    /** HZK glyph width; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_width?: number | null;
    /** HZK glyph height; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_height?: number | null;
    /** HZK first slot code, e.g. 0xA1A1. */
    hzk_first?: string | null;
    /** HZK last permitted slot code, inclusive. */
    hzk_last?: string | null;
    /** HZK slot domain for custom geometry. */
    hzk_code_space?: string | null;
    /** HZK bitmap storage orientation (default rows). */
    hzk_storage?: string | null;
    /** Exact HZK input or output glyph count. */
    hzk_count?: number | null;
    /** Explicit NFNT legacy charset label. */
    nfnt_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Relative AppleDouble companion when reading the data fork. */
    nfnt_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly threshold imported BMFont grayscale; default preserves samples. */
    bmfont_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** GEM input header integer order; default uses structural detection. */
    gem_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** GEM input bitmap word order; default follows its header flag. */
    gem_read_word_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input integer order; default uses version stamps. */
    snf_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input bitmap layout: bits,bytes,row-padding,scan-unit,rows; e.g. msb,big,4,1,top-down. */
    snf_read_layout?: string | null;
    /** Scoped PNG mask for a PILfont descriptor (its native suffix is .pbm). */
    pilfont_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Scoped PNG atlas for a Playdate FNT descriptor. */
    playdate_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell width. */
    playdate_read_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell height. */
    playdate_read_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for MGTK legacy positions; no implicit Unicode remapping. */
    mgtk_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Family name supplied externally for a QPF font. */
    qpf_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Require the DAVIC specification or FreeType PFR wire dialect. */
    pfr_read_dialect?: string | null;
    /** Require a Xerox native font family. */
    xerox_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicit baseline for Alto files with a zero native header baseline. */
    xerox_read_alto_baseline?: number | null;
    /** Require the SBCS or DBCS PC/GEOS layout. */
    pcgeos_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly round fractional PC/GEOS input metrics. */
    pcgeos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Retain the additional GPI unmapped null descriptor (default true). */
    gpi_include_unmapped_null?: boolean | null;
    /** Require a RISC OS bitmap generation. */
    riscos_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Relative RISC OS IntMetrics input companion. */
    riscos_read_metrics?: string | null;
    /** Explicit marker-image dialect; otherwise inspect native controls. */
    sfont_read_flavor?: string | null;
    /** Ordered SFont labels, comma-separated U+0041 or legacy:0x41. */
    sfont_read_codepoints?: string[];
    /** SFont baseline down from glyph top. */
    sfont_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a Daisy-Dot input generation. */
    daisy_read_version?: string | null;
    /** PolyPrint baseline measured from the cell top. */
    polyprint_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Print Shop baseline measured from the cell top. */
    printshop_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a TasPrint input platform. */
    tasprint_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit PCW input width. */
    tasprint_read_width?: number | null;
    /** Require PXL version 1001 or 1002. */
    pxl_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Scoped TFM sidecar path for PXL input. */
    pxl_read_tfm?: string | null;
    /** Require a Signum editor or printer input layout. */
    signum_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Signum baseline. */
    signum_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Explicit Signum line height. */
    signum_line_height?: WideInt | null;
    /** Include the later GEOS DEL slot when interpreting a native strike. */
    geos_read_include_del?: boolean;
    /** Bare Japanese Macintosh resource type (default fbit). */
    fbit_read_kind?: string | null;
    /** Scoped bitmap data fork for an fbit resource. */
    fbit_read_data_fork?: string | null;
    /** Scoped AppleDouble resource companion for an fbit data-fork input. */
    fbit_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
    /** Explicit cell width for bare HFNT input. */
    fbit_read_hfnt_width?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for Lisa legacy positions. */
    lisa_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Accept shortened SymbOS character ranges. */
    symbos_read_allow_short_range?: boolean;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific bit order zero. */
    wsfont_known_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific byte order zero. */
    wsfont_known_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** BeOS coverage interpretation (default native8). */
    beos_read_coverage?: string | null;
    /** Permit explicit rounding of fractional BeOS advances on input. */
    beos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Require a prebuilt bitmap numeric byte order. */
    prebuilt_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Prebuilt input bitmap pixel order (default msb; independent of numeric byte order). */
    prebuilt_read_bitmap_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Catalyst native directory origin (default resource-body). */
    catalyst_offset_base?: string | null;
    /** Require ChiWriter version 3 or 4. */
    chiwriter_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit compatible bitmap directory origin. */
    chiwriter_read_layout?: string | null;
    /** ChiWriter input raster bytes per row. */
    chiwriter_read_stride?: number | null;
    /** Require Dashen screen/printer generation. */
    dashen_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly accept the historical monobit PCL descriptor-size discrepancy. */
    hppcl_allow_legacy_descriptor_size?: boolean;
    /** Baseline below cell top for BBC, COM, Consoleet, GRASP, HRCG, Wyse, XBIN and Zap. */
    native_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Charset label for native console positions; numeric codes stay unchanged. */
    native_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Require one executable font loader variant. */
    comfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of Consoleet numeric filenames (default legacy). */
    consoleet_read_codes?: string | null;
    /** Require one Zap font layout. */
    zapfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Override the inferred first legacy code in a Dr. Halo font. */
    drhalo_read_first?: number | null;
    /** Korean 8×4×4 input: compose Hangul syllables or retain component slots. */
    hanfont_read_mode?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset label for Apple IIgs legacy character codes. */
    iigs_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** DRCS baseline down from cell top (default cell height). */
    drcs_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** DEC device matrix rules for both reading and writing DRCS. */
    drcs_terminal?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Berkeley vfont input integer byte order. */
    vfont_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Require a Palm wrapper instead of recognizing its structure. */
    palm_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Explicit handling of fractional Palm density coordinates (default exact). */
    palm_rounding?: string | null;
    /** Interpret GDR source codes as legacy positions instead of Unicode. */
    gdr_read_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicitly reduce KBITX grayscale during import; default retains exact samples. */
    kbitx_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Crop PBF blank margins during import, with a loss report. */
    pbf_trim?: boolean;
    /** C header dialect (default auto). */
    c_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Explicit C source or LVGL binary input container (default auto). */
    c_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Read the pre-2019 two-byte U8x8 header. */
    c_read_u8x8_legacy?: boolean;
    /** C input array or GFXfont symbol to select. */
    c_array?: string | null;
    /** Generic C cell width; requires height, first code and charset. */
    c_width?: number | null;
    /** Generic C cell height; requires `c_width`. */
    c_height?: number | null;
    /** First code in generic C arrays, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    c_first?: string | null;
    /** unicode or an explicit legacy charset name. */
    c_charset?: string | null;
    /** Generic C baseline down from cell top (default height). */
    c_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Generic C bytes store the leftmost pixel in bit zero. */
    c_lsb_first?: boolean;
    /** Relative JSON/TOML atlas mapping, resolved beside the primary input. */
    image_mapping?: string | null;
    /** Literal prefix on numeric glyph filenames in an input directory. */
    image_read_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Input directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_read_radix?: number | null;
    /** Input filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_read_domain?: string | null;
    /** Input image background (default black). */
    image_read_background?: string | null;
    /** Input glyph baseline measured down from each image's top. */
    image_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** HEX input/output rows (default 16); never inferred from record length. */
    hex_height?: number | null;
    /** HEX baseline-to-bottom distance (default 0). */
    hex_descent?: number | null;
    /** Explicit source FNT/FON legacy code page (does not remap byte positions). */
    fnt_read_code_page?: string | null;
    /** Primary input byte budget (default 64 MiB). */
    max_input_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Individual companion-file byte budget. */
    max_resource_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Aggregate resource and codec allocation budget (default 256 MiB). */
    max_total_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum companion reads and directory entries. */
    max_resources?: number | null;
    /** Explicit raster size for reviewed off-grid/curved outlines. */
    ppem?: number | null;
    /** Select a TTC/OTC face (zero based); otherwise read every face. */
    face_index?: number | null;
    /** Rasterize outlines even when matching embedded images exist. */
    no_embedded_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit design units per pixel; requires --ppem. */
    grid_units?: number | null;
    /** Reviewed horizontal and vertical translations in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_x?: number;
    /** Reviewed vertical translation in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_y?: number;
    /** Outline shape for SVG/TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2/TTC conversion. */
    shape?: Shape | null;
    /** Dot diameter or separate-square side relative to one pixel. */
    dotsize?: number | null;
    /** Native dot reuse; default patterns. Literal favors smaller webfonts. */
    dot_reuse?: string | null;
    /** Design units per source pixel (default 100). */
    ppu?: number | null;
    /** Explicit units per em for outline output. */
    upm?: number | null;
    /** Embed a matching EBDT/EBLC bitmap strike in outline output. */
    embed_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale-to-monochrome threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Outline source in webfonts/TTC (auto selects CFF squares, TrueType dots). */
    woff2_source?: string | null;
    /** WOFF2 Brotli quality, 0 through 11 (default 11). */
    woff2_quality?: number | null;
    /** Intra-font Brotli workers (1..16), independent of batch task workers. */
    woff2_threads?: number | null;
    /** Write a version 2 TTC/OTC header. */
    collection_v2?: boolean;
    /** Glyph 0 of TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2/TTC output: preserve (the source .notdef, otherwise an empty glyph) or empty (empty outline with exact design-unit metrics; requires --notdef-advance; replacing a source .notdef is loss). */
    notdef?: string | null;
    /** Empty .notdef advance width in design units. */
    notdef_advance?: number | null;
    /** Empty .notdef left side bearing in design units (default 0). */
    notdef_lsb?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::MergeResult`: Owned output and deterministic report. */
export interface MergeResult {
    /** New strike. */
    font: FontDict;
    /** Complete report. */
    report: MergeReport;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::merge::MergeSettings`: Merge-wide settings and writer options shared by every output. */
export interface MergeSettings {
    /** Required output family name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed. */
    family?: string;
    /** Spacing policy: `auto`, `mono` or `prop`. */
    spacing?: MergeSpacing;
    /** Width of geometric symbols: `half` or `full`. */
    geometric_width?: GeometricWidth;
    /** Accept parts whose baselines or cells do not align. */
    allow_misaligned?: boolean;
    /** Let later parts fill codes missing from earlier parts. */
    fallback?: boolean;
    /** Explicit output ascent in pixels. */
    ascent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Explicit output descent in pixels. */
    descent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Reject read, merge or write loss before any output is written. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Diagnostic format. */
    report?: ReportStyle;
    /** PCF table integer byte order. */
    byte_order?: Significance | null;
    /** PCF bitmap bit order. */
    bit_order?: Significance | null;
    /** PCF row alignment in bytes (1, 2, 4 or 8). */
    glyph_pad?: string | null;
    /** PCF bitmap scan unit in bytes (1, 2 or 4). */
    scan_unit?: string | null;
    /** Whether edited size/resolution rewrite existing PCF POINT_SIZE and RESOLUTION* properties (normalized-edits, the default) or the existing properties are kept and each disagreement is reported as loss. */
    pcf_metadata_precedence?: PcfMetadataPrecedence | null;
    /** PSF output version, 1 or 2 (default 2). */
    psf_version?: string | null;
    /** PSF1 cells, 256 or 512; default chooses the smallest fit. */
    psf1_count?: number | null;
    /** PSF Unicode table policy (default auto). */
    psf_unicode_table?: string | null;
    /** Windows raster output version; defaults to source version or 2. */
    fnt_version?: string | null;
    /** Windows dfCharSet identifier, 0..255 (ANSI=0, OEM=255). */
    fnt_charset?: number | null;
    /** Explicit target page for OEM, symbol, or historical Windows mappings. */
    fnt_code_page?: string | null;
    /** Output image organization (default atlas). */
    image_layout?: string | null;
    /** Explicit image container (directory default png; atlas uses extension). */
    image_encoding?: string | null;
    /** Atlas columns (default 16). */
    image_columns?: number | null;
    /** Atlas mapping format (default json). */
    image_mapping_format?: string | null;
    /** Literal prefix on numeric output glyph filenames. */
    image_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Output directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_radix?: number | null;
    /** Output filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_domain?: string | null;
    /** Output image background (default black). */
    image_background?: string | null;
    /** Output glyph baseline measured down from the image top. */
    image_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Output C dialect (default generic). */
    c_family?: string | null;
    /** C source (default) or native LVGL binary output. */
    c_container?: string | null;
    /** U8glib native font record format (default full). */
    u8glib_format?: string | null;
    /** Write the pre-2019 two-byte U8x8 header. */
    u8x8_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Output C symbol (default font). */
    c_name?: string | null;
    /** Inclusive C output range, e.g. U+0020-U+007E. */
    c_range?: string | null;
    /** LVGL coverage bit depth (default 1). */
    lvgl_bpp?: string | null;
    /** LVGL bitmap encoding (default plain). */
    lvgl_compression?: string | null;
    /** Pebble output wire version (default 3). */
    pbf_version?: string | null;
    /** Pebble bitmap encoding; RLE4 requires v3. */
    pbf_compression?: string | null;
    /** Pebble glyph offset width (default auto). */
    pbf_offset_width?: string | null;
    /** Pebble hash bucket count, 1..255 (default 255). */
    pbf_hash_buckets?: number | null;
    /** Pebble Unicode field width; default chooses 2 or 4 bytes. */
    pbf_codepoint_bytes?: string | null;
    /** Pebble line-top baseline override in pixels. */
    pbf_max_height?: number | null;
    /** Pebble BMP fallback codepoint, e.g. U+003F. */
    pbf_wildcard?: string | null;
    /** Relative HBF bitmap asset name, resolved beside the output header. */
    hbf_bitmap_name?: string | null;
    /** Split HBF bitmaps after this many glyphs per asset. */
    hbf_glyphs_per_file?: number | null;
    /** DOS output layout (default CP for .cp, CPX for .cpx, otherwise FONT). */
    cpi_version?: string | null;
    /** DOS code page for fonts without native code-page metadata. */
    cpi_code_page?: number | null;
    /** FONTX2 single-byte ANK or double-byte block tables (default auto). */
    fontx2_mode?: string | null;
    /** Charset used for exact FONTX2 output mapping. */
    fontx2_charset?: string | null;
    /** FONTX2 output cell width. */
    fontx2_width?: number | null;
    /** FONTX2 output cell height. */
    fontx2_height?: number | null;
    /** Macintosh output container (default dfont). */
    nfnt_container?: string | null;
    /** Resource type used for newly authored Macintosh bitmaps. */
    nfnt_resource_type?: string | null;
    /** BMFont descriptor encoding (default text). */
    bmfont_encoding?: string | null;
    /** BMFont PNG page width in pixels. */
    bmfont_page_width?: number | null;
    /** BMFont PNG page height in pixels. */
    bmfont_page_height?: number | null;
    /** Empty pixels between BMFont glyphs. */
    bmfont_padding?: number | null;
    /** TeX design size in points: integer or exact fraction, e.g. 10 or 21/2. */
    tex_design_size?: string | null;
    /** TeX horizontal and vertical resolution in dpi. */
    tex_dpi?: number | null;
    /** TeX horizontal resolution override in dpi. */
    tex_dpi_x?: number | null;
    /** TeX vertical resolution override in dpi. */
    tex_dpi_y?: number | null;
    /** Plan 9 mapping bundle or one subfont image (default font). */
    plan9_container?: string | null;
    /** Maximum glyphs per generated Plan 9 subfont. */
    plan9_max_glyphs?: number | null;
    /** Plan 9 image encoding: raw bytes or standard LZ77 literal blocks. */
    plan9_compression?: string | null;
    /** Amiga output as one strike or a .font descriptor with size assets (default auto). */
    amiga_packaging?: string | null;
    /** Refuse interpreting representable Unicode characters as Amiga Latin-1 codes. */
    amiga_no_unicode_latin1?: boolean;
    /** Amiga planar coverage depth, from 1 through 8 bits. */
    amiga_color_depth?: number | null;
    /** GEM output header integer order (default big). */
    gem_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** GEM output bitmap word order (default big). */
    gem_word_order?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly reinterpret GEM Unicode numbers as untagged legacy codes, with loss. */
    gem_unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** SNF output integer order (default little). */
    snf_byte_order?: string | null;

    native_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Require one executable font loader variant. */
    comfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of Consoleet numeric filenames (default legacy). */
    consoleet_read_codes?: string | null;
    /** Require one Zap font layout. */
    zapfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Override the inferred first legacy code in a Dr. Halo font. */
    drhalo_read_first?: number | null;
    /** Korean 8×4×4 input: compose Hangul syllables or retain component slots. */
    hanfont_read_mode?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset label for Apple IIgs legacy character codes. */
    iigs_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** DRCS baseline down from cell top (default cell height). */
    drcs_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** DEC device matrix rules for both reading and writing DRCS. */
    drcs_terminal?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Berkeley vfont input integer byte order. */
    vfont_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Require a Palm wrapper instead of recognizing its structure. */
    palm_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Explicit handling of fractional Palm density coordinates (default exact). */
    palm_rounding?: string | null;
    /** Interpret GDR source codes as legacy positions instead of Unicode. */
    gdr_read_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicitly reduce KBITX grayscale during import; default retains exact samples. */
    kbitx_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Crop PBF blank margins during import, with a loss report. */
    pbf_trim?: boolean;
    /** C header dialect (default auto). */
    c_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Explicit C source or LVGL binary input container (default auto). */
    c_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Read the pre-2019 two-byte U8x8 header. */
    c_read_u8x8_legacy?: boolean;
    /** C input array or GFXfont symbol to select. */
    c_array?: string | null;
    /** Generic C cell width; requires height, first code and charset. */
    c_width?: number | null;
    /** Generic C cell height; requires `c_width`. */
    c_height?: number | null;
    /** First code in generic C arrays, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    c_first?: string | null;
    /** unicode or an explicit legacy charset name. */
    c_charset?: string | null;
    /** Generic C baseline down from cell top (default height). */
    c_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Generic C bytes store the leftmost pixel in bit zero. */
    c_lsb_first?: boolean;
    /** Relative JSON/TOML atlas mapping, resolved beside the primary input. */
    image_mapping?: string | null;
    /** Literal prefix on numeric glyph filenames in an input directory. */
    image_read_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Input directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_read_radix?: number | null;
    /** Input filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_read_domain?: string | null;
    /** Input image background (default black). */
    image_read_background?: string | null;
    /** Input glyph baseline measured down from each image's top. */
    image_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** HEX input/output rows (default 16); never inferred from record length. */
    hex_height?: number | null;
    /** HEX baseline-to-bottom distance (default 0). */
    hex_descent?: number | null;
    /** Explicit source FNT/FON legacy code page (does not remap byte positions). */
    fnt_read_code_page?: string | null;
    /** Primary input byte budget (default 64 MiB). */
    max_input_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Individual companion-file byte budget. */
    max_resource_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Aggregate resource and codec allocation budget (default 256 MiB). */
    max_total_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum companion reads and directory entries. */
    max_resources?: number | null;
    /** Explicit raster size for reviewed off-grid/curved outlines. */
    ppem?: number | null;
    /** Select a TTC/OTC face (zero based); otherwise read every face. */
    face_index?: number | null;
    /** Rasterize outlines even when matching embedded images exist. */
    no_embedded_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit design units per pixel; requires --ppem. */
    grid_units?: number | null;
    /** Reviewed horizontal and vertical translations in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_x?: number;
    /** Reviewed vertical translation in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_y?: number;
    /** Outline shape for SVG/TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2/TTC conversion. */
    shape?: Shape | null;
    /** Dot diameter or separate-square side relative to one pixel. */
    dotsize?: number | null;
    /** Native dot reuse; default patterns. Literal favors smaller webfonts. */
    dot_reuse?: string | null;
    /** Design units per source pixel (default 100). */
    ppu?: number | null;
    /** Explicit units per em for outline output. */
    upm?: number | null;
    /** Embed a matching EBDT/EBLC bitmap strike in outline output. */
    embed_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale-to-monochrome threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Outline source in webfonts/TTC (auto selects CFF squares, TrueType dots). */
    woff2_source?: string | null;
    /** WOFF2 Brotli quality, 0 through 11 (default 11). */
    woff2_quality?: number | null;
    /** Intra-font Brotli workers (1..16), independent of batch task workers. */
    woff2_threads?: number | null;
    /** Write a version 2 TTC/OTC header. */
    collection_v2?: boolean;
    /** Glyph 0 of TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2/TTC output: preserve (the source .notdef, otherwise an empty glyph) or empty (empty outline with exact design-unit metrics; requires --notdef-advance; replacing a source .notdef is loss). */
    notdef?: string | null;
    /** Empty .notdef advance width in design units. */
    notdef_advance?: number | null;
    /** Empty .notdef left side bearing in design units (default 0). */
    notdef_lsb?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::MergeSpacing`: Requested/resolved spacing policy. */
export type MergeSpacing = "auto" | "mono" | "prop";

/** `fontpixel_ops::p3_formats::embedded_metadata::MetadataArguments`: Exact name-table records and OS/2 fields for OTB/bdat output. */
export interface MetadataArguments {
    /** Complete OTB/bdat name table record PLATFORM/ENCODING/LANGUAGE/NAME_ID=TEXT. */
    otb_name_record?: string[];
    /** Name record with exact bytes: PLATFORM/ENCODING/LANGUAGE/NAME_ID=HEX. */
    otb_name_record_hex?: string[];
    /** BCP 47 language tag for name format 1; the Nth tag is language 0x8000+N. */
    otb_name_language_tag?: string[];
    /** Exact head.flags (bit 15 is reserved); native default 11. */
    otb_head_flags?: number | null;
    /** head.lowestRecPPEM, 1..=65535; native default 8. */
    otb_lowest_rec_ppem?: number | null;
    /** head.created, seconds since 1904-01-01 UTC; requires --otb-modified. */
    otb_created?: WideInt | null;
    /** head.modified, seconds since 1904-01-01 UTC; requires --otb-created. */
    otb_modified?: WideInt | null;
    /** OS/2 table version (same layout); native default 4. */
    otb_os2_version?: string | null;
    /** OS/2 achVendID, exactly four printable ASCII characters; native NONE. */
    otb_vendor?: string | null;
    /** Ten comma-separated PANOSE bytes; native default all zero. */
    otb_panose?: SerdeBytes | null;
    /** OS/2 Unicode ranges: coverage (native), non-bmp (only bit 57, when the cmap maps a supplementary scalar), or four comma-separated words. */
    otb_unicode_ranges?: string | null;
    /** OS/2 usBreakChar; native default 0. */
    otb_break_char?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 fsType embedding permissions; native default 0. */
    otb_fs_type?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 fsSelection; native default 0x40 (regular). */
    otb_fs_selection?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 xAvgCharWidth arithmetic over nonzero advances (native nearest). */
    otb_average_width?: string | null;
    /** post glyph names: keep (format 2, native) or omit (format 3, reported loss). */
    otb_post_names?: string | null;
    /** post.isFixedPitch override; absent follows the source spacing. */
    otb_fixed_pitch?: boolean | null;
    /** cmap format-12 records: always (native: (0,4) and (3,10)), non-bmp (omit (0,4) for BMP-only maps) or when-needed (format 12 only when format 4 cannot hold the map, under (3,10) only). Mappings never change. */
    otb_cmap_unicode_full?: string | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc widthMax: bitmap (largest bitmap width, native) or advance. */
    otb_width_max?: string | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc index layout: canonical (native), shared-runs, or spanning (one format-1 subtable across glyph IDs absent from a strike). */
    otb_index_layout?: string | null;
    /** Shortest shared-metric run with --otb-index-layout shared-runs (default 8). */
    otb_index_min_run?: number | null;
    /** TrueType outline tables: none (native OTB) or empty-glyf (one-byte glyf, short loca, maxp 1.0; outline-derived bounds and bearings become zero). */
    otb_outline_tables?: string | null;
    /** maxp.maxZones (1 or 2) with --otb-outline-tables empty-glyf (default 1). */
    otb_max_zones?: string | null;
    /** Glyph 0: preserve (native) or empty (no bitmap in any strike, hmtx advance from --otb-notdef-advance; replacing a source .notdef is loss). */
    otb_notdef?: string | null;
    /** Empty .notdef advance width in design units. */
    otb_notdef_advance?: number | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc caret slope RISE,RUN of every strike (native 1,0: upright). */
    otb_caret_slope?: number[] | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc minOriginSB/minAdvanceSB/maxBeforeBL/minAfterBL: computed (native) or zero. */
    otb_line_extremes?: string | null;
    /** Vertical line record of horizontal-only strikes: zero (native) or mirror-horizontal (a copy of the horizontal record). */
    otb_vertical_line_metrics?: string | null;
    /** post underline POSITION,THICKNESS in design units; replacing source underline metrics is reported as loss. */
    otb_underline?: number[] | null;
    /** hmtx: full (native, one long metric per glyph) or compact-trailing. */
    otb_hmtx?: string | null;
    /** Glyph IDs: first-seen (native) or codepoint (encoded glyphs by smallest scalar, then unencoded glyphs in first-seen order). */
    otb_glyph_order?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataChange`: One committed metadata change with its complete before/after values. */
export interface MetadataChange {
    /** Strike index in the projected set. */
    font_index: number;
    /** Changed field. */
    field: MetadataField;
    /** Value before the projection (`None` when absent). */
    before?: MetadataValue | null;
    /** Value after the projection (`None` when removed). */
    after?: MetadataValue | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataField`: The model field a [`MetadataChange`] refers to. */
export type MetadataField = "font_name" | "point_size" | "resolution" | MetadataFieldProperty | MetadataFieldMetric;

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataField::Metric`: Normalized metric kept in sync with an integer property edit. */
export interface MetadataFieldMetric {
    /** Normalized metric kept in sync with an integer property edit. */
    metric: SyncedMetric;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataField::Property`: One record of the ordered property list. */
export interface MetadataFieldProperty {
    /** One record of the ordered property list. */
    property: MetadataFieldPropertyFields;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataField::Property::fields`: One record of the ordered property list. */
export interface MetadataFieldPropertyFields {
    /** Exact record spelling. */
    name: string;
    /** Record position in the property list just before this change. */
    record: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::variants::metadata::GlyphOrder`: Glyph ID order of the planned glyphs (glyph 0 is always `.notdef`). */
export type MetadataGlyphOrder = "planned" | "codepoint";

/** `fontpixel::variants::metadata::MetadataOptions`: Explicit head, OS/2, post, maxp, gasp, cmap and glyph-order controls. */
export interface MetadataOptions {
    /** `head.created` and `head.modified`, seconds since 1904-01-01 00:00 UTC. Absent writes zero (deterministic native default). */
    timestamps?: WideInt[] | null;
    /** OS/2 `fsType` embedding permissions (native default 0). */
    embedding_flags?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 `fsSelection` (native default 0x40, regular). The table is version 3, so bits 7..=9 are rejected. */
    selection_flags?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 `usBreakChar` (native default 0). */
    break_char?: number | null;
    /** Exact OS/2 `ulCodePageRange1..2` instead of the cmap-derived bits. */
    code_page_ranges?: number[] | null;
    /** `post.isFixedPitch` override; absent follows the source spacing. */
    fixed_pitch?: boolean | null;
    /** `maxp.maxZones` (1 or 2) of TrueType output (native default 1: no instructions use the twilight zone). */
    max_zones?: number | null;
    /** `gasp` table policy. */
    gasp?: GaspPolicy;
    /** Which cmap records carry the format-12 subtable. */
    cmap_full_records?: FullRecords;
    /** Glyph ID order. */
    glyph_order?: MetadataGlyphOrder;
    /** Position of the shared dot glyph. */
    dot_glyph?: DotGlyph;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcf::MetadataPrecedence`: Which value wins when a normalized size/resolution edit (for example an explicit [`crate::projection`]) disagrees with an existing PCF property. */
export type MetadataPrecedence = "normalized-edits" | "explicit-properties";

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataValue`: A value recorded in a [`MetadataChange`]. */
export type MetadataValue = MetadataValueText | MetadataValueInteger | MetadataValueRational | MetadataValueVector | MetadataValueProperty;

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataValue::Integer`: Normalized integer metric. */
export interface MetadataValueInteger {
    /** Normalized integer metric. */
    integer: WideInt;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataValue::Property`: Complete property value. */
export interface MetadataValueProperty {
    /** Complete property value. */
    property: PropertyValue;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataValue::Rational`: Exact point size. */

    /** Exact point size. */
    rational: Rational;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataValue::Text`: Font name text. */
export interface MetadataValueText {
    /** Font name text. */

}

/** `fontpixel::projection::MetadataValue::Vector`: Resolution. */
export interface MetadataValueVector {
    /** Resolution. */
    vector: Vector;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::bitmap::Metrics`: Native interpretation of small or big embedded glyph metrics. */
export interface Metrics {
    /** Pixel width, including intentional white margins. */
    width: number;
    /** Pixel height. */
    height: number;
    /** Horizontal metrics, absent for vertical-only small metrics. */

    /** Vertical metrics, absent for horizontal-only small metrics. */
    vertical?: Bearing | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::metrics::Header`: Axis-independent metric header. Caret vector is (rise, run), as on the wire. */
export interface MetricsHeader {
    /** Version: 0x10000 for horizontal, 0x10000 or 0x11000 for vertical. */
    version: number;
    /** Ascender, in font units. */
    ascender: number;
    /** Descender, generally negative. */
    descender: number;
    /** Line gap. */
    line_gap: number;
    /** Largest advance, including empty glyphs. */
    advance_max: number;
    /** Minimum left/top bearing over glyphs with contours. */
    min_side_bearing: number;
    /** Minimum right/bottom bearing over glyphs with contours. */
    min_other_side_bearing: number;
    /** Largest bearing + ink extent over glyphs with contours. */
    max_extent: number;
    /** Caret slope rise. */
    caret_slope_rise: number;
    /** Caret slope run. */
    caret_slope_run: number;
    /** Caret offset. */
    caret_offset: number;
    /** Number of full advance/bearing pairs, recomputed by `encode`. */
    num_long_metrics: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::report::MetricsReport`: Natural and overridden output metrics. */
export interface MetricsReport {
    /** Source metrics. */
    parts: PartMetrics[];
    /** Natural maximum ascent. */
    natural_ascent: WideInt;
    /** Natural maximum descent. */
    natural_descent: WideInt;
    /** Final ascent. */
    ascent: WideInt;
    /** Final descent. */
    descent: WideInt;
    /** Caller supplied ascent. */

    /** Caller supplied descent. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::mgtk::MgtkCodec`: Registry reader/writer with typed format options. */

    /** Input interpretation. */

    /** Output policy. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::mgtk::MgtkReadOptions`: Explicit legacy character interpretation. */
export interface MgtkReadOptions {
    /** Optional charset label; byte codes are not remapped implicitly. */
    charset?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::mgtk::MgtkWriteOptions`: Bounded native output options. */
export interface MgtkWriteOptions {
    /** One or two seven-bit strips. */
    columns?: Columns;
    /** Explicit Gray8 reduction; absent means Gray8 is rejected. */

    /** Cumulative source/output/reread limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum encoded output size. */

}

/** `fontpixel::merge::report::MissingBlock`: Missing selected scalar positions grouped by actual Unicode block. */

    /** Last missing position. */

    /** Exact missing count. */

}

/** `fontpixel::render::MissingGlyph`: Policy for absent or unrepresentable input codes. */
export type MissingGlyph = "blank" | "error" | MissingGlyphGlyph;

/** `fontpixel::render::MissingGlyph::Glyph`: Draw a borrowed replacement using the target font's cell and metrics. */

    /** Draw a borrowed replacement using the target font's cell and metrics. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::mkwinfont::MkwinfontCodec`: Native mkwinfont registry codec. */
export interface MkwinfontCodec {

    /** Output conversion and resource choices. */
    write_options?: W5a1CommonNativeWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::mkwinfont::MkwinfontReadOptions`: Typed mkwinfont input choices. */
export interface MkwinfontReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::model::budget::ModelUsage`: Conservative retained model storage and aggregate element counts. */
export interface ModelUsage {
    /** Retained storage in bytes, conservatively accounting for indexes. */
    bytes: number;
    /** Number of strikes, including empty strikes. */
    fonts: number;
    /** Number of live glyphs, including unencoded glyphs. */
    glyphs: number;
    /** Number of assigned glyph IDs, including deleted slots. */
    glyph_slots: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::ModificationPermission`: Declared modification permission, not a legal warranty. */
export type ModificationPermission = "unknown" | "allowed" | "prohibited";

/** `fontpixel_ops::metadata::NameOptions`: Normalized naming overrides applied to every selected strike. */
export interface NameOptions {
    /** Explicit normalized output family; original source/XLFD provenance is retained. */
    family?: string | null;
    /** Explicit normalized output style/subfamily; does not infer weight or permissions. */
    style?: string | null;
    /** Exact full display name; otherwise a changed family/style clears a stale one. */
    full_name?: string | null;
    /** Exact PostScript name; otherwise a changed family/style clears a stale one. */
    postscript_name?: string | null;
    /** Literal normalized output version name (no implicit Version prefix). */
    font_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit copyright statement; this does not infer legal permission. */
    copyright?: string | null;
    /** Explicit license text; unrelated original provenance is retained. */
    license?: string | null;
    /** Explicit license URL; does not grant permission or contact the URL. */
    license_url?: string | null;
    /** Explicit foundry/vendor display name. */
    foundry?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::metadata::NameOverrides`: Explicit normalized name replacements, applied to every strike. */
export interface NameOverrides {
    /** Family name; must contain a non-whitespace character when supplied. */
    family?: string | null;
    /** Style name; must contain a non-whitespace character when supplied. */
    style?: string | null;
    /** Full display name; must contain a non-whitespace character when supplied. */
    full_name?: string | null;
    /** PostScript name; format-specific character restrictions remain writer checks. */
    postscript_name?: string | null;
    /** Literal version text, with no automatically added or removed prefix. */
    version?: string | null;
    /** Copyright text; an empty string explicitly clears the normalized text. */
    copyright?: string | null;
    /** License text/identifier; editing it does not establish legal permission. */
    license?: string | null;
    /** License URL; an empty string explicitly clears the normalized text. */
    license_url?: string | null;
    /** Foundry/vendor name; an empty string is permitted. */
    foundry?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::name::NameRecord`: One original name record; non-Unicode encodings remain exact byte strings. */
export interface NameRecord {
    /** Platform ID. */
    platform_id: number;
    /** Platform encoding ID. */
    encoding_id: number;
    /** Platform language ID or format-1 tag index plus 0x8000. */
    language_id: number;
    /** OpenType name ID. */
    name_id: number;
    /** Original encoded bytes, without a trailing terminator. */
    value: SerdeBytes;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::name::NameTable`: Owned editable name table. Language tags select format 1 when nonempty. */
export interface NameTable {
    /** Name records, preserving source order when decoded. */
    records: NameRecord[];
    /** BCP-47 language strings indexed from 0x8000; stored as UTF-16BE on wire. */
    language_tags: string[];
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p3_formats::native_console::ReadOptions`: Read options: native console fonts, executable loaders and glyph directories. */
export interface NativeConsoleReadOptions {
    /** Baseline below cell top for BBC, COM, Consoleet, GRASP, HRCG, Wyse, XBIN and Zap. */
    native_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Charset label for native console positions; numeric codes stay unchanged. */
    native_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Require one executable font loader variant. */
    comfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of Consoleet numeric filenames (default legacy). */
    consoleet_read_codes?: string | null;
    /** Require one Zap font layout. */
    zapfont_read_variant?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p3_formats::native_console::WriteOptions`: Write options: native console fonts, executable loaders and glyph directories. */
export interface NativeConsoleWriteOptions {
    /** Executable font loader variant (default frapt). */
    comfont_variant?: string | null;
    /** CP/M target for PSFCOM and UDG native loaders (default pcw). */
    comfont_cpm_target?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of Consoleet output filenames (default legacy). */
    consoleet_codes?: string | null;
    /** XBIN glyph-slot count (default auto). */
    xbin_count?: string | null;
    /** Retain validated XBIN screen metadata or write font alone. */

    /** Zap output layout (default redraw). */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::NativeGlyph`: Complete native glyph metadata. Pixel bytes live only in the image. */

    /** Original stable glyph-table index. */

    /** Original aliases with explicit Unicode/legacy tags. */

    /** Original Unicode sequence mappings. */

    /** Exact glyph name, including absent versus empty. */

    /** Exact horizontal and vertical metrics. */

    /** Ordered per-glyph properties. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::image::NativeMetadata`: Exact native strike and container metadata. Versioned by the enclosing mapping. */

    /** Strike metrics, including stable default-glyph ID. */

    /** Human-readable metadata. */

    /** Original charset tags. */

    /** Original format provenance. */

    /** Ordered original headers. */

    /** Ordered original properties. */

    /** Total slots, including removed glyphs. */

    /** Ordered container properties. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::w5a2_common::NativeReadOptions`: Interpretation of native legacy cell positions. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::nfnt::NfntCodec`: Registry implementation with strongly typed options. */

    read_options?: NfntReadOptions;
    /** Output policy. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::nfnt::Container`: Outer representation for Macintosh bitmap font resources. */
export type NfntContainer = "bare" | "resource-fork" | "dfont" | "suitcase" | "macbinary" | "apple-single" | "apple-double" | "binhex";

/** `fontpixel::formats::nfnt::NfntReadOptions`: Explicit interpretation of Macintosh legacy codes and paired resources. */
export interface NfntReadOptions {
    /** Legacy encoding label; no implicit remapping to Unicode. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::nfnt::NfntWriteOptions`: Deterministic, bounded Macintosh font output. */

    /** Outer representation. */

    resource_type?: ResourceType;
    /** Optional explicit Gray8 reduction; absence preserves eight-bit samples. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;

}

/** `fontpixel::variants::notdef::NotdefPolicy`: Glyph 0 of an outline export. */
export type NotdefPolicy = "preserve" | NotdefPolicyEmpty;

/** `fontpixel::variants::notdef::NotdefPolicy::Empty`: Empty outline with exact design-unit horizontal metrics. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::oberon::OberonCodec`: Native registry codec. */
export interface OberonCodec {
    /** Input options. */
    read_options?: OberonReadOptions;
    /** Output options. */
    write_options?: OberonWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::oberon::OberonReadOptions`: Input policy for the documented bitmap wire format. */
export interface OberonReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::oberon::OberonWriteOptions`: Bounded native output choices. */
export interface OberonWriteOptions {
    /** Native family byte; absent preserves its source property. */
    family?: number | null;
    /** Native variant byte; absent preserves its source property, otherwise 32. */
    variant?: number | null;
    /** Explicit permission to interpret Unicode numbers as native byte codes. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit threshold for grayscale input. */

    /** Shared resource limits. */
