/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::OffsetMode`: How the transform applies to offset arguments. */
export type OffsetMode = "default" | "scaled" | "unscaled";

/** `fontpixel::formats::pbf::OffsetWidth`: Glyph offset field width (v1 always u16 words, v2 always u32 bytes). */
export type OffsetWidth = "auto" | "16" | "32";

/** `fontpixel::error::Operation`: Capability being requested. */
export type Operation = "detect" | "read" | "write";

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcf::Order`: Byte/bit significance order, independently selectable in PCF. */
export type Order = "msb" | "lsb";

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::os2::Os2Table`: Editable, version-aware OS/2 table. Unsupported extension loss is an error. */
export interface Os2Table {
    /** Version 0 through 5. */
    version: number;
    /** Original common fields. */
    base: Base;
    /** Required for version 1+, forbidden for version 0. */
    code_page_ranges?: number[] | null;
    /** Required for version 2+, forbidden in older versions. */
    extension?: Extension | null;
    /** Version 5 optical point-size bounds, in twentieths of a point. */
    optical_sizes?: number[] | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cff::Outline`: Writer geometry; dots reference one font-wide global subroutine. */
export type Outline = OutlinePath | OutlineDots;

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cff::Outline::Dots`: Lower-left cell origins in design units. */
export interface OutlineDots {
    /** Lower-left cell origins in design units. */
    dots: [number, number][];
}

/** `fontpixel::variants::export::OutlineFlavor`: Outline encoding inside the sfnt container. */
export type OutlineFlavor = "true_type" | "cff";

/** `fontpixel::outline::Limits`: Bounded geometry generation and expansion. */
export interface OutlineLimits {
    /** Maximum source pixels or output raster pixels. */
    max_pixels?: number;
    /** Maximum traced boundary edges. */
    max_edges?: number;
    /** Maximum points in a generated or expanded glyph. */
    max_points?: number;
    /** Maximum raster edge/scanline intersections. */
    max_intersections?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::outline_metadata::OutlineMetadataOptions`: Exact name-table records and OS/2 fields for outline exports. */
export interface OutlineMetadataOptions {
    /** Exact name record PLATFORM/ENCODING/LANGUAGE/NAME_ID=TEXT (the --otb-name-record syntax). Repeatable; any record (or --name-record-hex / --name-language-tag) replaces the whole generated table and the --family/--style/--full-name/--postscript-name/--copyright name texts. Source notices the table drops are reported as loss. Example: */
    name_record?: string[];
    /** Name record with exact bytes: PLATFORM/ENCODING/LANGUAGE/NAME_ID=HEX. */
    name_record_hex?: string[];
    /** BCP 47 language tag for name format 1; the Nth tag is language 0x8000+N. */
    name_language_tag?: string[];
    /** OS/2 fsType embedding permissions; native default 0. */
    fs_type?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 fsSelection (version 3: bits 7..=9 rejected); native default 0x40. */
    fs_selection?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 usBreakChar; native default 0. */
    break_char?: number | null;
    /** Exact OS/2 ulCodePageRange1,ulCodePageRange2 instead of the cmap-derived bits. */
    code_page_ranges?: number[] | null;
    /** head.created, seconds since 1904-01-01 UTC; requires --modified. */
    created?: WideInt | null;
    /** head.modified, seconds since 1904-01-01 UTC; requires --created. */
    modified?: WideInt | null;
    /** post.isFixedPitch override; absent follows the source spacing. */
    fixed_pitch?: boolean | null;
    /** maxp.maxZones of TrueType output, 1 (native) or 2. */
    max_zones?: string | null;
    /** gasp table: keep (native) or omit. */
    gasp?: string | null;
    /** cmap format-12 records: always (native), non-bmp, or when-needed (format 12 only when format 4 cannot hold the map, under (3,10) only). */
    cmap_unicode_full?: string | null;
    /** Glyph IDs: planned (native, by glyph name) or codepoint (encoded glyphs by smallest scalar, then alternates in planned order). */
    glyph_order?: string | null;
    /** Shared dot glyph of TrueType dot output: last (native) or after-notdef (glyph 1). */
    dot_glyph?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::outline::Options`: Explicit bitmap-to-outline options. */
export interface OutlineOptions {
    /** Shape to generate. */
    shape?: Shape;
    /** Positive integer design units per pixel. */
    units_per_pixel?: number;
    /** Dot/square side length relative to one pixel, in `(0, 1.5]`. */

    /** Pixel-relative lower-left bitmap origin. */
    origin?: [number, number];
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cff::Outline::Path`: Explicit closed paths; empty is a valid blank glyph. */
export interface OutlinePath {
    /** Explicit closed paths; empty is a valid blank glyph. */
    path: Command[];
}

/** `fontpixel::resources::OutputAsset`: One in-memory output asset; the caller decides where to persist it. */

/** `fontpixel_ops::p2_formats::ReadOptions`: Read options: explicit P2 codec options shared by inspection and conversion. */

    /** Glyph cells placed side by side in each raw horizontal strip (default 1). */

    /** Prefix bytes before the first raw glyph. */

    /** Fallback two-byte little-endian load address when no matching source prefix exists. */

    /** Explicit charset identity of raw slot codes. */

    /** DOS CPI input pointers (default linear). */

    /** Exact charset label of FONTX2 source codes. */

    /** Explicit HZK/ASC preset, e.g. HZK16, HZK24S, ASC16. */

    /** HZK glyph width; overrides a preset's geometry. */

    /** HZK glyph height; overrides a preset's geometry. */

    /** HZK first slot code, e.g. 0xA1A1. */

    /** HZK last permitted slot code, inclusive. */

    /** HZK slot domain for custom geometry. */

    /** HZK bitmap storage orientation (default rows). */

    /** Exact HZK input or output glyph count. */

    /** Explicit NFNT legacy charset label. */

    /** Relative AppleDouble companion when reading the data fork. */

    /** Explicitly threshold imported BMFont grayscale; default preserves samples. */

    /** GEM input header integer order; default uses structural detection. */

    /** GEM input bitmap word order; default follows its header flag. */

    /** SNF input integer order; default uses version stamps. */
    snf_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input bitmap layout: bits,bytes,row-padding,scan-unit,rows; e.g. msb,big,4,1,top-down. */
    snf_read_layout?: string | null;
}

    /** SymbOS alternative extended layout header. */

    /** SymbOS output cell height. */

    /** Project Oberon family byte. */

    /** Project Oberon variant byte. */

    /** WSF native encoding identifier. */

    /** WSF wire bit order. */

    /** WSF wire byte order. */

    /** WSF coverage storage. */

    /** WSF bytes per raster row. */

    /** BeOS output coverage palette. */

    /** Explicitly quantize BeOS gray samples to the selected palette. */

    /** Interpret BeOS source legacy labels as Unicode numbers. */

    /** Permit retained fractional BeOS advances on output. */
    beos_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Prebuilt numeric byte order (default big). */

    /** Prebuilt output bitmap pixel order (default msb; lsb for explicit compatibility). */
    prebuilt_bitmap_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Prebuilt native coverage precision; otherwise inferred per strike. */
    prebuilt_depth?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly round prebuilt gray samples to the selected palette. */

    /** Prebuilt character-set name. */
    prebuilt_charset_name?: string | null;
    /** Prebuilt font identifier. */
    prebuilt_identifier?: number | null;
    /** Catalyst output directory origin. */

    /** Catalyst common raster height. */
    catalyst_height?: number | null;
    /** Catalyst inter-line leading. */

    /** Catalyst common trailing bearing. */

    /** ChiWriter output generation (default 4). */

    /** ChiWriter compatible output directory. */

    /** ChiWriter output raster bytes per row. */
    chiwriter_stride?: number | null;
    /** ChiWriter output cell width. */
    chiwriter_width?: number | null;
    /** ChiWriter output cell height. */

    /** ChiWriter cell-top to baseline distance. */
    chiwriter_baseline?: number | null;
    /** ChiWriter v3 baseline-to-next-cell-top distance. */

    /** ChiWriter native filename (Latin-1, at most thirteen bytes). */
    chiwriter_filename?: string | null;

    dashen_version?: string | null;
    /** Dashen native screen top offset. */
    dashen_top?: number | null;
    /** Emit an explicit Dashen codepoint remapping table. */
    dashen_codepoint_map?: boolean;
    /** PCL physical raster orientation. */
    hppcl_orientation?: string | null;
    /** PCL character encoding (default raw). */
    hppcl_compression?: string | null;
    /** Maximum PCL character-command bytes, including descriptor (17..32767). */
    hppcl_continuation_bytes?: number | null;
    /** PCL format 20 horizontal resolution. */
    hppcl_x_resolution?: number | null;
    /** PCL format 20 vertical resolution. */
    hppcl_y_resolution?: number | null;
    /** PCL native symbol-set identifier. */
    hppcl_symbol_set?: number | null;
    /** Executable font loader variant (default frapt). */
    comfont_variant?: string | null;
    /** CP/M target for PSFCOM and UDG native loaders (default pcw). */
    comfont_cpm_target?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of Consoleet output filenames (default legacy). */
    consoleet_codes?: string | null;
    /** XBIN glyph-slot count (default auto). */
    xbin_count?: string | null;
    /** Retain validated XBIN screen metadata or write font alone. */
    xbin_screen?: string | null;
    /** Zap output layout (default redraw). */

    /** Fixed cell width for supported native console and small font formats. */

    /** Fixed cell height, paired with --native-cell-width. */

    drhalo_first?: number | null;

    iigs_version?: string | null;
    /** IIgs output envelope (default bare). */
    iigs_container?: string | null;
    /** Berkeley vfont output integer byte order (default little). */
    vfont_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly project Unicode numbers to vfont legacy byte positions. */
    vfont_unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;

    fzx_height?: number | null;
    /** FZX common tracking in pixels. */
    fzx_tracking?: number | null;
    /** Explicitly project Unicode numbers to FZX legacy byte positions. */
    fzx_unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Common FIGlet character-art cell height. */
    figlet_height?: number | null;
    /** FIGlet baseline measured in rows from the cell top. */
    figlet_baseline?: number | null;
    /** Explicitly interpret legacy code numbers as FIGlet Unicode values. */
    figlet_legacy_as_unicode?: boolean;
    /** Palm output wrapper (default prc). */
    palm_container?: string | null;
    /** Palm bitmap resource version (default 1). */
    palm_version?: string | null;
    /** Comma-separated Palm densities, one per input strike. */
    palm_densities?: number[];
    /** Explicitly project Unicode numbers to Palm legacy character codes. */
    palm_unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** GDR strike descriptor version (default 41). */
    gdr_version?: string | null;
    /** GDR collection UID in decimal or 0x hexadecimal notation. */
    gdr_collection_uid?: number | null;
    /** Use legacy character codes for GDR output instead of Unicode. */
    gdr_write_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Color bitmap table family; both encode black pixels with coverage alpha. */
    color_flavor?: string | null;
    /** Explicit OTB/bdat design units per em; absent preserves automatic scaling. */
    otb_upm?: number | null;
    /** OTB/bdat metric source: first, largest y-ppem, or a zero-based strike index. */
    otb_reference?: string | null;
    /** OTB/bdat pixel-to-design rounding; absent preserves native half-away rounding. */
    otb_rounding?: string | null;
    /** Complete OTB/bdat name table record PLATFORM/ENCODING/LANGUAGE/NAME_ID=TEXT. */
    otb_name_record?: string[];
    /** Name record with exact bytes: PLATFORM/ENCODING/LANGUAGE/NAME_ID=HEX. */
    otb_name_record_hex?: string[];
    /** BCP 47 language tag for name format 1; the Nth tag is language 0x8000+N. */
    otb_name_language_tag?: string[];
    /** Exact head.flags (bit 15 is reserved); native default 11. */
    otb_head_flags?: number | null;
    /** head.lowestRecPPEM, 1..=65535; native default 8. */
    otb_lowest_rec_ppem?: number | null;
    /** head.created, seconds since 1904-01-01 UTC; requires --otb-modified. */
    otb_created?: WideInt | null;
    /** head.modified, seconds since 1904-01-01 UTC; requires --otb-created. */
    otb_modified?: WideInt | null;
    /** OS/2 table version (same layout); native default 4. */
    otb_os2_version?: string | null;
    /** OS/2 achVendID, exactly four printable ASCII characters; native NONE. */
    otb_vendor?: string | null;
    /** Ten comma-separated PANOSE bytes; native default all zero. */
    otb_panose?: SerdeBytes | null;
    /** OS/2 Unicode ranges: coverage (native), non-bmp (only bit 57, when the cmap maps a supplementary scalar), or four comma-separated words. */
    otb_unicode_ranges?: string | null;
    /** OS/2 usBreakChar; native default 0. */
    otb_break_char?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 fsType embedding permissions; native default 0. */
    otb_fs_type?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 fsSelection; native default 0x40 (regular). */
    otb_fs_selection?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 xAvgCharWidth arithmetic over nonzero advances (native nearest). */
    otb_average_width?: string | null;
    /** post glyph names: keep (format 2, native) or omit (format 3, reported loss). */
    otb_post_names?: string | null;
    /** post.isFixedPitch override; absent follows the source spacing. */
    otb_fixed_pitch?: boolean | null;
    /** cmap format-12 records: always (native: (0,4) and (3,10)), non-bmp (omit (0,4) for BMP-only maps) or when-needed (format 12 only when format 4 cannot hold the map, under (3,10) only). Mappings never change. */
    otb_cmap_unicode_full?: string | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc widthMax: bitmap (largest bitmap width, native) or advance. */
    otb_width_max?: string | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc index layout: canonical (native), shared-runs, or spanning (one format-1 subtable across glyph IDs absent from a strike). */
    otb_index_layout?: string | null;
    /** Shortest shared-metric run with --otb-index-layout shared-runs (default 8). */
    otb_index_min_run?: number | null;
    /** TrueType outline tables: none (native OTB) or empty-glyf (one-byte glyf, short loca, maxp 1.0; outline-derived bounds and bearings become zero). */
    otb_outline_tables?: string | null;
    /** maxp.maxZones (1 or 2) with --otb-outline-tables empty-glyf (default 1). */
    otb_max_zones?: string | null;
    /** Glyph 0: preserve (native) or empty (no bitmap in any strike, hmtx advance from --otb-notdef-advance; replacing a source .notdef is loss). */
    otb_notdef?: string | null;
    /** Empty .notdef advance width in design units. */
    otb_notdef_advance?: number | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc caret slope RISE,RUN of every strike (native 1,0: upright). */
    otb_caret_slope?: number[] | null;
    /** EBLC/bloc minOriginSB/minAdvanceSB/maxBeforeBL/minAfterBL: computed (native) or zero. */
    otb_line_extremes?: string | null;
    /** Vertical line record of horizontal-only strikes: zero (native) or mirror-horizontal (a copy of the horizontal record). */
    otb_vertical_line_metrics?: string | null;
    /** post underline POSITION,THICKNESS in design units; replacing source underline metrics is reported as loss. */
    otb_underline?: number[] | null;
    /** hmtx: full (native, one long metric per glyph) or compact-trailing. */
    otb_hmtx?: string | null;
    /** Glyph IDs: first-seen (native) or codepoint (encoded glyphs by smallest scalar, then unencoded glyphs in first-seen order). */
    otb_glyph_order?: string | null;
    /** DRCS output cell width; requires --drcs-cell-height. */
    drcs_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** DRCS output cell height; requires --drcs-cell-width. */
    drcs_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** DRCS cell left edge relative to the glyph origin (default zero). */
    drcs_cell_x?: WideInt | null;
    /** DRCS cell bottom edge relative to the baseline (default zero). */
    drcs_cell_y?: WideInt | null;
    /** DRCS character set size (default 94). */
    drcs_charset?: string | null;
    /** DEC character set designator (default a space followed by @). */
    drcs_designator?: string | null;
    /** Use 8-bit DCS/ST control bytes instead of ESC P / ESC backslash. */
    drcs_eight_bit_controls?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::amiga::Packaging`: Amiga output packaging. */
export type Packaging = "auto" | "contents" | "strike";

/** `fontpixel::formats::palm::PalmCodec`: Registry codec with independent read/write choices. */
export interface PalmCodec {
    /** Reader options. */
    read_options?: PalmReadOptions;
    /** Writer options. */
    write_options?: PalmWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::palm::PalmContainer`: Palm font wrapper. */
export type PalmContainer = "bare" | "pdb" | "prc";

/** `fontpixel::formats::palm::PalmReadOptions`: Explicit Palm input choices. */
export interface PalmReadOptions {
    /** Override automatic wrapper recognition. */
    container?: PalmContainer | null;
    /** Fractional density coordinates are ambiguous in the published resource specification. */
    rounding?: PalmRounding;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::palm::PalmRounding`: Interpretation of fractional 108-dpi coordinates. */
export type PalmRounding = "exact" | "floor";

/** `fontpixel::formats::palm::PalmVersion`: Bitmap resource version. */
export type PalmVersion = "1" | "2" | "afnx" | "fontsubst" | "gray1" | "gray2";

/** `fontpixel::formats::palm::PalmWriteOptions`: Bounded native Palm output choices. */
export interface PalmWriteOptions {
    /** Output wrapper. */
    container?: PalmContainer;
    /** Bitmap layout. */
    version?: PalmVersion;
    /** Density per model strike; empty uses `palm.density`, or 72. */
    densities?: number[];
    /** Explicit permission to use Unicode numbers as Palm legacy character codes. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale threshold; absent rejects grayscale. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Allocation and geometry limits, also applied to output decoding. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum output bytes, also bounded by input limits. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::PartLicense`: Supplemental notices never erase originals. */
export interface PartLicense {
    /** Additional copyright. */
    copyright?: string | null;
    /** Additional license. */
    license?: string | null;
    /** Additional license URL. */
    license_url?: string | null;
    /** Explicit permission; Unknown permits metadata inspection. */
    modification?: ModificationPermission;
    /** Additional known reserved names. */
    reserved_names?: string[];
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::report::PartMetrics`: Per-part baseline metric accounting. */
export interface PartMetrics {
    /** Source part. */
    part_index: number;
    /** Original explicit ascent. */
    original_ascent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Original explicit descent. */
    original_descent?: WideInt | null;
    /** Effective shifted ascent. */
    shifted_ascent: WideInt;
    /** Effective shifted descent. */
    shifted_descent: WideInt;
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::report::PartReport`: Selection, contribution and omission totals for an input part. */
export interface PartReport {
    /** Zero-based index. */
    index: number;
    /** Component label. */
    label: string;
    /** Selection expression. */
    selection: string;
    /** Vertical shift, positive up. */
    dy: WideInt;
    /** Output glyph records. */
    taken_glyphs: number;
    /** Distinct scalar mappings. */
    taken_codepoints: number;
    /** Distinct complete sequence mappings. */
    taken_sequences: number;
    /** Scalars supplied through fallback. */
    fallback_codepoints: number;
    /** Sequences supplied through fallback. */
    fallback_sequences: number;
    /** Selected positions absent from this source. */
    selected_missing: WideInt;
    /** Exact missing intervals. */
    missing_ranges: CodepointRange[];
    /** Missing block summaries. */
    missing_blocks: MissingBlock[];
    /** Non-Unicode source mappings omitted. */
    omitted_legacy_mappings: number;
    /** Non-scalar mappings omitted. */
    omitted_invalid_mappings: number;
    /** Unencoded records omitted. */
    omitted_unencoded_glyphs: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pbf::PbfCodec`: Registry codec; no filesystem or external resources are accessed. */

    /** Reader normalization. */
    read_options?: PbfReadOptions;
    /** Writer choices. */
    write_options?: PbfWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pbf::Compression`: Bitmap storage; RLE4 is available only in v3. */
export type PbfCompression = "raw" | "rle4";

/** `fontpixel::formats::pbf::PbfReadOptions`: Optional catalogue-compatible trimming. */
export interface PbfReadOptions {
    /** Crop blank margins, reporting changed rectangles as loss. */
    trim?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pbf::Version`: PBF wire version. */
export type PbfVersion = "1" | "2" | "3";

/** `fontpixel::formats::pbf::PbfWriteOptions`: Explicit, bounded Pebble output choices. */
export interface PbfWriteOptions {
    /** Wire version, default v3. */
    version?: PbfVersion;
    /** Raw or v3 RLE4. */
    compression?: PbfCompression;
    /** Glyph offset field width. */
    offset_width?: OffsetWidth;
    /** Hash bucket count for v2/v3, between one and 255. */
    hash_buckets?: number;
    /** Unicode field width, None chooses 2 or 4; v1 only accepts 2. */
    codepoint_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Override line-top baseline; otherwise ascent then pixel size. */
    max_height?: number | null;
    /** Override BMP fallback codepoint. */
    wildcard?: number | null;
    /** Required explicit threshold for gray input. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Aggregate and geometry limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum generated file size. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcf::PcfCodec`: Actual PCF registry hooks, with strongly typed writer configuration. */
export interface PcfCodec {
    /** Options for registry writes. */
    write_options?: PcfWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::options::PcfMetadataPrecedence`: Whether normalized size edits or existing PCF properties win. */
export type PcfMetadataPrecedence = "normalized-edits" | "explicit-properties";

/** `fontpixel_ops::options::PcfOptions`: PCF output layout and metadata options (`--to pcf` only). */
export interface PcfOptions {
    /** PCF table integer byte order. */
    byte_order?: Significance | null;
    /** PCF bitmap bit order. */
    bit_order?: Significance | null;
    /** PCF row alignment in bytes (1, 2, 4 or 8). */
    glyph_pad?: string | null;
    /** PCF bitmap scan unit in bytes (1, 2 or 4). */
    scan_unit?: string | null;
    /** Whether edited size/resolution rewrite existing PCF POINT_SIZE and RESOLUTION* properties (normalized-edits, the default) or the existing properties are kept and each disagreement is reported as loss. */
    pcf_metadata_precedence?: PcfMetadataPrecedence | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcf::PcfWriteOptions`: PCF-specific deterministic output choices. */
export interface PcfWriteOptions {
    /** Integer byte order inside tables. */
    byte_order?: Order;
    /** Bitmap bit order. */
    bit_order?: Order;
    /** Per-row byte alignment. */
    glyph_pad?: GlyphPad;
    /** Bitmap byte-swap unit. */
    scan_unit?: ScanUnit;
    /** Explicit Gray8 threshold; None refuses grayscale input. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Maximum serialized bytes, enforced before output allocations. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
    /** Budgets for glyphs, intermediate tables, pixels and model data. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Size/resolution property precedence after normalized edits. */
    metadata_precedence?: MetadataPrecedence;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcgeos::PcgeosCodec`: Native registry codec. */
export interface PcgeosCodec {
    /** Input policy. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcgeos::PcgeosReadOptions`: Native input policy. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcgeos::PcgeosVariant`: Native layout families. */
export type PcgeosVariant = "sbcs" | "dbcs";

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcgeos::PcgeosWriteOptions`: Bounded native output choices. */
export interface PcgeosWriteOptions {
    /** Layout; absent preserves source, otherwise SBCS. */
    variant?: PcgeosVariant | null;
    /** Native registered font ID. */

    /** Shared family name. */

    /** Explicit permission to round fractional integer-only native metrics. */
    round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Explicit permission to interpret Unicode numbers as SBCS byte codes. */

    /** Explicit permission to interpret legacy numbers as DBCS Unicode scalars. */

    /** Explicit grayscale threshold. */

    /** Shared resource limits. */

    /** Output cap, also bounded by max_input_bytes. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcr::PcrCodec`: Native pcr registry codec. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcr::PcrReadOptions`: Typed pcr input choices. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::pf2::Pf2Codec`: Native PF2 registry codec. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::pfr::PfrCodec`: Native registry codec. */

    read_options?: PfrReadOptions;
    /** Typed writer options. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pfr::PfrDialect`: Native conventions whose published specification and FreeType consumer differ. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::pfr::PfrReadOptions`: Typed input choices. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::pfr::PfrWriteOptions`: Native output and explicit conversion choices. */

    /** Raster encoding. */

    /** Store raster rows from the top downward. */

    /** Raw-stream bit value representing ink. */

    /** Cumulative allocation and field limits. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pilfont::PilfontCodec`: Native format codec and typed options. */

    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::Progress`: One completed step of a long operation, passed to the progress observer of [`merge_with_progress`] and [`convert_with_progress`]. */
export interface Progress {
    /** The step that has just completed. */
    step: ProgressStep;
    /** Completed items of this step so far, starting at 1. */
    done: number;
    /** Items this step has in total. */
    total: number;
    /** The input path (`read`) or output destination (`encode`); `None` for `merge`. Non-UTF-8 path bytes are replaced. */
    item?: string | null;
    /** Glyphs decoded from the input or selected from the part (`read`), or glyphs in the merged font (`merge`). */
    glyphs?: number | null;
    /** Bytes of every asset of the encoded output (`encode`). */
    bytes?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::ProgressStep`: Step kinds reported in [`Progress`]. */
export type ProgressStep = "read" | "merge" | "encode";

/** `fontpixel_ops::metadata::ProjectionOptions`: Explicit target-application projection; omitted means no change. Every replaced or removed source value is reported as loss, so --strict rejects it. */
export interface ProjectionOptions {
    /** Replace every glyph's scalable advance (BDF SWIDTH x) with round-half-even(DWIDTH x * --swidth-units / PPEM). Overwritten source values are reported as loss, so --strict rejects them. */
    swidth_ppem?: number | null;
    /** Scalable units per em for --swidth-ppem (BDF uses 1000). */
    swidth_units?: number | null;
    /** Exact FONT/XLFD name. The decomposed XLFD fields and an existing FONT property follow it; other name properties are not rewritten. */
    font_name?: string | null;
    /** Point size (BDF SIZE); requires --resolution. */
    point_size?: number | null;
    /** Resolution as X,Y dots per inch (BDF SIZE); requires --point-size. */
    resolution?: [number, number] | null;
    /** Set an integer property, NAME=VALUE (repeatable). PIXEL_SIZE, FONT_ASCENT/DESCENT and other integer metrics keep the model in sync. */
    set_integer_property?: string[];
    /** Set a text property, NAME=TEXT (repeatable). */
    set_text_property?: string[];
    /** Remove every record of a property (repeatable). Comments and copyright/notice/licence properties cannot be removed. */
    remove_property?: string[];
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::ProjectionOutcome`: Complete result of a committed projection. */
export interface ProjectionOutcome {
    /** Diagnostics: one entry per strike, option and impact class. */
    report: Report;
    /** Every changed scalable advance, in strike then glyph-ID order. */
    scalable_advance_changes: ScalableAdvanceChange[];
    /** Every changed metadata value, in strike then option order. */
    metadata_changes: MetadataChange[];
}

/** `fontpixel::model::properties::Properties` */
export type PropertiesDict = Property[];

/** `fontpixel::model::properties::Property`: One original-cased source property. */
export interface Property {
    /** Exact source key spelling. */
    name: string;
    /** Interpreted value. */
    value: PropertyValue;
    /** Optional original record bytes, including delimiters/line ending if needed. This is provenance; writers must not blindly reuse it after model edits. */
    raw?: SerdeBytes | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::properties::PropertyValue`: Typed property value. Decimal text avoids lossy float parsing; raw records can preserve exact spelling/quoting independently of this semantic value. */
export type PropertyValue = "Flag" | PropertyValueInteger | PropertyValueUnsigned | PropertyValueDecimal | PropertyValueText | PropertyValueBytes | PropertyValueList;

/** `fontpixel::model::properties::PropertyValue::Bytes`: Opaque binary field. */
export interface PropertyValueBytes {
    /** Opaque binary field. */
    Bytes: SerdeBytes;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::properties::PropertyValue::Decimal`: Exact decimal representation, interpreted by its owning format. */
export interface PropertyValueDecimal {
    /** Exact decimal representation, interpreted by its owning format. */
    Decimal: string;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::properties::PropertyValue::Integer`: Signed integer. */
export interface PropertyValueInteger {
    /** Signed integer. */
    Integer: WideInt;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::properties::PropertyValue::List`: Ordered compound value, such as comments or numeric vectors. */
export interface PropertyValueList {
    /** Ordered compound value, such as comments or numeric vectors. */
    List: PropertyValue[];
}

/** `fontpixel::model::properties::PropertyValue::Text`: Text content, with source quoting removed when appropriate. */
export interface PropertyValueText {
    /** Text content, with source quoting removed when appropriate. */
    Text: string;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::properties::PropertyValue::Unsigned`: Unsigned integer (e.g. source fields above i64::MAX). */
export interface PropertyValueUnsigned {
    /** Unsigned integer (e.g. source fields above i64::MAX). */
    Unsigned: WideInt;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::psf2txt::Psf2txtCodec`: Native psf2txt registry codec. */
export interface Psf2txtCodec {
    /** Input profile choices. */
    read_options?: Psf2txtReadOptions;
    /** Output conversion and resource choices. */
    write_options?: W5a1CommonNativeWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::psf2txt::Psf2txtReadOptions`: Typed psf2txt input choices. */
export interface Psf2txtReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::psf::PsfCodec`: Immutable registry codec for PSF1 and PSF2, including gzip transport. */
export interface PsfCodec {
    /** Writer options; reads use the caller's shared resource limits. */
    write_options?: PsfWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::psf::Version`: PSF wire format, independent of the source font's format. */
export type PsfVersion = "1" | "2";

/** `fontpixel::formats::psf::PsfWriteOptions`: Bounded deterministic PSF writer options. */
export interface PsfWriteOptions {
    /** PSF version (default 2). */
    version?: PsfVersion;
    /** Optional PSF1 count, exactly 256 or 512. None chooses the smallest fit. */
    psf1_count?: number | null;
    /** Unicode-table policy. */
    unicode_table?: UnicodeTable;
    /** Required explicit threshold for Gray8 input. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Glyph, pixel, bitmap-table, mapping-table and cumulative budgets. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum generated file bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pxl::PxlCodec`: Registry codec. */
export interface PxlCodec {
    /** Input choices. */
    read_options?: PxlReadOptions;
    /** Output choices. */
    write_options?: PxlWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pxl::PxlReadOptions`: Optional explicit TFM resource; no implicit filename lookup. */
export interface PxlReadOptions {
    /** Require one PXL identifier. */
    version?: PxlVersion | null;
    /** Apply this bounded TFM width table. */
    tfm?: ResourcePath | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pxl::PxlVersion`: PXL storage alignment. */
export type PxlVersion = "1001" | "1002";

/** `fontpixel::formats::pxl::PxlWriteOptions`: Bounded output and optional TFM generation. */
export interface PxlWriteOptions {
    /** Raster variant. */
    version?: PxlVersion;
    /** Optional TFM output path. */
    tfm?: ResourcePath | null;
    /** Magnification units (five per dpi); absent preserves source or uses 1000. */
    magnification?: number | null;
    /** Explicit numeric Unicode projection. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Gray reduction threshold. */

    /** Shared resource limits. */

    /** Aggregate output size cap. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::qpf2::Qpf2Codec`: Registry adapter with explicit native options. */
export interface Qpf2Codec {
    /** Input policy. */
    read_options?: Qpf2ReadOptions;
    /** Output policy. */
    write_options?: Qpf2WriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::qpf2::Qpf2ReadOptions`: QPF2 never implicitly opens a linked outline font. */
export interface Qpf2ReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::qpf2::Qpf2WriteOptions`: Native QPF2 output policy. */
export interface Qpf2WriteOptions {
    /** Native raster layout for newly encoded or edited data. */
    glyph_format?: GlyphFormat;
    /** Required to reduce Gray8 when requesting packed Mono output. */

    /** Cumulative input/model/temporary/output/reread limits. */

    /** Maximum output bytes. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::qpf::QpfCodec`: Registry adapter for the packed legacy QPF format. */

    /** Explicit external input metadata. */
    read_options?: QpfReadOptions;
    /** Output policy. */
    write_options?: QpfWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::qpf::QpfReadOptions`: Metadata explicitly supplied from outside the headerless QPF record. */
export interface QpfReadOptions {
    /** Family name, conventionally carried in a QPF filename rather than bytes. */
    family?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::qpf::QpfWriteOptions`: Native packed QPF output options. */
export interface QpfWriteOptions {
    /** Explicit Gray8-to-Mono conversion; absence preserves native Gray8. */

    /** Cumulative input/model/output/reread storage limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum output bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::gasp::Range`: Inclusive upper ppem bound and behavior flags (bits 0–3). */
export interface Range {
    /** Last ppem covered by this range; final range must be 65535. */
    max_ppem: number;

    behavior: number;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::options::RasterOptions`: Input decoding options and resource limits shared by every reading command. */
export interface RasterOptions {
    /** Explicit raw layout preset (VGA, C64, Spectrum, CH8, MSX or Harlekin). */
    raw_preset?: string | null;
    /** Raw glyph width; overrides a selected preset. */
    raw_width?: number | null;
    /** Raw glyph height; overrides a selected preset. */

    /** Exact raw glyph count; otherwise consume complete records. */

    /** First raw slot code, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */

    /** Bit order within each raw byte (default msb). */
    raw_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Raw row order (default top-down). */
    raw_row_order?: string | null;
    /** Raw alignment: byte-aligned rows or continuous packed bits. */
    raw_packing?: string | null;
    /** Row-major or byte-column-major storage within each horizontal strip. */
    raw_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Glyph cells placed side by side in each raw horizontal strip (default 1). */
    raw_strike_count?: number | null;
    /** Extra padding bytes after every raw row. */
    raw_row_padding?: number | null;
    /** Prefix bytes before the first raw glyph. */
    raw_offset?: number | null;
    /** Fallback two-byte little-endian load address when no matching source prefix exists. */
    raw_default_load_address?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset identity of raw slot codes. */
    raw_charset?: string | null;
    /** DOS CPI input pointers (default linear). */
    cpi_pointer_mode?: string | null;
    /** Exact charset label of FONTX2 source codes. */
    fontx2_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Explicit HZK/ASC preset, e.g. HZK16, HZK24S, ASC16. */
    hzk_preset?: string | null;
    /** HZK glyph width; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_width?: number | null;
    /** HZK glyph height; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_height?: number | null;
    /** HZK first slot code, e.g. 0xA1A1. */
    hzk_first?: string | null;
    /** HZK last permitted slot code, inclusive. */
    hzk_last?: string | null;
    /** HZK slot domain for custom geometry. */
    hzk_code_space?: string | null;
    /** HZK bitmap storage orientation (default rows). */
    hzk_storage?: string | null;
    /** Exact HZK input or output glyph count. */
    hzk_count?: number | null;
    /** Explicit NFNT legacy charset label. */
    nfnt_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Relative AppleDouble companion when reading the data fork. */
    nfnt_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly threshold imported BMFont grayscale; default preserves samples. */
    bmfont_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** GEM input header integer order; default uses structural detection. */
    gem_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** GEM input bitmap word order; default follows its header flag. */
    gem_read_word_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input integer order; default uses version stamps. */
    snf_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input bitmap layout: bits,bytes,row-padding,scan-unit,rows; e.g. msb,big,4,1,top-down. */
    snf_read_layout?: string | null;
    /** Scoped PNG mask for a PILfont descriptor (its native suffix is .pbm). */
    pilfont_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Scoped PNG atlas for a Playdate FNT descriptor. */
    playdate_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell width. */
    playdate_read_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell height. */
    playdate_read_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for MGTK legacy positions; no implicit Unicode remapping. */
    mgtk_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Family name supplied externally for a QPF font. */
    qpf_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Require the DAVIC specification or FreeType PFR wire dialect. */
    pfr_read_dialect?: string | null;
    /** Require a Xerox native font family. */
    xerox_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicit baseline for Alto files with a zero native header baseline. */
    xerox_read_alto_baseline?: number | null;
    /** Require the SBCS or DBCS PC/GEOS layout. */
    pcgeos_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly round fractional PC/GEOS input metrics. */
    pcgeos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Retain the additional GPI unmapped null descriptor (default true). */
    gpi_include_unmapped_null?: boolean | null;
    /** Require a RISC OS bitmap generation. */
    riscos_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Relative RISC OS IntMetrics input companion. */
    riscos_read_metrics?: string | null;
    /** Explicit marker-image dialect; otherwise inspect native controls. */
    sfont_read_flavor?: string | null;
    /** Ordered SFont labels, comma-separated U+0041 or legacy:0x41. */
    sfont_read_codepoints?: string[];
    /** SFont baseline down from glyph top. */
    sfont_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a Daisy-Dot input generation. */
    daisy_read_version?: string | null;
    /** PolyPrint baseline measured from the cell top. */
    polyprint_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Print Shop baseline measured from the cell top. */
    printshop_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a TasPrint input platform. */
    tasprint_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit PCW input width. */
    tasprint_read_width?: number | null;
    /** Require PXL version 1001 or 1002. */
    pxl_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Scoped TFM sidecar path for PXL input. */
    pxl_read_tfm?: string | null;
    /** Require a Signum editor or printer input layout. */
    signum_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Signum baseline. */
    signum_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Explicit Signum line height. */
    signum_line_height?: WideInt | null;
    /** Include the later GEOS DEL slot when interpreting a native strike. */
    geos_read_include_del?: boolean;
    /** Bare Japanese Macintosh resource type (default fbit). */
    fbit_read_kind?: string | null;
    /** Scoped bitmap data fork for an fbit resource. */
    fbit_read_data_fork?: string | null;
    /** Scoped AppleDouble resource companion for an fbit data-fork input. */
    fbit_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
    /** Explicit cell width for bare HFNT input. */
    fbit_read_hfnt_width?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for Lisa legacy positions. */
    lisa_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Accept shortened SymbOS character ranges. */
    symbos_read_allow_short_range?: boolean;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific bit order zero. */
    wsfont_known_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific byte order zero. */
    wsfont_known_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** BeOS coverage interpretation (default native8). */
    beos_read_coverage?: string | null;
    /** Permit explicit rounding of fractional BeOS advances on input. */
    beos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Require a prebuilt bitmap numeric byte order. */
    prebuilt_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Prebuilt input bitmap pixel order (default msb; independent of numeric byte order). */
    prebuilt_read_bitmap_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Catalyst native directory origin (default resource-body). */
    catalyst_offset_base?: string | null;
    /** Require ChiWriter version 3 or 4. */
    chiwriter_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit compatible bitmap directory origin. */
    chiwriter_read_layout?: string | null;
    /** ChiWriter input raster bytes per row. */
    chiwriter_read_stride?: number | null;
    /** Require Dashen screen/printer generation. */
    dashen_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly accept the historical monobit PCL descriptor-size discrepancy. */
    hppcl_allow_legacy_descriptor_size?: boolean;
    /** Baseline below cell top for BBC, COM, Consoleet, GRASP, HRCG, Wyse, XBIN and Zap. */
    native_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Charset label for native console positions; numeric codes stay unchanged. */
    native_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Require one executable font loader variant. */

    /** Meaning of Consoleet numeric filenames (default legacy). */
