    /** Require one Zap font layout. */
    zapfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Override the inferred first legacy code in a Dr. Halo font. */
    drhalo_read_first?: number | null;
    /** Korean 8×4×4 input: compose Hangul syllables or retain component slots. */
    hanfont_read_mode?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset label for Apple IIgs legacy character codes. */
    iigs_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** DRCS baseline down from cell top (default cell height). */
    drcs_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** DEC device matrix rules for both reading and writing DRCS. */
    drcs_terminal?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Berkeley vfont input integer byte order. */
    vfont_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Require a Palm wrapper instead of recognizing its structure. */
    palm_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Explicit handling of fractional Palm density coordinates (default exact). */
    palm_rounding?: string | null;
    /** Interpret GDR source codes as legacy positions instead of Unicode. */
    gdr_read_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicitly reduce KBITX grayscale during import; default retains exact samples. */
    kbitx_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Crop PBF blank margins during import, with a loss report. */
    pbf_trim?: boolean;
    /** C header dialect (default auto). */
    c_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Explicit C source or LVGL binary input container (default auto). */
    c_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Read the pre-2019 two-byte U8x8 header. */
    c_read_u8x8_legacy?: boolean;
    /** C input array or GFXfont symbol to select. */
    c_array?: string | null;
    /** Generic C cell width; requires height, first code and charset. */
    c_width?: number | null;
    /** Generic C cell height; requires `c_width`. */
    c_height?: number | null;
    /** First code in generic C arrays, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    c_first?: string | null;
    /** unicode or an explicit legacy charset name. */
    c_charset?: string | null;
    /** Generic C baseline down from cell top (default height). */
    c_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Generic C bytes store the leftmost pixel in bit zero. */
    c_lsb_first?: boolean;
    /** Relative JSON/TOML atlas mapping, resolved beside the primary input. */
    image_mapping?: string | null;
    /** Literal prefix on numeric glyph filenames in an input directory. */
    image_read_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Input directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_read_radix?: number | null;
    /** Input filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_read_domain?: string | null;
    /** Input image background (default black). */
    image_read_background?: string | null;
    /** Input glyph baseline measured down from each image's top. */
    image_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** HEX input/output rows (default 16); never inferred from record length. */
    hex_height?: number | null;
    /** HEX baseline-to-bottom distance (default 0). */
    hex_descent?: number | null;
    /** Explicit source FNT/FON legacy code page (does not remap byte positions). */
    fnt_read_code_page?: string | null;
    /** Primary input byte budget (default 64 MiB). */
    max_input_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Individual companion-file byte budget. */
    max_resource_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Aggregate resource and codec allocation budget (default 256 MiB). */
    max_total_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum companion reads and directory entries. */
    max_resources?: number | null;
    /** Explicit raster size for reviewed off-grid/curved outlines. */
    ppem?: number | null;
    /** Select a TTC/OTC face (zero based); otherwise read every face. */
    face_index?: number | null;
    /** Rasterize outlines even when matching embedded images exist. */
    no_embedded_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit design units per pixel; requires --ppem. */
    grid_units?: number | null;
    /** Reviewed horizontal and vertical translations in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_x?: number;
    /** Reviewed vertical translation in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_y?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::Rational`: Exact rational metric, avoiding float rounding and preserving equality. Unreduced fractions are allowed so the source's scale remains expressible. */
export interface Rational {
    /** Signed numerator. */
    numerator: WideInt;
    /** Nonzero denominator. */
    denominator: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::raw::RawByteOrder`: Byte ordering inside a horizontal strike. */
export type RawByteOrder = "row-major" | "column-major";

/** `fontpixel::formats::raw::RawCodec`: Raw registry codec; its default reader refuses unspecified layouts. */
export interface RawCodec {
    /** Import configuration. */
    read_options?: RawReadOptions;
    /** Export configuration. */
    write_options?: RawWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::raw::RawLayout`: Binary cell layout; no field is inferred from arbitrary input bytes. */
export interface RawLayout {
    /** Cell width in pixels. */
    width: number;
    /** Cell height in pixels. */
    height: number;
    /** Cell count; absent consumes the entire payload exactly. */
    count?: number | null;
    /** First legacy code assigned in file order. */
    first_codepoint: number;
    /** Significance of bits within each byte. */
    bit_order: BitOrder;
    /** Ordering of glyph rows. */
    row_order: RowOrder;
    /** Extra bytes after every row. */
    row_padding: number;
    /** Row/glyph alignment; defaults to the original byte-aligned rows. */
    packing: RawPacking;
    /** Ordering of byte columns and rows within a strike. */
    byte_order: RawByteOrder;
    /** Glyph cells side by side in each horizontal strike; must be positive. */
    strike_count: number;
    /** Prefix bytes before the first glyph. */
    offset: number;
    /** Default little-endian PRG load address when no matching `raw.prefix` exists. Requires a two-byte offset; import preserves the actual prefix instead. */
    default_load_address?: number | null;
    /** Explicit legacy charset identity. */
    charset?: string | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::raw::RawPacking`: Alignment of raw bitmap rows and glyph boundaries. */
export type RawPacking = "byte-rows" | "bit-aligned";

/**
 * `fontpixel::formats::raw::RawPreset`: Common layouts selected explicitly by name.
 *
 * Input aliases: ``vga-8x8``, ``vga-8x14``, ``vga-8x16``, ``c64-prg``, ``zx-spectrum``, ``harlekin-iii``, ``harlekin512``.
 */
export type RawPreset = "vga8" | "vga14" | "vga16" | "c64" | "64c" | "spectrum" | "ch8" | "msx" | "harlekin" | "harlekin8" | "harlekin16" | "vga-8x8" | "vga-8x14" | "vga-8x16" | "c64-prg" | "zx-spectrum" | "harlekin-iii" | "harlekin512";

/** `fontpixel::formats::raw::RawReadOptions`: Explicit raw import configuration. */
export interface RawReadOptions {
    /** Required layout or explicitly selected preset. */
    layout?: RawLayout | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::raw::RawWriteOptions`: Raw export settings. */
export interface RawWriteOptions {
    /** Explicit output layout; absent uses uniform source cells. */
    layout?: RawLayout | null;
    /** Explicit grayscale threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Output byte bound. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
    /** Model and read-back limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hanfont::ReadMode`: Model projection of a native component font. */
export type ReadMode = "syllables" | "components";

/** `fontpixel::render::GlyphOrder`: Ordering for `draw_all`; file order means last effective occurrence of each code, matching Python's BDF parser. */
export type RenderGlyphOrder = "ascending" | "descending" | "file" | "reverse_file";

/** `fontpixel::render::RenderLimits`: Limits for layout, rendering and diagnostic bookkeeping. */
export interface RenderLimits {
    /** Maximum number of input characters/codes (including missing ones). */
    max_glyphs?: number;
    /** Combined placement/line bookkeeping budget, separate from result pixels. */
    max_layout_bytes?: number;
    /** Diagnostic entries, deduplication keys and text budget, independent of layout. */
    max_report_bytes?: number;
    /** Output bitmap dimensions, pixel count and byte budget. */
    bitmap?: BitmapLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::render::RenderMode`: Spacing mode. SPEC mode 0 concatenates font cells, not tight ink bounds. */
export type RenderMode = "advance" | "cell" | "ink";

/** `fontpixel::render::RenderOptions`: Text rendering controls. No implicit shaping, bidi reordering or line-feed interpretation is performed; input order is placed in the selected direction. */
export interface RenderOptions {
    /** Maximum accumulated width-plus-offset per line, matching SPEC exactly. */
    line_limit?: WideInt;
    /** Advance, cell or explicit tight-ink concatenation. */
    mode?: RenderMode;
    /** Glyph and line progression. */
    direction?: WritingDirection;
    /** Use the arriving glyph's advance for each boundary rather than the prior one. */
    use_current_glyph_spacing?: boolean;
    /** Additional signed gap between glyphs; included in line-limit accounting. */
    letter_spacing?: WideInt;
    /** Additional signed gap between completed lines/columns. */
    line_spacing?: WideInt;
    /** Missing-code behavior (default: SPEC empty cell). */
    missing?: MissingGlyph;
    /** Optional explicit Gray8-to-Mono threshold. `None` rejects grayscale input. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Reject clipping, missing replacements and grayscale conversion reports. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Work and output budgets. */
    limits?: RenderLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::render::RenderRequest`: Render text (or every mapping) to a PNG or SVG image. */
export interface RenderRequest {
    /** Explicit raw layout preset (VGA, C64, Spectrum, CH8, MSX or Harlekin). */
    raw_preset?: string | null;
    /** Raw glyph width; overrides a selected preset. */
    raw_width?: number | null;
    /** Raw glyph height; overrides a selected preset. */
    raw_height?: number | null;
    /** Exact raw glyph count; otherwise consume complete records. */
    raw_count?: number | null;
    /** First raw slot code, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    raw_first?: string | null;
    /** Bit order within each raw byte (default msb). */
    raw_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Raw row order (default top-down). */
    raw_row_order?: string | null;
    /** Raw alignment: byte-aligned rows or continuous packed bits. */
    raw_packing?: string | null;
    /** Row-major or byte-column-major storage within each horizontal strip. */
    raw_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Glyph cells placed side by side in each raw horizontal strip (default 1). */
    raw_strike_count?: number | null;
    /** Extra padding bytes after every raw row. */
    raw_row_padding?: number | null;
    /** Prefix bytes before the first raw glyph. */
    raw_offset?: number | null;
    /** Fallback two-byte little-endian load address when no matching source prefix exists. */
    raw_default_load_address?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset identity of raw slot codes. */
    raw_charset?: string | null;
    /** DOS CPI input pointers (default linear). */
    cpi_pointer_mode?: string | null;
    /** Exact charset label of FONTX2 source codes. */
    fontx2_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Explicit HZK/ASC preset, e.g. HZK16, HZK24S, ASC16. */
    hzk_preset?: string | null;
    /** HZK glyph width; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_width?: number | null;
    /** HZK glyph height; overrides a preset's geometry. */
    hzk_height?: number | null;
    /** HZK first slot code, e.g. 0xA1A1. */
    hzk_first?: string | null;
    /** HZK last permitted slot code, inclusive. */
    hzk_last?: string | null;
    /** HZK slot domain for custom geometry. */
    hzk_code_space?: string | null;
    /** HZK bitmap storage orientation (default rows). */
    hzk_storage?: string | null;
    /** Exact HZK input or output glyph count. */
    hzk_count?: number | null;
    /** Explicit NFNT legacy charset label. */
    nfnt_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Relative AppleDouble companion when reading the data fork. */
    nfnt_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly threshold imported BMFont grayscale; default preserves samples. */
    bmfont_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** GEM input header integer order; default uses structural detection. */
    gem_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** GEM input bitmap word order; default follows its header flag. */
    gem_read_word_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input integer order; default uses version stamps. */
    snf_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** SNF input bitmap layout: bits,bytes,row-padding,scan-unit,rows; e.g. msb,big,4,1,top-down. */
    snf_read_layout?: string | null;
    /** Scoped PNG mask for a PILfont descriptor (its native suffix is .pbm). */
    pilfont_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Scoped PNG atlas for a Playdate FNT descriptor. */
    playdate_read_atlas?: string | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell width. */
    playdate_read_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** Playdate source atlas cell height. */
    playdate_read_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for MGTK legacy positions; no implicit Unicode remapping. */
    mgtk_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Family name supplied externally for a QPF font. */
    qpf_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Require the DAVIC specification or FreeType PFR wire dialect. */
    pfr_read_dialect?: string | null;
    /** Require a Xerox native font family. */
    xerox_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicit baseline for Alto files with a zero native header baseline. */
    xerox_read_alto_baseline?: number | null;
    /** Require the SBCS or DBCS PC/GEOS layout. */
    pcgeos_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly round fractional PC/GEOS input metrics. */
    pcgeos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Retain the additional GPI unmapped null descriptor (default true). */
    gpi_include_unmapped_null?: boolean | null;
    /** Require a RISC OS bitmap generation. */
    riscos_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Relative RISC OS IntMetrics input companion. */
    riscos_read_metrics?: string | null;
    /** Explicit marker-image dialect; otherwise inspect native controls. */
    sfont_read_flavor?: string | null;
    /** Ordered SFont labels, comma-separated U+0041 or legacy:0x41. */
    sfont_read_codepoints?: string[];
    /** SFont baseline down from glyph top. */
    sfont_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a Daisy-Dot input generation. */
    daisy_read_version?: string | null;
    /** PolyPrint baseline measured from the cell top. */
    polyprint_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Print Shop baseline measured from the cell top. */
    printshop_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Require a TasPrint input platform. */
    tasprint_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit PCW input width. */
    tasprint_read_width?: number | null;
    /** Require PXL version 1001 or 1002. */
    pxl_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Scoped TFM sidecar path for PXL input. */
    pxl_read_tfm?: string | null;
    /** Require a Signum editor or printer input layout. */
    signum_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Signum baseline. */
    signum_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Explicit Signum line height. */
    signum_line_height?: WideInt | null;
    /** Include the later GEOS DEL slot when interpreting a native strike. */
    geos_read_include_del?: boolean;
    /** Bare Japanese Macintosh resource type (default fbit). */
    fbit_read_kind?: string | null;
    /** Scoped bitmap data fork for an fbit resource. */
    fbit_read_data_fork?: string | null;
    /** Scoped AppleDouble resource companion for an fbit data-fork input. */
    fbit_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
    /** Explicit cell width for bare HFNT input. */
    fbit_read_hfnt_width?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for Lisa legacy positions. */
    lisa_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Accept shortened SymbOS character ranges. */
    symbos_read_allow_short_range?: boolean;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific bit order zero. */
    wsfont_known_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific byte order zero. */
    wsfont_known_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** BeOS coverage interpretation (default native8). */
    beos_read_coverage?: string | null;
    /** Permit explicit rounding of fractional BeOS advances on input. */
    beos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
    /** Require a prebuilt bitmap numeric byte order. */
    prebuilt_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Prebuilt input bitmap pixel order (default msb; independent of numeric byte order). */
    prebuilt_read_bitmap_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Catalyst native directory origin (default resource-body). */
    catalyst_offset_base?: string | null;
    /** Require ChiWriter version 3 or 4. */
    chiwriter_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicit compatible bitmap directory origin. */
    chiwriter_read_layout?: string | null;
    /** ChiWriter input raster bytes per row. */
    chiwriter_read_stride?: number | null;
    /** Require Dashen screen/printer generation. */
    dashen_read_version?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly accept the historical monobit PCL descriptor-size discrepancy. */
    hppcl_allow_legacy_descriptor_size?: boolean;
    /** Baseline below cell top for BBC, COM, Consoleet, GRASP, HRCG, Wyse, XBIN and Zap. */
    native_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Charset label for native console positions; numeric codes stay unchanged. */
    native_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Require one executable font loader variant. */
    comfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of Consoleet numeric filenames (default legacy). */
    consoleet_read_codes?: string | null;
    /** Require one Zap font layout. */
    zapfont_read_variant?: string | null;
    /** Override the inferred first legacy code in a Dr. Halo font. */
    drhalo_read_first?: number | null;
    /** Korean 8×4×4 input: compose Hangul syllables or retain component slots. */
    hanfont_read_mode?: string | null;
    /** Explicit charset label for Apple IIgs legacy character codes. */
    iigs_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** DRCS baseline down from cell top (default cell height). */
    drcs_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** DEC device matrix rules for both reading and writing DRCS. */
    drcs_terminal?: string | null;
    /** Explicit Berkeley vfont input integer byte order. */
    vfont_read_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Require a Palm wrapper instead of recognizing its structure. */
    palm_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Explicit handling of fractional Palm density coordinates (default exact). */
    palm_rounding?: string | null;
    /** Interpret GDR source codes as legacy positions instead of Unicode. */
    gdr_read_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicitly reduce KBITX grayscale during import; default retains exact samples. */
    kbitx_read_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Crop PBF blank margins during import, with a loss report. */
    pbf_trim?: boolean;
    /** C header dialect (default auto). */
    c_read_family?: string | null;
    /** Explicit C source or LVGL binary input container (default auto). */
    c_read_container?: string | null;
    /** Read the pre-2019 two-byte U8x8 header. */
    c_read_u8x8_legacy?: boolean;
    /** C input array or GFXfont symbol to select. */
    c_array?: string | null;
    /** Generic C cell width; requires height, first code and charset. */
    c_width?: number | null;
    /** Generic C cell height; requires `c_width`. */
    c_height?: number | null;
    /** First code in generic C arrays, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */
    c_first?: string | null;
    /** unicode or an explicit legacy charset name. */
    c_charset?: string | null;
    /** Generic C baseline down from cell top (default height). */
    c_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Generic C bytes store the leftmost pixel in bit zero. */
    c_lsb_first?: boolean;
    /** Relative JSON/TOML atlas mapping, resolved beside the primary input. */
    image_mapping?: string | null;
    /** Literal prefix on numeric glyph filenames in an input directory. */
    image_read_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Input directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_read_radix?: number | null;
    /** Input filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_read_domain?: string | null;
    /** Input image background (default black). */
    image_read_background?: string | null;
    /** Input glyph baseline measured down from each image's top. */
    image_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** HEX input/output rows (default 16); never inferred from record length. */
    hex_height?: number | null;
    /** HEX baseline-to-bottom distance (default 0). */
    hex_descent?: number | null;
    /** Explicit source FNT/FON legacy code page (does not remap byte positions). */
    fnt_read_code_page?: string | null;
    /** Primary input byte budget (default 64 MiB). */
    max_input_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Individual companion-file byte budget. */
    max_resource_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Aggregate resource and codec allocation budget (default 256 MiB). */
    max_total_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum companion reads and directory entries. */
    max_resources?: number | null;
    /** Explicit raster size for reviewed off-grid/curved outlines. */
    ppem?: number | null;
    /** Select a TTC/OTC face (zero based); otherwise read every face. */
    face_index?: number | null;
    /** Rasterize outlines even when matching embedded images exist. */
    no_embedded_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit design units per pixel; requires --ppem. */
    grid_units?: number | null;
    /** Reviewed horizontal and vertical translations in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_x?: number;
    /** Reviewed vertical translation in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_y?: number;
    /** Input font (BDF/PCF, including gzip when enabled). */
    input?: string;
    /** Text in logical input order. Newline is an ordinary glyph, as in SPEC. */
    text?: string | null;
    /** Render every effective encoded mapping (drawall). */
    all?: boolean;
    /** Inclusive code ranges, e.g. U+0020-007E,U+4E00-4EFF; requires --all. */
    range?: string | null;
    /** Ordering for --all. */
    order?: DrawOrder;
    /** Input format override. */
    from?: string | null;
    /** Zero-based strike index; required for inputs containing multiple fonts. */
    font_index?: number | null;
    /** lr, rl, tb, bt, or a four-letter pair such as lrbt or tbrl. */
    direction?: WritingDirection;
    /** Maximum accumulated width-plus-offset per line (SPEC vertical behavior). */
    line_limit?: WideInt;
    /** Advance (1), complete font cell (0), or tight ink; --all defaults to cell. */
    mode?: DrawMode | null;
    /** Use the current glyph's spacing at boundaries instead of the previous glyph. */
    use_current_glyph_spacing?: boolean;
    /** Additional signed gap between glyphs. */
    letter_spacing?: WideInt;
    /** Additional signed gap between lines/columns. */
    line_spacing?: WideInt;
    /** Replacement glyph code, e.g. U+003F, 0x3f, or 63. */
    missing?: string | null;
    /** Fail on any absent/unrepresentable character. */
    fail_missing?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale-to-monochrome threshold (0..255). */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Reject read/render loss before displaying or saving output. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Maximum rendered/scaled pixel count; increase for large --all atlases. */
    max_pixels?: number;
    /** Maximum rendered width or height. */
    max_dimension?: number;
    /** Maximum layout bookkeeping bytes. */
    max_layout_bytes?: number;
    /** Maximum diagnostic text and deduplication bookkeeping bytes. */
    max_report_bytes?: number;
    /** Maximum number of input glyphs, including missing ones. */
    max_glyphs?: number;
    /** Maximum encoded image/text bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
    /** Diagnostics format (preview diagnostics go to stderr). */
    report?: ReportStyle;
    /** PNG or SVG output; written only after successful validation. */
    output?: string;
    /** Explicit image type; otherwise inferred from output extension. */
    to?: string | null;
    /** Positive integer nearest-neighbor scale. */
    scale?: number;
    /** Ink color: #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, or transparent. */
    color?: Rgba;
    /** Paper color, in the same syntax as --color. */
    background?: Rgba;
    /** SVG pixel shape (PNG uses square pixels). */
    shape?: Shape | null;
    /** SVG dot diameter or separate-square side relative to one pixel. */
    dotsize?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::render::RenderResponse`: Summary of one rendered image. */
export interface RenderResponse {
    /** Encoded image bytes. */
    bytes: number;
    /** `png` or `svg`. */
    format: string;
    /** Image height in source pixels. */
    height: number;
    /** Output path. */
    output: string;
    /** Read and render diagnostics. */
    report: Report;
    /** Nearest-neighbor scale. */
    scale: number;
    /** Image width in source pixels. */
    width: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::render::Rendered`: Result pixels and deterministic diagnostics. Missing and clipped ink are reported even though those are valid SPEC rendering operations. */
export interface RenderedDict {
    /** Packed monochrome result, top-left origin. */
    bitmap: BitmapDict;
    /** Warnings, repairs and information loss. */
    report: Report;
}

/** `fontpixel::report::Report`: Diagnostics in deterministic encounter order; no generated timestamps. */
export interface Report {
    /** Entries in source/operation order. */
    entries: ReportEntry[];
}

/** `fontpixel::report::ReportEntry`: A stable machine-readable code plus a human-readable explanation. */
export interface ReportEntry {
    /** Severity. */
    level: Level;
    /** Effect on information. */
    impact: Impact;
    /** Stable dotted code, e.g. `encoding.out_of_range`. */
    code: string;
    /** Affected source location. */
    location: Location;
    /** Human-readable description. */
    message: string;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::options::ReportStyle`: Diagnostic and summary presentation style. */
export type ReportStyle = "text" | "json";

/** `fontpixel::formats::fbit::ResourceKind`: Native record kind. HFNT has no magic and needs explicit selection for bare input. */
export type ResourceKind = "fbit" | "hfnt";

/** `fontpixel::resources::ResourceLimits`: Configurable input budgets. Format implementations must also enforce the decompression, glyph, pixel, and table limits before allocating. */
export interface ResourceLimits {
    /** Maximum primary input size. */
    max_input_bytes?: number;
    /** Maximum size of one sidecar. */
    max_resource_bytes?: number;
    /** Maximum primary + cumulative resolved sidecar bytes. */
    max_total_bytes?: number;
    /** Maximum number of resource resolutions (including repeats). */
    max_resources?: number;
    /** Maximum decompressed size, enforced by the shared gzip transport. */
    max_decompressed_bytes?: number;
    /** Maximum glyph count, enforced by model readers. */
    max_glyphs?: number;
    /** Maximum pixels in one glyph, enforced by model readers. */
    max_pixels_per_glyph?: number;
    /** Maximum font table or text record size, enforced by format readers. */
    max_table_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::opentype::ResourceOptions`: Explicit variants budgets; absent values keep the library's defaults. This CLI surface is reconstructed, not a byte-certified historical recovery. */
export interface ResourceOptions {
    /** Maximum primary input bytes (default 64 MiB). */
    max_input_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum bytes in one companion resource. */
    max_resource_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Aggregate input/model and codec allocation budget (default 256 MiB). */
    max_total_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum companion resource resolutions. */
    max_resources?: number | null;
    /** Maximum decompressed bytes. */
    max_decompressed_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum aggregate source glyph slots and writer glyph count. */
    max_glyphs?: number | null;
    /** Maximum pixels in a source glyph. */
    max_pixels_per_glyph?: number | null;
    /** Maximum table or text-record bytes. */
    max_table_bytes?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::resources::ResourcePath`: Portable relative asset name with no empty, parent, or current components. */
export type ResourcePath = string;

/** `fontpixel::formats::nfnt::ResourceType`: Bitmap resource type. */
export type ResourceType = "nfnt" | "font";

/** `fontpixel::render::image::Rgba`: Unpremultiplied sRGB color and opacity. Channels range from 0 to 255. */
export interface Rgba {
    /** Red. */
    red: number;
    /** Green. */
    green: number;
    /** Blue. */
    blue: number;
    /** Alpha (0 transparent, 255 opaque). */
    alpha: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::riscos::RiscosCodec`: Registry codec. */
export interface RiscosCodec {
    /** Reading choices. */
    read_options?: RiscosReadOptions;
    /** Writing choices. */
    write_options?: RiscosWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::riscos::RiscosCompression`: Native one-bit storage. */
export type RiscosCompression = "raw" | "packed";

/** `fontpixel::formats::riscos::RiscosDepth`: Native bitmap depth. */
export type RiscosDepth = "mono" | "gray4";

/** `fontpixel::formats::riscos::RiscosMetricsVersion`: Optional native scalable-metrics output version. */
export type RiscosMetricsVersion = "0" | "2";

/** `fontpixel::formats::riscos::RiscosReadOptions`: Input profile and scoped sidecar. */
export interface RiscosReadOptions {
    /** Require a file generation. */
    version?: RiscosVersion | null;
    /** Explicit scoped IntMetrics resource. */
    metrics_path?: ResourcePath | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::riscos::RiscosVersion`: Native bitmap file generation. */
export type RiscosVersion = "xy" | "4" | "5" | "6" | "7" | "8";

/** `fontpixel::formats::riscos::RiscosWriteOptions`: Native output choices. */
export interface RiscosWriteOptions {
    /** Bitmap file generation. */
    version?: RiscosVersion;
    /** Native depth; old XY files always require Gray4. */
    depth?: RiscosDepth;
    /** Packed encoding is available only for new one-bit files. */
    compression?: RiscosCompression;
    /** Optional IntMetrics output resource. */
    metrics_path?: ResourcePath | null;
    /** IntMetrics generation. */
    metrics_version?: RiscosMetricsVersion;
    /** Permit numeric Unicode codes. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit Gray8-to-Mono threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Explicit rounding to sixteen grayscale levels. */
    quantize?: boolean;
    /** Shared ceilings. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Aggregate output cap. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::rockbox::RockboxCodec`: Registry codec with explicit native input and output choices. */
export interface RockboxCodec {
    /** Native input options. */
    read_options?: RockboxReadOptions;
    /** Native output options. */
    write_options?: RockboxWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::rockbox::RockboxDepth`: Native raster encoding. */
export type RockboxDepth = "mono" | "gray4";

/** `fontpixel::formats::rockbox::RockboxFlavor`: Native Rockbox font generations. */
export type RockboxFlavor = "rb11" | "rb12";

/** `fontpixel::formats::rockbox::RockboxReadOptions`: Both native generations are recognized from their signatures. */
export interface RockboxReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::rockbox::RockboxWriteOptions`: Bounded native output choices. */
export interface RockboxWriteOptions {
    /** Native file generation. */
    flavor?: RockboxFlavor;
    /** Override native depth; otherwise retain the source depth or choose mono. */
    depth?: RockboxDepth | null;
    /** Explicit threshold when reducing grayscale to mono. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Cumulative source, conversion, output and readback limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Additional primary output cap. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::bitmap::bytes::RowOrder`: Order of rows in a serialized bitmap. */
export type RowOrder = "top-down" | "bottom-up";

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::bitmap::runs::RunTables`: Encoded tables plus the number of shared-metric (format 2/5) subtables. Shared runs store zero vertical big metrics for horizontal-only glyphs. */
export interface RunTables {
    /** EBDT/EBLC or bdat/bloc pair. */
    tables: Tables;
    /** Number of index format 2 subtables over all strikes. */
    shared_runs: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::sbf::SbfCodec`: Registry codec with explicit native input and output choices. */
export interface SbfCodec {
    /** Native input options. */
    read_options?: SbfReadOptions;
    /** Native output options. */
    write_options?: SbfWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::sbf::SbfReadOptions`: SBF native positions remain Legacy codepoints. */
export interface SbfReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::sbf::SbfWriteOptions`: Bounded native SBF output choices. */
export interface SbfWriteOptions {
    /** Permit numerical Unicode-to-native byte mapping. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale-to-monochrome threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Cumulative source, output, scratch and readback limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Additional primary output cap. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::bitmap::color::Sbix`: Decoded sbix table, retaining the optional outline-overlay requirement. */
export interface Sbix {
    /** Whether source asks consumers to draw outlines over bitmap images. */
    draw_outlines: boolean;
    /** Physical strikes in original order. */
    strikes: SbixStrike[];
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::bitmap::color::SbixGlyph`: A decoded sbix glyph; placement offsets are pixels in the strike coordinate space. */
export interface SbixGlyph {
    /** Signed left/bottom graphic origin offsets. */
    origin: number[];
    /** Coverage image; RGB is projected explicitly by the selected rule. */
    bitmap: GlyphBitmap;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::bitmap::color::SbixStrike`: One sbix strike, including only present images. */
export interface SbixStrike {
    /** Pixel size. */
    ppem: number;
    /** Device pixel density, preserved independently from ppem. */
    ppi: number;
    /** Sparse source glyph IDs. */
    glyphs: Record<string, SbixGlyph>;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::ScalableAdvance`: How horizontal scalable advances (BDF `SWIDTH` x) are produced. */
export type ScalableAdvance = "preserve" | ScalableAdvanceFromDevice;

/** `fontpixel::projection::ScalableAdvanceChange`: One committed scalable-advance change. */
export interface ScalableAdvanceChange {
    /** Strike index in the projected set. */
    font_index: number;
    /** Stable glyph ID within that strike. */
    glyph: GlyphId;
    /** Glyph-level source value (`None` when absent on the glyph). */
    glyph_value?: Vector | null;
    /** Effective source value, falling back to the strike's glyph defaults. */
    effective_before?: Vector | null;
    /** Device advance x the new value was derived from. */
    device_advance: WideInt;
    /** New glyph-level value. */
    after: Vector;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::ScalableAdvance::FromDevice`: Derive `round_half_even(device_x * units_per_em / reference_ppem)` for every live glyph, including unencoded and duplicate-code records. Vertical components and all other metrics are kept. */
export interface ScalableAdvanceFromDevice {
    /** Derive `round_half_even(device_x * units_per_em / reference_ppem)` for every live glyph, including unencoded and duplicate-code records. Vertical components and all other metrics are kept. */
    from_device: ScalableAdvanceFromDeviceFields;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::ScalableAdvance::FromDevice::fields`: Derive `round_half_even(device_x * units_per_em / reference_ppem)` for every live glyph, including unencoded and duplicate-code records. Vertical components and all other metrics are kept. */
export interface ScalableAdvanceFromDeviceFields {
    /** Scalable units per em; BDF uses 1000. */
    units_per_em: number;
    /** Pixels per em the device advance is measured at; must be positive. */
    reference_ppem: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::bitmap::Scale`: An EBSC target-size instruction; this is not an additional physical strike. */
export interface Scale {
    /** Horizontal target line metrics. */
    horizontal: LineMetrics;
    /** Vertical target line metrics. */
    vertical: LineMetrics;
    /** Requested horizontal/vertical ppem. */
    target: SerdeBytes;
    /** Existing source strike horizontal/vertical ppem. */
    source: SerdeBytes;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::pcf::ScanUnit`: Bitmap byte-swap unit when bit and byte order differ. */
export type ScanUnit = "1" | "2" | "4";

/** `fontpixel::formats::xbin::ScreenMode`: Treatment of native non-font sections. */
export type ScreenMode = "preserve" | "font-only";

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::gsub::Script`: A script's default and explicitly tagged languages. */
export interface Script {
    /** Default language system (not a language named `dflt`). */
    default?: LanguageSystem | null;
    /** Ordered language systems. */
    languages: Record<string, LanguageSystem>;
}

/** `fontpixel::variants::ScriptVariant`: A face selected by script, regardless of the shaping language. */
export interface ScriptVariant {
    /** Scripts that activate this alternative (e.g. latn/grek/cyrl). */
    scripts: string[];
    /** Alternative glyphs. */
    font: FontDict;
}

/** `fontpixel::outline::Segment`: Outline segments with implied on-curve midpoints resolved. */
export type Segment = SegmentLine | SegmentQuad;

/** `fontpixel::outline::Segment::Line`: Straight edge. */
export interface SegmentLine {
    /** Straight edge. */
    line: [[number, number], [number, number]];
}

/** `fontpixel::outline::Segment::Quad`: Quadratic Bézier start/control/end. */
export interface SegmentQuad {
    /** Quadratic Bézier start/control/end. */
    quad: [[number, number], [number, number], [number, number]];
}

/** `fontpixel::merge::selection::Selection`: Union of selected ranges, with exclusions applied last. */
export type SelectionDict = string;

/** `fontpixel::formats::sfd::SfdCodec`: SFD registry adapter, retaining all bitmap strikes. */
export interface SfdCodec {
    /** Native writer controls. */
    write_options?: SfdWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::sfd::SfdWriteOptions`: Controls deterministic bitmap-only SFD output. */
export interface SfdWriteOptions {
    /** Cumulative model, input and output budgets. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::bitmap::Limits`: Resource, graph and image-work budgets shared by embedded bitmap readers. */
export interface SfntBitmapLimits {
    /** Shared sfnt and model budgets. */
    sfnt?: SfntLimits;
    /** Maximum physical strikes or scaling instructions. */
    max_strikes?: number;
    /** Maximum nested composite or duplicate references. */
    max_depth?: number;
    /** Cumulative pixels decoded/copied, including repeated component work. */
    max_pixel_work?: number;
    /** Cumulative glyph/component visits, including zero-area images. */
    max_visits?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::cff::Glyph`: One named glyph for canonical CFF output. */
export interface SfntCffGlyph {
    /** Unique PostScript glyph name; first glyph must be `.notdef`. */
    name: string;
    /** Nonnegative advance in design units, representable in Type 2 16.16. */
    advance: number;
    /** Explicit geometry or shared-dot positions. */
    outline: Outline;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::Glyph`: One glyph entry, retaining component relationships rather than flattening them. */
export type SfntGlyfGlyph = "empty" | SfntGlyfGlyphSimple | SfntGlyfGlyphComposite;

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::Glyph::Composite`: Transformed child glyphs. */
export interface SfntGlyfGlyphComposite {
    /** Transformed child glyphs. */
    composite: CompositeGlyph;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::Glyph::Simple`: Direct quadratic contours. */
export interface SfntGlyfGlyphSimple {
    /** Direct quadratic contours. */
    simple: SimpleGlyph;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::Limits`: Additional allocation/work budgets for sfnt operations. */
export interface SfntLimits {
    /** Shared input, output, table and glyph budgets. */
    resources?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum tables in a directory. */
    max_tables?: number;
    /** Maximum nominal character mappings expanded while reading or writing. */
    max_cmap_mappings?: number;
    /** Maximum name records and language-tag records, combined. */
    max_name_records?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::opentype::SfntOutputOptions`: Output path, container, Brotli settings and diagnostics of sfnt writers. */
export interface SfntOutputOptions {
    /** TTF, OTF, OTB, WOFF or WOFF2 output (TTF/OTF retain subset outline flavor). */
    output?: string;
    /** Explicit output container; defaults to extension. */
    to?: string | null;
    /** Brotli quality, 0 through 11. */
    woff2_quality?: number;
    /** Legal intra-font parallel Brotli workers, 1 through 16. */
    woff2_threads?: number;
    /** Reject any conversion loss before replacing output. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Diagnostics format. */
    report?: ReportStyle;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::sfont::SfontCodec`: Native format codec and typed options. */
export interface SfontCodec {
    /** Native reader options. */
    read_options?: SfontReadOptions;
    /** Native writer options. */
    write_options?: SfontWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::sfont::SfontFlavor`: Native marker-image dialect. */
export type SfontFlavor = "sfont" | "rfont";

/** `fontpixel::formats::sfont::SfontReadOptions`: Caller-declared interpretation of native image fields. */
export interface SfontReadOptions {
    /** Force a dialect; absent detects RFont's control columns/chunks. */
    flavor?: SfontFlavor | null;
    /** Explicit SFont character order; absent uses consecutive ASCII from 33. */
    codepoints?: CodepointDict[] | null;
    /** SFont baseline measured from glyph top; absent uses image glyph height. */
    baseline?: WideInt | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::sfont::SfontWriteOptions`: Deterministic native PNG output options. */
export interface SfontWriteOptions {
    /** Native dialect, default SFont. */
    flavor?: SfontFlavor;
    /** Explicit SFont order; absent emits ASCII 33..126 including blank slots. */
    codepoints?: CodepointDict[] | null;
    /** Cumulative source, image codec, output and readback allowance. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Additional PNG byte cap. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::outline::Shape`: Pixel outline shape. */
export type Shape = "square" | "square-separate" | "dot";

/** `fontpixel_ops::options::Significance`: Most- or least-significant-first ordering. */
export type Significance = "msb" | "lsb";

/** `fontpixel::formats::signum::SignumCodec`: Registry codec for all four Signum families. */
export interface SignumCodec {
    /** Input interpretation. */
    read_options?: SignumReadOptions;
    /** Output choices. */
    write_options?: SignumWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::signum::SignumReadOptions`: Explicit overrides for Signum's inferred baseline convention. */
export interface SignumReadOptions {
    /** Require this format variant; absent detects magic. */
    version?: SignumVersion | null;
    /** Override the conventional baseline. */
    baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** Override line height. */
    line_height?: WideInt | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::signum::SignumVersion`: Signum! editor/printer raster family. */
export type SignumVersion = "e24" | "p9" | "p24" | "l30";

/** `fontpixel::formats::signum::SignumWriteOptions`: Bounded Signum output choices. */
export interface SignumWriteOptions {
    /** Variant, default editor E24. */
    version?: SignumVersion;
    /** Permit Unicode numbers as legacy positions. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale reduction threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared resource bounds. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Output cap, bounded by reader limits as well. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::SimpleGlyph`: Simple glyph's ordered points and opaque interpreter program. */
export interface SimpleGlyph {
    /** Closed contours, with integral signed 16-bit design coordinates. */
    contours: [number, number, boolean][][];
    /** Preserved instruction bytes. */
    instructions: SerdeBytes;
    /** OVERLAP_SIMPLE marker. */
    overlap: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::SizeProjection`: Explicit point size and resolution (BDF `SIZE`). Both values are replaced together; each differing component is audited separately. */
export interface SizeProjection {
    /** Positive typographic point size. BDF output requires an integer. */
    point_size: Rational;
    /** Positive horizontal and vertical dots per inch. */
    resolution: Vector;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::snf::SnfCodec`: SNF registry codec. */
export interface SnfCodec {
    /** Explicit input interpretation. */
    read_options?: SnfReadOptions;
    /** Output representation. */
    write_options?: SnfWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::snf::SnfReadOptions`: SNF input options. Bitmap layout is not part of the historical SNF header. */
export interface SnfReadOptions {
    /** Integer byte order; absent uses both version stamps. */
    byte_order?: ByteOrder | null;
    /** Complete raster interpretation. Absent uses a layout property or unambiguous inference. */
    bitmap?: ByteLayout | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::snf::SnfWriteOptions`: SNF output choices. */
export interface SnfWriteOptions {
    /** Integer byte order and corresponding native C bitfield allocation. */
    byte_order?: ByteOrder;
    /** Independent bitmap packing. */
    bitmap?: ByteLayout;
    /** Add a legal X11 vendor property describing the otherwise unrecorded layout. */
    include_layout_property?: boolean;
    /** Aggregate and per-glyph bounds. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum output length, additionally capped by reader limits. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
    /** Explicit threshold for grayscale input; absent rejects grayscale. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::Spacing`: Spacing classification (BDF P/M/C), without inventing a default when absent. */
export type Spacing = "Proportional" | "Monospaced" | "CharacterCell";

/** `fontpixel::merge::report::SpacingAdjustment`: One output glyph's halfwidth decision. */
export interface SpacingAdjustment {
    /** Source part. */
    part_index: number;
    /** Source stable glyph index. */
    glyph_index: number;
    /** Scalar aliases. */
    codepoints: number[];
    /** Decision. */
    kind: AdjustmentKind;
    /** Original horizontal advance. */
    original_advance?: WideInt | null;
    /** Integral halfwidth target, absent for odd W. */
    target_advance?: WideInt | null;
    /** Added left advance-space. */
    left_padding: WideInt;
    /** Added right advance-space. */
    right_padding: WideInt;
    /** Human-readable explanation. */
    reason: string;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::ssfn::SsfnCodec`: Registry codec with typed read/write choices. */
export interface SsfnCodec {
    /** Reader options. */
    read_options?: SsfnReadOptions;
    /** Writer options. */
    write_options?: SsfnWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::ssfn::SsfnEncoding`: Native SSFN representation. */
export type SsfnEncoding = "binary" | "ascii";

/** `fontpixel::formats::ssfn::SsfnReadOptions`: Typed input choices. */
export interface SsfnReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::ssfn::SsfnWriteOptions`: Native output and explicit conversion choices. */
export interface SsfnWriteOptions {
    /** Binary or ASCII output. */
    encoding?: SsfnEncoding;
    /** Optional explicit monochrome threshold; otherwise retain grayscale. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Permit legacy numeric positions to become Unicode scalars. */
    legacy_as_unicode?: boolean;
    /** Cumulative resource limits, including writer readback. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Additional maximum output size. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::glyf::Statistics`: Geometry maxima for an unhinted maxp table or an existing maxp update. */
export interface Statistics {
    /** Simple glyph's maximum point count. */
    max_points: number;
    /** Simple glyph's maximum contour count. */
    max_contours: number;
    /** Maximum expanded composite point count. */
    max_composite_points: number;
    /** Maximum expanded composite contour count. */
    max_composite_contours: number;
    /** Largest instruction program length. */
    max_size_of_instructions: number;
    /** Largest number of immediate child components. */
    max_component_elements: number;
    /** Largest nesting depth; a simple child has depth zero. */
    max_component_depth: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::hzk::Storage`: Byte-padded raster orientation. */
export type Storage = "rows" | "columns";

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::bitmap::Strike`: An embedded bitmap strike, keyed by enclosing sfnt glyph ID. */
export interface Strike {
    /** Horizontal ppem, nonzero. */
    ppem_x: number;
    /** Vertical ppem, nonzero. */
    ppem_y: number;
    /** Source depth; write supports 1, 2, 4, 8, or 32 for CBDT. */
    bit_depth: number;
    /** Small-metric direction: 1 horizontal, 2 vertical; 3 only for big metrics. */
    flags: number;
    /** Horizontal line record. */
    horizontal: LineMetrics;
    /** Vertical line record. */
    vertical: LineMetrics;
    /** Only glyphs with actual embedded images; no synthesized missing glyphs. */
    glyphs: Record<string, BitmapGlyph>;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::subset::Subset`: A complete subset and the stable old-to-new glyph correspondence. */
export interface Subset {
    /** Standalone sfnt bytes; callers may apply WOFF wrappers. */
    bytes: SerdeBytes;
    /** Original glyph IDs mapped to compact subset IDs, including dependencies. */
    glyph_mapping: Record<string, number>;
    /** Signature removals and explicitly requested table losses. */
    report: Report;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::subset::Options`: Options for subsetting a standalone sfnt. */
export interface SubsetOptions {
    /** Retained Unicode scalars; all other cmap entries are removed. */
    codepoints?: number[];
    /** Explicitly discard these otherwise unsupported tables, reporting loss. */
    drop_tables?: string[];
    /** Shared container and layout budgets. */
    limits?: LayoutLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::opentype::SubsetRequest`: Subset an sfnt, WOFF or WOFF2 font by text or Unicode ranges. */
export interface SubsetRequest {
    /** sfnt, WOFF or WOFF2 input font. */
    input?: string;
    /** Keep all characters in this Unicode text. */
    text?: string | null;
    /** Inclusive hexadecimal ranges, e.g. U+0020-007E,U+4E00. */
    unicodes?: string | null;
    /** Read UTF-8 text from a file. */
    text_file?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly discard a table whose glyph references cannot be remapped. */
    drop_tables?: string[];
    /** TTF, OTF, OTB, WOFF or WOFF2 output (TTF/OTF retain subset outline flavor). */
    output?: string;
    /** Explicit output container; defaults to extension. */
    to?: string | null;
    /** Brotli quality, 0 through 11. */
    woff2_quality?: number;
    /** Legal intra-font parallel Brotli workers, 1 through 16. */
    woff2_threads?: number;
    /** Reject any conversion loss before replacing output. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Diagnostics format. */
    report?: ReportStyle;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::svg::SvgCodec`: Registered SVG-font codec (standalone images are deliberately output-only). */
export interface SvgCodec {
    /** Font reader options. */
    read_options?: SvgReadOptions;
    /** Font writer options. */
    write_options?: SvgWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::svg::ImageOptions`: Standalone image options. Paths use y-down coordinates and no font resources. */
export interface SvgImageOptions {
    /** Palette, integer scale and image/output limits. */
    image?: ImageOptions;
    /** Pixel outline shape. */
    shape?: Shape;
    /** Diameter/side relative to one pixel, (0, 1]. */
    dot_size?: number;
    /** Geometry budgets. */
    limits?: OutlineLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::svg::Limits`: Explicit aggregate XML, geometry and raster budgets. */
export interface SvgLimits {
    /** Input bytes, per-record bytes, glyph count and per-glyph pixels. */
    resources?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum XML nodes, including comments and text. */
    max_nodes?: number;
    /** Maximum element nesting depth. */
    max_depth?: number;
    /** Maximum attributes on one element. */
    max_attributes?: number;
    /** Maximum fonts in one document. */
    max_fonts?: number;
    /** Total parsed/rasterized path edges, including repeated alias records. */
    max_total_edges?: number;
    /** Total raster pixels and row overhead across all records. */
    max_total_pixels?: number;
    /** Per-glyph geometry limits. */
    geometry?: OutlineLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::svg::ReadOptions`: SVG-font raster projection options. */
export interface SvgReadOptions {
    /** Explicit pixel size, 1..=4096; otherwise native extension or exhaustive grid. */
    ppem?: number | null;
    /** Select one font by document order; None reads all. */
    font_index?: number | null;
    /** Bounded input and output resources. */
    limits?: SvgLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::svg::WriteOptions`: Native SVG-font serialization options. */
export interface SvgWriteOptions {
    /** Positive design units per source pixel. */
    units_per_pixel?: number;
    /** Merged squares, separate squares or true circular dots. */
    shape?: Shape;
    /** Diameter/side relative to a pixel, (0, 1]; merged squares require 1. */
    dot_size?: number;
    /** Explicit conversion for grayscale glyphs; None rejects Gray8. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Encoded UTF-8 output byte budget. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
    /** Input model and geometry budgets. */
    limits?: SvgLimits;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::symbos::SymbosCodec`: Registry codec. */
export interface SymbosCodec {
    /** Input choices. */
    read_options?: SymbosReadOptions;
    /** Output choices. */
    write_options?: SymbosWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::symbos::SymbosExtendedInfo`: Interpretation of the second byte in a 255-character file. */
export type SymbosExtendedInfo = SymbosExtendedInfoWritingSystem | SymbosExtendedInfoLayout;

/** `fontpixel::formats::symbos::SymbosExtendedInfo::Layout`: Alternative header with WYSIWYG flag. */
export interface SymbosExtendedInfoLayout {
    /** Alternative header with WYSIWYG flag. */
    layout: SymbosExtendedInfoLayoutFields;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::symbos::SymbosExtendedInfo::Layout::fields`: Alternative header with WYSIWYG flag. */
export interface SymbosExtendedInfoLayoutFields {
    /** Whether this font is intended for WYSIWYG rendering. */
    wysiwyg: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::symbos::SymbosExtendedInfo::WritingSystem`: Native writing-system identifier, 2 through 31. */
export interface SymbosExtendedInfoWritingSystem {
    /** Native writing-system identifier, 2 through 31. */
    writing_system: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::symbos::SymbosReadOptions`: Explicit input compatibility choices. */
export interface SymbosReadOptions {
    /** Accept a short medium/small character range; native files normally end at 127 or 255. */
    allow_short_range?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::symbos::SymbosVersion`: Native record layout. */
export type SymbosVersion = "medium" | "small" | "big";

/** `fontpixel::formats::symbos::SymbosWriteOptions`: Native bounded output choices. */
export interface SymbosWriteOptions {
    /** Layout; absent preserves source layout or uses medium. */
    version?: SymbosVersion | null;
    /** Initial code for ordinary fonts; absent preserves source value or uses 32. */
    first_code?: number | null;
    /** 255-character metadata; absent preserves source extension if present. */
    extended?: SymbosExtendedInfo | null;
    /** Cell height; absent derives a cell containing all input ink. */
    height?: number | null;
    /** Explicit permission to use Unicode numbers as legacy codes. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit threshold for grayscale input. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared model, geometry and allocation limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Output length cap, also bounded by max_input_bytes. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::projection::SyncedMetric`: Normalized integer metric kept in sync with an edited property. */
export type SyncedMetric = "pixel_size" | "ascent" | "descent" | "underline_position" | "underline_thickness" | "space_width" | "line_gap" | "line_height";

/** `fontpixel_ops::p3_formats::system::ReadOptions`: Read options: native Macintosh resources and operating-system font options. */
export interface SystemReadOptions {
    /** Include the later GEOS DEL slot when interpreting a native strike. */
    geos_read_include_del?: boolean;
    /** Bare Japanese Macintosh resource type (default fbit). */
    fbit_read_kind?: string | null;
    /** Scoped bitmap data fork for an fbit resource. */
    fbit_read_data_fork?: string | null;
    /** Scoped AppleDouble resource companion for an fbit data-fork input. */
    fbit_apple_double_resource?: string | null;
    /** Explicit cell width for bare HFNT input. */
    fbit_read_hfnt_width?: number | null;
    /** Charset label for Lisa legacy positions. */
    lisa_read_charset?: string | null;
    /** Accept shortened SymbOS character ranges. */
    symbos_read_allow_short_range?: boolean;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific bit order zero. */
    wsfont_known_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific byte order zero. */
    wsfont_known_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** BeOS coverage interpretation (default native8). */
    beos_read_coverage?: string | null;
    /** Permit explicit rounding of fractional BeOS advances on input. */
    beos_read_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p3_formats::system::WriteOptions`: Write options: native Macintosh resources and operating-system font options. */
export interface SystemWriteOptions {
    /** GEOS output resource envelope (default preserves source, otherwise cvt). */
    geos_container?: string | null;
    /** GEOS native strike and mapping variant. */
    geos_variant?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly include or omit the GEOS DEL slot. */
    geos_include_del?: boolean | null;
    /** GEOS family identifier. */
    geos_font_id?: number | null;
    /** GEOS family name. */
    geos_family?: string | null;
    /** Rebuild GEOS records instead of preserving unchanged native resources. */
    geos_rebuild?: boolean;
    /** Explicitly use legacy codes as Unicode in GEOS extended output. */
    geos_legacy_as_unicode?: boolean;
    /** VFNT single-column width (double-width glyphs use two halves). */
    vtfont_cell_width?: number | null;
    /** VFNT cell height. */
    vtfont_cell_height?: number | null;
    /** Rebuild VFNT native glyph pools and maps even for unchanged input. */
    vtfont_rebuild?: boolean;
    /** Explicitly project legacy numeric labels to VFNT Unicode mappings. */
    vtfont_legacy_as_unicode?: boolean;
    /** Japanese Macintosh resource kind (default fbit). */
    fbit_kind?: string | null;
    /** Japanese Macintosh resource envelope (default bare). */
    fbit_container?: string | null;
    /** fbit bitmap placement (default inline). */
    fbit_definition?: string | null;
    /** Relative companion name for a split bare fbit output. */
    fbit_data_fork?: string | null;
    /** Lisa resource compression (default preserve). */
    lisa_compression?: string | null;
    /** SymbOS native layout. */
    symbos_version?: string | null;
    /** Initial native SymbOS character code. */
    symbos_first_code?: number | null;
    /** SymbOS extended writing-system identifier. */
    symbos_writing_system?: number | null;
    /** SymbOS alternative extended layout header. */
    symbos_layout?: string | null;
    /** SymbOS output cell height. */
    symbos_height?: number | null;
    /** Project Oberon family byte. */
    oberon_family?: number | null;
    /** Project Oberon variant byte. */
    oberon_variant?: number | null;
    /** WSF native encoding identifier. */
    wsfont_encoding?: number | null;
    /** WSF wire bit order. */
    wsfont_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** WSF wire byte order. */
    wsfont_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** WSF coverage storage. */
    wsfont_depth?: string | null;
    /** WSF bytes per raster row. */
    wsfont_stride?: number | null;
    /** BeOS output coverage palette. */
    beos_coverage?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly quantize BeOS gray samples to the selected palette. */
    beos_quantize_gray?: boolean;
    /** Interpret BeOS source legacy labels as Unicode numbers. */
    beos_legacy_as_unicode?: boolean;
    /** Permit retained fractional BeOS advances on output. */
    beos_round_fractional_metrics?: boolean;
}

/** `fontpixel::sfnt::bitmap::Tables`: Encoded bitmap pair; insert using `kind.tags()` into a shared sfnt builder. */
export interface Tables {
    /** EBDT or bdat bytes. */
    data: SerdeBytes;
    /** EBLC or bloc bytes. */
    location: SerdeBytes;
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::batch::TaskKind`: Task kind as reported in the batch document. */
export type TaskKind = "convert" | "vectorize" | "variants" | "subset" | "merge" | "charset" | "validate" | "diff";

/** `fontpixel_ops::batch::TaskRequest`: One typed task operation. Its result is always rendered as compact JSON. */
export type TaskRequest = TaskRequestConvert | TaskRequestVectorize | TaskRequestVariants | TaskRequestSubset | TaskRequestMerge | TaskRequestCharset | TaskRequestValidate | TaskRequestDiff;

/** `fontpixel_ops::batch::TaskRequest::Charset`: Charset remapping. */
export interface TaskRequestCharset extends CharsetRequest {
    /** Variant tag. */
    kind: "charset";
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::batch::TaskRequest::Convert`: Convert. */
export interface TaskRequestConvert extends ConvertRequest {
    /** Variant tag. */
    kind: "convert";
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::batch::TaskRequest::Diff`: Comparison. */
export interface TaskRequestDiff extends DiffRequest {
    /** Variant tag. */
    kind: "diff";
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::batch::TaskRequest::Merge`: Multi-part merge. */
export interface TaskRequestMerge extends MergeRequest {
    /** Variant tag. */
    kind: "merge";
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::batch::TaskRequest::Subset`: sfnt subsetting. */
export interface TaskRequestSubset extends SubsetRequest {
    /** Variant tag. */
    kind: "subset";
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::batch::TaskRequest::Validate`: Validation. */
export interface TaskRequestValidate extends ValidateRequest {
    /** Variant tag. */

/** `fontpixel_ops::batch::TaskRequest::Variants`: Regional OpenType variants. */

}

/** `fontpixel_ops::batch::TaskRequest::Vectorize`: Vectorize: the same operation as convert, reported as `vectorize`. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::tasprint::TasprintCodec`: Registry codec. */
export interface TasprintCodec {
    /** Read interpretation. */

    /** Write choices. */
    write_options?: TasprintWriteOptions;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::tasprint::TasprintReadOptions`: Explicit interpretation for headerless input. */
export interface TasprintReadOptions {
    /** Absent uses signatures and bounded size heuristics. */
    version?: TasprintVersion | null;
    /** Actual PCW width, 1..16. */
    width?: number | null;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::tasprint::TasprintVersion`: Tasprint platform layouts. */
export type TasprintVersion = "48k" | "plus3" | "cpc" | "pcw";

/** `fontpixel::formats::tasprint::TasprintWriteOptions`: Bounded native encoding choices. */
export interface TasprintWriteOptions {
    /** Platform layout. */
    version?: TasprintVersion;
    /** Actual +3/PCW width, 1..16; absent uses source or cell width. */
    width?: number | null;
    /** PCW slots: original 127 or interoperable extended 128. */
    pcw_count?: number;
    /** Permit Unicode numeric positions. */
    unicode_as_legacy?: boolean;
    /** Explicit gray reduction. */

    /** Shared resource budgets. */

    /** Output size cap. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::formats::drcs::Terminal`: Terminal profile governing omitted DECDLD dimensions and legal matrices. */
export type Terminal = "vt320" | "vt510";

/** `fontpixel::formats::tex_common::TexWriteOptions`: Common output controls for TeX PK and GF. */
export interface TexWriteOptions {
    /** Override design size in TeX points (72.27 points per inch). */
    design_size?: Rational | null;
    /** Override the integral horizontal and vertical dpi. */
    resolution?: Vector | null;
    /** Explicit threshold required for grayscale source glyphs. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Shared resource and geometry limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum generated file length, also capped by the reader input limit. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::resources::TransportLimits`: Additional native-write and registry-applied envelope budgets. */
export interface TransportLimits {
    /** Limits used by the matching reader and native writer validation. */
    resources?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Maximum sum of serialized asset lengths for plain output, or maximum serialized envelope size including its header and trailer for gzip. Plain output is checked before returning assets, after error/strict diagnostics. A format without a native output cap may finish encoding under its resource budget before this aggregate returned-output check. */
    max_output_bytes?: number;
}

/** `fontpixel::compat::bdfparser::ttf::TtfOptions`: SPEC TrueType output options. */
export interface TtfOptions {
    /** Square merged outlines or individual circles. */
    shape?: string;
    /** Pixel-relative dot diameter, in (0, 1.5]. */
    dotsize?: number;
    /** Even integer font units per pixel, at least 2. */

    /** Include lossless BDFP metadata. */
    metadata?: boolean;
    /** Unix timestamp; zero is deterministic. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::c::U8glibFormat`: Native legacy U8glib record representation. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::u8m::U8mCodec`: Registry codec with explicit native input and output choices. */

/** `fontpixel::formats::u8m::U8mReadOptions`: Native header detection also accepts an optional two-byte load address. */
export interface U8mReadOptions {}

/** `fontpixel::formats::u8m::U8mWriteOptions`: Bounded U8/M output choices. */

    load_address?: number | null;
    /** Explicit grayscale-to-monochrome conversion threshold. */

/** `fontpixel::charset::merge_categories::UnicodeRange`: Inclusive Unicode block/category range. */

    /** Require a Xerox native font family. */

    /** Explicit Signum baseline. */

    /** Scoped bitmap data fork for an fbit resource. */

    /** Charset label for Lisa legacy positions. */

    /** Accept shortened SymbOS character ranges. */

    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific bit order zero. */

    /** Meaning of WSF driver-specific byte order zero. */

    /** Permit explicit rounding of fractional BeOS advances on input. */

    /** Prebuilt input bitmap pixel order (default msb; independent of numeric byte order). */

    /** ChiWriter input raster bytes per row. */

    /** Meaning of Consoleet numeric filenames (default legacy). */

    /** Explicit C source or LVGL binary input container (default auto). */

    /** Generic C cell height; requires `c_width`. */

    /** First code in generic C arrays, e.g. U+0020 or 32. */

    /** unicode or an explicit legacy charset name. */

    /** Generic C baseline down from cell top (default height). */

    /** Generic C bytes store the leftmost pixel in bit zero. */

    /** Relative JSON/TOML atlas mapping, resolved beside the primary input. */

    /** Literal prefix on numeric glyph filenames in an input directory. */
    image_read_prefix?: string | null;
    /** Input directory filename radix (default 16). */
    image_read_radix?: number | null;
    /** Input filename code domain (default legacy). */
    image_read_domain?: string | null;
    /** Input image background (default black). */
    image_read_background?: string | null;
    /** Input glyph baseline measured down from each image's top. */
    image_read_baseline?: WideInt | null;
    /** HEX input/output rows (default 16); never inferred from record length. */
    hex_height?: number | null;
    /** HEX baseline-to-bottom distance (default 0). */
    hex_descent?: number | null;
    /** Explicit source FNT/FON legacy code page (does not remap byte positions). */
    fnt_read_code_page?: string | null;
    /** Primary input byte budget (default 64 MiB). */
    max_input_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Individual companion-file byte budget. */
    max_resource_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Aggregate resource and codec allocation budget (default 256 MiB). */
    max_total_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum companion reads and directory entries. */
    max_resources?: number | null;
    /** Explicit raster size for reviewed off-grid/curved outlines. */
    ppem?: number | null;
    /** Select a TTC/OTC face (zero based); otherwise read every face. */

    /** Rasterize outlines even when matching embedded images exist. */
    no_embedded_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit design units per pixel; requires --ppem. */
    grid_units?: number | null;
    /** Reviewed horizontal and vertical translations in pixel units. */
    pixel_offset_x?: number;
    /** Reviewed vertical translation in pixel units. */

}

/** `fontpixel::variants::Variants`: One default face plus ordered region and script alternatives. */
export interface VariantsDict {
    /** Default face and global metadata source. */
    base: FontDict;
    /** Language alternatives, applied in this order. */
    languages: LanguageVariant[];
    /** Script alternatives, applied after language planning. */
    scripts: ScriptVariant[];
}

/** `fontpixel_ops::opentype::VariantsRequest`: Combine regional and script faces into one locl-enabled OpenType font. */
export interface VariantsRequest {
    /** Default Unicode bitmap font. */
    base?: string;
    /** Language tag(s) and font, e.g. zh-Hant,zh-HK=TC.bdf; repeatable. */
    languages?: string[];
    /** Override scripts for a language: ja=DFLT,hani,kana; repeatable. */
    language_scripts?: string[];
    /** Script list and font, e.g. latn,grek,cyrl=Latin.bdf; repeatable. */
    scripts?: string[];
    /** Font design units per source pixel. */
    ppu?: number;
    /** Override units per em (otherwise pixel size times ppu). */
    upm?: number | null;
    /** Outline shape. */
    shape?: Shape;
    /** Pixel diameter/side ratio; default 1 for square, 0.9 for dot. */
    dotsize?: number | null;
    /** Native dot reuse: literal favors webfont ratio; patterns favors export speed. */
    dot_reuse?: string;
    /** Embed a matching EBDT/EBLC strike. */
    embed_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit gray-to-mono threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Family name override. */
    family?: string | null;
    /** Style name override. */
    style?: string | null;
    /** Legacy subfamily (name ID 2); defaults to Regular independently of --style. */
    legacy_style?: string | null;
    /** Exact full display name override (name ID 4). */
    full_name?: string | null;
    /** Exact PostScript name override (name ID 6); no silent sanitization. */
    postscript_name?: string | null;
    /** Version without the Version prefix; no timestamps are generated. */
    version?: string;
    /** Exactly four printable ASCII bytes. */
    vendor?: string;
    /** Copyright text override. */
    copyright?: string | null;
    /** License text override. */
    license?: string | null;
    /** License URL override. */
    license_url?: string | null;
    /** Outline source for WOFF/WOFF2; auto uses CFF square and TrueType dots. */
    woff2_source?: string;
    /** Glyph 0: keep the generated box (preserve) or write an empty outline with exact design-unit metrics (empty; requires --notdef-advance). */
    notdef?: string;
    /** Empty .notdef advance width in design units. */
    notdef_advance?: number | null;
    /** Empty .notdef left side bearing in design units (default 0). */
    notdef_lsb?: number | null;
    /** Exact name record PLATFORM/ENCODING/LANGUAGE/NAME_ID=TEXT (the --otb-name-record syntax). Repeatable; any record (or --name-record-hex / --name-language-tag) replaces the whole generated table and the --family/--style/--full-name/--postscript-name/--copyright name texts. Source notices the table drops are reported as loss. Example: */
    name_record?: string[];
    /** Name record with exact bytes: PLATFORM/ENCODING/LANGUAGE/NAME_ID=HEX. */
    name_record_hex?: string[];
    /** BCP 47 language tag for name format 1; the Nth tag is language 0x8000+N. */
    name_language_tag?: string[];
    /** OS/2 fsType embedding permissions; native default 0. */
    fs_type?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 fsSelection (version 3: bits 7..=9 rejected); native default 0x40. */
    fs_selection?: number | null;
    /** OS/2 usBreakChar; native default 0. */
    break_char?: number | null;
    /** Exact OS/2 ulCodePageRange1,ulCodePageRange2 instead of the cmap-derived bits. */
    code_page_ranges?: number[] | null;
    /** head.created, seconds since 1904-01-01 UTC; requires --modified. */
    created?: WideInt | null;
    /** head.modified, seconds since 1904-01-01 UTC; requires --created. */
    modified?: WideInt | null;
    /** post.isFixedPitch override; absent follows the source spacing. */
    fixed_pitch?: boolean | null;
    /** maxp.maxZones of TrueType output, 1 (native) or 2. */
    max_zones?: string | null;
    /** gasp table: keep (native) or omit. */
    gasp?: string | null;
    /** cmap format-12 records: always (native), non-bmp, or when-needed (format 12 only when format 4 cannot hold the map, under (3,10) only). */
    cmap_unicode_full?: string | null;
    /** Glyph IDs: planned (native, by glyph name) or codepoint (encoded glyphs by smallest scalar, then alternates in planned order). */
    glyph_order?: string | null;
    /** Shared dot glyph of TrueType dot output: last (native) or after-notdef (glyph 1). */
    dot_glyph?: string | null;
    /** Maximum primary input bytes (default 64 MiB). */
    max_input_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum bytes in one companion resource. */
    max_resource_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Aggregate input/model and codec allocation budget (default 256 MiB). */
    max_total_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum companion resource resolutions. */
    max_resources?: number | null;
    /** Maximum decompressed bytes. */
    max_decompressed_bytes?: number | null;
    /** Maximum aggregate source glyph slots and writer glyph count. */
    max_glyphs?: number | null;
    /** Maximum pixels in a source glyph. */
    max_pixels_per_glyph?: number | null;
    /** Maximum table or text-record bytes. */
    max_table_bytes?: number | null;
    /** TTF, OTF, OTB, WOFF or WOFF2 output (TTF/OTF retain subset outline flavor). */
    output?: string;
    /** Explicit output container; defaults to extension. */
    to?: string | null;
    /** Brotli quality, 0 through 11. */
    woff2_quality?: number;
    /** Legal intra-font parallel Brotli workers, 1 through 16. */
    woff2_threads?: number;
    /** Reject any conversion loss before replacing output. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Diagnostics format. */
    report?: ReportStyle;
}

/** `fontpixel::model::Vector`: A signed two-dimensional font-space vector (y up). */

    /** Horizontal component. */

    /** Vertical component. */

/** `fontpixel_ops::options::VectorOptions`: SVG and OpenType outline output options. */

    shape?: Shape | null;
    /** Dot diameter or separate-square side relative to one pixel. */

    /** Native dot reuse; default patterns. Literal favors smaller webfonts. */
    dot_reuse?: string | null;
    /** Design units per source pixel (default 100). */
    ppu?: number | null;
    /** Explicit units per em for outline output. */
    upm?: number | null;
    /** Embed a matching EBDT/EBLC bitmap strike in outline output. */
    embed_bitmaps?: boolean;
    /** Explicit grayscale-to-monochrome threshold. */
    gray_threshold?: number | null;
    /** Outline source in webfonts/TTC (auto selects CFF squares, TrueType dots). */
    woff2_source?: string | null;
    /** WOFF2 Brotli quality, 0 through 11 (default 11). */

    /** Intra-font Brotli workers (1..16), independent of batch task workers. */
    woff2_threads?: number | null;
    /** Write a version 2 TTC/OTC header. */
    collection_v2?: boolean;
    /** Glyph 0 of TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2/TTC output: preserve (the source .notdef, otherwise an empty glyph) or empty (empty outline with exact design-unit metrics; requires --notdef-advance; replacing a source .notdef is loss). */
    notdef?: string | null;
    /** Empty .notdef advance width in design units. */
    notdef_advance?: number | null;
    /** Empty .notdef left side bearing in design units (default 0). */
    notdef_lsb?: number | null;

/** `fontpixel::formats::vector_raster::Limits`: Limits shared by all vector-reader paths and accumulated model output. */

    /** Input, sfnt table and glyph limits. */

    max_total_edges?: number;
    /** Cumulative graph visits or CFF executed bytes across a face pass. */

    /** Maximum collection faces and retained strikes. */

}

/** `fontpixel::formats::vector_raster::Options`: Explicit overrides distinguish rasterization from automatic grid recovery. */
export interface VectorRasterOptions {
    /** None detects a native grid or extracts every physical embedded size. */
    ppem?: number | null;
    /** Face index for TTC/OTC; None reads every face. */
    face_index?: number | null;

    /** zlib level in 0..=9 (default 9). */

    /** Envelope version and optional blocks. */
