}

/** `fontpixel::woff::woff2::Options`: Deterministic WOFF2 output options. */
export interface Woff2Options {
    /** Brotli quality in 0..=11; the required default is 11. */
    quality?: number;
    /** Apply glyf/loca transforms whenever those tables exist (default true). */
    transform_glyf?: boolean;
    /** Apply hmtx transform when a full LSB array is reconstructible (default true). */
    transform_hmtx?: boolean;
    /** Intra-font Brotli workers, 1..=16. Default two; more changes compression decisions/size but still emits one standard Brotli stream. The value selects how the stream is split, not how it is scheduled: on targets without threads (`wasm`) the workers run in sequence and the bytes are identical to the native multithreaded output. */
    compression_threads?: number;
    /** Envelope version and optional blocks. */
    auxiliary?: Auxiliary;
}

}

export interface WoffLimits {

    /** Cumulative simple points across one font. */

    /** Cumulative component records, without recursively expanding them. */
    max_total_components?: number;
    /** Cumulative instruction bytes. */
    max_total_instructions?: number;
    /** Maximum uncompressed metadata and private-data bytes each. */
    max_auxiliary_bytes?: number;
    /** Maximum fonts queued by a multi-font compression call. */

    /** Maximum aggregate input bytes and, separately, retained output bytes for one multi-font call. Per-font working memory still scales with workers. */
    max_batch_bytes?: number;
}

    /** Explicit compatible bitmap directory origin. */

    /** ChiWriter input raster bytes per row. */

    /** Require Dashen screen/printer generation. */

}

/** `fontpixel_ops::p3_formats::workstation::WriteOptions`: Write options: native workstation/printer font variants and associated interpretation. */
export interface WorkstationWriteOptions {
    /** Prebuilt numeric byte order (default big). */
    prebuilt_byte_order?: string | null;
    /** Prebuilt output bitmap pixel order (default msb; lsb for explicit compatibility). */
    prebuilt_bitmap_bit_order?: string | null;
    /** Prebuilt native coverage precision; otherwise inferred per strike. */
    prebuilt_depth?: string | null;
    /** Explicitly round prebuilt gray samples to the selected palette. */
    prebuilt_quantize?: boolean;
    /** Prebuilt character-set name. */
    prebuilt_charset_name?: string | null;
    /** Prebuilt font identifier. */
    prebuilt_identifier?: number | null;
    /** Catalyst output directory origin. */

    /** Catalyst common raster height. */

    /** Catalyst inter-line leading. */
    catalyst_leading?: number | null;
    /** Catalyst common trailing bearing. */
    catalyst_sidebearing?: number | null;
    /** ChiWriter output generation (default 4). */
    chiwriter_version?: string | null;
    /** ChiWriter compatible output directory. */
    chiwriter_layout?: string | null;
    /** ChiWriter output raster bytes per row. */
    chiwriter_stride?: number | null;
    /** ChiWriter output cell width. */
    chiwriter_width?: number | null;
    /** ChiWriter output cell height. */
    chiwriter_height?: number | null;
    /** ChiWriter cell-top to baseline distance. */
    chiwriter_baseline?: number | null;
    /** ChiWriter v3 baseline-to-next-cell-top distance. */
    chiwriter_line_gap?: number | null;
    /** ChiWriter native filename (Latin-1, at most thirteen bytes). */
    chiwriter_filename?: string | null;
    /** Dashen output generation (default 3). */
    dashen_version?: string | null;
    /** Dashen native screen top offset. */
    dashen_top?: number | null;
    /** Emit an explicit Dashen codepoint remapping table. */
    dashen_codepoint_map?: boolean;
    /** PCL physical raster orientation. */
    hppcl_orientation?: string | null;
    /** PCL character encoding (default raw). */
    hppcl_compression?: string | null;
    /** Maximum PCL character-command bytes, including descriptor (17..32767). */
    hppcl_continuation_bytes?: number | null;

// Hand-written argument aliases of the fontpixel package (see
// docs/bindings-design.md, "JS/WASM"). Plain-data types are generated into
// types.d.ts by tools/bindings/gen_dts.py.

/** Bytes accepted by every byte parameter (copied once into WASM memory). */
export type BytesLike = Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer | DataView;

/** Bytes inside plain data: arrays of numbers on output; inputs also take buffers. */
export type SerdeBytes = number[];
/** Input form of {@link SerdeBytes}. */
export type SerdeBytesLike = number[] | Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer | DataView;

/** A 64-bit (or wider) Rust integer: `number` when |v| <= 2^53 - 1, else `bigint`. */
export type WideInt = number | bigint;

/** `"mono"` (1 bit per pixel) or `"gray8"` (one byte per pixel). */
export type Depth = "mono" | "gray8";

/**
 * A codepoint argument: a number or a one-character string is Unicode; a
 * `Codepoint` or plain data names the domain.
 */
export type CodepointLike = number | string | Codepoint | CodepointDict;

/** Options of the `FontSet` constructor. */
export interface FontSetArgs {
    /** Set-level properties (copied). */
    properties?: Properties | PropertiesDict;
    /** Format ID the set was read from. */
    sourceFormat?: string | null;
}

/** Options of the `Glyph` constructor. */
export interface GlyphArgs {
    /** Mapped codepoints. */
    codepoints?: CodepointLike[];
    /** Glyph name. */
    name?: string | null;
}

/**
 * A property value argument: `null` is `Flag`; an integer (number or
 * bigint) is `Integer` (`Unsigned` above the i64 range); a string `Text`;
 * bytes `Bytes`; an array `List`; or the tagged plain data.
 */
export type PropertyValueLike =
| null
| number
| bigint
| string
| BytesLike
| PropertyValueLike[]
| PropertyValue;

/** A bitmap-projection property edit (plain data). */
export type PropertyEditLike =
| { set: { name: string; value: WideInt | string } }
| { remove: { name: string } };

/** Options of `BitmapProjection` / `applyBitmapProjection` (the Rust field names). */
export interface BitmapProjectionArgs {
    /** `"preserve"` (default) or `{from_device: {units_per_em, reference_ppem}}`. */
    scalable_advance?: ScalableAdvance;
    /** Complete FONT/XLFD name. */
    font_name?: string | null;
    /** Point size and resolution. */
    size?: SizeProjection | null;
    /** Property edits, applied in order. */
    properties?: PropertyEditLike[];
}

/** Result of `applyBitmapProjection`: the outcome plus its retained bytes. */
export interface ProjectionResult extends ProjectionOutcome {
    /** `ProjectionOutcome::retained_bytes`. */
    retained_bytes: number;
}

/** Options of the `Input` constructor. */
export interface InputArgs {
    /** Filename hint (never content evidence). */
    name?: string | null;
    /** Sidecars. */
    resources?: ResourcesLike;
}

/**
 * A progress observer: receives `Progress` plain data; returning exactly
 * `false` cancels (`CancelledError`), throwing cancels and rethrows.
 */
export type ProgressFunction = (progress: Progress) => unknown;

/**
 * A synchronous sidecar resolver: return the file's bytes, or `null`/`undefined`
 * when it does not exist. Called while the operation runs; it must not await.
 */
export type ResolveFunction = (path: string, maxBytes: number) => BytesLike | null | undefined;

/** A resolver object; `list` enables directory enumeration (`directory` is `null` for the root). */
export interface ResolverObject {
    resolve(path: string, maxBytes: number): BytesLike | null | undefined;
    list?(directory: string | null, maxEntries: number, maxBytes: number): string[];
}

/** Sidecar resources: a `ResourceSet`, named files, or a synchronous resolver. */
export type ResourcesLike =
| ResourceSet
| Record<string, BytesLike>
| Map<string, BytesLike>
| ResolveFunction
| ResolverObject;

/** Options of `read`. */
export interface ReadArgs {
    /** Format ID; bypasses detection. */
    format?: string;
    /** The format's typed read options (applied to the detected format when `format` is absent). */
    options?: object;
    /** Filename hint (never content evidence). */
    name?: string;
    /** Sidecars. */
    resources?: ResourcesLike;
    /** Input resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Directory entry point (no primary bytes; files come from `resources`; needs `format`). */
    directory?: string;
}

/** Options of `Registry.read`. */
export interface RegistryReadArgs {
    /** Format ID; bypasses detection. */
    format?: string;
    /** Filename hint (never content evidence). */
    name?: string;
    /** Sidecars. */
    resources?: ResourcesLike;
    /** Input resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Directory entry point (no primary bytes; files come from `resources`; needs `format`). */
    directory?: string;
}

/** Options of `detect` / `Registry.detect`. */
export interface DetectArgs {
    /** Filename hint, used only when no content detector matches. */
    name?: string;
    /** Sidecars. */
    resources?: ResourcesLike;
    /** Input resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Directory entry point (`Registry.detect` only; always an error: directory inputs need a format). */
    directory?: string;
}

/** Common options of every registry write route. */
export interface WriteCommonArgs {
    /** Primary output name (default `font.<first extension>`; a `.gz` suffix selects the gzip envelope). */
    primaryName?: string;
    /** Throw `StrictLossError` on any read or write loss. */
    strict?: boolean;
    /** Common transport limits. */
    transportLimits?: TransportLimits;
}

/** Options of `Registry.write`, `writeReservedWithReport` and `writeOwned`. */
export interface RegistryWriteArgs extends WriteCommonArgs {
    /** Earlier diagnostics (for example a read report) combined before strict checks. */
    report?: Report;
}

/** Options of the module function `write`. */
export interface WriteArgs extends RegistryWriteArgs {
    /** The format's typed write options. */
    options?: object;
}

/** `Loaded.intoSingle()`: the sole strike as a `Font`. */
export interface LoadedFont {
    fonts: Font;
    report: Report;
    format: string;
}

/** One output file: a validated relative path and a fresh copy of its bytes. */
export interface OutputAssetLike {
    path: string;
    data: Uint8Array;
}

/** Result of a direct reader: the model exactly as the Rust function returns it, and its report. */
export interface ModelReport<M> {
    model: M;
    report: Report;
}

/** Result of a direct byte writer. */
export interface BytesReport {
    data: Uint8Array;
    report: Report;
}

/** Options of a direct context reader (`formats.<module>.read`). */
export interface DirectContextReadArgs<O> {
    /** The module's read options. */
    options?: O;
    /** Filename hint. */
    name?: string;
    /** Sidecars. */
    resources?: ResourcesLike;
    /** Input resource limits. */
    limits?: ResourceLimits;
    /** Directory entry point. */
    directory?: string;
}

/** Options of a direct bundle writer (`formats.<module>.write`). */
export interface DirectWriteArgs<O> extends WriteCommonArgs {
    /** The module's write options. */
    options?: O;
}

/** The input of a JS codec hook (a `HookContext`). */
export type CodecContext = HookContext;

/** A JS writer: a function, or an object with `write` and optional transport hooks. */
export type WriterHook =
| ((fonts: FontSet, options: FormatsWriteOptions) => Written | OutputBundle | [OutputBundle, Report])
| {
    write(fonts: FontSet, options: FormatsWriteOptions): Written | OutputBundle | [OutputBundle, Report];
    transportLimits?(): TransportLimits;
    validateTransport?(fonts: FontSet, options: FormatsWriteOptions, limits: TransportLimits): void;
};

/** Hooks of `Registry.register`. */
export interface CodecHooks {
    /** Content detector: `"no_match"`, `"possible"` or `"certain"`. */
    detector?: (ctx: HookContext) => Confidence;
    /** Reader: `[fonts, report]`. */
    reader?: (ctx: HookContext, options: FormatsReadOptions) => [FontSet | Font, Report];
    /** Writer. */
    writer?: WriterHook;
}

/** A palette for `Bitmap.fromText`: character -> pixel value (object, Map or `[char, value]` pairs). */
export type TextPalette = Record<string, number> | Map<string, number> | [string, number][];
/** A palette for `Bitmap.toText`: pixel value -> character (object, Map or `[value, char]` pairs). */
export type OutputPalette = Record<number, string> | Map<number, string> | [number, string][];
/** A palette for `Bitmap.toPaletteBytes`: pixel value -> bytes per pixel. */
export type BytesPalette =
| Record<number, BytesLike | number[]>
| Map<number, BytesLike | number[]>
| [number, BytesLike | number[]][];

/** A TrueType outline point `[x, y, onCurve]` in upward design units (`fontpixel::outline::Point`). */
export type OutlinePoint = [number, number, boolean];
/** A closed contour without a repeated closing point (`fontpixel::outline::Contour`). */
export type Contour = OutlinePoint[];

/** A capability record of `capabilities()`. */
export interface Capability {
    name: string;
    available: boolean;
    description: string;
    /** Why it is unavailable (empty when available). */
    reason: string;
    /** Evidence for the reason (empty when available). */
    evidence: string;
    /** What to use instead (empty when available). */
    alternative: string;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- ops (W8.3)

/** A memory-storage provider for `ops` calls, called synchronously while an operation runs. */
export interface FileProviderObject {
    /** `null`/`undefined` (absent), a file length in bytes, or `"directory"`. */
    entry(path: string): number | bigint | "directory" | null | undefined;
    /** The complete contents of a file `entry` reported. */
    read(path: string): BytesLike;
    /** Names (not paths) directly inside `directory` (`""` is the root), in a deterministic order. */
    list(directory: string): string[];
}

/** Memory storage of an `ops` call: named buffers (storage key -> bytes) or a provider. */
export type FilesLike = Record<string, BytesLike> | Map<string, BytesLike> | FileProviderObject;

/** Trailing options of an `ops` call. `files` is required: WebAssembly has no filesystem storage. */
export interface OpsCallOptions {
    files?: FilesLike;
}

/** Trailing options of `ops.convert`/`ops.vectorize`/`ops.merge`. */
export interface OpsProgressOptions extends OpsCallOptions {
    /** Called after each step; returning exactly `false` cancels (`CancelledError`). */
    progress?: ProgressFunction;
}

/** Options of `ops.batchToml`. */
export interface BatchTomlOptions extends OpsCallOptions {
    /** Directory that relative task paths resolve against (default none). */
    base?: string;
    /** Overrides the file's worker ceiling. */
    jobs?: number;
}

/**
 * A typed batch task: a string `id`, the task `kind` and the flat request
 * keys of that operation (`ConvertRequest`, `MergeRequest`, ...).
 */
export type BatchTaskSpec = { id: string } & TaskRequest;

/** The request of `ops.batch`. */
export interface BatchSpec {
    tasks: BatchTaskSpec[];
    jobs?: number | null;
    max_working_bytes?: number;
    max_pending_bytes?: number;
    max_report_bytes?: number;
    max_task_report_bytes?: number;
    protected_paths?: string[];
}

/** One task outcome of a `BatchResult`. */
export interface BatchTaskSummary {
    index: number;
    id: string;
    kind: string;
    success: boolean;
    exit_code: number;
    committed: boolean;
    diagnostics_truncated: boolean;
    error: string | null;
}

/** `ops.parseBatchToml` result. */
export interface ParsedBatch {
    jobs: number | null;
    max_working_bytes: number;
    max_pending_bytes: number;
    max_report_bytes: number;
    max_task_report_bytes: number;
    tasks: {
        id: string;
        kind: string;
        declared_inputs: string[];
        /** The normalized request: `kind` plus the operation's flat keys. */
        request?: { kind: BatchTaskSpec["kind"]; [key: string]: unknown };
        weight?: number;
        error?: string;
    }[];
}

/** `ops.capabilities()`: the operations layer's booleans. */
export interface OpsCapabilities {
    filesystem: boolean;
    threads: boolean;
    toml_batch: boolean;
}

/** `ops.defaults()`: the batch budget defaults. */
export interface BatchDefaults {
    max_working_bytes: number;
    max_pending_bytes: number;
    max_report_bytes: number;
    max_task_report_bytes: number;
}

/** `ops.parseArgs` / `ops.inspectRequest` result. */
export interface RequestDescription {
    command: string;
    request: any;
    report_style: "text" | "json";
    source_identity_total_bytes: number;
    declared_inputs?: string[];
    weight?: number;
}

/** The `info --json` document returned by `info(bytes)`. */
export interface InfoDocument {
    format: string;
    font_count: number;
    fonts: any[];
    report: Report;
}

/** Options of `info(bytes, options)`: `name` plus `InfoRequest` keys other than `input`/`json`. */
export type InfoArgs = { name?: string } & Omit<Partial<InfoRequest>, "input" | "json">;

/** One part of `merge(parts, options)`, in priority order. */
export interface MergePart {
    /** The font file. */
    bytes: BytesLike;
    /** Selection expression, e.g. `"cjk"`, `"western,geometric"`, `"U+2190-21FF,-U+21A0"`. */
    take: string;
    /** Vertical offset in pixels (positive moves glyphs up). */
    dy?: number;
    /** File name: storage key, format hint, diagnostic asset name (default `part-<n>`). */
    name?: string;
    /** Explicit input format. */
    from?: string | null;
    /** Strike of a multi-font input. */
    font_index?: number | null;
}

/** Options of `merge(parts, options)`: the command line's merge options. */
export type MergeArgs = Omit<MergeRequest, "parts" | "outputs"> & {
    /** Output file names (format from the extension) or `{destination, format}`. */
    outputs: (string | MergeOutput)[];
    /** Progress observer; returning exactly `false` cancels. */
    progress?: ProgressFunction;
};

/** Result of `merge(parts, options)`. */
export interface MergeFilesResult {
    /** Every output asset by name. */
    files: Record<string, Uint8Array>;
    /** The parsed `--report json` document. */
    report: any;
    /** The `--report json` document exactly as the command line prints it. */
    json: string;
    /** The text report exactly as the command line prints it. */
    text: string;
}

/** Options of `render(fontBytes, text, options)`. */
export type RenderArgs = { name?: string } & Omit<Partial<PreviewRequest>, "input" | "text" | "chars"> &
(
| { format?: "mono" }
| {
    format: "rgba";
    /** Integer nearest-neighbor scale (default 1). */
    scale?: number;
    /** Ink color (default opaque black). */
    color?: Rgba;
    /** Paper color (default opaque white). */
    background?: Rgba;
}
);

/** Result of `render(fontBytes, text, options)`. */
export interface RenderResult {
    format: "mono" | "rgba";
    /** Image width in pixels (scaled for `rgba`). */
    width: number;
    /** Image height in pixels (scaled for `rgba`). */
    height: number;
    /** Bytes per row. */
    stride: number;
    /** Pixel scale (1 for `mono`). */
    scale: number;
    /** Packed 1-bit rows (`mono`) or RGBA pixels (`rgba`). */
    data: Uint8Array | Uint8ClampedArray;
    /** `#`/`.` character art (`fontpixel preview` output without the final newline). */
    art: string;
    /** Read and render diagnostics. */
    report: Report;
}



/**
 * The result of a batch: the complete JSON document plus typed summaries.
 */
export class BatchResult {
    private constructor();
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * The complete batch JSON document exactly as `fontpixel batch` prints it.
     */
    json(): string;
    /**
     * Committed outputs as `{destination key: OutputBundleDict}`.
     */
    readonly bundles: Record<string, OutputBundleDict>;
    /**
     * The parsed batch document.
     */
    readonly document: any;
    /**
     * Aggregate exit code (precedence 2 > 1 > 3 > 0), as `fontpixel batch`.
     */
    readonly exitCode: number;
    /**
     * Requested worker ceiling, capped by the task count.
     */
    readonly jobs: number;
    /**
     * Committed outputs as `{storage key: Uint8Array}`.
     */
    readonly outputs: Record<string, Uint8Array>;
    /**
     * Per-task outcomes in request order (`{index, id, kind, success,
     * exit_code, committed, diagnostics_truncated, error}`).
     */
    readonly tasks: BatchTaskSummary[];
    /**
     * Workers actually used (always 1 here: no threads).
     */
    readonly workers: number;
}

/**
 * A bitmap of `'0'`/`'1'`/`'2'` rows (row 0 at the top) backed by a native raster.
 */
export class BdfparserRawBitmap {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Replace the raster with a copy of another bitmap's.
     */
    assign(other: BdfparserRawBitmap): void;
    /**
     * Ink bounding box `[w, h, xoff, yoff]`, bottom-left origin (`Bitmap::bbox`).
     */
    bbox(): [number, number, number, number];
    /**
     * The rows as a new array of strings (`Bitmap::bindata`).
     */
    bindata(): string[];
    /**
     * An all-zero `w`×`h` bitmap (`Bitmap::blank`).
     */
    static blank(w: number, h: number): BdfparserRawBitmap;
    /**
     * Embolden by `n` pixels (`Bitmap::bold`).
     */
    bold(n: number): void;
    /**
     * Pad the width to a multiple of `bits` (`Bitmap::bytepad`).
     */
    bytepad(bits: number): void;
    /**
     * Independent copy.
     */
    clone(): BdfparserRawBitmap;
    /**
     * Concatenate another bitmap in place (`Bitmap::concat`).
     */
    concat(other: BdfparserRawBitmap, direction: number, align: number, offset: number): void;
    /**
     * A bitmap from rows of equal length made of `'0'`, `'1'`, `'2'` (`Bitmap::new`).
     */
    constructor(rows: string[]);
    /**
     * Crop/extend to `w`×`h`; `(xoff, yoff)` is the new bottom-left corner
     * relative to the current one, y up (`Bitmap::crop`).
     */
    crop(w: number, h: number, xoff: number, yoff: number): void;
    /**
     * Integer scale (`Bitmap::enlarge`).
     */
    enlarge(x: number, y: number): void;
    /**
     * Whether both bitmaps have the same rows (`Bitmap::equals`).
     */
    equals(other: BdfparserRawBitmap): boolean;
    /**
     * Mirror left-right (`Bitmap::fliph`).
     */
    fliph(): void;
    /**
     * Mirror top-bottom (`Bitmap::flipv`).
     */
    flipv(): void;
    /**
     * Parse a `toString()` picture (`#`=1, `.`=0, `&`=2, digits accepted;
     * outer empty lines ignored) (`Bitmap::fromstring`).
     */
    static fromstring(text: string): BdfparserRawBitmap;
    /**
     * Pixel label at `(x, y)` (top-left origin) (`Bitmap::getpixel`).
     */
    getpixel(x: number, y: number): number;
    /**
     * Add a label-2 glow (`mode` 0: 4-neighbour, 1: 8-neighbour) (`Bitmap::glow`).
     */
    glow(mode: number): void;
    /**
     * Number of rows (`Bitmap::height`).
     */
    height(): number;
    /**
     * Swap ink and background (`Bitmap::invert`).
     */
    invert(): void;
    /**
     * Shear rows: one pixel per `step` rows above `base` (`Bitmap::italic`).
     */
    italic(step: number, base: number): void;
    /**
     * The pixel labels (0, 1, 2) row by row, top to bottom, one byte each
     * (`Bitmap::label_rows`).
     */
    labels(): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Overlay another bitmap aligned top-left, keeping this size (`Bitmap::overlay`).
     */
    overlay(other: BdfparserRawBitmap): void;
    /**
     * Paste the non-zero pixels of `bitmap` at `(x, y)` (top-left origin) (`Bitmap::paste`).
     */
    paste(bitmap: BdfparserRawBitmap, x: number, y: number): void;
    /**
     * Replace a label substring in every row (`Bitmap::replace`).
     */
    replace(substr: string, newsubstr: string): void;
    /**
     * Python-style representation (`Bitmap::repr`).
     */
    repr(): string;
    /**
     * Rotate clockwise by a multiple of 90 degrees (`Bitmap::rotate`).
     */
    rotate(angle: number): void;
    /**
     * The hex (`todata(4)`) or decimal (`todata(5)`) text of each row
     * (`Bitmap::row_number`).
     */
    rowNumbers(hex: boolean): string[];
    /**
     * Replace the raster with new rows (`Bitmap::new`).
     */
    setBindata(rows: string[]): void;
    /**
     * Set the pixel at `(x, y)` to 0, 1 or 2 (`Bitmap::setpixel`).
     */
    setpixel(x: number, y: number, value: number): void;
    /**
     * Add a label-2 shadow (`Bitmap::shadow`).
     */
    shadow(xoff: number, yoff: number): void;
    /**
     * Move the content by `(dx, dy)` (y up), keeping the size (`Bitmap::shift`).
     */
    shift(dx: number, dy: number): void;
    /**
     * `#`/`.`/`&` picture of the rows (`Display`).
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Pillow `Image.frombytes` data for mode `'1'`, `'L'`, `'RGB'` or
     * `'RGBA'`; `palette` maps labels 0/1/2 to byte records (single bits for
     * mode `'1'`) (`Bitmap::tobytes`).
     */
    tobytes(mode: string, palette: [number[], number[], number[]] | null | undefined): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Export data type 0 (string), 1 (rows), 2 (number rows), 3 (flat
     * numbers), 4 (hex rows) or 5 (number per row; `bigint` beyond 2^53 − 1)
     * (`Bitmap::todata`).
     */
    todata(datatype: number): any;
    /**
     * SVG output: `format` `'path'`, `'pathOnly'` or `'rect'`; `shape`
     * `'square'` or `'circle'` (`Bitmap::tosvg`).
     */
    tosvg(pixelsize: number, format: string, inverted: boolean, xoff: number, yoff: number, shape: string): string;
    /**
     * Remove empty outer rows and columns (`Bitmap::trim`).
     */
    trim(): void;
    /**
     * Width in pixels (`Bitmap::width`).
     */
    width(): number;
}

/**
 * A list of bitmaps for `concatall` (bitmaps are copied in with `push`, so
 * the JS handles stay valid).
 */
export class BdfparserRawBitmapList {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Concatenate the bitmaps: `direction` 1 right, 2 left, 0 down, -1 up;
     * `align` 1 bottom/left, 0 top/right; `offsets` gaps between neighbours
     * (`Bitmap::concatall`).
     */
    concatall(direction: number, align: number, offsets: Float64Array): BdfparserRawBitmap;
    /**
     * An empty list.
     */
    constructor();
    /**
     * Append a copy of `bitmap`.
     */
    push(bitmap: BdfparserRawBitmap): void;
}

/**
 * A character ⇄ codepoint converter of one charset (`fontpixel::charset::CharsetCodec`).
 */
export class BdfparserRawCodec {
    private constructor();
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * One character → code (`CharsetCodec::char2cp`).
     */
    char2cp(ch: string): number | undefined;
    /**
     * Code → one character (`CharsetCodec::cp2char`).
     */
    cp2char(code: number): string | undefined;
    /**
     * Code → Unicode code point (surrogates retained for Unicode identity),
     * `undefined` if not mapped (`CharsetCodec::cp2unicode`).
     */
    cp2unicode(code: number): number | undefined;
    /**
     * The codec of a charset name (any spelling, canonicalized with
     * `canonicalCharset`); `gl` selects the 94×94 GL form (`undefined`: GL
     * only for charsets that are always GL) (`CharsetCodec::new`).
     */
    static open(name: string, gl?: boolean | null): BdfparserRawCodec;
    /**
     * Unicode code point → code (round-trip exact), `undefined` if not
     * representable (`CharsetCodec::unicode2cp`).
     */
    unicode2cp(value: number): number | undefined;
    /**
     * The canonical key (`CharsetCodec::name`).
     */
    readonly charset: string;
    /**
     * Whether the charset is a GL-capable 94×94 set.
     */
    readonly gl94: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether this codec uses 94×94 GL codes (`CharsetCodec::gl`).
     */
    readonly gl: boolean;
    /**
     * `'unicode'`, `'sbcs'`, `'dbcs'` or `'gb18030'` (`CharsetCodec::kind`).
     */
    readonly kind: string;
    /**
     * Whether the name is a known charset (`CharsetCodec::known`).
     */
    readonly known: boolean;
}

/**
 * Handle over `fontpixel::compat::bdfparser::Font` (wrapped by the
 * bdfparser-js `Font` of `fontpixel/compat/bdfparser`). Attached glyph
 * handles share its model.
 */
export class BdfparserRawFont {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Add and attach a glyph handle (`Font::add_handle`).
     */
    addHandle(glyph: BdfparserRawGlyph, replace: boolean): void;
    /**
     * Add glyph metadata (`Font::addglyph`).
     */
    addglyph(fields: Record<string, unknown>, replace: boolean): void;
    /**
     * One-character string → code (`Font::char2cp`).
     */
    char2cp(ch: string): number | undefined;
    /**
     * Canonical charset key (`Font::charset`).
     */
    charset(): string;
    /**
     * Re-encode to another charset (`Font::charsetconvert`).
     */
    charsetconvert(name: string): void;
    /**
     * Deep copy (`Font::clone`): converters are shared, the model is copied.
     */
    clone(): BdfparserRawFont;
    /**
     * An empty font (`Font::default`).
     */
    constructor();
    /**
     * A detached native `Font` copy of the model (`Font::core`).
     */
    core(): Font;
    /**
     * Code → one-character string (`Font::cp2char`).
     */
    cp2char(cp: any): string | undefined;
    /**
     * Code → Unicode code point, surrogates retained (`Font::cp2unicode`).
     */
    cp2unicode(cp: any): number | undefined;
    /**
     * A new font from `CreateOptions` plain data (`Font::create`).
     */
    static create(options?: CreateOptions): BdfparserRawFont;
    /**
     * Delete every case-insensitive occurrence of a property (`Font::delprop`).
     */
    delprop(key: string): void;
    /**
     * Draw text after charset conversion (`Font::draw`).
     */
    draw(text: string, kw: Record<string, unknown>): BdfparserRawBitmap;
    /**
     * Draw all filtered glyphs (`order`, `r` plus the draw keywords) (`Font::drawall`).
     */
    drawall(kw: Record<string, unknown>): BdfparserRawBitmap;
    /**
     * Draw explicit codes with SPEC draw keywords (`linelimit`, `mode`,
     * `direction`, `ucgs`, `missing`) (`Font::drawcps`).
     */
    drawcps(cps: Float64Array, kw: Record<string, unknown>): BdfparserRawBitmap;
    /**
     * Override the charset; `''` clears the override (`Font::encoding`).
     */
    encoding(name: string): void;
    /**
     * Wrap a copy of a native `Font` (`Font::from_core`).
     */
    static fromCore(font: Font): BdfparserRawFont;
    /**
     * Case-insensitive property lookup, `null` if absent (`Font::getprop`).
     */
    getprop(key: string): any;
    /**
     * Attached handle by character, with bdfparser's warning on a miss (`Font::glyph`).
     */
    glyph(ch: string): BdfparserRawGlyph | undefined;
    /**
     * Attached handle, or `undefined` with bdfparser's warning
     * (`Font::glyphbycp`). bdfparser-js does not warn: its `glyphbycp` uses
     * [`lookup`](Self::lookup).
     */
    glyphbycp(cp: any): BdfparserRawGlyph | undefined;
    /**
     * Projected SPEC headers in insertion order (`Font::headers`).
     */
    headers(): Record<string, unknown>;
    /**
     * Encoded codes in an order (0 file, -1 reverse, 1 ascending, 2
     * descending) filtered by a SPEC range (`Font::itercps`).
     */
    itercps(order: number, r: any): number[];
    /**
     * Attached handles in order and range (`Font::iterglyphs`).
     */
    iterglyphs(order: number, r: any): BdfparserRawGlyph[];
    /**
     * Characters without a glyph, or `undefined` (`Font::lacksglyphs`).
     */
    lacksglyphs(text: string): string[] | undefined;
    /**
     * Number of encoded glyphs (`Font::length`).
     */
    length(): number;
    /**
     * Load auto-detected BDF/PCF/TTF bytes, also gzip-compressed
     * (`Font::load_bytes_with_options`; `Font::load_bytes` without `pixelsize`).
     */
    loadBytes(data: BytesLike, pixelsize?: number): void;
    /**
     * Load from a reader object `{read(n) => Uint8Array | null}` with the
     * bounded format detection of `loadBytes` (`Font::load_file_obj`).
     */
    loadFileObj(reader: { read(n: number): BytesLike | null | undefined }): void;
    /**
     * Load a file by path (`Font::load_file_path`): unavailable, the package
     * never reads paths (capability `filesystem`).
     */
    loadFilePath(_path: string): void;
    /**
     * Load BDF lines (`Font::load_lines`); line delimiters are not changed.
     */
    loadLines(lines: string[]): void;
    /**
     * Load BDF text (`Font::load_string`).
     */
    loadString(text: string): void;
    /**
     * Load glyph-based TrueType bytes (`Font::load_ttf`).
     */
    loadTtf(data: BytesLike, pixelsize?: number): void;
    /**
     * Attached handle, or `undefined` without a warning (`Font::lookup`).
     */
    lookup(cp: any): BdfparserRawGlyph | undefined;
    /**
     * Copy the encoded glyphs of another font (`Font::merge`).
     */
    merge(other: BdfparserRawFont, replace: boolean): void;
    /**
     * Canonical full model: headers, props, propnames, glyphs, unencoded,
     * charset (`Font::model`).
     */
    model(): Record<string, unknown>;
    /**
     * Create an attached glyph (`Font::newglyph`).
     */
    newglyph(cp: any, bitmap: BdfparserRawBitmap | null | undefined, mode: number, name: string | null | undefined, dwidth: any): BdfparserRawGlyph;
    /**
     * The 17 metadata slots of a fields object, normalized as `addglyph`
     * does (`Font::prepare_meta`).
     */
    prepareMeta(fields: Record<string, unknown>): unknown[];
    /**
     * Case-normalized properties in insertion order (`Font::props`).
     */
    props(): Record<string, unknown>;
    /**
     * Add normalized glyph metadata and, for an unencoded glyph, its
     * alternate code (`Font::prepare_meta` + `Font::put_with_alt`).
     */
    putWithAlt(fields: Record<string, unknown>, altcode: any): void;
    /**
     * Remove exactly a handle's slot (`Font::remove_handle`).
     */
    removeHandle(glyph: BdfparserRawGlyph): void;
    /**
     * Remove one header key; false if absent (`Font::remove_header`).
     */
    removeHeader(key: string): boolean;
    /**
     * Remove the `index`-th unencoded glyph, or all of them without an index;
     * false if the index is out of range (`Font::remove_unencoded`).
     */
    removeUnencoded(index?: number | null): boolean;
    /**
     * Remove a code; missing codes are a no-op (`Font::removeglyph`).
     */
    removeglyph(cp: any): void;
    /**
     * Structured warnings collected so far (`Font::report`), as plain data.
     */
    report(): Report;
    /**
     * Serialize to a writer object `{write(bytes: Uint8Array)}`; `format`
     * `bdf`, `pcf`, `ttf` or `svg` with the writer's plain-data options
     * (`Font::save_to`).
     */
    saveTo(writer: { write(bytes: Uint8Array): unknown }, format: string, options?: any | null): void;
    /**
     * Save to a path (`Font::save`): unavailable, the package never writes
     * paths (capability `filesystem`); use `saveTo` or the byte outputs.
     */
    save(_path: string): void;
    /**
     * Install JS converters `char2cp(char) => number | null` and
     * `cp2char(cp) => string | null`; `undefined`/`null` restores the
     * charset table in that direction (`Font::set_converters`).
     */
    setConverters(char2cp: any, cp2char: any): void;
    /**
     * Set one header key, appended when new (`Font::set_header`).
     */
    setHeader(key: string, value: any): void;
    /**
     * Replace all headers in place (`Font::set_headers`); glyph handles stay attached.
     */
    setHeaders(headers: Record<string, unknown>): void;
    /**
     * Set the alternate code of the `index`-th unencoded glyph (`null` removes
     * it); false if there is no such glyph (`Font::set_unencoded_altcode`).
     */
    setUnencodedAltcode(index: number, altcode: any): boolean;
    /**
     * Set metadata keys of the `index`-th unencoded glyph; false if there is
     * no such glyph (`Font::set_unencoded_meta`).
     */
    setUnencodedMeta(index: number, fields: Record<string, unknown>): boolean;
    /**
     * Set a property, keeping the first spelling of an existing key (`Font::setprop`).
     */
    setprop(key: string, value: any): void;
    /**
     * Deep copy restricted to a range (`Font::subset`).
     */
    subset(r: any): BdfparserRawFont;
    /**
     * SWIDTH from DWIDTH (`Font::swidth`).
     */
    swidth(dwx: any): any;
    /**
     * Serialize BDF text (`Font::tobdf`).
     */
    tobdf(): string;
    /**
     * Serialize PCF with `PcfWriteOptions` plain data (`Font::topcf`).
     */
    topcf(options?: PcfWriteOptions): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Serialize an SVG font (`Font::tosvgfont`).
     */
    tosvgfont(xoff: number, yoff: number, controlcharnoskip: boolean, unicodeformat: string): string;
    /**
     * Serialize TrueType with `TtfOptions` plain data (`Font::tottf`).
     */
    tottf(options?: TtfOptions): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Apply a JS bitmap function `(raw: BdfparserRawBitmap) => void` to
     * glyphs (`Font::transform`): the function edits the bitmap handle it
     * receives; the JS wrapper copies a returned bitmap into it. Its
     * exception is rethrown after Rust's partial-mutation order.
     */
    transform(_function: Function, r: any, mode: number): void;
    /**
     * Alternate code of the `index`-th unencoded glyph, `null` if none,
     * `undefined` if there is no such glyph (`Font::unencoded_altcode`).
     */
    unencodedAltcode(index: number): any;
    /**
     * Attached handle of the `index`-th unencoded glyph (`Font::unencoded_handle`).
     */
    unencodedHandle(index: number): BdfparserRawGlyph | undefined;
    /**
     * Attached handles of the unencoded glyphs in order (`Font::unencoded_handles`).
     */
    unencodedHandles(): BdfparserRawGlyph[];
    /**
     * Unicode code point → code, `undefined` if not representable (`Font::unicode2cp`).
     */
    unicode2cp(code: number): number | undefined;
    /**
     * FONTBOUNDINGBOX := union of the positive glyph boxes (`Font::updatebbox`).
     */
    updatebbox(): void;
    /**
     * Messages of the warning-level report entries from index `start` on (the
     * ones bdfparser-js passes to its warning handler) and the new entry count
     * (`Font::warnings_since`).
     */
    warningsSince(start: number): [string[], number];
}

/**
 * Glyph metadata snapshot with an optional live attachment.
 */
export class BdfparserRawGlyph {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Character through the owner's charset (`Glyph::chr`).
     */
    chr(): string | undefined;
    /**
     * Detached copy sharing the font (`Glyph::clone`).
     */
    clone(): BdfparserRawGlyph;
    /**
     * A detached glyph from a metadata object owned by `font` (`Glyph::new`;
     * keys outside the 17 `META_TITLES` are ignored).
     */
    constructor(meta: Record<string, unknown>, font: BdfparserRawFont);
    /**
     * Code; unencoded glyphs (and a null codepoint) give -1 (`Glyph::cp`).
     */
    cp(): any;
    /**
     * Draw: mode 0 font box, 1 glyph box, 2 raw hex rows, -1 custom `bb`
     * `[w, h, xoff, yoff]` (`Glyph::draw`).
     */
    draw(mode: number, bb: [number, number, number, number] | null | undefined): BdfparserRawBitmap;
    /**
     * A handle sharing the owning font's model (`Glyph::font`).
     */
    font(): BdfparserRawFont;
    /**
     * Whether the original slot still exists unreplaced (`Glyph::is_attached`).
     */
    isAttached(): boolean;
    /**
     * The 17 metadata slots in `META_TITLES` order (`Glyph::meta`).
     */
    meta(): unknown[];
    /**
     * Origin displacement `[x, y]` for a draw mode (`Glyph::origin`).
     */
    origin(mode: number, fromorigin: boolean, xoff: any, yoff: any): [number, number];
    /**
     * Replace the raster (`Glyph::setbitmap`).
     */
    setbitmap(bitmap: BdfparserRawBitmap, mode: number, bb: [number, number, number, number] | null | undefined, trim: boolean): void;
    /**
     * Set metadata keys, writing through when attached (`Glyph::setmeta`).
     */
    setmeta(fields: Record<string, unknown>): void;
    /**
     * Move the ink offsets (`Glyph::shift`).
     */
    shift(dx: any, dy: any): void;
    /**
     * The glyph drawn in the font box as a `#`/`.` picture (`Display`).
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Draw, apply a JS bitmap function `(raw: BdfparserRawBitmap) => void`
     * that edits the handle it receives, and set the result (`Glyph::transform`).
     */
    transform(_function: Function, mode: number): void;
}

/**
 * A Mono or Gray8 raster (`fontpixel::model::GlyphBitmap`). Always owned:
 * reading a glyph's bitmap returns a copy; assign it back to edit the glyph.
 */
export class Bitmap {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * A copy of the canonical storage (`Bitmap::as_bytes`): top-down rows,
     * Mono packed MSB-first and padded to whole bytes, Gray8 one byte per
     * pixel.
     */
    asBytes(): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Tight ink rectangle in bottom-left coordinates (`Bitmap::bbox`).
     */
    bbox(): Bounds;
    /**
     * Rightward emboldening by `n` pixels (default 1) (`Bitmap::bold`).
     */
    bold(n?: number | null): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Pad the width up to a multiple of `pixels` (`Bitmap::byte_pad`).
     */
    bytePad(pixels: number): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Combine `region` (a `Bounds` with top-left offsets into `source`) of
     * `source` in place at `(x, y)` (`Bitmap::composite_region`).
     */
    compositeRegion(source: Bitmap, region: Bounds, x?: WideInt, y?: WideInt, mode?: CompositeMode): void;
    /**
     * Combine a copy of `source` into this bitmap in place at `(x, y)`
     * (top-left offsets) with `mode` (default `"over"`) (`Bitmap::composite`).
     */
    composite(source: Bitmap, x?: WideInt, y?: WideInt, mode?: CompositeMode): void;
    /**
     * Concatenate copies of several bitmaps in one allocation
     * (`Bitmap::concat_all`). `options`: `direction` (default `"right"`),
     * `alignment` (default `"start"`), `gaps` (empty, or one per boundary;
     * numbers or bigints), `limits`.
     */
    static concatAll(bitmaps: Bitmap[], options?: { direction?: Direction; alignment?: Alignment; gaps?: WideInt[]; limits?: BitmapLimits }): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Concatenate with a copy of `other` (`Bitmap::concat`); the later
     * operand wins where both have ink. `options`: `direction` (default
     * `"right"`), `alignment` (default `"start"`), `gap` (number or bigint).
     */
    concat(other: Bitmap, options?: { direction?: Direction; alignment?: Alignment; gap?: WideInt }): Bitmap;
    /**
     * A blank `width` × `height` raster (`Bitmap::new`, or
     * `Bitmap::with_limits` when `limits` is given); `depth` is `"mono"`
     * (default) or `"gray8"`.
     */
    constructor(width: number | null | undefined, height: number | null | undefined, depth?: Depth, limits?: BitmapLimits);
    /**
     * An independent copy (limits included).
     */
    copy(): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Crop to a `Bounds` (`{width, height, x, y}`, bottom-left offsets)
     * (`Bitmap::crop_bounds`, also `GlyphBitmap::crop`).
     */
    cropBounds(bounds: Bounds): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Crop or zero-extend to `width`×`height` at bottom-left offset
     * `(x, y)` (`Bitmap::crop`).
     */
    crop(width: number, height: number, x?: WideInt, y?: WideInt): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Scale by integer factors (`Bitmap::enlarge`; `y` defaults to `x`).
     */
    enlarge(x: number, y?: number | null): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Whether `other` has the same depth, size and pixels (limits are not
     * compared).
     */
    equals(other: Bitmap): boolean;
    /**
     * Add blank margins (`Bitmap::extend`).
     */
    extend(left?: number | null, right?: number | null, top?: number | null, bottom?: number | null): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Mirror left/right (`Bitmap::flip_horizontal`).
     */
    flipHorizontal(): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Mirror top/bottom (`Bitmap::flip_vertical`).
     */
    flipVertical(): Bitmap;
    /**
     * From an exact-sized byte stream in `options.layout` (a `ByteLayout`:
     * `bit_order` `"msb"`/`"lsb"`, `byte_order` `"big"`/`"little"`,
     * `row_alignment`, `scan_unit`, `row_order` `"top-down"`/`"bottom-up"`;
     * default MSB-first byte rows, top-down) with `options.depth` and
     * `options.limits` (`Bitmap::from_bytes`).
     */
    static fromBytes(width: number, height: number, data: BytesLike, options?: { layout?: ByteLayout; depth?: Depth; limits?: BitmapLimits }): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Build from the plain-data form produced by `toDict()`.
     */
    static fromDict(data: GlyphBitmap): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Parse strict BDF-style byte-padded hex rows into a Mono bitmap
     * (`Bitmap::<Mono>::from_hex_rows`). `options`: `limits`.
     */
    static fromHexRows(width: number, rows: string[], options?: { limits?: BitmapLimits }): Bitmap;
    /**
     * From canonical storage: top-down rows, Mono rows packed MSB-first
     * and padded to whole bytes, Gray8 one byte per pixel
     * (`Bitmap::from_raw`). `options`: `depth`, `limits`.
     */
    static fromRaw(width: number, height: number, data: BytesLike, options?: { depth?: Depth; limits?: BitmapLimits }): Bitmap;
    /**
     * From rows of pixel values (arrays of numbers or `Uint8Array`s), top
     * row first; the inverse of `toRows`. `options`: `depth`, `limits`.
     */
    static fromRows(rows: ArrayLike<number>[], options?: { depth?: Depth; limits?: BitmapLimits }): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Parse text rows through `options.palette` (character → value, as an
     * object, a `Map` or `[char, value]` pairs); the Mono default accepts
     * `#`/`1` as ink and `.`/`0` as paper. Blank leading and trailing lines
     * are ignored (`Bitmap::from_text`). `options`: `palette`, `depth`,
     * `limits`.
     */
    static fromText(text: string, options?: { palette?: TextPalette; depth?: Depth; limits?: BitmapLimits }): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Pixel value at `(x, y)` (`Bitmap::get_pixel`).
     */
    getPixel(x: number, y: number): number;
    /**
     * One-pixel glow around pixels equal to `ink` (`Bitmap::glow`).
     */
    glow(diagonals: boolean, ink: number, value: number): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Whether any pixel is nonzero (`Bitmap::has_ink`).
     */
    hasInk(): boolean;
    /**
     * Binary inversion in place with ink value `ink` (`Bitmap::invert_with`).
     */
    invertWith(ink: number): void;
    /**
     * Binary inversion in place: zero becomes full ink, nonzero zero
     * (`Bitmap::invert`).
     */
    invert(): void;
    /**
     * Slant by `floor((row_from_bottom - base) / step)` (`Bitmap::italic`).
     */
    italic(step: WideInt, base?: WideInt): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Continuous-tone inversion `255 - v` in place
     * (`Bitmap::<Gray8>::negate`).
     */
    negate(): void;
    /**
     * `paste(source, 0, 0)` (`Bitmap::overlay`).
     */
    overlay(source: Bitmap): void;
    /**
     * `composite(source, x, y, "over")` (`Bitmap::paste`).
     */
    paste(source: Bitmap, x?: WideInt, y?: WideInt): void;
    /**
     * Row-wise non-overlapping pattern replacement; patterns are pixel
     * values (`BytesLike` or number arrays) (`Bitmap::replace_pattern`).
     */
    replacePattern(old: BytesLike | number[], _new: BytesLike | number[]): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Replace every pixel equal to `old` with `new`, in place
     * (`Bitmap::replace`).
     */
    replace(old: number, _new: number): void;
    /**
     * Rotate clockwise by a multiple of 90 degrees (`Bitmap::rotate`).
     */
    rotate(degrees: number): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Replace the limits after checking the current size against them
     * (`Bitmap::set_limits`).
     */
    setLimits(limits: BitmapLimits): void;
    /**
     * Set the pixel at `(x, y)`; the value must fit the depth
     * (`Bitmap::set_pixel`).
     */
    setPixel(x: number, y: number, value: number): void;
    /**
     * Displaced silhouette behind the ink (`Bitmap::shadow`).
     */
    shadow(dx: WideInt, dy: WideInt, value: number): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Move pixels right/up inside the same size, filling with 0
     * (`Bitmap::shift`).
     */
    shift(dx: WideInt, dy: WideInt): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Serialize in an explicit `ByteLayout` (default: MSB-first, byte rows,
     * top-down) (`Bitmap::to_bytes`).
     */
    toBytes(layout?: ByteLayout): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * The plain-data form (`{mono: {width, height, data}}` or `{gray8: …}`).
     */
    toDict(): GlyphBitmap;
    /**
     * Gray8 copy with explicit paper and ink values
     * (`Bitmap::<Mono>::to_gray8_palette`).
     */
    toGray8Palette(paper: number, ink: number): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Gray8 copy with paper 0 and ink 255 (`Bitmap::<Mono>::to_gray8`).
     */
    toGray8(): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Byte-padded uppercase hex rows (BDF storage)
     * (`Bitmap::<Mono>::to_hex_rows`).
     */
    toHexRows(): string[];
    /**
     * Every pixel value in row-major order (one byte per pixel).
     */
    toList(): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Mono copy: ink where the value is `>= threshold`
     * (`Bitmap::<Gray8>::to_mono`).
     */
    toMono(threshold: number): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Right-aligned lowercase hex rows (`Bitmap::<Mono>::to_numeric_hex_rows`).
     */
    toNumericHexRows(): string[];
    /**
     * One fixed-size byte string per pixel, from `palette` (value → bytes,
     * as an object, a `Map` or `[value, bytes]` pairs; bytes are
     * `BytesLike` or number arrays) (`Bitmap::to_palette_bytes`).
     */
    toPaletteBytes(palette: BytesPalette): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Rows as integers, leftmost pixel most significant; width ≤ 64
     * (`Bitmap::<Mono>::to_row_values`). Each value is a `number` up to
     * 2^53 − 1, else a `bigint`.
     */
    toRowValues(): WideInt[];
    /**
     * Rows of pixel values, top row first: one fresh `Uint8Array` per row.
     */
    toRows(): Uint8Array[];
    /**
     * Mono: rows of `.`/`#` (Rust `Display`); Gray8:
     * `Bitmap(width=…, height=…, depth='gray8')`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Text rows through `palette` (value → character, as an object, a `Map`
     * or `[value, char]` pairs; Mono default `.`/`#`) (`Bitmap::to_text`).
     */
    toText(palette?: OutputPalette): string;
    /**
     * Crop to the ink (`Bitmap::trim`).
     */
    trim(): Bitmap;
    /**
     * A blank raster under explicit limits (`Bitmap::with_limits`).
     */
    static withLimits(width: number, height: number, limits: BitmapLimits, depth?: Depth): Bitmap;
    /**
     * `"mono"` or `"gray8"`.
     */
    readonly depth: Depth;
    /**
     * Height in pixels.
     */
    readonly height: number;
    /**
     * The bitmap's resource limits (`Bitmap::limits`), inherited by every
     * derived bitmap.
     */
    readonly limits: BitmapLimits;
    /**
     * Largest pixel value: 1 for Mono, 255 for Gray8 (`PixelFormat::MAX`).
     */
    readonly maxValue: number;
    /**
     * Whether rows are bit-packed (`PixelFormat::PACKED`).
     */
    readonly packed: boolean;
    /**
     * Bytes per canonical row (`Bitmap::stride`).
     */
    readonly stride: number;
    /**
     * Width in pixels.
     */
    readonly width: number;
}

/**
 * Typed bitmap-projection options (`fontpixel::projection::BitmapProjection`
 * with owned property edits). The default changes nothing.
 *
 * - `scalable_advance`: `"preserve"` or
 *   `{from_device: {units_per_em, reference_ppem}}`
 * - `font_name`: complete `FONT`/XLFD name
 * - `size`: `{point_size: {numerator, denominator}, resolution: {x, y}}`
 * - `properties`: edits `{set: {name, value: integer | string}}` or
 *   `{remove: {name}}`, applied in order
 *
 * The limits are the static getters `MAX_PROPERTY_EDITS`,
 * `MAX_PROPERTY_NAME_BYTES`, `MAX_PROPERTY_TEXT_BYTES` and
 * `MAX_FONT_NAME_BYTES` (`fontpixel::projection::MAX_*`).
 */
export class BitmapProjection {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Apply to every strike of `fontSet` (`apply_bitmap_projection`); see
     * the function `applyBitmapProjection`.
     */
    apply(fontSet: FontSet, maxWorkingBytes?: number | null): ProjectionResult;
    /**
     * `new BitmapProjection({scalable_advance, font_name, size, properties})`
     * (every key optional).
     */
    constructor(options?: BitmapProjectionArgs);
    /**
     * Whether these options change nothing
     * (`BitmapProjection::is_identity`).
     */
    isIdentity(): boolean;
    /**
     * The edited property names in order (`PropertyEdit::name`).
     */
    propertyNames(): string[];
    /**
     * Options deriving scalable advances from device advances
     * (`BitmapProjection::scalable_from_device`).
     */
    static scalableFromDevice(unitsPerEm: number, referencePpem: number): BitmapProjection;
    /**
     * `BitmapProjection(scalableAdvance=…, fontName=…, size=…, properties=[…])`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * The projected font name.
     */
    readonly fontName: string | undefined;
    /**
     * `MAX_FONT_NAME_BYTES` (4096).
     */
    static readonly MAX_FONT_NAME_BYTES: number;
    /**
     * `MAX_PROPERTY_EDITS` (64).
     */
    static readonly MAX_PROPERTY_EDITS: number;
    /**
     * `MAX_PROPERTY_NAME_BYTES` (255).
     */
    static readonly MAX_PROPERTY_NAME_BYTES: number;
    /**
     * `MAX_PROPERTY_TEXT_BYTES` (65,535).
     */
    static readonly MAX_PROPERTY_TEXT_BYTES: number;
    /**
     * The property edits (plain data).
     */
    readonly properties: PropertyEditLike[];
    /**
     * The scalable-advance policy (plain data).
     */
    readonly scalableAdvance: ScalableAdvance;
    /**
     * The projected size (plain data), or `undefined`.
     */
    readonly size: SizeProjection | undefined;
}

/**
 * A parsed CFF1 table (`fontpixel::sfnt::cff::Cff`).
 *
 * Owns the table (or the containing `Sfnt`'s storage) and the limits; each
 * call re-parses.
 */
export class Cff {
    private constructor();
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * The `CFF ` table of an `OTTO` `Sfnt` handle (requires maxp 0.5 and
     * head; `Cff::from_sfnt`).
     */
    static fromSfnt(font: Sfnt, limits?: CffLimits): Cff;
    /**
     * Number of global subroutines.
     */
    globalSubrCount(): number;
    /**
     * The glyph name bytes of a name-keyed font, or `undefined`.
     */
    glyphName(gid: number): Uint8Array | undefined;
    /**
     * Evaluate one glyph: `{advance, commands}` (`DecodedGlyph`).
     */
    glyph(gid: number, limits?: CffLimits): DecodedGlyph;
    /**
     * The SID or CID of glyph `gid`, or `undefined`.
     */
    identifier(gid: number): number | undefined;
    /**
     * Whether this is a CID-keyed font.
     */
    isCid(): boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the font has no glyphs.
     */
    isEmpty(): boolean;
    /**
     * Number of glyphs (`Cff::len`).
     */
    len(): number;
    /**
     * Parse a raw `CFF ` table with the containing font's units per em
     * (`Cff::parse`).
     */
    static parse(data: BytesLike, unitsPerEm: number, limits?: CffLimits): Cff;
    /**
     * Evaluate every glyph under one whole-font budget.
     */
    readAll(limits?: CffLimits): DecodedGlyph[];
    /**
     * Subset to `glyphs` (old IDs in new order, `.notdef` first): CFF bytes.
     */
    subset(glyphs: number[], limits?: CffLimits): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * A copy of the CFF table bytes.
     */
    readonly data: Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Number of glyphs.
     */
    readonly length: number;
}

/**
 * An exact charset mapping (`fontpixel::charset::CharsetCodec`).
 */
export class CharsetCodec {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Glyph code for a one-character string, or `undefined`
     * (`CharsetCodec::char2cp`).
     */
    char2cp(value: string): number | undefined;
    /**
     * Resolve a user-facing charset name (`CharsetCodec::new`). `gl`
     * `undefined` selects GL for `iso2022cn` only. Unknown names give an
     * identity codec with `known === false`.
     */
    constructor(name: string, gl?: boolean | null);
    /**
     * Character for a glyph code, or `undefined` (`CharsetCodec::cp2char`).
     */
    cp2char(code: number): string | undefined;
    /**
     * Unicode value for a glyph code, or `undefined`
     * (`CharsetCodec::cp2unicode`).
     */
    cp2unicode(code: number): number | undefined;
    /**
     * The codec of `FontCharset` plain data (`FontCharset::codec`).
     */
    static forCharset(charset: FontCharset): CharsetCodec;
    /**
     * The codec of a font's charset (`FontCharset::codec`).
     */
    static forFont(font: Font): CharsetCodec;
    /**
     * Resolve a canonical key or cleaned alias without re-sanitizing it
     * (`CharsetCodec::from_key`).
     */
    static fromKey(key: string, gl?: boolean | null): CharsetCodec;
    /**
     * `CharsetCodec(name=…, known=…, gl=…)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Glyph code for a Unicode value, or `undefined`
     * (`CharsetCodec::unicode2cp`).
     */
    unicode2cp(value: number): number | undefined;
    /**
     * Whether 94×94 GL codes are used (`CharsetCodec::gl`).
     */
    readonly gl: boolean;
    /**
     * Allowed code lengths (`CharsetCodec::kind`).
     */
    readonly kind: CharsetKind;
    /**
     * Whether the name resolved to a known table (`CharsetCodec::known`).
     */
    readonly known: boolean;
    /**
     * Canonical key (`CharsetCodec::name`).
     */
    readonly name: string;
}

/**
 * A tagged character code (`fontpixel::model::Codepoint`): a Unicode
 * number or a legacy code in the font's own charset. Every function taking
 * a codepoint also accepts a number or one-character string (Unicode) and
 * the plain data `{Unicode: n}` / `{Legacy: n}`; results use the plain data.
 */
export class Codepoint {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * `-1`, `0` or `1`: the Rust order, in which every Unicode code precedes
     * every legacy code (use as an `Array.prototype.sort` comparator body).
     */
    compare(other: CodepointLike): number;
    /**
     * `new Codepoint(value, kind = "unicode")`; `kind` is `"unicode"` or
     * `"legacy"`.
     */
    constructor(value: number, kind?: "unicode" | "legacy");
    /**
     * Whether `other` (any `CodepointLike`) is the same codepoint (kind and
     * value); `false` for values that are not codepoints.
     */
    equals(other: unknown): boolean;
    /**
     * From the plain data (or any `CodepointLike`).
     */
    static fromDict(value: CodepointLike): Codepoint;
    /**
     * A legacy charset code (`Codepoint::Legacy`).
     */
    static legacy(value: number): Codepoint;
    /**
     * The character of a Unicode scalar value, or `undefined` for legacy
     * codes, surrogates and values above U+10FFFF (`Codepoint::scalar`).
     */
    scalar(): string | undefined;
    /**
     * Plain data: `{Unicode: n}` or `{Legacy: n}`.
     */
    toDict(): CodepointDict;
    /**
     * `Codepoint.unicode(0x0041)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * A Unicode codepoint (`Codepoint::Unicode`).
     */
    static unicode(value: number): Codepoint;
    /**
     * Whether this is a Unicode codepoint.
     */
    readonly isUnicode: boolean;
    /**
     * `"unicode"` or `"legacy"`.
     */
    readonly kind: "unicode" | "legacy";
    /**
     * The numeric value regardless of kind (`Codepoint::value`).
     */
    readonly value: number;
}

/**
 * A parsed TrueType/OpenType collection
 * (`fontpixel::sfnt::collection::Collection`).
 *
 * Owns a copy of the bytes and the limits; each call re-parses (every
 * face is checked).
 */
export class Collection {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Parse a `ttcf` collection (same as `Collection.parse(data, limits)`).
     */
    constructor(data: BytesLike, limits?: CollectionLimits);
    /**
     * Extract face `index` as a standalone sfnt: `{bytes, report}`
     * (`Collection::extract`; `limits` defaults to the parse limits).
     */
    extract(index: number, limits?: CollectionLimits): BytesWithReport;
    /**
     * Parse a `ttcf` collection, checking every face before exposing any
     * (`Collection::parse`).
     */
    static parse(data: BytesLike, limits?: CollectionLimits): Collection;
    /**
     * Check every face's table checksums and head adjustment.
     */
    validateChecksums(): void;
    /**
     * A copy of the collection bytes this handle owns.
     */
    readonly data: Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Faces as `{flavor, offset, tables}` with records as in `Sfnt.tables()`.
     */
    readonly faces: CollectionFace[];
    /**
     * The opaque version-2 DSIG block, or `undefined`.
     */
    readonly signature: Uint8Array | undefined;
    /**
     * TTC version (`0x00010000` or `0x00020000`).
     */
    readonly version: number;
}

/**
 * One strike (`fontpixel::model::Font`), owned or a view into a `FontSet`.
 */
export class Font {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Add a copy of `glyph` (a handle or plain data) after validating it;
     * returns its new ID (`Font::add_glyph`).
     */
    addGlyph(glyph: Glyph | GlyphDict): number;
    /**
     * The canonical charset name (`FontCharset::canonical_name`).
     */
    charsetCanonicalName(): string;
    /**
     * Storage a new owned copy would need, without copying
     * (`Font::cloned_usage`).
     */
    clonedUsage(maxBytes?: number | null): ModelUsage;
    /**
     * Effective mappings with `start <= codepoint <= end` (inclusive, in
     * codepoint order; empty when `start > end`) (`Font::codepoint_range`).
     */
    codepointRange(start: CodepointLike, end: CodepointLike): [CodepointDict, number][];
    /**
     * `[codepoint, id]` pairs of every effective mapping in codepoint order
     * (`Font::codepoints`; Unicode codes precede legacy codes).
     */
    codepoints(): [CodepointDict, number][];
    /**
     * A strike built from copies of `glyphs` (`Font::from_glyphs`; IDs are
     * assigned in order from 0). Without arguments: an empty strike.
     */
    constructor(glyphs?: (Glyph | GlyphDict)[]);
    /**
     * An independent owned deep copy (also of a view).
     */
    copy(): Font;
    /**
     * Render every effective mapping in `order` (`"ascending"` (default),
     * `"descending"`, `"file"`, `"reverse_file"`), optionally restricted to
     * inclusive `[start, end]` ranges (`Font::draw_all`).
     */
    drawAll(order?: RenderGlyphOrder, ranges?: [number, number][], options?: RenderOptions, missing_glyph?: Glyph | GlyphDict): Rendered;
    /**
     * Render explicit codes (`Font::draw_codepoints`): numbers or
     * one-character strings are Unicode, `{Legacy: n}` names legacy codes,
     * `null` stands for an unencodable character.
     */
    drawCodepoints(codes: (CodepointLike | string | null)[], options?: RenderOptions, missing_glyph?: Glyph | GlyphDict): Rendered;
    /**
     * Render Unicode `text` through the font's charset map (`Font::draw`).
     * Returns `Rendered`; throws `StrictLossError` (with `report`) in strict
     * mode and `ResourceLimitError` over budget. `missingGlyph` (a `Glyph`
     * or `GlyphDict`) replaces missing codes.
     */
    draw(text: string, options?: RenderOptions, missing_glyph?: Glyph | GlyphDict): Rendered;
    /**
     * Edit glyph `id` through `edit(glyph)`, which receives an owned copy
     * (no borrow is held while it runs). The edited copy replaces the glyph
     * when `edit` returns, validated by `Font::edit_glyph`; if `edit` throws,
     * nothing changes and the exception propagates unchanged.
     */
    editGlyph(id: number, edit: (glyph: Glyph) => unknown): void;
    /**
     * Whether `other` is a `Font` with equal contents.
     */
    equals(other: unknown): boolean;
    /**
     * Build from the plain-data form produced by `toDict()` (removed glyph
     * slots stay `null`, so IDs survive).
     */
    static fromDict(data: FontDict): Font;
    /**
     * The effective glyph of a codepoint as a view, or `undefined`
     * (`Font::glyph_for_codepoint`).
     */
    glyphForCodepoint(codepoint: CodepointLike): Glyph | undefined;
    /**
     * The effective glyph of a Unicode sequence (a string or an array of
     * numbers) as a view, or `undefined` (`Font::glyph_for_sequence`).
     */
    glyphForSequence(sequence: string | number[]): Glyph | undefined;
    /**
     * The effective glyph ID of a codepoint, or `undefined`
     * (`Font::glyph_id`).
     */
    glyphId(codepoint: CodepointLike): number | undefined;
    /**
     * Every glyph ID mapped to a codepoint, in file order; the last is
     * effective (`Font::glyph_ids_for_codepoint`).
     */
    glyphIdsForCodepoint(codepoint: CodepointLike): number[];
    /**
     * IDs of every live glyph in order.
     */
    glyphIds(): number[];
    /**
     * Glyph `id` cropped or extended to the font's cell bounds
     * (`Font::glyph_in_cell`).
     */
    glyphInCell(id: number): Bitmap;
    /**
     * A live view of glyph `id`, or `undefined` (`Font::glyph`).
     */
    glyph(id: number): Glyph | undefined;
    /**
     * `[id, glyph view]` pairs of every live glyph in ID order
     * (`Font::glyphs`).
     */
    glyphs(): [number, Glyph][];
    /**
     * Whether the font has no live glyphs (`Font::is_empty`).
     */
    isEmpty(): boolean;
    /**
     * Remove glyph `id`; returns it as an owned handle, or `undefined`.
     * Its ID is never reused (`Font::remove_glyph`).
     */
    removeGlyph(id: number): Glyph | undefined;
    /**
     * Replace glyph `id` with a copy of `glyph`, re-indexing its codes;
     * returns the old glyph as an owned handle (`Font::replace_glyph`).
     */
    replaceGlyph(id: number, glyph: Glyph | GlyphDict): Glyph;
    /**
     * Conservative retained storage of this strike (`Font::retained_usage`);
     * `ResourceLimitError` above `maxBytes` (inclusive budget, default
     * unbounded).
     */
    retainedUsage(maxBytes?: number | null): ModelUsage;
    /**
     * The complete plain-data form; copies every pixel.
     */
    toDict(): FontDict;
    /**
     * `Font(glyphs=2, family="Demo", view=true)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Set `metrics.bounds` to the union of all inked glyph boxes
     * (`Font::update_bounds`).
     */
    updateBounds(): void;
    /**
     * Validate glyphs, the default glyph and resource budgets
     * (`Font::validate`).
     */
    validate(limits?: ResourceLimits): void;
    /**
     * Charset identification (`FontCharset`) as a copy; assign to replace.
     */
    charset: FontCharset;
    /**
     * Format header records (a live `Properties` view); assignable.
     */
    get headers(): Properties;
    /**
     * Replace the header records with a copy of `value`.
     */
    set headers(value: Properties | PropertiesDict);
    /**
     * Whether this handle is a view into a `FontSet`.
     */
    readonly isView: boolean;
    /**
     * Number of live glyphs (`Font::len`).
     */
    readonly length: number;
    /**
     * A live view of `names.localized`.
     */
    readonly localizedNames: Properties;
    /**
     * Font-wide metrics (`FontMetrics`) as a copy; assign to replace.
     */
    metrics: FontMetrics;
    /**
     * Font names (`FontNames`) as a copy; assign to replace.
     */
    names: FontNames;
    /**
     * Font properties (a live `Properties` view); assignable.
     */
    get properties(): Properties;
    /**
     * Replace the font properties with a copy of `value`.
     */
    set properties(value: Properties | PropertiesDict);
    /**
     * The format ID this strike was read from, if any.
     */
    get sourceFormat(): string | undefined;
    /**
     * Set or clear (`null`/`undefined`) the source format ID.
     */
    set sourceFormat(value: string | null | undefined);
    /**
     * Number of assigned glyph IDs, including removed slots
     * (`Font::slot_count`).
     */
    readonly slotCount: number;
}

/**
 * A set of strikes (`fontpixel::model::FontSet`).
 */
export class FontSet {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Append a copy of `font` (a handle or plain data); returns its index.
     */
    append(font: Font | FontDict): number;
    /**
     * A set of strikes: copies of `fonts` (`Font` handles or plain data),
     * with optional `properties` and `sourceFormat`.
     */
    constructor(fonts?: (Font | FontDict)[], options?: FontSetArgs);
    /**
     * An independent deep copy.
     */
    copy(): FontSet;
    /**
     * Whether `other` is a `FontSet` with equal contents.
     */
    equals(other: unknown): boolean;
    /**
     * A live view of strike `index`; edits through it change this set.
     */
    font(index: number): Font;
    /**
     * Build from the plain-data form produced by `toDict()`.
     */
    static fromDict(data: FontSetDict): FontSet;
    /**
     * An owned copy of the only strike (`FontSet::into_single`; the set is
     * kept, since JS cannot consume the handle).
     */
    intoSingle(): Font;
    /**
     * Remove and return strike `index` (default: the last) as an owned
     * font. Views of later strikes now address the following font.
     */
    pop(index?: number | null): Font;
    /**
     * Conservative retained storage of the set (`FontSet::retained_usage`):
     * `{bytes, fonts, glyphs, glyph_slots}`; `ResourceLimitError` above
     * `maxBytes` (default unbounded). Sizes are those of this wasm32 build.
     */
    retainedUsage(maxBytes?: number | null): ModelUsage;
    /**
     * A view of the only strike; `InvalidInputError` unless there is exactly
     * one (`FontSet::single`).
     */
    single(): Font;
    /**
     * The complete plain-data form; copies every pixel.
     */
    toDict(): FontSetDict;
    /**
     * `FontSet(fonts=2, sourceFormat="bdf")`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Check glyph counts, pixel and byte budgets of every strike
     * (`FontSet::validate`); throws `ResourceLimitError`/`InvalidInputError`.
     */
    validate(limits?: ResourceLimits): void;
    /**
     * Live views of every strike, in order. Assigning an array of fonts
     * (handles or plain data) replaces them with copies.
     */
    get fonts(): Font[];
    /**
     * Replace every strike with copies of `fonts`.
     */
    set fonts(value: (Font | FontDict)[]);
    /**
     * Number of strikes.
     */
    readonly length: number;
    /**
     * Set-level properties (a live `Properties` view); assignable.
     */
    get properties(): Properties;
    /**
     * Replace the set-level properties with a copy of `value`.
     */
    set properties(value: Properties | PropertiesDict);
    /**
     * The format ID the set was read from, if any.
     */
    get sourceFormat(): string | undefined;
    /**
     * Set or clear (`null`/`undefined`) the source format ID.
     */
    set sourceFormat(value: string | null | undefined);
}

/**
 * One glyph (`fontpixel::model::Glyph`), owned or a view into a font.
 */
export class Glyph {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * The glyph cropped or extended to `cell` (a `Bounds` object), in cell
     * coordinates (`Glyph::bitmap_in_cell`).
     */
    bitmapInCell(cell: Bounds): Bitmap;
    /**
     * A glyph holding a copy of `bitmap` (a `Bitmap` or `GlyphBitmap` plain
     * data; default an empty raster) whose bounds match the bitmap at offset
     * (0, 0) (`Glyph::new`). `options.codepoints` lists `CodepointLike`
     * values; `options.name` sets the glyph name.
     */
    constructor(bitmap?: Bitmap | GlyphBitmap, options?: GlyphArgs);
    /**
     * An independent owned deep copy (also of a view).
     */
    copy(): Glyph;
    /**
     * Whether `other` is a `Glyph` with equal contents.
     */
    equals(other: unknown): boolean;
    /**
     * Build from the plain-data form produced by `toDict()`.
     */
    static fromDict(data: GlyphDict): Glyph;
    /**
     * Replace the bitmap and its bounds, placing its bottom-left corner at
     * `(x, y)` (numbers or bigints, default 0); with `trim`, crop to the ink
     * first (`Glyph::set_bitmap`).
     */
    setBitmap(bitmap: Bitmap | GlyphBitmap, x?: WideInt, y?: WideInt, trim?: boolean): void;
    /**
     * Move the glyph box by `(dx, dy)` (numbers or bigints) with overflow
     * checks (`Glyph::shift`).
     */
    shift(dx: WideInt, dy: WideInt): void;
    /**
     * The complete plain-data form; copies the pixels.
     */
    toDict(): GlyphDict;
    /**
     * `Glyph(id=3, codepoints=[Codepoint.unicode(0x0041)], name="A", size=5x8)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Check bounds/bitmap agreement and Unicode sequences
     * (`Glyph::validate`).
     */
    validate(): void;
    /**
     * A copy of the raster. Assigning a `Bitmap` (or plain data) replaces
     * the pixels and resizes `metrics.bounds`, keeping its offset.
     */
    get bitmap(): Bitmap;
    /**
     * Replace the raster with a copy of `bitmap` at the current offset
     * (`Glyph::set_bitmap(bitmap, bounds.x, bounds.y, false)`).
     */
    set bitmap(value: Bitmap | GlyphBitmap);
    /**
     * The mapped codepoints (`{Unicode: n}` / `{Legacy: n}` plain data);
     * assignable from `CodepointLike` values. Edits of a view re-index the
     * font.
     */
    get codepoints(): CodepointDict[];
    /**
     * Replace the mapped codepoints.
     */
    set codepoints(value: CodepointLike[]);
    /**
     * The glyph ID of a view, or `undefined` for an owned glyph.
     */
    readonly id: number | undefined;
    /**
     * Whether this handle is a view into a font.
     */
    readonly isView: boolean;
    /**
     * Glyph metrics (`GlyphMetrics`) as a copy; assign to replace (validated:
     * the bounds must match the bitmap; a failed assignment changes nothing).
     */
    metrics: GlyphMetrics;
    /**
     * The glyph name, if any.
     */
    get name(): string | undefined;
    /**
     * Set or clear (`null`/`undefined`) the glyph name.
     */
    set name(value: string | null | undefined);
    /**
     * Glyph properties (a live `Properties` view); assignable.
     */
    get properties(): Properties;
    /**
     * Replace the glyph properties with a copy of `value`.
     */
    set properties(value: Properties | PropertiesDict);
    /**
     * Unicode sequences (ligatures/clusters) mapped to this glyph.
     */
    unicodeSequences: number[][];
}

/**
 * The input of a JS detector or reader hook: the registry's `ReadContext`
 * of the running call (`fontpixel::resources::ReadContext`), valid only
 * while the hook runs.
 */
export class HookContext {
    private constructor();
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Primary bytes after transport decoding (`ReadContext::bytes`), a copy.
     */
    bytes(): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Immediate files of `directory` (`null` for the root) with shared
     * accounting (`ReadContext::list_resources_limited`).
     */
    listResourcesLimited(directory: string | null | undefined, max_entries: number, max_bytes: number): string[];
    /**
     * Resolve with an extra byte allowance (`ReadContext::resource_limited`).
     */
    resourceLimited(path: string, max_bytes: number): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Resolve a sidecar under the remaining budget (`ReadContext::resource`).
     */
    resource(path: string): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Bytes retained so far, including resolved resources
     * (`ReadContext::retained_input_bytes`).
     */
    retainedInputBytes(): number;
    /**
     * `HookContext(name=…, directory=…)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Whether the input is a directory entry point (`ReadContext::is_directory`).
     */
    readonly isDirectory: boolean;
    /**
     * The budgets in force (`ReadContext::limits`).
     */
    readonly limits: ResourceLimits;
    /**
     * The filename hint (`ReadContext::name`).
     */
    readonly name: string | undefined;
}

/**
 * Primary bytes, a filename hint and sidecar resources
 * (`fontpixel::resources::Input`). Immutable: `withName` and
 * `withResources` return new inputs.
 */
export class Input {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * A standalone input over a copy of `data` (`Input::new`), optionally
     * with a filename hint (`options.name`, `Input::with_name`) and sidecars
     * (`options.resources`, `Input::with_resources`).
     */
    constructor(data: BytesLike, options?: InputArgs);
    /**
     * A directory entry point without primary bytes; `resources` is rooted
     * at the directory (`Input::directory`).
     */
    static directory(name: string, resources: ResourcesLike): Input;
    /**
     * `Input(bytes=3, name="font.bdf", directory=false)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * A copy with a filename hint (`Input::with_name`).
     */
    withName(name: string): Input;
    /**
     * A copy with sidecar resources (`Input::with_resources`).
     */
    withResources(resources: ResourcesLike): Input;
    /**
     * A copy of the primary bytes.
     */
    readonly data: Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Whether this is a directory entry point.
     */
    readonly isDirectory: boolean;
    /**
     * Length of the primary bytes.
     */
    readonly length: number;
    /**
     * The filename hint.
     */
    readonly name: string | undefined;
}

/**
 * A decoded model with its read report and the format actually used
 * (`fontpixel::formats::Loaded`).
 */
export class Loaded {
    private constructor();
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * The sole strike (`Loaded::into_single`): `{fonts: Font, report,
     * format}` with a copy of the font. Throws `InvalidInputError` for
     * several strikes (or none).
     */
    intoSingle(): LoadedFont;
    /**
     * `Loaded(format=…, report_entries=…)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * The decoded `FontSet` (a handle sharing this result's storage).
     */
    readonly fonts: FontSet;
    /**
     * The format ID used to decode the input.
     */
    readonly format: string;
    /**
     * The read report (plain data, every entry).
     */
    readonly report: Report;
}

/**
 * The result of one operation (`fontpixel_ops::Completed` plus the
 * response). `json()`/`text()` reproduce the command line's standard
 * output; `document` is the parsed JSON document, `summary` the typed
 * response fields, `report` the diagnostics (or `null` for operations with
 * one report per output or input), `outputs` every prepared asset as
 * `{storage key: Uint8Array}`.
 */
export class OperationResult {
    private constructor();
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * The JSON metadata of one decoded font (`info` results only).
     */
    fontJson(index: number, pretty?: boolean | null): string;
    /**
     * The status record of one format identifier (`formats` results only),
     * or `undefined`.
     */
    formatStatus(id: string): FormatStatus | undefined;
    /**
     * The command-line JSON document (`--report json` / `--json` stdout):
     * pretty (the default) for standalone commands, compact as in batch
     * task results.
     */
    json(pretty?: boolean | null): string;
    /**
     * The command line's text-mode standard output.
     */
    text(): string;
    /**
