```typescript
     * Every prepared output as `{destination key: OutputBundleDict}` (the
     * primary asset and its sidecars or directory members, with paths
     * relative to the destination's parent).
     */
    readonly bundles: Record<string, OutputBundleDict>;
    /**
     * The requested destination of each prepared output, in order.
     */
    readonly destinations: string[];
    /**
     * The parsed JSON document, equal to `JSON.parse(this.json())` (with
     * integers beyond 2^53 − 1 as bigints).
     */
    readonly document: any;
    /**
     * Command-line exit status of the completed operation: 0, or 1 for a
     * diff that found differences.
     */
    readonly exitCode: number;
    /**
     * The decoded fonts of an `info` result (a `FontSet` sharing this
     * result's storage), else `undefined`.
     */
    readonly fonts: FontSet | undefined;
    /**
     * Operation name (`"convert"`, `"merge"`, …).
     */
    readonly operation: string;
    /**
     * Every prepared asset as `{storage key: Uint8Array}` (fresh copies).
     */
    readonly outputs: Record<string, Uint8Array>;
    /**
     * The operation's diagnostics, or `null` for operations with one
     * report per output or input (convert, merge, diff, formats).
     */
    readonly report: Report | null;
    /**
     * Typed response fields as plain data (per operation; see the module
     * documentation).
     */
    readonly summary: any;
}

/**
 * One in-memory output file (`fontpixel::resources::OutputAsset`).
 */
export class OutputAsset {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * `new OutputAsset(path, data)` (bytes copied; `path` validated).
     */
    constructor(path: string, data: BytesLike);
    /**
     * Whether `other` is an `OutputAsset` with the same path and bytes.
     */
    equals(other: unknown): boolean;
    /**
     * `OutputAsset(path="font.fnt", bytes=1)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * A copy of the bytes.
     */
    readonly data: Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Number of bytes.
     */
    readonly length: number;
    /**
     * The validated relative path.
     */
    readonly path: string;
}

/**
 * In-memory output files with a primary entry point
 * (`fontpixel::resources::OutputBundle`); immutable.
 */
export class OutputBundle {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * `new OutputBundle(primary, assets, {directory})`: `assets` holds
     * `OutputAsset`s or `[path, bytes]` pairs. A file bundle must contain
     * `primary` (`OutputBundle::new`); a directory bundle names its
     * directory and holds files beneath it (`OutputBundle::directory`).
     */
    constructor(primary: string, assets: (OutputAsset | OutputAssetLike | [string, BytesLike])[], options?: { directory?: boolean });
    /**
     * Whether `other` is an equal `OutputBundle`.
     */
    equals(other: unknown): boolean;
    /**
     * From the plain-data form (`{primary, assets: [{path, bytes}],
     * directory}`), validated like the constructors.
     */
    static fromDict(data: OutputBundleDict): OutputBundle;
    /**
     * The assets as an array (`OutputBundle::into_assets`; the bundle stays
     * usable).
     */
    intoAssets(): OutputAsset[];
    /**
     * The only file's bytes; `MultipleAssetsError` for several, and
     * `InvalidInputError` for a directory (`OutputBundle::into_single`).
     */
    intoSingle(): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Retained bytes of the bundle, checked against `maxBytes` (default
     * unbounded) (`OutputBundle::retained_bytes`; wasm32 sizes).
     */
    retainedBytes(maxBytes?: number | null): number;
    /**
     * A one-file bundle (`OutputBundle::single`).
     */
    static single(path: string, data: BytesLike): OutputBundle;
    /**
     * The plain-data form (`bytes` as number arrays).
     */
    toDict(): OutputBundleDict;
    /**
     * `OutputBundle(primary="font.fnt", assets=2, directory=false)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Copies of every asset, sorted by path (`OutputBundle::assets`).
     */
    readonly assets: OutputAsset[];
    /**
     * Whether the primary path names a directory
     * (`OutputBundle::is_directory`).
     */
    readonly isDirectory: boolean;
    /**
     * Number of assets.
     */
    readonly length: number;
    /**
     * The primary path (`OutputBundle::primary`).
     */
    readonly primary: string;
}

/**
 * An immutable plan ready for repeated exports
 * (`fontpixel::variants::PreparedVariants`).
 */
export class PreparedVariants {
    private constructor();
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * `PreparedVariants::encode_allowance`: bytes one `encode` may admit
     * besides the plan.
     */
    encodeAllowance(): number;
    /**
     * `PreparedVariants::encode`: export without replanning;
     * `options.limits` must equal the limits given to `prepare`.
     */
    encode(options?: ExportOptions): VariantsEncoded;
    /**
     * `PreparedVariants::plan`: the `Plan` plain data.
     */
    plan(): Plan;
    /**
     * `PreparedVariants::retained_bytes`: admitted bytes of the shared plan.
     */
    retainedBytes(): number;
}

/**
 * An ordered list of named properties (`fontpixel::model::Properties`).
 *
 * From `FontSet.properties`, `Font.properties`, `Font.headers`,
 * `Font.localizedNames` or `Glyph.properties` it is a live view: `set`,
 * `push` and `remove` edit the owning model in place. `new Properties(items)`
 * builds a standalone list; `copy()` detaches a view.
 *
 * Values (`PropertyValueLike`): `null` → `Flag`; a safe-integer number or a
 * bigint → `Integer` (`Unsigned` above the `i64` range); a string → `Text`;
 * bytes → `Bytes`; an array → `List`; any other object is the tagged plain
 * data (`{Decimal: "1.5"}`). Values are returned in the tagged form, which
 * keeps every variant (`"Flag"`, `{Integer: n}`, …).
 */
export class Properties {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * The record at `index` (negative counts from the end, as
     * `Array.prototype.at`), or `undefined`.
     */
    at(index: number): Property | undefined;
    /**
     * A standalone list from another `Properties` or `Property[]` plain data.
     */
    constructor(items?: Properties | PropertiesDict);
    /**
     * A standalone copy.
     */
    copy(): Properties;
    /**
     * Whether `other` (a `Properties` or `Property[]`) holds the same records.
     */
    equals(other: unknown): boolean;
    /**
     * Like `get`, comparing names ASCII-case-insensitively
     * (`Properties::get_case_insensitive`).
     */
    getCaseInsensitive(name: string): PropertyValue | undefined;
    /**
     * The value of the last property named exactly `name` (tagged form), or
     * `undefined` (`Properties::get`).
     */
    get(name: string): PropertyValue | undefined;
    /**
     * Whether the list is empty (`Properties::is_empty`).
     */
    isEmpty(): boolean;
    /**
     * Append a property, keeping duplicates (`Properties::push` with
     * `Property::new`); `raw` is the optional source spelling.
     */
    push(name: string, value: PropertyValueLike, raw?: BytesLike): void;
    /**
     * Remove every property whose name matches case-insensitively; returns
     * how many were removed (`Properties::remove`).
     */
    remove(name: string): number;
    /**
     * Replace the last property whose name matches case-insensitively
     * (keeping its spelling and position), or append (`Properties::set`).
     */
    set(name: string, value: PropertyValueLike): void;
    /**
     * The records as plain data (`Properties::iter` / `into_vec`; the list
     * stays usable).
     */
    toList(): Property[];
    /**
     * `Properties(["NAME", …])`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Number of records, including repeated names (`Properties::len`).
     */
    readonly length: number;
}

/**
 * Shared resource accounting for one input
 * (`fontpixel::resources::ReadContext`).
 *
 * Construction validates the primary input against `limits` and decodes a
 * gzip transport envelope. Each `resource*`/`listResourcesLimited` call
 * counts against `max_resources` and the aggregate byte budget exactly as
 * codecs see it (failed resolutions count too). See the module
 * documentation for how the context is kept without borrowing (replay of
 * recorded results; the resolver is called once per operation).
 */
export class ReadContext {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Primary bytes after transport decoding (`ReadContext::bytes`).
     */
    bytes(): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * `new ReadContext(input, limits?)`: `input` is an `Input` or bytes;
     * `limits` a `ResourceLimits` object (`ReadContext::new`).
     */
    constructor(input: Input | BytesLike, limits?: ResourceLimits);
    /**
     * List the immediate files of `directory` (`null`: the root) with
     * shared accounting (`ReadContext::list_resources_limited`).
     */
    listResourcesLimited(directory: string | null | undefined, maxEntries: number, maxBytes: number): string[];
    /**
     * Resolve with an extra byte allowance (`ReadContext::resource_limited`).
     */
    resourceLimited(path: string, maxBytes: number): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Resolve a sidecar under the remaining budget (`ReadContext::resource`).
     */
    resource(path: string): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Bytes retained so far, including resolved resources
     * (`ReadContext::retained_input_bytes`).
     */
    retainedInputBytes(): number;
    /**
     * `ReadContext(name="p.fnt", directory=false)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Whether the input is a directory entry point
     * (`ReadContext::is_directory`).
     */
    readonly isDirectory: boolean;
    /**
     * The budgets in force (`ReadContext::limits`).
     */
    readonly limits: ResourceLimits;
    /**
     * The filename hint (`ReadContext::name`).
     */
    readonly name: string | undefined;
}

/**
 * The format registry (`fontpixel::Registry<FontSet>`, alias `FontRegistry`).
 *
 * Methods borrow the registry for the whole call: a JS codec hook that
 * configures or registers on the same registry while it runs gets
 * `InvalidInputError` (nested reads and writes are fine).
 */
export class Registry {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * `new Registry()` is the built-in registry with every compiled codec
     * (`fontpixel::registry()`); `new Registry({builtin: false})` is the
     * planned catalogue without codecs (`Registry::new`).
     */
    constructor(options?: { builtin?: boolean });
    /**
     * Detect the format of an input: content detectors first, the filename
     * hint only when no detector matches. Returns `{format: FormatInfo,
     * confidence}`. A directory input (`directory`) throws: directory
     * inputs need an explicit format.
     */
    detect(data: BytesLike | Written | OutputBundle | undefined, options?: DetectArgs): Detected;
    /**
     * Throw `NotImplementedFormatError` unless `format` has a writer.
     */
    ensureWritable(format: string): void;
    /**
     * Formats whose extension is the longest matching suffix of `name`
     * (`FormatInfo` records; ties are all returned).
     */
    extensionCandidates(name: string): FormatInfo[];
    /**
     * The unique `FormatInfo` for a filename; throws
     * `UnrecognizedFormatError` or `AmbiguousFormatError` (with
     * `candidates`).
     */
    formatFromName(name: string): FormatInfo;
    /**
     * Every catalogue format with its capabilities, as `FormatStatus`
     * records (`{format: {id, name, extensions, feature_enabled}, detect,
     * read, write}`).
     */
    formats(): FormatStatus[];
    /**
     * Decode an input (`Registry::read`). `format` bypasses detection;
     * `limits` is a `ResourceLimits` object; `resources` supplies sidecars;
     * `directory: "name"` reads a directory entry point whose files come
     * from `resources` (an explicit format is then required).
     */
    read(data: BytesLike | Written | OutputBundle | undefined, options?: RegistryReadArgs): Loaded;
    /**
     * Register a format implemented in JS (`Registry::register` with a
     * `Registration`). `format` is a catalogue ID or `{id, name,
     * extensions}` for a new ID (lowercase ASCII letters, digits and
     * hyphens). Without hooks this is an honest planned entry
     * (`Registration::planned`). A live entry cannot be replaced: use
     * `new Registry({builtin: false})` to register a catalogue ID. The hook
     * objects stay referenced until this registry is freed.
     */
    register(format: string | { id: string; name?: string; extensions?: string[] }, hooks?: CodecHooks): void;
    setAmigaReadOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::amiga::AmigaReadOptions']): void;
    setAmigaWriteOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::amiga::AmigaWriteOptions']): void;
    setBbcReadOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::bbc::BbcReadOptions']): void;
    setBbcWriteOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::bbc::BbcWriteOptions']): void;
    setBeosReadOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::beos::BeosReadOptions']): void;
    setBeosWriteOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::beos::BeosWriteOptions']): void;
    setBmfontReadOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::bmfont::BmfontReadOptions']): void;
    setBmfontWriteOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::bmfont::BmfontWriteOptions']): void;
    setCReadOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::c::CReadOptions']): void;
    setCWriteOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::c::CWriteOptions']): void;
    setCatalystReadOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::catalyst::CatalystReadOptions']): void;
    setCatalystWriteOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::catalyst::CatalystWriteOptions']): void;
    setChiwriterReadOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::chiwriter::ChiwriterReadOptions']): void;
    setChiwriterWriteOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::chiwriter::ChiwriterWriteOptions']): void;
    /**
     * Install a codec from its plain form (`{read_options, write_options}`,
     * the format's `*Codec` struct); missing sides keep their configuration.
     */
    setCodec(format: string, codec: { read_options?: object; write_options?: object }): void;
    setColorWriteOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::embedded::ColorWriteOptions']): void;
    setComfontReadOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::comfont::ComfontReadOptions']): void;
    setComfontWriteOptions(options: SerdeTypes['formats::comfont::ComfontWriteOptions']): void;

    write(fonts: FontSet | Font, format: string, options?: RegistryWriteArgs): Written;

/**
 * Result of a render call (`fontpixel::render::Rendered`): the Mono
 * `bitmap` (top-left origin) and the `report` with every diagnostic.
 */
export class Rendered {
    private constructor();
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Plain data: `{bitmap: {width, height, data}, report: {...}}`.
     */
    toDict(): RenderedDict;
    /**
     * `Rendered(bitmap=WxH, report_entries=N)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * The rendered pixels: a fresh Mono `Bitmap` copy on every read.
     */
    readonly bitmap: Bitmap;
    /**
     * The complete report plain data (`{entries: [...]}`).
     */
    readonly report: Report;
}

/**
 * Named in-memory files offered to readers as sidecars (a
 * `ResourceResolver`). Paths are validated `ResourcePath`s (`/`-separated,
 * relative, no `.`/`..`). A set passed as `resources` is shared, not
 * copied.
 */
export class ResourceSet {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * A set holding copies of `files` (an object or `Map` of path → bytes).
     */
    constructor(files?: Record<string, BytesLike> | Map<string, BytesLike>);
    /**
     * A copy of one file, or `undefined`.
     */
    get(path: string): Uint8Array | undefined;
    /**
     * Whether `path` is present (`false` for invalid paths).
     */
    has(path: string): boolean;
    /**
     * Add or replace a file (bytes are copied).
     */
    insert(path: string, data: BytesLike): void;
    /**
     * Immediate files of `directory` (`null`/`undefined`: the root) in
     * sorted order (`ResourceResolver::list`), bounded by `maxEntries` and
     * `maxBytes` (default unbounded).
     */
    list(directory?: string | null, maxEntries?: number | null, maxBytes?: number | null): string[];
    /**
     * Every path in sorted order.
     */
    paths(): string[];
    /**
     * Remove a file; returns whether it existed.
     */
    remove(path: string): boolean;
    /**
     * Resolve like a reader would (`ResourceResolver::resolve`):
     * `MissingResourceError` when absent, `ResourceLimitError` above
     * `maxBytes` (default unbounded).
     */
    resolve(path: string, maxBytes?: number | null): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * `ResourceSet(["a.bin", …])`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Number of files.
     */
    readonly length: number;
}

/**
 * A parsed Unicode selection (`fontpixel::merge::Selection`): a union of
 * ranges with exclusions applied last, e.g. `"U+4E00-9FFF,-U+4E01"`, or
 * category names such as `"cjk"`.
 */
export class Selection {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * `Selection::parse`: parse a selection expression.
     */
    constructor(expression: string);
    /**
     * `Selection::contains`: whether `codepoint` is selected.
     */
    contains(codepoint: number): boolean;
    /**
     * `Selection::parse`: parse a selection expression.
     */
    static parse(expression: string): Selection;
    /**
     * `Selection::ranges`: normalized inclusive ranges `[{start, end}]`.
     */
    ranges(): CodepointRange[];
    /**
     * `Selection::scalar_count`: number of selected Unicode scalars.
     */
    scalarCount(): number;
    /**
     * `Selection("U+41-5A,-U+45")`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * `Selection::expression`: the original expression text.
     */
    readonly expression: string;
}

/**
 * A parsed standalone sfnt (`fontpixel::sfnt::Sfnt`).
 *
 * The handle owns a copy of the input bytes and the `SfntLimits` it was
 * validated with; every method re-parses the directory from them.
 */
export class Sfnt {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Parse a standalone sfnt (same as `Sfnt.parse(data, limits)`).
     */
    constructor(data: BytesLike, limits?: SfntLimits);
    /**
     * Parse a standalone sfnt directory, checking table bounds and limits
     * (`Sfnt::parse`). `limits` is an `SfntLimits` object (see
     * `sfnt.defaults()`); checksums are checked by `validateChecksums()`.
     */
    static parse(data: BytesLike, limits?: SfntLimits): Sfnt;
    /**
     * A copy of table `tag` (`"OS/2"` or four bytes), or `undefined`.
     */
    table(tag: TagLike): Uint8Array | undefined;
    /**
     * Directory records in tag order (`Sfnt::tables`).
     */
    tables(): SfntTableRecord[];
    /**
     * `Sfnt(true_type, tables=11, bytes=1234)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * Check every table checksum and the head checksum adjustment
     * (`InvalidInputError` on a mismatch).
     */
    validateChecksums(): void;
    /**
     * A copy of the font bytes this handle owns.
     */
    readonly data: Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Outline flavor: `"true_type"`, `"cff"` or `"apple_true_type"`.
     */
    readonly flavor: Flavor;
    /**
     * The limits used for parsing.
     */
    readonly limits: SfntLimits;
}

/**
 * Assembles a standalone sfnt (`fontpixel::sfnt::SfntBuilder`).
 */
export class SfntBuilder {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Build the font with sorted tables, checksums and head adjustment.
     */
    build(limits?: SfntLimits): Uint8Array;
    /**
     * Start an empty font of `flavor` (`"true_type"`, `"cff"`,
     * `"apple_true_type"`).
     */
    constructor(flavor: Flavor);
    /**
     * Add table `tag` with a copy of `table`; duplicate or malformed tags
     * throw `InvalidInputError`.
     */
    insert(tag: TagLike, table: BytesLike): void;
}

/**
 * One default face plus ordered language and script alternatives
 * (`fontpixel::variants::Variants`).
 */
export class Variants {
    free(): void;
    [Symbol.dispose](): void;
    /**
     * Append a language alternative with an explicit OpenType `language`
     * tag and `scripts` tags (the `languages` field).
     */
    addLanguageVariant(language: TagLike, scripts: TagLike[], font: FontLike): void;
    /**
     * `Variants::add_language`: add a BCP-47/OpenType language with the
     * default CJK script scope (DFLT, hani, kana, hang, bopo).
     */
    addLanguage(language: string, font: FontLike): void;
    /**
     * Append a script alternative for `scripts` tags (the `scripts` field).
     */
    addScript(scripts: TagLike[], font: FontLike): void;
    /**
     * `Variants::new`: start with a default face (`Font` handle or
     * `FontDict`).
     */
    constructor(base: FontLike);
    /**
     * An independent deep copy (a consumed handle cannot be copied).
     */
    copy(): Variants;
    /**
     * `Variants::encode_owned`: plan and export, consuming this handle's
     * model and dropping faces as soon as they are planned.
     */
    encodeOwned(options?: ExportOptions): VariantsEncoded;
    /**
     * `variants::encode`: plan and export (`{bytes, report}`).
     */
    encode(options?: ExportOptions): VariantsEncoded;
    /**
     * Build from `VariantsDict` plain data (`{base, languages, scripts}`).
     */
    static fromDict(value: VariantsDict): Variants;
    /**
     * `Variants::into_prepared`: as `prepare`, consuming this handle's model.
     */
    intoPrepared(limits?: LayoutLimits): PreparedVariants;
    /**
     * `Variants::plan`: glyph order, deduplication and locl routing as
     * `Plan` plain data (`{glyphs: [[name, glyph]], cmap, gsub}`).
     */
    plan(limits?: LayoutLimits): Plan;
    /**
     * `Variants::prepare`: validate and plan once for repeated exports.
     * Plans an owned copy of the model (Rust borrows it instead), so the
     * returned handle is independent of later edits to this one.
     */
    prepare(limits?: LayoutLimits): PreparedVariants;
    /**
     * `Variants::retained_usage`: retained bytes as an owning caller
     * charges them; throws `ResourceLimitError` above `maxBytes`.
     */
    retainedUsage(maxBytes: number): number;
    /**
     * The `VariantsDict` plain data (fonts as `FontDict`s).
     */
    toDict(): VariantsDict;
    /**
     * A copy of the default face as a `Font` handle.
     */
    get base(): Font;
    /**
     * Replace the default face (`Font` handle or `FontDict`, copied).
     */
    set base(value: FontLike);
    /**
     * Whether `encodeOwned()`/`intoPrepared()` consumed this handle.
     */
    readonly consumed: boolean;
    /**
     * Language alternatives as `[{language, scripts, font}]` (OpenType tag
     * strings, `Font` handle copies), in application order.
     */
    get languages(): VariantsLanguage[];
    /**
     * Replace the language alternatives with `[{language, scripts, font}]`
     * (tags as four-character strings or four bytes; fonts as handles or
     * plain data).
     */
    set languages(value: VariantsLanguageLike[]);
    /**
     * Script alternatives as `[{scripts, font}]`.
     */
    get scripts(): VariantsScript[];
    /**
     * Replace the script alternatives with `[{scripts, font}]`.
     */
    set scripts(value: VariantsScriptLike[]);

    toDict(): WrittenDict;
    /**
     * `Written(output=OutputBundle(…), entries=0)`.
     */
    toString(): string;
    /**
     * The output files (an `OutputBundle`).
     */
    readonly output: OutputBundle;
    /**
     * The report (plain data, every entry).

    readonly report: Report;
}

/**
 * The geometric ranges, in order (`merge_categories::GEOMETRIC_RANGES`).
 */
export function geometricRanges(): UnicodeRange[];

/**
 * Describe a font (`fontpixel info --json`): the parsed JSON document
 * `{format, font_count, fonts, report}`, equal to the command line's for
 * the same bytes and file name.
 *
 * `options`: `name` (the file name: storage key, detection hint and
 * diagnostic asset name; default `"font"`) plus any `InfoRequest` key
 * except `input`/`json` (`from`, `max_input_bytes`, codec options, …).
 * For the text output, the `FontSet` handle or per-font JSON use
 * `ops.info`.
 */
export function info(bytes: BytesLike, options?: InfoArgs): InfoDocument;

/**
 * Explicit CJK block policy (`merge_categories::is_cjk`).
 */
export function isCjk(cp: number): boolean;

/**
 * Box/block/braille/Powerline ranges (`merge_categories::is_geometric`).
 */
export function isGeometric(cp: number): boolean;

/**
 * Han ideograph blocks (`merge_categories::is_han`).
 */
export function isHan(cp: number): boolean;

/**
 * Whether a value is a Unicode scalar (`merge_categories::is_scalar`).
 */
export function isScalar(cp: number): boolean;

/**
 * Whether a canonical key denotes Unicode identity (`is_unicode_charset`).
 */
export function isUnicodeCharset(key: string): boolean;

/**
 * Scalar complement of CJK (`merge_categories::is_western`).
 */
export function isWestern(cp: number): boolean;

/**
 * One-based 94×94 row/cell to an EUC code, or `undefined` (`kuten_to_euc`).
 */
export function kutenToEuc(row: number, cell: number): number | undefined;

/**
 * Every catalogue format with its capabilities in this build
 * (`FormatStatus` records of the built-in registry).
 */
export function listFormats(): FormatStatus[];

/**
 * Merge selected glyphs from ordered parts (`fontpixel merge`) and return
 * `{files, report, json, text}`:
 *
 * - `files`: every output asset as `{name: Uint8Array}` (keys are the
 *   requested destinations, plus sidecars where a format has them);
 * - `report`: the parsed `--report json` document (family, glyphs, the
 *   merge report, per-output summaries and diagnostics);
 * - `json`/`text`: that document and the text report exactly as the
 *   command line prints them.
 *
 * `parts`: `[{bytes, take, dy, name, from, font_index}]` in priority order
 * (`take` is the selection expression, e.g. `"cjk"` or
 * `"western,geometric,-U+2190-21FF"`; `name` defaults to `part-<n>` and
 * acts as the file name on the command line). `options`: the command
 * line's merge options as plain data (`family` (required), `outputs` (file
 * names or `{destination, format}`), `spacing`, `geometric_width`,
 * `allow_misaligned`, `fallback`, `ascent`, `descent`, `strict`, `report`,
 * `shape`, resource limits and writer options), plus `progress`: a
 * function receiving `Progress` after each part is read, after the merge
 * and after each output is encoded; returning `false` cancels
 * (`CancelledError`), a throw cancels and is rethrown.
 */
export function merge(parts: MergePart[], options: MergeArgs): MergeFilesResult;

/**
 * Default `MergeOptions` (with an empty `family`, which `merge` rejects)
 * and `PartLicense` objects.
 */
declare function mergeLib__defaults(): Record<string, unknown>;

/**
 * `GeometricWidth::as_str`: the CLI/JSON spelling of a geometric width.
 */
declare function mergeLib__geometricWidthAsStr(value: GeometricWidth): string;

/**
 * `merge::merge`: merge `parts` in priority order under `options`
 * (`MergeOptions`; `family` is required). Returns `{font, report}`.
 */
declare function mergeLib__merge(parts: MergePartLike[], options: MergeOptions): MergeLibResult;

/**
 * `ModificationPermission::as_str`: the JSON spelling of a permission.
 */
declare function mergeLib__modificationAsStr(value: ModificationPermission): string;

/**
 * `MergeReport::to_json`: the deterministic JSON text of a report, exactly
 * as the CLI prints it.
 */
declare function mergeLib__reportToJson(report: MergeReport): string;

/**
 * `MergeSpacing::as_str`: the CLI/JSON spelling of a spacing value.
 */
declare function mergeLib__spacingAsStr(value: MergeSpacing): string;

export let mergeLib: {
    defaults: typeof mergeLib__defaults,
    geometricWidthAsStr: typeof mergeLib__geometricWidthAsStr,
    merge: typeof mergeLib__merge,
    modificationAsStr: typeof mergeLib__modificationAsStr,
    reportToJson: typeof mergeLib__reportToJson,
    spacingAsStr: typeof mergeLib__spacingAsStr,
};

/**
 * Whether a `NameOverrides` object requests no change
 * (`NameOverrides::is_empty`).
 */
export function nameOverridesIsEmpty(overrides: NameOverrides): boolean;

/**
 * Validate `value` as the Rust type `typeName` and return its serialized
 * form; `undefined`/`null` normalizes `{}`, giving the documented defaults
 * of option structs. Unknown keys, wrong types, unknown enum names and
 * out-of-range integers throw `InvalidInputError`.
 */
export function normalize(typeName: string, value?: unknown): unknown;

/**
 * Run typed tasks as one batch (`fontpixel batch` with typed tasks).
 *
 * Request keys: `tasks` (request objects, each with `id` and a `kind` of
 * `convert`, `vectorize`, `variants`, `subset`, `merge`, `charset`,
 * `validate` or `diff`), `jobs`, `max_working_bytes`, `max_pending_bytes`,
 * `max_report_bytes`, `max_task_report_bytes` and `protected_paths`. A task
 * whose request is invalid fails alone with exit code 2. Every successful
 * writer's outputs are returned. Without threads a batch runs one worker
 * inline; one whose admission computes more than one worker throws
 * `UnsupportedError` (capability `threads`). A whole-batch failure throws
 * with a `document` property.
 */
declare function ops__batch(request: BatchSpec, options?: OpsCallOptions): BatchResult;

/**
 * `fontpixel batch FILE`: reads a job file and writes outputs through the
 * filesystem, which WebAssembly does not have. Always throws
 * `UnsupportedError` (capability `filesystem`); read the job file and its
 * inputs yourself and call `ops.batchToml(text, {files})`.
 */
declare function ops__batchFile(_path: string, options?: { jobs?: number }): BatchResult;

/**
 * Run a version-1 TOML job text (the `fontpixel batch` file format) in
 * memory storage. Options: `files` (required), `base` (relative paths
 * resolve against it; default none) and `jobs` (overrides the file's
 * worker ceiling). Needs the `toml_batch` capability.
 */
declare function ops__batchToml(text: string, options?: BatchTomlOptions): BatchResult;

/**
 * The operations layer's platform answers: `{filesystem, threads,
 * toml_batch}` (booleans, `fontpixel_ops::capabilities()`); see the
 * top-level `capabilities()` for the records with reasons.
 */
declare function ops__capabilities(): OpsCapabilities;

/**
 * r" Remap glyph codes into another charset and write the result
 * r" (`fontpixel charset`).
 */
declare function ops__charset(request: CharsetRequest, options?: OpsCallOptions): OperationResult;

/**
 * Convert inputs into one output, or each input into its own output
 * (`fontpixel convert`). Request keys: `inputs`, `output`, `from`, `to`,
 * `each`, `strict`, `font_index`, `report` and every reader/writer option.
 *
 * `options.progress`, if given, is called with `{step, done, total, item,
 * glyphs, bytes}` after each input is read (`"read"`) and each output is
 * encoded (`"encode"`). Returning `false` cancels with `CancelledError`;
 * throwing cancels and rethrows; nothing is returned either way. Results
 * do not depend on it.
 */
declare function ops__convert(request: ConvertRequest, options?: OpsProgressOptions): OperationResult;

/**
 * The batch defaults (`fontpixel_ops::batch::DEFAULT_*`):
 * `{max_working_bytes, max_pending_bytes, max_report_bytes,
 * max_task_report_bytes}`.
 */
declare function ops__defaults(): BatchDefaults;

/**
 * r" Compare two inputs (`fontpixel diff`). Differences are reported in
 * r" the result (`summary.equal`, `exitCode` 1), not thrown.
 */
declare function ops__diff(request: DiffRequest, options?: OpsCallOptions): OperationResult;

/**
 * List every catalogue format with the reader/writer compiled into this
 * build (`fontpixel formats`). Request keys: `json`.
 */
declare function ops__formats(request?: FormatsRequest): OperationResult;

/**
 * r" Decode one input and describe its fonts (`fontpixel info`); the
 * r" result's `fonts` is the decoded `FontSet`.
 */
declare function ops__info(request: InfoRequest, options?: OpsCallOptions): OperationResult;

/**
 * Validate a request for `operation` and describe it: the normalized
 * `request` (every default filled in), `report_style`,
 * `source_identity_total_bytes` and, for batch task kinds,
 * `declared_inputs` and `weight`. Throws `InvalidInputError` (exit code 2)
 * exactly when the operation would reject the request before running.
 */
declare function ops__inspectRequest(operation: string, request?: object): RequestDescription;

/**
 * The memory-storage key of a path: `.` removed, `..` folded, `/`
 * separators.
 */
declare function ops__memoryKey(path: string): string;

/**
 * Merge selected glyphs from ordered parts and produce every output as one
 * group (`fontpixel merge`). Request keys: `parts` (`[{input, take, dy,
 * from, font_index}]`), `outputs` (`[{destination, format}]`), `family`
 * and the merge/writer options.
 *
 * `options.progress`, if given, is called after each part is read
 * (`"read"`), after the merge (`"merge"`) and after each output is encoded
 * (`"encode"`), before anything is returned. Returning `false` cancels
 * with `CancelledError`; throwing cancels and rethrows. Results do not
 * depend on it.
 */
declare function ops__merge(request: MergeRequest, options?: OpsProgressOptions): OperationResult;

/**
 * The output format `convert` infers for a destination path (OpenType
 * container extensions first, then the registry's filename hints); an
 * ambiguous or unknown extension throws like `convert` without `to`.
 */
declare function ops__outputFormatFor(destination: string): string;

/**
 * Parse a `fontpixel` command line (without the program name) with the
 * command-line definition and return `{command, request, report_style,
 * source_identity_total_bytes}`; `request` can be passed to the matching
 * `ops` function. A rejected command line throws `InvalidInputError` with
 * the parser's message and `exitCode` (0 for `--help`/`--version`). Needs
 * the `cli_parser` capability.
 */
declare function ops__parseArgs(argv: string[]): RequestDescription;

/**
 * Parse a TOML job text without running it: `{jobs, max_*_bytes, tasks}`
 * with each task's `id`, `kind`, `declared_inputs` and either `request`
 * (the normalized request) and `weight`, or `error` for a task that failed
 * preparation. Option `base` as in `batchToml`. Needs the `toml_batch`
 * capability.
 */
declare function ops__parseBatchToml(text: string, options?: { base?: string }): ParsedBatch;

/**
 * r" Lay out text (or every mapping) as character art (`fontpixel
 * r" preview`): `text()` is the art, `json()` the diagnostics document.
 */
declare function ops__preview(request: PreviewRequest, options?: OpsCallOptions): OperationResult;

/**
 * r" Lay out text (or every mapping with `all: true`) into a PNG or SVG
 * r" image (`fontpixel render`).
 */
declare function ops__render(request: RenderRequest, options?: OpsCallOptions): OperationResult;

/**
 * r" Subset an sfnt, WOFF or WOFF2 font (`fontpixel subset`). Needs the
 * r" `sfnt_operations` capability.
 */
declare function ops__subset(request: SubsetRequest, options?: OpsCallOptions): OperationResult;

/**
 * r" Validate one input (`fontpixel validate`).
 */
declare function ops__validate(request: ValidateRequest, options?: OpsCallOptions): OperationResult;

/**
 * r" Build a locl-enabled OpenType font from regional and script faces
 * r" (`fontpixel variants`). Needs the `sfnt_operations` capability.
 */
declare function ops__variants(request: VariantsRequest, options?: OpsCallOptions): OperationResult;

/**
 * Vectorize (`fontpixel vectorize`): the command line's alias of
 * `convert`; the same operation, documents and progress contract.
 */
declare function ops__vectorize(request: ConvertRequest, options?: OpsProgressOptions): OperationResult;

export let ops: {
    batch: typeof ops__batch,
    batchFile: typeof ops__batchFile,
    batchToml: typeof ops__batchToml,
    capabilities: typeof ops__capabilities,
    charset: typeof ops__charset,
    convert: typeof ops__convert,
    defaults: typeof ops__defaults,
    diff: typeof ops__diff,
    formats: typeof ops__formats,
    info: typeof ops__info,
    inspectRequest: typeof ops__inspectRequest,
    memoryKey: typeof ops__memoryKey,
    merge: typeof ops__merge,
    outputFormatFor: typeof ops__outputFormatFor,
    parseArgs: typeof ops__parseArgs,
    parseBatchToml: typeof ops__parseBatchToml,
    preview: typeof ops__preview,
    render: typeof ops__render,
    subset: typeof ops__subset,
    validate: typeof ops__validate,
    variants: typeof ops__variants,
    vectorize: typeof ops__vectorize,
};

/**
 * Every type name `normalize` accepts.
 */
export function optionTypes(): string[];

/**
 * Trace a Mono bitmap into closed contours (`outline::contours`).
 */
export function outlineContours(bitmap: Bitmap, options?: OutlineOptions | null, limits?: OutlineLimits | null): Contour[];

/**
 * The default `OutlineOptions` and `OutlineLimits`:
 * `{Options: {...}, Limits: {...}}`.
 */
export function outlineDefaults(): { Options: OutlineOptions; Limits: OutlineLimits };

/**
 * One independent square/dot inside the cell at `(0, 0)`
 * (`outline::pixel_contour`).
 */
export function outlinePixelContour(options?: OutlineOptions | null): Contour;

/**
 * Lower-left positions of ink cells, top-to-bottom, as `[x, y]`
 * (`outline::pixel_origins`).
 */
export function outlinePixelOrigins(bitmap: Bitmap, options?: OutlineOptions | null, limits?: OutlineLimits | null): [number, number][];

/**
 * Unhinted nonzero-winding pixel-centre fill of TrueType contours into a
 * `width`×`height` Mono bitmap (`outline::rasterize`); `origin` (`[x, y]`)
 * and the dimensions are in pixels, `unitsPerPixel` is positive.
 */
export function outlineRasterize(contours: Contour[], units_per_pixel: number, origin: [number, number], width: number, height: number, limits?: OutlineLimits | null): Bitmap;

/**
 * Segments of a contour (`{line: [a, b]}` / `{quad: [a, c, b]}`), with
 * implied on-curve midpoints resolved (`outline::segments`).
 */
export function outlineSegments(contour: Contour): Segment[];

/**
 * Parse `#RGB`, `#RGBA`, `#RRGGBB`, `#RRGGBBAA` or `transparent`
 * (`Rgba: FromStr`); throws `InvalidInputError` otherwise.
 */
export function parseRgba(text: string): Rgba;

/**
 * Strict direction parsing (`WritingDirection: FromStr`); throws
 * `InvalidInputError` for unknown spellings.
 */
export function parseWritingDirection(spec: string): WritingDirection;

/**
 * Nonzero-winding fill at exact pixel centres of `Edge`s into a Mono
 * bitmap (`outline::path::rasterize`); `origin` is `[x, y]`.
 */
export function pathRasterize(edges: Edge[], scale: number, origin: [number, number], width: number, height: number, limits?: OutlineLimits | null): Bitmap;

/**
 * Decode font bytes with the built-in registry (`fontpixel::read`).
 *
 * `format` selects the reader (otherwise content detection, then `name`
 * as a filename hint). `options` is the format's typed read options
 * (applied to the detected format when `format` is absent). `resources`
 * supplies sidecars (see `ResourcesLike`); `limits` is a `ResourceLimits`
 * object; `directory: "name"` reads a directory entry point through
 * `resources`. `data` may also be a `Written`/`OutputBundle`.
 */
export function read(data: BytesLike | Written | OutputBundle | undefined, options?: ReadArgs): Loaded;

/**
 * The built-in registry (`fontpixel::registry()`).
 */
export function registry(): Registry;

/**
 * Lay out `text` with a font (the native renderer, exactly as `fontpixel
 * preview`) and return the pixels for a page preview:
 * `{format, width, height, stride, scale, data, art, report}`.
 *
 * - `format: "mono"` (default): `data` is a `Uint8Array` of packed 1-bit
 *   rows (most significant bit first, each row padded to whole bytes,
 *   `stride` bytes per row), `width`×`height` source pixels.
 * - `format: "rgba"`: `data` is a `Uint8ClampedArray` of RGBA pixels
 *   (`stride` = 4 × width), each source pixel scaled to `scale`×`scale`
 *   (default 1) in `color` (default opaque black) on `background` (default
 *   opaque white), both `{red, green, blue, alpha}`; ready for `ImageData`.
 *   The scaled image is bounded by `max_pixels`.
 *
 * `art` is the `#`/`.` character art (`fontpixel preview` stdout without
 * its final newline) and `report` the read and render diagnostics.
 * `options`: `name` (file name, default `"font"`) plus every `preview`
 * layout key (`from`, `font_index`, `direction`, `line_limit`, `mode`,
 * `letter_spacing`, `line_spacing`, `missing`, `fail_missing`,
 * `gray_threshold`, `strict`, `all`, `range`, `order`, limits). With
 * `all: true`, pass `null` or `""` as `text`.
 */
export function render(fontBytes: BytesLike, text: string | null | undefined, options?: RenderArgs): RenderResult;

/**
 * A new report with every entry of `other` appended (`Report::extend`).
 */
export function reportExtend(report: Report, other: Report): Report;

/**
 * Whether a report has any error entry (`Report::has_errors`).
 */
export function reportHasErrors(report: Report): boolean;

/**
 * Whether a report has any loss entry (`Report::has_loss`).
 */
export function reportHasLoss(report: Report): boolean;

/**
 * A new report with `entry` appended, after validating both
 * (`Report::push`); the argument is not modified.
 */
export function reportPush(report: Report, entry: ReportEntry): Report;

/**
 * The report in the command line's text form, one line per entry
 * (`Report: Display`).
 */
export function reportToText(report: Report): string;

/**
 * Throw `UnsupportedError` (with `capability`, `reason`, `evidence`,
 * `alternative`) unless `name` is available; unknown names throw
 * `InvalidInputError`.
 */
export function requireCapability(name: string): void;

/**
 * Validate a portable relative asset path and return it
 * (`ResourcePath::new`): `/`-separated, relative, no empty, `.` or `..`
 * components, no backslashes, drive prefixes or control characters.
 */
export function resourcePath(path: string): string;

/**
 * An RGBA color (`Rgba::new`); `alpha` defaults to 255.
 */
export function rgba(red: number, green: number, blue: number, alpha?: number | null): Rgba;

/**
 * `Rgba::BLACK` (opaque black).
 */
export function rgbaBlack(): Rgba;

/**
 * `Rgba::TRANSPARENT` (all channels zero).
 */
export function rgbaTransparent(): Rgba;

/**
 * `Rgba::WHITE` (opaque white).
 */
export function rgbaWhite(): Rgba;

/**
 * Canonical key from XLFD registry/encoding (`sanitize_charset`); either
 * may be `undefined`/`null`.
 */
export function sanitizeCharset(registry?: string | null, encoding?: string | null): string;

/**
 * `bitmap::decode`: strikes from location (EBLC/bloc/CBLC) and data tables.
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__decode(location: BytesLike, data: BytesLike, kind: BitmapKind, numGlyphs: number, limits?: SfntBitmapLimits): Strike[];

/**
 * `color::decode_sbix`: an `Sbix` (PNG payloads converted to gray;
 * `darkness` uses darkness rather than luminance).
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__decodeSbix(data: BytesLike, numGlyphs: number, darkness: boolean | null | undefined, limits?: SfntBitmapLimits): Sbix;

/**
 * `bitmap::decode_scaling`: EBSC `Scale` records.
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__decodeScaling(data: BytesLike, limits?: SfntBitmapLimits): Scale[];

/**
 * `bitmap::decode_with_color`: as `decode`, converting color strikes to
 * gray (`darkness` uses darkness rather than luminance).
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__decodeWithColor(location: BytesLike, data: BytesLike, kind: BitmapKind, numGlyphs: number, darkness: boolean, limits?: SfntBitmapLimits): Strike[];

/**
 * `bitmap::encode`: `{data, location}` table bytes for `strikes`.
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__encode(strikes: Strike[], kind: BitmapKind, numGlyphs: number, limits?: SfntBitmapLimits): BytesFields<Tables, "data" | "location">;

/**
 * `color::encode_sbix`: sbix table bytes.
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__encodeSbix(sbix: Sbix, numGlyphs: number, limits?: SfntBitmapLimits): Uint8Array;

/**
 * `bitmap::encode_scaling`: EBSC bytes.
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__encodeScaling(scales: Scale[], limits?: SfntBitmapLimits): Uint8Array;

/**
 * `runs::encode_shared_metric_runs`: `{tables: {data, location},
 * shared_runs}`.
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__encodeSharedMetricRuns(strikes: Strike[], kind: BitmapKind, numGlyphs: number, minimumRun: number, limits?: SfntBitmapLimits): { tables: BytesFields<Tables, "data" | "location">; shared_runs: number };

/**
 * `bitmap::encode_spanning`: as `encode`, with index subtables spanning gaps.
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__encodeSpanning(strikes: Strike[], kind: BitmapKind, numGlyphs: number, limits?: SfntBitmapLimits): BytesFields<Tables, "data" | "location">;

/**
 * `Kind::tags`: `[dataTag, locationTag]`, e.g. `["EBDT", "EBLC"]`.
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__kindTags(kind: BitmapKind): [string, string];

/**
 * `LineMetrics::ascender`: the signed ascender of a `LineMetrics` value.
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__lineAscender(lineMetrics: LineMetrics): number;

/**
 * `LineMetrics::descender`: the signed descender of a `LineMetrics` value.
 */
declare function sfnt__bitmap__lineDescender(lineMetrics: LineMetrics): number;

/**
 * `cff::Font::encode`: encode a CFF `Font` (`CffFont` plain data); returns
 * `{data, bounds, maxp}` with `data`/`maxp` as `Uint8Array`s.
 */
declare function sfnt__cff__encode(font: CffFont, limits?: CffLimits): BytesFields<CffEncoded, "data" | "maxp">;

/**
 * `cff::Glyph::from_bitmap`: a CFF glyph (`SfntCffGlyph`) from a Mono
 * `Bitmap` handle or `GlyphBitmap` plain data; `options` is an outline `Options`
 * object.
 */
declare function sfnt__cff__glyphFromBitmap(name: string, advance: number, bitmap: Bitmap | GlyphBitmap, options?: OutlineOptions, limits?: CffLimits): SfntCffGlyph;

/**
 * `fontpixel::sfnt::checksum`: the wrapping sum of big-endian 32-bit
 * words (a short last word is zero padded).
 */
declare function sfnt__checksum(data: BytesLike): number;

/**
 * `cmap::decode`: the preferred Unicode subtable as `{codepoint: glyphId}`
 * (decimal-string keys).
 */
declare function sfnt__cmap__decode(data: BytesLike, numGlyphs: number, limits?: SfntLimits): Record<string, number>;

/**
 * `cmap::encode`: encode `{codepoint: glyphId}` (object or `Map`) with the
 * default record set. Returns `{data, has_bmp_subtable}`.
 */
declare function sfnt__cmap__encode(mapping: Record<string, number> | Map<number, number>, numGlyphs: number, limits?: SfntLimits): BytesFields<EncodedCmap, "data">;

/**
 * `cmap::encode_records`: as `encode`, optionally adding the Unicode full
 * record even for BMP-only mappings.
 */
declare function sfnt__cmap__encodeRecords(mapping: Record<string, number> | Map<number, number>, numGlyphs: number, unicodeFullForBmp: boolean, limits?: SfntLimits): BytesFields<EncodedCmap, "data">;

/**
 * `cmap::encode_with_records`: choose the full-repertoire records
 * (`"always"`, `"non-bmp"` or `"when-needed"`).
 */
declare function sfnt__cmap__encodeWithRecords(mapping: Record<string, number> | Map<number, number>, numGlyphs: number, records: FullRecords, limits?: SfntLimits): BytesFields<EncodedCmap, "data">;

/**
 * `collection::encode`: build a collection (`version` `0x10000` or
 * `0x20000`) from standalone fonts, sharing identical tables. Returns
 * `{bytes, report}`.
 */
declare function sfnt__collection__encode(fonts: BytesLike[], version: number, limits?: CollectionLimits): BytesWithReport;

/**
 * Default limit and option objects of `sfnt` and its namespaces, keyed by
 * Rust type path relative to `fontpixel::sfnt` (`"Limits"`,
 * `"collection.Limits"`, `"glyf.Limits"`, `"cff.Limits"`,
 * `"cff.DotOptions"`, `"bitmap.Limits"`, `"gsub.LayoutLimits"`,
 * `"subset.Options"`; `collection.Limits` only where collections are
 * built in).
 */
declare function sfnt__defaults(): Record<string, unknown>;

/**
 * `Flavor::version`: the four-byte sfnt version of a flavor.
 */
declare function sfnt__flavorVersion(flavor: Flavor): number;

/**
 * `GaspTable::decode`: a `GaspTable`.
 */
declare function sfnt__gasp__decode(data: BytesLike, limits?: SfntLimits): GaspTable;

/**
 * `GaspTable::encode`: gasp table bytes.
 */
declare function sfnt__gasp__encode(table: GaspTable, limits?: SfntLimits): Uint8Array;

/**
 * `Component::translated`: a component offset by `(x, y)`.
 */
declare function sfnt__glyf__componentTranslated(glyphId: number, x: number, y: number): Component;

/**
 * `GlyfTable::contours`: flattened contours of `glyphId` (composites
 * expanded).
 */
declare function sfnt__glyf__contours(table: GlyfTable, glyphId: number, limits?: GlyfLimits): GlyfContour[];

/**
 * `GlyfTable::decode`: a `GlyfTable` from glyf and loca bytes.
 */
declare function sfnt__glyf__decode(glyf: BytesLike, loca: BytesLike, numGlyphs: number, indexToLocFormat: number, limits?: GlyfLimits): GlyfTable;

/**
 * `GlyfTable::encode`: `{glyf, loca, index_to_loc_format, bounds,
 * statistics}` with `glyf`/`loca` as `Uint8Array`s; `format` is
 * `"short"`, `"long"` or `"auto"`.
 */
declare function sfnt__glyf__encode(table: GlyfTable, format: LocaFormat, limits?: GlyfLimits): BytesFields<GlyfEncoded, "glyf" | "loca">;

/**
 * `GlyfTable::from_sfnt`: the `GlyfTable` of an `Sfnt` handle.
 */
declare function sfnt__glyf__fromSfnt(font: Sfnt, limits?: GlyfLimits): GlyfTable;

/**
 * `Glyph::pixels`: a glyph tracing a Mono `Bitmap` handle or
 * `GlyphBitmap` plain data (Dot shapes reference `sharedGlyph`).
 */
declare function sfnt__glyf__glyphPixels(bitmap: Bitmap | GlyphBitmap, options?: OutlineOptions, sharedGlyph?: number, limits?: GlyfLimits): SfntGlyfGlyph;

/**
 * `Glyph::simple`: a simple glyph from `[[x, y, onCurve], …]` contours.
 */
declare function sfnt__glyf__glyphSimple(contours: GlyfContour[]): SfntGlyfGlyph;

/**
 * `Statistics::unhinted_maxp`: maxp 1.0 bytes from encode statistics.
 */
declare function sfnt__glyf__unhintedMaxp(statistics: Statistics, numGlyphs: number): Uint8Array;

/**
 * `Gsub::closure`: `glyphs` (array or `Set`) plus every glyph reachable by
 * substitution, as a sorted array.
 */
declare function sfnt__gsub__closure(gsub: Gsub, glyphs: Iterable<number>): number[];

/**
 * `Gsub::decode`: a `Gsub` (scripts keyed by tag strings).
 */
declare function sfnt__gsub__decode(data: BytesLike, numGlyphs: number, limits?: LayoutLimits): Gsub;

/**
 * `Gsub::encode`: GSUB table bytes.
 */
declare function sfnt__gsub__encode(gsub: Gsub, numGlyphs: number, limits?: LayoutLimits): Uint8Array;

/**
 * `Gsub::subset`: the `Gsub` remapped through `{oldId: newId}`.
 */
declare function sfnt__gsub__subset(gsub: Gsub, mapping: Record<string, number> | Map<number, number>): Gsub;

/**
 * `metrics::decode`: `{header, metrics}` from the header (hhea/vhea) and
 * metrics (hmtx/vmtx) tables.
 */
declare function sfnt__metrics__decode(axis: Axis, header: BytesLike, data: BytesLike, numGlyphs: number, limits?: SfntLimits): { header: MetricsHeader; metrics: LongMetric[] };

/**
 * `metrics::encode`: `{header, metrics, num_long_metrics}` with the two
 * tables as `Uint8Array`s.
 */
declare function sfnt__metrics__encode(axis: Axis, header: MetricsHeader, metrics: LongMetric[], compact: boolean, limits?: SfntLimits): BytesFields<EncodedMetrics, "header" | "metrics">;

/**
 * `metrics::Header::new`: a default header for `axis` (`"horizontal"` or
 * `"vertical"`).
 */
declare function sfnt__metrics__headerNew(axis: Axis): MetricsHeader;

/**
 * `Header::recompute`: a copy of `header` with extents recomputed from
 * `metrics` (`LongMetric[]`) and per-glyph ink extents (`null` = blank).
 */
declare function sfnt__metrics__headerRecompute(header: MetricsHeader, metrics: LongMetric[], inkExtents: (number | null)[]): MetricsHeader;

/**
 * `NameTable::decode`: a `NameTable` (`{records, language_tags}`).
 */
declare function sfnt__name__decode(data: BytesLike, limits?: SfntLimits): NameTable;

/**
 * `NameTable::encode`: canonical sorted name table bytes.
 */
declare function sfnt__name__encode(table: NameTable, limits?: SfntLimits): Uint8Array;

/**
 * `NameTable::encode_configured`: `validateConfigured`, then encode.
 */
declare function sfnt__name__encodeConfigured(table: NameTable, limits?: SfntLimits): Uint8Array;

/**
 * `name::language_tag_well_formed`: RFC 5646 well-formedness only.
 */
declare function sfnt__name__languageTagWellFormed(tag: string): boolean;

/**
 * `NameRecord::text`: the decoded text of a record, or `undefined` for
 * encodings without a text decoding.
 */
declare function sfnt__name__recordText(record: NameRecord): string | undefined;

/**
 * `NameRecord::unicode`: a Windows Unicode (3, 1) `NameRecord`.
 */
declare function sfnt__name__recordUnicode(nameId: number, languageId: number, value: string): NameRecord;

/**
 * `NameTable::retained_bytes`: retained logical storage of the table as
 * deserialized from `table` (spare capacity included), bounded by
 * `maximum` (`ResourceLimitError` above it).
 */
declare function sfnt__name__retainedBytes(table: NameTable, maximum: number): number;

/**
 * `NameTable::validate_configured`: check platform/encoding/language/ID
 * rules of a caller-supplied table; throws `InvalidInputError`.
 */
declare function sfnt__name__validateConfigured(table: NameTable, limits?: SfntLimits): void;

/**
 * `os2::average_width`: xAvgCharWidth of the given advances.
 */
declare function sfnt__os2__averageWidth(advances: number[]): number;

/**
 * `os2::check_code_page_ranges`: `undefined` when valid, else the reason.
 */
declare function sfnt__os2__checkCodePageRanges(ranges: [number, number]): string | undefined;

/**
 * `os2::check_embedding_flags`: `undefined` when valid, else the reason.
 */

/**
 * `os2::check_selection_flags`: `undefined` when valid for `version`, else

/**
 * `os2::code_page_ranges`: the two ulCodePageRange words for `codepoints`

/**
 * `Os2Table::decode`: an `Os2Table`.
 */
declare function sfnt__os2__decode(data: BytesLike, limits?: SfntLimits): Os2Table;

/**
 * `Os2Table::encode`: OS/2 table bytes of the table's version.
 */
declare function sfnt__os2__encode(table: Os2Table, limits?: SfntLimits): Uint8Array;

/**
 * `Os2Table::set_unicode_coverage`: a copy of `table` with Unicode ranges

declare function sfnt__os2__setUnicodeCoverage(table: Os2Table, codepoints: Iterable<number>): Os2Table;

/**
 * `os2::unicode_ranges`: the four ulUnicodeRange words.
 */
declare function sfnt__os2__unicodeRanges(codepoints: Iterable<number>): [number, number, number, number];

/**
 * `PostTable::decode`: a `PostTable`.
 */
declare function sfnt__post__decode(data: BytesLike, numGlyphs: number, limits?: SfntLimits): PostTable;

/**
 * `PostTable::encode`: post table bytes.
 */
declare function sfnt__post__encode(table: PostTable, numGlyphs: number, limits?: SfntLimits): Uint8Array;

/**
 * `subset::Options::text`: options selecting every scalar of `text`.
 */
declare function sfnt__subset__optionsText(text: string): SubsetOptions;

/**
 * `subset::subset`: subset a standalone sfnt. Returns `{bytes,
 * glyph_mapping, report}`; `glyph_mapping` maps old to new glyph IDs.
 */
declare function sfnt__subset__subset(data: BytesLike, options?: SubsetOptions): SubsetResult;

export let sfnt: {
    bitmap: {
        decode: typeof sfnt__bitmap__decode,
        decodeSbix: typeof sfnt__bitmap__decodeSbix,
        decodeScaling: typeof sfnt__bitmap__decodeScaling,
        decodeWithColor: typeof sfnt__bitmap__decodeWithColor,
        encode: typeof sfnt__bitmap__encode,
        encodeSbix: typeof sfnt__bitmap__encodeSbix,
        encodeScaling: typeof sfnt__bitmap__encodeScaling,
        encodeSharedMetricRuns: typeof sfnt__bitmap__encodeSharedMetricRuns,
        encodeSpanning: typeof sfnt__bitmap__encodeSpanning,
        kindTags: typeof sfnt__bitmap__kindTags,
        lineAscender: typeof sfnt__bitmap__lineAscender,
        lineDescender: typeof sfnt__bitmap__lineDescender,
    },
    cff: {
        encode: typeof sfnt__cff__encode,
        glyphFromBitmap: typeof sfnt__cff__glyphFromBitmap,
    },
    checksum: typeof sfnt__checksum,
    cmap: {

/**
 * The exact SPEC row adapter shared with the bdfparser compatibility layer
 * (`'0'` is paper, any other character ink) (`outline::spec_bitmap_contours`).
 */
export function specBitmapContours(rows: string[], shape: string, dotsize: number, ppu: WideInt, xoff: WideInt, yoff: WideInt): Contour[];

/**
 * Report Rust panics on the console before the instance traps. A panic is
 * a bug; the trapped instance must be discarded (re-initialize or restart
 * the Worker).
 */
export function start(): void;

/**
 * Encode a Mono bitmap as an indexed 1-bit PNG (`render::image::to_png`).
 * `options` is an `ImageOptions` object (`scale`, `foreground`,
 * `background`, `limits`).
 */
export function toPng(bitmap: Bitmap, options?: ImageOptions): Uint8Array;

/**
 * Export a Mono bitmap as a standalone SVG string (`render::image::to_svg`).
 */
export function toSvg(bitmap: Bitmap, options?: ImageOptions): string;

/**
 * The Unicode block `{start, end, name}`, or `undefined`
 * (`merge_categories::unicode_block`).
 */
export function unicodeBlock(cp: number): UnicodeRange | undefined;

/**
 * Every Unicode block, in order (`merge_categories::UNICODE_BLOCKS`).
 */
export function unicodeBlocks(): UnicodeRange[];

/**
 * The Unicode version of the category tables
 * (`merge_categories::UNICODE_VERSION`).
 */
export function unicodeVersion(): string;

/**
 * Default option objects of `variants` (`"Options"`, `"MetadataOptions"`,
 * `"NotdefPolicy"`, `"LayoutLimits"`).
 */
declare function variants__defaults(): Record<string, unknown>;

/**
 * `variants::encode`: plan and export a `Variants` handle.
 */
declare function variants__encode(variants: Variants, options?: ExportOptions): VariantsEncoded;

/**
 * `variants::encode_single`: export one face without alternatives. Unlike
 * regional planning (`Variants`), this keeps physical glyph identity and
 * order, so its bytes differ from `Variants.encodeOwned` by design.
 */
declare function variants__encodeSingle(font: FontLike, options?: ExportOptions): VariantsEncoded;

/**
 * `variants::encode_single_owned`: as `encodeSingle`, letting the export
 * own (and drop early) a copy of the face; output is identical.
 */
declare function variants__encodeSingleOwned(font: FontLike, options?: ExportOptions): VariantsEncoded;

/**
 * `variants::language_tag`: the OpenType language-system tag of a BCP-47
 * or OpenType tag via the OpenType language registry (`"zh-HK"` →
 * `"ZHH "`); unknown tags throw `InvalidInputError`.
 */
declare function variants__languageTag(value: string): string;

/**
 * `NotdefPolicy::empty_metrics`: `[advance, leftSideBearing]` of an empty
 * `.notdef` policy, or `null` for `"preserve"`.
 */
declare function variants__notdefEmptyMetrics(policy: NotdefPolicy): [number, number] | null;

/**
 * `variants::script_tag`: validate an explicit four-letter script tag
 * (e.g. `"latn"`); other lengths or characters throw `InvalidInputError`.
 */
declare function variants__scriptTag(value: string): string;

/**
 * `MetadataOptions::validate`: check metadata controls against an outline
 * `flavor` (`"true_type"`/`"cff"`) and `shape`.
 */
declare function variants__validateMetadata(metadata: MetadataOptions, flavor: OutlineFlavor, shape: Shape): void;

export let variants: {
    defaults: typeof variants__defaults,
    encode: typeof variants__encode,
    encodeSingle: typeof variants__encodeSingle,
    encodeSingleOwned: typeof variants__encodeSingleOwned,
    languageTag: typeof variants__languageTag,
    notdefEmptyMetrics: typeof variants__notdefEmptyMetrics,
    scriptTag: typeof variants__scriptTag,
    validateMetadata: typeof variants__validateMetadata,
};

/**
 * The fontpixel version this package was built from.
 */
export function version(): string;

/**
 * Resolve a Windows `dfCharSet` byte (`windows_charset`):
 * `{code_page: "cp1252"}`, `"system_ansi"`, `"system_oem"`,
 * `"system_mac"`, `"symbol"` or `{unknown: n}`.
 */
export function windowsCharset(value: number): WindowsCharset;

/**
 * Default limit and option objects of `woff` (`"Limits"`, `"Auxiliary"`,
 * `"woff1.Options"`, `"woff2.Options"`).
 */
declare function woff__defaults(): Record<string, unknown>;

/**
 * `woff1::decode`: reconstruct the standalone sfnt from WOFF1 bytes.
 */
declare function woff__woff1__decode(data: BytesLike, limits?: WoffLimits): WoffDecoded;

/**
 * `woff1::encode`: deterministic WOFF1 of a standalone sfnt.
 */
declare function woff__woff1__encode(data: BytesLike, options?: Woff1Options, limits?: WoffLimits): BytesWithReport;

/**
 * `woff2::brotli_encoder_heap_bound`: the admitted Brotli encoder heap
 * bound (proven for quality 0–9, an empirical envelope for 10–11), or
 * `undefined` on arithmetic overflow. WOFF2 always uses `lgwin = 22`.
 *
 * The bound is computed for this target, as the encoder admits it here:
 * `usize` is 32-bit in WebAssembly (`inputLen`/`threads` beyond 2^32 − 1
 * throw `InvalidInputError`), and the terms that count Rust allocation
 * sizes use wasm32's smaller pointers, so some values are below the 64-bit
 * native ones (the quality 10–11 envelope is the same).
 */
declare function woff__woff2__brotliEncoderHeapBound(quality: number, lgwin: number, inputLen: number, threads: number): number | undefined;

/**
 * `woff2::brotli_encoder_proven_heap_bound`: the source-derived upper
 * bound of all encoder heap for the same call shape (computed for this
 * target, see `brotliEncoderHeapBound`), or `undefined` on overflow.
 */
declare function woff__woff2__brotliEncoderProvenHeapBound(quality: number, lgwin: number, inputLen: number, threads: number): number | undefined;

/**
 * `woff2::decode`: reconstruct the sfnt (or `ttcf` collection) from WOFF2.
 */
declare function woff__woff2__decode(data: BytesLike, limits?: WoffLimits): WoffDecoded;

/**
 * `woff2::encode`: deterministic WOFF2 of an sfnt or `ttcf` collection.
 * The Brotli stream of larger inputs can differ from native output (see the
 * module documentation); it always decodes to the same font.
 */
declare function woff__woff2__encode(data: BytesLike, options?: Woff2Options, limits?: WoffLimits): BytesWithReport;

/**
 * `woff2::encode_many`: encode several fonts (bounded by
 * `max_batch_fonts`/`max_batch_bytes`); output order matches input order.
 * `jobs` (default 1) is the native worker count; here the jobs run in
 * input order with identical results.
 */
declare function woff__woff2__encodeMany(inputs: BytesLike[], options?: Woff2Options, limits?: WoffLimits, jobs?: number): BytesWithReport[];

export let woff: {
    defaults: typeof woff__defaults,
    woff1: {
        decode: typeof woff__woff1__decode,
        encode: typeof woff__woff1__encode,
    },
    woff2: {
        brotliEncoderHeapBound: typeof woff__woff2__brotliEncoderHeapBound,
        brotliEncoderProvenHeapBound: typeof woff__woff2__brotliEncoderProvenHeapBound,
        decode: typeof woff__woff2__decode,
        encode: typeof woff__woff2__encode,
        encodeMany: typeof woff__woff2__encodeMany,
    },
};

/**
 * Encode a `FontSet` (or one `Font`) with the built-in registry
 * (`fontpixel::write`, or `write_with_report` when `report` is given).
 *
 * `options` is the format's typed write options; `primaryName` defaults
 * to `font.<first extension>` (a `.gz` suffix selects the gzip envelope);
 * `strict: true` throws `StrictLossError` on any loss; `transportLimits`
 * is a `TransportLimits` object. Returns a `Written`.
 */
export function write(fonts: FontSet | Font, format: string, options?: WriteArgs): Written;

/**
 * Lenient SPEC direction parsing: invalid strings give `lrtb`
 * (`WritingDirection::from_spec`). Returns `{glyphs, lines}`.
 */
export function writingDirectionFromSpec(spec: string): WritingDirection;

/**
 * Instantiates the given `module`, which can either be bytes or
 * a precompiled `WebAssembly.Module`.

 */
export function initSync(module: { module: SyncInitInput } | SyncInitInput): InitOutput;

/**
 * If `module_or_path` is {RequestInfo} or {URL}, makes a request and
 * for everything else, calls `WebAssembly.instantiate` directly.
 *
 * @param {{ module_or_path: InitInput | Promise<InitInput> }} module_or_path - Passing `InitInput` directly is deprecated.
 *
 * @returns {Promise<InitOutput>}
 */
export default function __wbg_init (module_or_path?: { module_or_path: InitInput | Promise<InitInput> } | InitInput | Promise<InitInput>): Promise<InitOutput>;
```

```typescript
// Iteration protocol of the list-like classes (added by js/model.js).
import type { Font, Glyph, OutputAsset, Property } from "./fontpixel_wasm.js";

declare module "./fontpixel_wasm.js" {
  interface FontSet {
    /** Live views of every strike. */
    [Symbol.iterator](): IterableIterator<Font>;
  }
  interface Font {
    /** Live views of every glyph, in ID order. */
    [Symbol.iterator](): IterableIterator<Glyph>;
  }
  interface Properties {
    /** The property records (plain data). */
    [Symbol.iterator](): IterableIterator<Property>;
  }
  interface OutputBundle {
    /** Copies of every asset, sorted by path. */
    [Symbol.iterator](): IterableIterator<OutputAsset>;
  }
}
```

## errors.d.ts

```typescript
import type { Report } from "./fontpixel_wasm.js";

/** Rust `fontpixel::Error` variant names, plus `Unsupported` and `Other`. */
export type ErrorKind =
  | "UnknownFormat"
  | "FeatureDisabled"
  | "NotImplemented"
  | "AmbiguousFormat"
  | "UnrecognizedFormat"
  | "InvalidInput"
  | "BdfParse"
  | "ResourceLimit"
  | "MissingResource"
  | "MultipleAssets"
  | "StrictLoss"
  | "ReportedErrors"
  | "Io"
  | "Unsupported"
  | "Cancelled"
  | "Other";

/** Base class of every error fontpixel throws on purpose. */
export class FontpixelError extends Error {
  /** Rust variant name. */
  kind: ErrorKind;
  /** CLI exit convention: 3 strict loss, 2 unusable request, else 1. */
  exitCode: number;
  /** Full diagnostics of strict-loss and reported-error failures. */
  report?: Report;
}
/** Unknown format identifier. */
export class UnknownFormatError extends FontpixelError {
  format: string;
}
/** Format compiled out of this build. */
export class FeatureDisabledError extends FontpixelError {
  format: string;
}
/** Capability not implemented for a format. */
export class NotImplementedFormatError extends FontpixelError {
  format: string;
  /** `"Read"` or `"Write"`. */
  operation: string;
}
/** Several formats match; pass an explicit format. */
export class AmbiguousFormatError extends FontpixelError {
  candidates: string[];
}
/** No detector recognized the input. */
export class UnrecognizedFormatError extends FontpixelError {}
/** Invalid options, plain data, handles, paths or data. */
export class InvalidInputError extends FontpixelError {}
/** Fatal BDF syntax error. */
export class BdfParseError extends FontpixelError {
  /** One-based source line. */
  line: number;
}
/** A resource limit was exceeded. */
export class ResourceLimitError extends FontpixelError {
  resource: string;
  limit: number;
}
/** A referenced sidecar was not supplied. */
export class MissingResourceError extends FontpixelError {
  path: string;
}
/** Several output assets where one was expected. */
export class MultipleAssetsError extends FontpixelError {
  count: number;
}
/** Strict mode rejected an information loss. */
export class StrictLossError extends FontpixelError {
  report: Report;
}
/** A codec reported error diagnostics. */
export class ReportedErrorsError extends FontpixelError {
  report: Report;
}
/** Caller resource or host I/O error. */
export class FontpixelIoError extends FontpixelError {
  /** Rust `std::io::ErrorKind` name. */
  ioKind: string;
}
/** Capability unavailable on this platform or build; see `capabilities()`. */
export class UnsupportedError extends FontpixelError {
  /** Capability name (absent for an `Io` error of kind `Unsupported`). */
  capability?: string;
  reason?: string;
  evidence?: string;
  alternative?: string;
  ioKind?: string;
}
/** A progress callback cancelled the operation (strict `false`, or it threw); nothing was written or returned. */
export class CancelledError extends FontpixelError {}
```

## resources.d.ts

```typescript
import type { BytesLike, ResolverObject } from "./fontpixel_wasm.js";

/** Options of {@link withAsyncResources}. */
export interface AsyncResourceOptions {
  /** Files known up front. */
  files?: Map<string, BytesLike> | Record<string, BytesLike>;
  /** Async directory listing (`null` = the root); enables enumeration. */
  list?: (directory: string | null) => Promise<Iterable<string>> | Iterable<string>;
  /** Maximum number of runs (default 1024). */
  maxRounds?: number;
}

/**
 * Run the synchronous, deterministic `run(resources)` until it asks for no
 * unknown file, awaiting `resolve(path)` for every name a run asked for.
 * Pass the given `resources` object as the `resources` argument of the
 * fontpixel call inside `run`.
 */
export function withAsyncResources<T>(
  run: (resources: ResolverObject) => T,
  resolve: (path: string) => Promise<BytesLike | null | undefined> | BytesLike | null | undefined,
  options?: AsyncResourceOptions,
): Promise<T>;
```

## ops-client.d.ts

```typescript
import type {
  BytesLike,
  InfoArgs,
  InfoDocument,
  MergeArgs,
  MergePart,
  MergeFilesResult,
  Progress,
  RenderArgs,
  RenderResult,
} from "./fontpixel_wasm.js";

/** Per-call options of a worker call. */
export interface WorkerCallOptions {
  /** Aborting cancels the call (`CancelledError`); see `FontpixelWorker.cancellation`. */
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

/** Per-call options of a worker merge. */
export interface WorkerMergeOptions extends WorkerCallOptions {
  /** Receives every `Progress` record of the merge (read, merge, encode steps). */
  onProgress?: (progress: Progress) => void;
}

/** Options of {@link createWorker}. */
export interface CreateWorkerOptions {
  /** Compiled module to instantiate (default: the package's `.wasm`, compiled once and cached). */
  module?: WebAssembly.Module;
  /** Override the worker script URL (default: `ops-worker.js` next to this module). */
  workerUrl?: URL | string;
  /**
   * `"auto"` (default): cooperative where `SharedArrayBuffer` is usable (Node,
   * cross-origin isolated pages), else terminate. `"cooperative"` throws
   * `UnsupportedError` without shared memory.
   */
  cancellation?: "auto" | "cooperative" | "terminate";
}

/** A worker running the W8.3 calls off the main thread. */
export declare class FontpixelWorker {
  private constructor();
  /** How an abort is carried out. */
  readonly cancellation: "cooperative" | "terminate";
  /** Calls sent and not yet settled. */
  readonly pending: number;
  /** `merge(parts, options)` in the worker (`options.progress` is not allowed: use `onProgress`). */
  merge(parts: MergePart[], options: Omit<MergeArgs, "progress">, call?: WorkerMergeOptions): Promise<MergeFilesResult>;
  /** `info(bytes, options)` in the worker. */
  info(bytes: BytesLike, options?: InfoArgs, call?: WorkerCallOptions): Promise<InfoDocument>;
  /** `render(fontBytes, text, options)` in the worker. */
  render(
    fontBytes: BytesLike,
    text: string | null | undefined,
    options?: RenderArgs,
    call?: WorkerCallOptions,
  ): Promise<RenderResult>;
  /** Hard stop: terminate the worker; pending calls reject with `CancelledError`. */
  terminate(): void;
}

/** Compile the WebAssembly module once (cached when `source` is omitted). */
export declare function compileModule(
  source?: WebAssembly.Module | BytesLike | URL | string | Response,
): Promise<WebAssembly.Module>;

/** Start a worker (browser module worker or Node `worker_threads`) and wait until it is ready. */
export declare function createWorker(options?: CreateWorkerOptions): Promise<FontpixelWorker>;

/** Run one merge in a worker (a new one unless `worker` is given, terminated afterwards). */
export declare function mergeInWorker(
  parts: MergePart[],
  options: Omit<MergeArgs, "progress">,
  call?: WorkerMergeOptions & { worker?: FontpixelWorker; module?: WebAssembly.Module },
): Promise<MergeFilesResult>;
```

## Native mapping and explicit exceptions

Each rule below is checked against the Rust public inventory by `tools/bindings/gate.sh python,js`. A mapping does not imply that a disabled feature works in every profile.

### bitmap

| Rust pattern | Status | JS entry / reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fontpixel::bitmap` | bound | fontpixel (Bitmap, defaultBitmapLimits, defaultByteLayout) |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap` | bound | Bitmap |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::new` | adapted | new Bitmap(width, height, depth, limits); Python constructor; depth selects Mono or Gray8 |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::as_bytes` | bound | Bitmap.asBytes |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::stride` | bound | Bitmap.stride |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::width` | bound | Bitmap.width |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::height` | bound | Bitmap.height |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::from_raw` | bound | Bitmap.fromRaw |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::with_limits` | bound | Bitmap.withLimits |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::get_pixel` | bound | Bitmap.getPixel |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::set_pixel` | bound | Bitmap.setPixel |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::limits` | bound | Bitmap.limits |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::set_limits` | bound | Bitmap.setLimits |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::bbox` | bound | Bitmap.bbox |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::bold` | bound | Bitmap.bold |

| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::italic` | bound | Bitmap.italic |

| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::replace_pattern` | bound | Bitmap.replacePattern |
| `fontpixel::bitmap::Bitmap::rotate` | bound | Bitmap.rotate |

| `fontpixel::resources::Written` | bound | Written |

| Rust pattern | Status | JS entry / reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fontpixel::read` | bound | read(data, {format, options, name, resources, limits, directory}) |
| `fontpixel::write` | bound | write(fonts, format, {options, report, primaryName, strict, transportLimits}) |
| `fontpixel::registry` | bound | registry |
| `fontpixel::FontRegistry` | adapted | Registry; type alias of Registry<FontSet>; the Python Registry class is that specialization |
| `fontpixel::formats` | bound | formats |
| `fontpixel::formats::Confidence` | adapted | detection result strings ('no_match', 'extension', 'possible', 'certain'); plain data through serde (snake_case strings) |
| `fontpixel::formats::Detected` | adapted | plain object {'format', 'confidence'} returned by detect / Registry.detect; Serialize-only result returned as a dict |
| `fontpixel::formats::FormatInfo` | adapted | plain object {'id', 'name', 'extensions', 'feature_enabled'}; Serialize-only catalogue record returned as a dict; input is the id string or a dict for Registry.register |
| `fontpixel::formats::FormatStatus` | adapted | plain object returned by Registry.formats/status, listFormats; Serialize-only status returned as a dict |
| `fontpixel::formats::FormatDetector` | adapted | Registry.register(format, {detector}); trait implemented by Python hooks registered on a Registry |
| `fontpixel::formats::FormatDetector::detect` | adapted | detector(ctx: HookContext) -> confidence; Python hook called with a ReadContext |
| `fontpixel::formats::FormatReader` | adapted | Registry.register(format, {reader}); trait implemented by Python hooks registered on a Registry |
| `fontpixel::formats::FormatReader::read` | adapted | reader(ctx: HookContext, options) -> [fonts, report]; Python hook called with a ReadContext and the ReadOptions dict |
| `fontpixel::formats::FormatWriter` | adapted | Registry.register(format, {writer: function or object}); trait implemented by Python hooks registered on a Registry |
| `fontpixel::formats::FormatWriter::write` | adapted | writer(fonts, options) / writer.write(fonts, options); Python hook returning Written, OutputBundle or (OutputBundle, report) |
| `fontpixel::formats::FormatWriter::transport_limits` | adapted | writer.transportLimits() -> TransportLimits; optional method of a Python writer object |
